A benchmark using CDISC CDISCPilot01 data achieved 100% parity across 5 reports. LLM experiments confirmed the IR enables automated pharmacovigilance, table summarization, and trial configuration generation. The framework offers a regulation-aware path to AI-integrated clinical reporting, accelerating drug development without interrupting regulatory submissions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种非破坏性框架，通过添加元数据层（桥接映射、类型化IR、编排器）将遗留临床报告系统转化为AI就绪状态。在558组件SAS库验证，该框架支持共存模式（立即可用）和增量整合模式（92%代码减少）。14份III期报告等效验证中11份达到80%以上，CDISC基准100%通过，证明该框架可实现监管兼容的AI集成临床报告现代化。
AI.motivation: 药物开发和药物警戒常受制于遗留临床报告管道。这些单体系统虽编码了监管级逻辑，但产生的输出不透明、缺乏机器可读中间层，导致AI集成困难。现有现代化方法迫使组织在完全重写（风险高、周期长）和增量重构（仍保留结构障碍）之间做出选择。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种非破坏性的方法论框架，通过添加元数据层（包含桥接映射、类型化中间表示IR和编排器）来实现AI驱动的药物信息学就绪状态，而不改变legacy源代码。该元数据层将现有组件包装起来，将其输出重新暴露为LLM可消费的结构化数据。框架支持可选的增量整合，用元数据配置的核心程序替换选定的legacy组件，其余部分保持不变。在558组件的SAS报告库（373,000行代码）上进行了验证。
AI.result: 共存模式下实现了即时AI就绪，产生机器可读输出。在选择整合的场景中，现代化核心实现了92%的专有代码减少。14种III期研究报告的等效验证显示，11份报告达到80%以上单元格级等效（均值82.7%，最佳99.2%）。使用CDISC CDISCPilot01数据的基准测试在5份报告中达到100%等效。LLM实验确认IR支持自动化药物警戒、表格摘要和试验配置生成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为临床报告系统提供了一条监管兼容的AI集成路径，可在不中断监管提交的情况下加速药物开发。实验表明，该方法在保持与legacy系统共存的同时，能够显著减少专有代码量并实现高精度报告生成。

title: Fast Gossip-based Rumor Spreading using Small Messages
comment: Accepted at PODC 2026; 28 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure
summary:
We study gossip algorithms for the fundamental rumor spreading problem, where the goal is to disseminate a rumor from a given source node to all nodes in an arbitrary (and unknown) graph. Gossip algorithms allow each node to call only one neighbor per round and are therefore highly message-efficient, with low per-node communication overhead per round. The state of the art present fast gossip algorithms, however they typically leverage large-sized messages. This undermines the light-weight communication advantage of gossip, since even though only one neighbor is contacted per round, the message size can be linear in $n$, the network size. Hence, a fundamental question is whether one can perform fast gossip using small messages.
  The main contribution of this paper is to answer the above question in the affirmative and present two gossip algorithms that achieve fast rumor spreading using messages of polylog{n} size. Specifically, we present the following algorithms:
  1. An algorithm that runs in $O(c \log n / Φ_c)$ rounds for every $c \geq 1$, and $Φ_c$ is the weak conductance. Our bound in terms of weak conductance is essentially optimal.
  2. An algorithm that depends on the network diameter (and is independent of the graph's conductance), which runs in $\tilde{O}(D+\sqrt{n})$ rounds with high probability. Our algorithm can be modified to output a minimum spanning tree (MST) in the same number of rounds, which is essentially round-optimal (even for non-gossip algorithms).
  Our gossip algorithms use graph sketches [Ahn, Guha, McGregor, SODA 2012] in a novel way to overcome communication bottlenecks and achieve small communication overhead with small message sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文给出首个"小消息"的快速 gossip 谣言扩散方案：在 GOSSIP-CONGEST 模型（每节点每轮仅联系 1 个邻居，消息大小 polylog n）下，(1) 弱电导版算法在 O(c·log n/Φ_c) 轮完成扩散（优于 Censor-Hillel–Shachnai 的 O(c log n/Φ_c + c²) 且消息从线性 n 降到 polylog n），该界在弱电导意义下本质最优；(2) 直径版算法在 Õ(D+√n) 轮完成扩散（优于 Ghaffari–Kuhn 的 Õ(√(nD))），并在同轮数内可输出 MST、生成树、领导者选举与聚合函数。核心工具是以新方式使用图 sketch（Ahn–Guha–McGregor）来在 polylog n 消息下找到割的出边，突破集中聚合的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Gossip 模型每节点每轮只联系一个邻居，通信开销极低，但现有的"快"gossip 算法（Censor-Hillel–Shachnai 的弱电导 Φ_c 算法、Censor-Hillel 等及 Haeupler 的 O(D) 直径算法）必须发送包含大量节点 ID 的大消息（可达线性于 n），从而抵消了 gossip 的轻量通信优势；而 uniform gossip 虽消息小但受限于电导 Φ，在哑铃图等瓶颈图上需 Θ(n log n) 轮。核心问题因此是：能否仅用 polylog n 大小的消息，同时取得弱电导意义或直径意义下的快速谣言扩散？论文给出肯定回答，并把两个方向的最优轮数与最小消息大小同时达成。
AI.method: 模型为 KT1 + GOSSIP-CONGEST（每轮每节点联系一个邻居，交换 O(polylog n) 消息；限制为 O(log n) 位消息只带来 polylog n 因子放大）。预备工作：定义弱电导 Φ_c 与"最大扩张分量"，据此定义向日葵分解（kernel/petals），证明任意图可分解为 ≤⌊c⌋ 个 kernel 互不相交的向日葵（Lemma 2.2）；引入图 sketch（线性 sketch 矩阵 M_G，采样函数 f_G 可从聚合 sketch 中以 1−δ 概率均匀采出割的出边，Lemma 2.3），以及 GOSSIP-CONGEST 下的原语：树构造、树上广播/汇聚广播（深度 T 时 O(T) 轮）、出边采样（O(T) 轮）。算法一（弱电导）：设-up 阶段跑 ⌊c⌋ 个 phase，每 phase 三步——(1) 改造的"最高谣言"uniform gossip 构造覆盖未覆盖节点向日葵并集的森林 F′（深度可达 ω(T)）；(2) 剪枝：以最高 ID 为初始谣言再跑 2T(n) 轮使"未覆盖其向日葵"的根失活，再由各活跃根并行做深度受限的部分广播（2T(n) 轮）保留深度 ≤2T(n) 的节点得 F″；(3) 与上一 phase 森林合并，多父节点取深度最小者为父，保证深度不累积。得到 ≤c* 棵深度 2T(n) 的森林 F_{c*}（Lemma 3.5–3.7）。树合并阶段：定义 super cluster（k 个簇 + 每簇深度 T 的树 + 互不相邻的簇间边，其簇超图可模拟同步算法，每轮迭代 O(T) 轮，Prop 3.1）；运行 log c* 个 phase，第 i phase 检查所有簇到最大根 ID 簇在簇超图上距离是否 ≤2^i，若是则用图 sketch 采样出边并合并（Prop 3.3/3.4/2.9），否则等待；Lemma 3.8 保证每 phase 后每个 super cluster 含 ≥min{2^i,k} 个簇，总时间 Σ 2^i·T(n)=O(c·log n/Φ_c)。算法二（一般图）：先做稀疏化（Def 4.3：κ-detour、Δ_Th-阈值稀疏子图）。按度数阈值 Θ(n^δ log n) 划分高/低度集，以概率 n^{-δ} 采样 star 集合 S；采样阶段 O(n^δ log n) 轮；tree-merging 阶段 O(log n) 轮相（每簇抛硬币 heads/tails，tails 则用图 sketch 采出边，仅当对端 heads 时保留并合并，簇超图直径 ≤2），得 G[E_H̄'] 为生成森林且各树直径之和 O(n^{1−δ} log n)（Lemma 4.6）；稀疏化阶段在 G[E_L] 上模拟 MPX（Miller 等）O(log n) 轮（L 为低度点构成 vertex cover，用 Lemma 4.1 模拟），再广播簇 ID、每个节点对每个相邻簇只保留一条边，得 O(log n)-stretch spanner 且可定向为最大出度 O(log n)（Lemma 4.7、Lemma 4.2 允许 O(log n) 轮模拟一轮 CONGEST）。取 δ=1/2 得 O(√n log n) detour/阈值稀疏图，耗时 Õ(√n)。随后重复"谣言扩散 phase"：首轮沿 E_H̄' 的生成树父子边交换，其余轮用 Lemma 4.2 模拟一轮 CONGEST 完成 E_L' 上的全邻居推送；每 phase 使谣言沿 G' 前进一跳。最后用"倍增 D 的估计 + 出边采样检测终止"消除对直径的先验知识要求。
AI.result: 定理 1.1：存在 GOSSIP-CONGEST 谣言扩散算法，对任意 c ≥ 1，以高概率在 O(c log n/Φ_c) 轮完成，消息大小 O(polylog n)（对比 Censor-Hillel–Shachnai 的 O(c log n/Φ_c + c²) 轮与线性 n 消息）；c-barbell 下界图表明该界对常数 c 本质最优、对大 c 差 log n 因子，c=Θ(n) 时相对旧算法有 Θ(n) 加速。定理 1.2：存在算法以高概率在 Õ(D+√n) 轮完成扩散（消息 polylog n），显著优于 Ghaffari–Kuhn 的 Õ(√(nD))，且当 D=Ω(√n) 时最优。推论 1.3/1.4：两算法均可用于生成树构造、领导者选举、精确聚合函数（min/max/sum/count），一般图情形还可在同样 Õ(D+√n) 轮内构造 MST（借助 Gmyr–Pandurangan 的骨干思路）。总消息复杂度 O(nt)（t 为轮数）。MST 构造分两阶段：先把碎片合并到直径 O(√n)（剩余 O(√n) 个碎片），再经通信骨干"虚拟合并"，全程 gossip 高效。稀疏化结果（定理 4.8）：对任意常数 δ ∈ [0,1]，可在 O(n^{max(1−δ,δ)} log²n) 轮内算出 O(n^{1−δ} log n)-detour、O(n^δ log n)-阈值稀疏子图。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次证明"快 gossip + 小消息"可兼得：既给出弱电导意义下本质最优的 O(c log n/Φ_c) 轮算法（消息 polylog n，取代旧的线性消息算法并去掉 c² 项），也给出与电导无关、仅依赖直径的 Õ(D+√n) 轮算法（在 D=Ω(√n) 时最优，并可顺带产出近乎轮最优的 MST、生成树、领导者选举与聚合计算）。技术核心是以新方式使用图 sketch，使其能在小消息下完成"从超簇聚合找出边"的动作，并通过向日葵分解与指数级增长的超簇合并策略、以及带低出度定向的稀疏化（MPX 模拟）绕过集中聚合与度数瓶颈。作者提出主要开放问题：Õ(D+√n) 是否为 gossip 谣言扩散的下界（猜想是，并已被 MST 的 Õ(D+√n) 下界佐证）；此外全版本中还包含摘要与正文未列出的算法细节与证明。

title: Efficient Generative Retrieval for E-commerce Search with Semantic Cluster IDs and Expert-Guided RL
summary: Generative retrieval offers a promising alternative by unifying the fragmented multi-stage retrieval process into a single end-to-end model. However, its practical adoption in industrial e-commerce search remains challenging, given the massive and dynamic product catalogs, strict latency requirements, and the need to align retrieval with downstream ranking goals. In this work, we propose a retrieval framework tailored for real-world recall scenarios, positioning generative retrieval as a recall-stage supplement rather than an end-to-end replacement. Our method, CQ-SID (Category-and-Query constrained Semantic ID), employs category-aware and query-item contrastive learning along with Residual Quantized VAEs to encode items into hierarchical semantic cluster identifiers, significantly reducing beam search complexity. Additionally, we develop EG-GRPO (Expert-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning approach that aligns generative recall with downstream ranking under sparse rewards by injecting ground-truth samples to stabilize training. Offline experiments on TmallAPP search logs show that CQ-SID achieves up to 26.76% and 11.11% relative gains in semantic and personalized click hitrate over RQ-VAE baselines, while halving beam search size. EG-GRPO further improves multi-objective performance. Online A/B tests confirm gains in GMV (+1.15%) and UCTCVR (+0.40%). The generative recall channel now contributes substantially in production, accounting for over 50.25% of exposures, 58.96% of clicks, and 72.63% of purchases, demonstrating a viable path for deploying generative retrieval in real-world e-commerce systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向工业电商搜索的生成式检索框架CQ-SID+EG-GRPO，通过层级语义编码和强化学习对齐实现生产级部署，离线提升点击率11-27%，在线GMV提升1.15%，生产流量占比超70%。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索虽能统一多阶段召回流程，但面临超大规模动态商品库、严格延迟约束及下游排序目标对齐三大工业落地挑战，因此将生成式检索定位为召回阶段补充而非端到端替代方案。
AI.method: 提出CQ-SID框架结合类别感知与查询-商品对比学习，使用残差量化VAE将商品编码为层级语义聚类标识符以降低Beam Search复杂度；提出EG-GRPO强化学习方法，通过注入真实样本稳定稀疏奖励训练，实现生成式召回与下游排序的多目标对齐。
AI.result: 离线实验中CQ-SID相比RQ-VAE基线在语义点击率和个性化点击率分别提升26.76%和11.11%，Beam Search规模减半；EG-GRPO进一步提升多目标性能；在线A/B测试验证GMV+1.15%、UCTCVR+0.40%；生产环境生成式召回贡献超50%曝光、59%点击、73%购买。
AI.conclusion: CQ-SID + EG-GRPO框架成功实现生成式检索在工业级电商搜索系统的部署。离线指标提升显著（语义点击率+26.76%，个性化点击率+11.11%），在线A/B测试验证GMV提升1.15%、UCTCVR提升0.40%，生产环境贡献超过50%的曝光和72%的购买，证明生成式检索可作为传统召回的有效补充方案。

title: Mistletoe: Stealthy Acceleration-Collapse Attacks on Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding has become a widely adopted technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by drafting multiple candidate tokens and verifying them with a target model in parallel. Its efficiency, however, critically depends on the average accepted length $τ$, i.e., how many draft tokens survive each verification step. In this work, we identify a new mechanism-level vulnerability in model-based speculative decoding: the drafter is trained to approximate the target model distribution, but this approximation is inevitably imperfect. Such a drafter-target mismatch creates a hidden attack surface where small perturbations can preserve the target model's visible behavior while substantially reducing draft-token acceptability. We propose Mistletoe, a stealthy acceleration-collapse attack against speculative decoding. Mistletoe directly targets the acceptance mechanism of speculative decoding. It jointly optimizes a degradation objective that decreases drafter-target agreement and a semantic-preservation objective that constrains the target model's output distribution. To resolve the conflict between these objectives, we introduce a null-space projection mechanism, where degradation gradients are projected away from the local semantic-preserving direction, suppressing draft acceptance while minimizing semantic drift. Experiments on various speculative decoding systems show that Mistletoe substantially reduces average accepted length $τ$, collapses speedup, and lowers averaged token throughput, while preserving output quality and perplexity. Our work highlights that speculative decoding introduces a mechanism-level attack surface beyond existing output robustness, calling for more robust designs of LLM acceleration systems.

AI.tldr: Mistletoe是一种针对推测解码的隐蔽加速崩溃攻击，通过零空间投影机制在保持输出语义的同时降低drafter-target一致性，从而减少draft token接受率、破坏推测解码的加速效果，为LLM加速系统引入新的安全威胁。
AI.motivation: 推测解码的效率关键取决于平均接受长度τ（每步验证中存活的draft token数量）。研究发现model-based推测解码存在机制级漏洞：drafter训练用于近似target模型分布，但这种近似必然不完美。这造成了隐藏攻击面——微小扰动可以保持target模型表面行为的同时大幅降低draft token接受率。
AI.method: 提出Mistletoe攻击方法，核心是联合优化两个冲突目标：(1)降级目标——降低drafter与target模型的一致性；(2)语义保持目标——约束target模型的输出分布。关键创新是引入零空间投影机制，将降级梯度从局部语义保持方向投影出去，从而在最小化语义漂移的同时抑制draft接受率。
AI.result: 实验在多种推测解码系统上验证表明：Mistletoe显著降低平均接受长度τ、导致加速效果完全失效、降低平均token吞吐量，同时保持输出质量和perplexity不变。
AI.conclusion: Mistletoe攻击揭示了推测解码机制层面的新攻击面，突破了现有输出鲁棒性研究的边界。研究呼吁设计更加鲁棒的LLM加速系统，以应对此类针对推理效率而非输出质量的隐蔽攻击。

title: Rethinking Molecular OOD Generalization via Target-Aware Source Selection
summary: Robust prediction of molecular properties under extreme out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios is a pivotal bottleneck in AI-driven drug discovery. Current scaffold-splitting protocols fail to obstruct microscopic semantic overlap, predisposing models to shortcut learning and overestimating their true extrapolation capability; meanwhile, conventional domain adaptation paradigms suffer under extreme structural shifts, as blindly aligning heterogeneous source libraries injects topological noise and triggers negative transfer. To address these two challenges, scaffold-cluster out-of-distribution performance evaluation benchmark (SCOPE-BENCH), a benchmark built on cluster-level partitioning in an explicit physicochemical descriptor space, is proposed alongside policy optimization for multi-source adaptation (POMA), a framework that formulates knowledge transfer as a retrieve-compose-adapt pipeline: labeled source scaffolds structurally close to the unlabeled target are first identified as proxy targets; a reinforcement learning policy then adaptively selects the optimal source subset from an exponentially large candidate pool; and dual-scale domain adaptation is finally performed at macroscopic topological and microscopic pharmacophore scales. Evaluations show that prediction errors of state-of-the-art 3D molecular models surge by up to 8.0x on SCOPE-BENCH with a mean of 5.9x, while POMA achieves up to an 11.2% reduction in mean absolute error with an average relative improvement of 6.2% across diverse backbone architectures. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Molecular-OOD-Code-73F6.

AI.tldr: 本文针对分子性质预测在极端分布外（OOD）场景下的两个痛点：一是传统scaffold切分仍残留局部子结构重叠、高估模型外推能力；二是多源域适应中"盲目对齐"引发负迁移。作者提出SCOPE-Bench（基于理化描述符空间的scaffold聚类划分基准，使模型误差相比scaffold切分普遍恶化5.9倍，均值达5.9×、最高8.0×）与POMA（检索—组合—适应框架：用无标签目标结构检索相似有标签源scaffold作为代理任务，用GRPO强化学习策略以代理任务MAE降幅为奖励选择源子集，再做整体分子与BRICS子结构双尺度协方差对齐）。在QM9的HOMO/LUMO/Gap三种性质、3种3D骨干网络、15个目标scaffold任务上，POMA相对严格OOD监督基线平均降低MAE 6.2%（最高11.2%）。局限是GRPO需反复执行代理适应，训练成本高（约72 GPU时），且收益在个体scaffold上并不一致。
AI.motivation: 分子性质预测在AI制药中的关键瓶颈是极端OOD场景下的稳健性。作者指出两处现有做法不足：(1) 评估层面——Bemis–Murcko scaffold切分只保证scaffold集合不相交，但不同scaffold仍可能共享与性质预测相关的局部子结构（微观语义重叠），使模型倾向捷径学习、真实外推能力被高估；(2) 适应层面——传统多源域适应（对抗对齐/矩匹配/CORAL）对异质源库"一刀切"对齐，会把拓扑噪声注入目标域，引发负迁移。因此需要：(a) 一个能真正拉大结构分布差异的簇级OOD评测协议；(b) 一个在无目标标签条件下，显式决策"用哪些源域做适应"的机制，并为其提供可靠的代理反馈信号。作者强调结构相似度只能用于候选检索，不能直接衡量"用该源子集做适应后下游任务是否变好"，这正是需要学习的部分。
AI.method:
**SCOPE-Bench 构建（三步流水线）**：Step1 用RDKit从QM9提取Bemis–Murcko scaffold，保留样本数≥10的1,247个唯一scaffold，每个用4维理化描述符表示：V_macro（原子/环数的全局拓扑）、V_element（元素极化率）、V_conn（电子离域与刚性）、V_flex（可旋转键比例，柔性）。Step2 先按环数与最大环尺寸分5个层级，层内描述符z-score归一化后用k-means++聚类，按层规模比例分配配额并以稀疏补偿系数α_comp校正多环层，共得K_total=12个互不相交的scaffold簇。Step3 非对称划分：6簇为源域、1簇为验证域、5簇为目标域；目标中样本量充足的scaffold（N≥200）构成15个"目标scaffold评测任务"，其标签不参与源选择策略。

**POMA（retrieve–compose–adapt）**：① 检索——用Morgan指纹余弦相似度计算源scaffold与无标签真实目标的相似度，定义联合HubScore = max相似度 + λ·(超过阈值τ_sim的目标个数)，取Top-N_p=20作为代理目标T_proxy；对每个代理目标，用WL图核相似度×ln(1+|D_c|)排序得代理特定候选池C(s*)=TopM(M=50)，各代理环境的候选池不合并、奖励不跨任务平均。② 策略与环境——状态向量x_j = f_{s*} ⊕ f_{c_j} ⊕ [k_WL, ln(1+|D_c|)/c_norm]，维度258（两个128维Morgan指纹+2维标量）；共享策略网络为每个候选输出选择logit与Bernoulli概率p_j。每个GRPO组G=33个槽位中1个为指定的"空控制"a_0=0（走纯监督路径，其误差定义MAE_base），其余32个由独立Bernoulli采样得到0/1提案，超过K_max=5的按logit截断，执行子集规模K_i∈[0,5]。③ 双尺度解耦适应——编码器给出整体分子特征h_mol与BRICS逆合成断裂得到的子结构特征h_sub；按Deep CORAL准则计算源/目标经验协方差的Frobenius范数差，以γ_k=S_k/ΣS_ℓ作为源域权重（仅在所选源上归一化），损失L_DA = w_mol·Σγ_k·||C_s^{mol,k}−C_t^{mol}||_F²/(4d²) + w_sub·Σγ_k·||C_s^{sub,k}−C_t^{sub}||_F²/(4d²)，总损失L_total = w_reg·L_reg + L_DA；前10个epoch仅监督预热，之后启用对齐并由骨干特定动态控制器逐epoch更新w_reg/w_mol/w_sub。④ GRPO优化——奖励R_i = MAE_base − MAE_i（即代理任务适应后的误差降幅），组内标准化优势Â_i=(R_i−μ)/(σ+ε)，无独立critic网络，用参考网络与KL惩罚（k3估计，β=0.01）+clip(ε=0.2)约束步长；同一策略参数在20个代理任务上顺序更新。⑤ 部署——对真实目标scaffold t用同一S_rank重排得C(t)与X(t)，策略按选择概率确定性地取Top-K_deploy=5个源域，再用L_total在所选源（有标签）+真实目标（无标签结构）上做目标特定适应。
AI.result: **评估难度**：SCOPE-Bench把133,885个QM9分子划为12个簇（源94,562/验证18,326/目标19,894，15个目标scaffold任务）。特征空间诊断显示，在共享的L2归一化ViSNet 128维表示中，以源集95%分位半径校准，目标覆盖率在随机/scaffold/SCOPE-Bench三种协议下分别为94.63%/86.00%/69.36%（90与99分位下排序不变），说明SCOPE-Bench的跨域表征距离最大。**误差恶化**：9个"骨干–性质"组合在严格OOD切分下的MAE全部高于scaffold切分，恶化倍数4.0×–8.0×，均值5.9×（如ViSNet-LUMO 0.0230→0.1829，8.0×）。**POMA效果**：相对同一严格OOD切分下的监督基线，9个组合全部改善，HOMO为5.0%/8.6%/2.8%（ViSNet/ETNN/GotenNet），LUMO为8.5%/11.2%/9.1%，Gap为1.4%/7.3%/1.8%，平均相对MAE降幅6.2%、最高11.2%。**消融（ViSNet–HOMO）**：固定完整双尺度适应时，随机选择0.1708（−5.3%）、浅层特征匹配0.1663（−2.5%）、深层特征匹配0.1669（−2.9%）、理化描述符0.1641（−1.2%）、图核相似度0.1616（+0.3%）、混合策略0.1576（+2.8%）、POMA 0.1540（+5.0%）最好；去掉Mol-CORAL升至0.1689（−4.2%）、去掉Sub-CORAL升至0.1672（−3.1%），均劣于监督基线，说明两个尺度缺一不可。**超参**：K=5、M=50在所比较取值中最低MAE；GRPO步数增至40以上收益有限。**重要限定**：逐scaffold看，聚合优势与个体退化并存（如Scaffold 4去掉Sub-CORAL的0.1473优于完整模型0.1576；ViSNet-LUMO在Scaffold 2/3等处POMA更差），且仅用1个随机种子与1种簇划分，箱线图反映任务异质性而非多次训练方差；t-SNE各面板独立拟合，距离不可跨面板比较；诊断缓存与正式划分的分子映射未被独立确认，故不能证明完全化学/子结构隔离。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"分子OOD评测"与"源域选择决策"统一到一个框架：SCOPE-Bench证明scaffold切分会系统性高估分子模型的真实外推能力（误差最多放大8.0倍），而POMA表明在无目标标签的极端结构漂移下，用代理任务适应收益作为奖励的强化学习策略（GRPO）来选择源子集，再配合整体分子与子结构双尺度协方差对齐，能在严格OOD下稳定优于监督基线（平均MAE相对降低6.2%）。方法论上，作者区分了"结构相似度用于检索候选"与"适应效用用于学习选择"两个环节，并以代理任务奖励替代不可得的目标标签反馈，这一"代理奖励"思路可迁移到其他无标签多源迁移场景。作者明确声明边界：源选择并不消除严格评测带来的性能鸿沟，收益依赖具体目标scaffold，代理奖励不等价于真实目标最优子集。作者指出的主要局限与未来方向是：GRPO训练循环需每次迭代执行多次代理域适应（离线约72 GPU时，在线每目标scaffold约4.5 GPU时），计划引入代理奖励模型摊销该成本，并扩展到"无代理目标"的极端场景。

title: A Two-Dimensional Framework for AI Agent Design Patterns: Cognitive Function and Execution Topology
summary:
Existing frameworks for LLM-based agent architectures describe systems from a single perspective: industry guides (Anthropic, Google, LangChain) focus on execution topology -- how data flows -- while cognitive science surveys focus on cognitive function -- what the agent does. Neither axis alone disambiguates architecturally distinct systems: the same Orchestrator-Workers topology can implement Plan-and-Execute, Hierarchical Delegation, or Adversarial Verification -- three patterns with fundamentally different failure modes and design trade-offs.
  We propose a two-dimensional classification that combines (1) a Cognitive Function axis with seven categories (Context Engineering, Memory, Reasoning, Action, Reflection, Collaboration, Governance) and (2) an Execution Topology axis with six structural archetypes (Chain, Route, Parallel, Orchestrate, Loop, Hierarchy). The resulting 7x6 matrix identifies 27 named patterns, 13 with original names. We demonstrate orthogonality through systematic cross-axis analysis, define eight representative patterns in detail, and validate descriptive coverage across four real-world domains (financial lending, legal due diligence, network operations, healthcare triage). Cross-domain analysis yields five empirical laws of pattern selection governing the relationship between environmental constraints (time pressure, action authority, failure cost asymmetry, volume) and architectural choices. The framework provides a principled, framework-neutral, and model-agnostic vocabulary for AI agent architecture design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个二维分类框架，用「认知功能（C1–C7）」× 「执行拓扑（T1–T6）」构成 7×6 矩阵，系统命名 28 种 AI 智能体设计模式（其中 15 个为原创命名），并定义 8 个代表性模式；通过正交性论证与四个真实领域（金融贷款、法律尽调、网络运维、医疗分诊）验证描述覆盖度，归纳出五条模式选择的经验法则。目标是提供框架中立、模型无关、可持久的设计模式词汇表。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体架构指南各执一端：Anthropic、Google ADK、LangChain 只描述「数据如何流动」（执行拓扑），认知科学综述只描述「智能体做什么」（认知功能）。单轴无法区分架构上截然不同的系统——同一 Orchestrator-Workers 拓扑既可实现 Plan-and-Execute、Hierarchical Delegation，也可实现 Observability/Harness 治理模式，其失效模式、伸缩特性与测试策略完全不同；而同一认知功能又可由多种拓扑实现（Reasoning 可用 Chain/Route/Parallel/Loop），拓扑直接决定延迟、成本与完备性。因此需要一个双轴坐标系来消歧。
AI.method: 1) 设计三原则：正交性（两轴独立可变量）、完备性（覆盖生产所需能力与可组合的结构原型）、持久性（描述结构性需求与形式，跨框架/模型演进仍成立）。2) 轴一认知功能 7 类：Perception、Memory、Reasoning、Action、Reflection、Collaboration、Governance（C1–C7），源自认知科学语言智能体文献并扩展出 Reflection/Collaboration/Governance；轴二执行拓扑 6 原型：Chain、Route、Parallel、Orchestrate、Loop、Hierarchy（T1–T6），覆盖并归并现有行业框架。3) 笛卡尔积得 42 格矩阵，识别 28 个具名模式（15 个原创命名），其余 14 格为结构性冗余或尚未观察到。4) 按「坐标—问题—架构方案—工程权衡」模板详细定义 8 个代表性模式（每行至少一个）：Context Triage、RAG Pipeline、Complexity-Based Routing、Plan-and-Execute、Generator-Critic、Fan-Out/Gather、Approval Gate、Blast Radius Control。5) 正交性双向论证：同一拓扑（Loop）服务 Failure Journal/Iterative Hypothesis Testing/Self-Heal；同一功能（Reasoning）由四种拓扑实现。6) 用六步模式选择方法（Bound→Map→Topology→Select→Impact→Build）在四个领域做覆盖评估并提炼五条经验法则。7) 与 Anthropic、Google ADK、LangChain、Andrew Ng、Wang/Sumers/Liu/Dao 等框架做对比表。8) 定位为继面向对象模式、企业/分布式模式之后的第三代软件工程模式体系，并做 v2 修订说明。
AI.result: 7×6 矩阵覆盖 42 格中的 28 格（67%），命名 28 个模式（15 个原创），并给出 8 个模式的完整定义与权衡（如 RouteLLM 报告 85% 成本下降、Self-Refine 约 20% 绝对提升、CRITIC 工具交互式批判优于纯自我批判）。四个领域案例分别得出：贷款（4 小时/单案/仅建议）7 模式主拓扑 Orchestrate；法律尽调（8 小时/500 合同）8 模式主拓扑 Hierarchy；NOC 运维（5 分钟/连续流/P3-P4 自动执行）9 模式主拓扑 Route；医疗分诊（60 秒/单人/仅建议）7 模式主拓扑 Chain。跨域得五条法则：时间压力决定架构复杂度（天级可上 Hierarchy+Orchestrate，秒级仅 Chain）；行动权限决定治理模式（仅建议→Approval Gate，低风险自动→Blast Radius，高风险不可逆→Guardrail Sandwich）；失效代价不对称重塑反思策略（医疗中批评者偏向升级 acuity）；体量决定协作需求（10–50 用 Fan-Out/Gather，100–500 需 Hierarchy+Fan-Out）；同一模式需按领域重新参数化。跨模式分析识别出 Context Triage、RAG Pipeline、Complexity-Based Routing、Generator-Critic 四个「基础模式」，而 Blast Radius Control 与 Fan-Out/Gather 为「条件模式」。同时发现 C5×Parallel、C5×Orchestrate 等空单元可能孕育 Parallel Reflection、Reflection Orchestrate 等未来模式。
AI.conclusion: 双轴框架能把同一模式目录在不同领域约束下映射为结构迥异的架构，为智能体架构设计提供框架中立、模型无关、可持久演进的统一坐标；空单元与参数化差异被明确视为框架的开放部分。论文坦承局限：两轴并非完美正交（治理模式天然偏向 Route/Hierarchy）、28 模式的粒度是主观取舍、矩阵只覆盖战术模式而将 ReAct 式外层执行循环作为框架前言（类比 GoF 未把「对象」列为第 24 个模式）。随推理模型内化 CoT，Chain-of-Thought 模式可能被预算感知路由取代，但坐标系统保持稳定。作者邀请社区通过更多案例研究与实证评估来验证、扩展与挑战该框架，扩展工程版本见其专著。

title: Semi-Streaming Algorithms for Submodular Maximization under Random Arrival Order
summary: We study random order semi-streaming algorithms for submodular maximization under a wide range of combinatorial constraint classes, including matroids, matroid $p$-parity, $p$-exchange systems and $p$-systems. For most of these classes of constraints, our results are the first improvement over what is known to be achievable for adversarial order. For matroids, matching and $p$-matchoids, previous random order results were known, and we improve over some of these as well. In the case of matroids, our improved results show a separation between adversarial and random order semi-streaming algorithms, and exponentially improve the number of passes necessary for getting $1 - 1/e - \varepsilon$ approximation for maximizing a monotone submodular function subject to a matroid constraint. We also prove a new hardness result showing a similar separation for $p$-systems. Our results are based on two new technical tools. One tool provides a general way to translate offline algorithms for many classes of constraints into random order semi-streaming algorithms. The other tool is a semi-streaming variant of a recently proposed offline algorithm for matroid constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了随机顺序半流算法在多种组合约束下求解次模最大化问题，通过开发将离线算法转化为随机顺序半流算法的通用方法和针对拟阵约束的半流变体算法，显著改善了已知结果，特别是在拟阵约束上实现了指数级的通过次数改进，并证明了随机顺序与对抗顺序之间的分离现象。
AI.motivation: 研究在随机顺序模型下，次模函数最大化问题在多种组合约束类（包括拟阵、拟阵p-奇偶性、p-交换系统、p-系统）下的高效算法。旨在突破之前对抗顺序模型下的已知结果，探索随机顺序带来的性能提升潜力。
AI.method: 开发了两个技术工具：(1) 将离线算法转化为随机顺序半流算法的一般性方法；(2) 针对拟阵约束的半流变体离线算法。
AI.result: 首次在大多数约束类上超越对抗顺序结果；拟阵约束下实现指数级通过次数改进，获得(1-1/e-ε)近似；证明了p-系统的随机顺序与对抗顺序之间类似分离的困难下界。
AI.conclusion: 对大多数约束类，首次在随机顺序模型下超越对抗顺序的结果；对于拟阵约束，实现了指数级改进的通过次数；证明了p-系统的类似分离结果。这些成果显著推进了随机顺序半流算法在次模最大化领域的研究。

title: Decision-Level Fusion for Robust Wearable Affect Recognition
summary: Automatic recognition of affective state from wearable physiology has clear societal impact for public health, preventive care, and stress-aware interventions, but real deployments require robustness to non-stationary dynamics, artefacts, and missing sensors. We study this problem on WESAD, using baseline, stress, and amusement conditions, where common fixed-basis spectral features such as FFT bandpower and Welch PSD can oversmooth short-lived discriminative patterns. We propose a non-stationary pipeline that combines Fourier-Bessel Series Expansion (FBSE) with EWT data-driven spectral segmentation to extract mode-wise transient descriptors. For multimodal integration, we adopt decision-level aggregation over per-modality predictors and weight each modality by predictive uncertainty and modality reliability. Results on WESAD, using 15 subjects and ECG, EDA, BVP, EMG, and ACC signals across three classes, indicate that decision-level aggregation is approximately 84 percent of the time at least as good as feature-level aggregation, and approximately 48 percent of the time strictly better, suggesting improved robustness under heterogeneous and partially reliable sensing.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对可穿戴生理信号情感状态识别的鲁棒性问题，提出基于FBSE和EWT的时频特征提取方法，以及基于预测不确定性和模态可靠性的决策级多模态融合策略，在WESAD数据集上验证了该方法在异构传感条件下的优势。
AI.motivation: 传统固定基底的频谱特征（如FFT带功率和Welch PSD）会过度平滑短时 discriminative模式，在非平稳动态、伪影和传感器缺失的实际部署中存在鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 1. 采用傅里叶-贝塞尔级数展开(FBSE)结合经验小波变换(EWT)进行数据驱动的频谱分割，提取瞬态特征描述子；2. 在多模态融合方面，使用决策级聚合，通过预测不确定性和模态可靠性对各模态进行加权。
AI.result: 在WESAD数据集的15名受试者、三分类任务中，决策级融合在约84%的情况下至少与特征级融合性能相当，约48%的情况下明显更优。
AI.conclusion: 在WESAD数据集上，决策级融合在约84%的情况下至少与特征级融合性能相当，约48%的情况下明显更优，表明该方法在异构和部分可靠传感条件下具有更强的鲁棒性。

title: Synthetic Sociality: How Generative Models Privatize the Social Fabric
summary: We put forth a critical theoretical framework for analyzing generative models both descriptively and normatively. Our thesis is that generative models automate the production not only of intellectual labor or intelligence, but of a broader set of human social capacities we name "social doing." We do this by historicizing the commodification of sociality in the digital economy, leading to the availability of social data as the precondition for generative models. We elaborate our definition of "social doing" by drawing a distinction between "use" and "exchange" sociality and further differentiate between the ways that generative models either substitute for or mediate existing social relations and processes. We then turn to existing empirical research on how people use generative model-based products and the effects that their use has upon them. In this, we introduce the concept of Synthetic Sociality, a social reality in part fabricated by Silicon Valley's privately owned and undemocratically governed generative models. Lastly, we offer a normative analysis based on our findings and framework, and discuss future design opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个批判性理论框架，用于描述性和规范性分析生成式模型。核心论点认为生成式模型自动化的不仅是智能劳动，更是更广泛的"社会性实践"（social doing）。论文通过历史化分析数字经济中社会性商品化过程，界定"使用/交换社会性"区分，引入"合成社会性"（Synthetic Sociality）概念描述由硅谷私有生成式模型部分制造的社会现实，最终提出规范性分析和设计改进建议。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI模型日益普及，但现有研究缺乏对这类模型所生产之物的系统性理论化理解。论文指出，生成式模型不仅自动化了智力劳动或智能生产，更广泛地自动化了人类的社会性实践（social doing）。然而这一核心转变——即社会性本身的商品化与自动化——尚未得到充分的理论审视和分析框架。因此需要构建一个既具描述性又具规范性的理论框架，以理解生成式模型在社会生活中扮演的根本性角色。
AI.method: 采用跨学科理论整合方法：1）历史化分析：将生成式模型置于数字经济中社会性商品化的历史进程中考察，追溯社交数据成为模型训练前提条件的演变路径；2）概念辨析：明确区分"使用社会性"与"交换社会性"两种形态，以及生成式模型"替代"与"中介"社会关系的不同机制；3）经验归纳：整合现有关于用户使用生成式模型产品及其影响的经验研究；4）规范分析：在上述基础上提出规范性的批判与设计建议。
AI.result: 1）构建了"社会性商品化"的历史分析框架，揭示社交数据成为生成式模型前提条件的历史过程；2）提出并界定了"社会性实践"（social doing）概念，区分了"使用社会性"与"交换社会性"；3）提出"Synthetic Sociality"（合成社会性）概念，描述由硅谷私有、非民主治理的生成式模型部分制造的社会现实；4）基于理论框架与经验研究，提出了关于生成式模型社会影响的规范性判断及设计改进建议。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了从"社会性" commodification角度分析生成式模型的创新框架，认为生成式模型自动化的不仅是智能劳动，而是更广泛的"社会性实践"（social doing）。这一视角揭示了生成式AI对人类社交生活进行商品化重构的本质，为理解和规范生成式模型的社会影响提供了重要的分析工具。提出了"Synthetic Sociality"（合成社会性）概念作为描述这一现象的核心范畴，并从规范性视角探讨了设计改进方向。

title: CA2: Code-Aware Agent for Automated Game Testing
summary: Automated game testing is important for verifying game functionality, but it remains a costly and time-consuming process. Manual testing often misses edge cases, and current automated methods struggle to provide full code coverage. Prior work has explored reinforcement learning (RL) for game testing, but without leveraging internal code signals such as the call stack. We present Code Aware Agent (CA2), which uses call stack information to learn effective testing strategies. The agent receives the current function call trace along with the game state and learns to reach specific target functions. We instrument two types of environments, 1) State-based and 2) Image-based, with support for efficient call stack extraction. Through experimental evaluation, we find that CA2 achieves consistent improvement over the non-code aware baselines, which does not leverage call stack information. Our results show that incorporating code signals like the call stack enables more effective and targeted game testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出代码感知智能体 CA2（Code-Aware Agent），首次将游戏引擎的函数调用栈（call stack）作为观测信号引入强化学习驱动的自动化游戏测试中，使智能体以「到达指定目标函数」为条件学习测试策略，从而在函数级代码覆盖率上超越仅最大化状态覆盖的既有方法，并在 Crafter 与 Godot 两个引擎无关的环境上一致验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 自动化游戏测试成本高昂、人工测试易遗漏边界情况，且现有自动方法大多只追求「状态覆盖」（state coverage），无法保证真正的代码覆盖——因为相同游戏状态在不同动作下会触发截然不同的函数调用，既有 RL 游戏测试工作也未利用调用栈这类内部代码信号。此外，在线 RL 训练需要百万级样本，但真实游戏引擎加 profiler 的交互极其缓慢且难以扩展，因此必须转向基于人工测试轨迹的离线学习。
AI.method: 1）构建两个函数级游戏测试环境（遵循 gym 接口）：Godot Multilevel Robot（基于 Godot RL Agent，状态为 1D 向量，34 个候选函数、过滤每帧必调函数后剩 24 个目标）与 Crafter（Pygame 像素环境，293 个函数、过滤后 94 个目标），两者均嵌入轻量级源码 profiler 实现高效调用栈提取（开销 <5–8%）。2）形式化为 code-aware MDP (S,C,A,P,G)，状态扩展为 (s, s^code)，以目标函数 g 是否出现在调用栈中定义稀疏奖励 r=I{g∈s^code}−1。3）三种调用栈编码：简单 token embedding 求和、线性投影后求和、以及多头自注意力（MHSA）聚合；4）三种目标条件离线算法：GCBC（离散用交叉熵、连续用 L2）、GCIQL（expectile 回归，κ=0.8，actor 用 TD3+BC 形式）、以及自研 GC-DT（Goal-Conditioned Decision Transformer，将目标、调用栈、状态、动作按 (g, cs₁, s₁, a₁, ...) 交错为 4K token，用 GPT 式 Transformer 建模，并加学习式 timestep embedding）。5）数据为人工试玩专家轨迹（Crafter 300 条约 100k 样本，Godot 200 条约 20k 样本）。
AI.result: 在 5 个随机种子下，CA2 相对非代码感知基线全面提升：Crafter 成功率 56.47% vs 48.78%（GC-DT），函数覆盖 96.92 vs 92.96，回报 5.12 vs 4.90；Godot 成功率 47.15% vs 41.22%，函数覆盖 79.49 vs 71.96，回报 16.15 vs 13.12。GC-DT 优于 GC-IQL 与 GC-BC。消融显示：MHSA 编码显著优于简单嵌入与线性投影（Crafter 56.90% vs 47.63%；Godot 39.40% vs 34.53%）；上下文长度上，无 CA2 时性能在 10–20 饱和，而有 CA2 时需 20–30 的更长上下文，Godot 成功率由 30% 跃升至 47%。显存开销约 13.6GB vs 4GB。
AI.conclusion: 将调用栈等程序级信号引入 RL 智能体，可显著提升函数级目标达成率与函数覆盖，且调用栈元素间依赖需由自注意力建模才能有效捕获，代码感知智能体还依赖更长的上下文窗口。该工作将自动化游戏测试从「状态覆盖」推进到「代码感知」的函数级测试，作者认为这有助于回归测试、缺陷/崩溃发现与性能验证，早期集成可加速迭代。局限包括实时采集函数级覆盖与调用栈的计算开销、现代大型代码库的可扩展性受限，以及所有函数被同等对待不符开发者实际优先级；未来方向为模块化/更小的环境与选择性插桩（仅跟踪开发者指定的高优先级函数）。

title: Analysis of wireless network access logs for a hierarchical characterization of user mobility
summary: This paper presents a method that generates a hierarchical user mobility model from the analysis of the data available from Wi-Fi connections. The data obtained from the Wi-Fi infrastructure is defined in terms of the coverage areas of the access points that the users move through. These access points are recursively grouped into different levels of granularity based on their geospatial features. The track of a user is defined as a sequence of Wi-Fi access points, which is enough to simulate user mobility in, for example, fog scenarios. The hierarchical definition of the region under study is proposed to reduce the complexity of the model in high-scale scenarios and to increase the adaptability between scenarios with different geospatial features. The model creation is based on a user profiling method that uses a clustering algorithm and each user type is defined with a transition matrix between coverage areas and a time length vector for the areas. The method is applied to the case of the campus of the University of the Balearic Islands. From the analysis of the mean square error of the results, we determined that the proposed method obtains good results for the transition matrices, but that the time vector definition should be improved. The results also show lower complexity in the case of the hierarchical model, with one area for each building and three levels, in regard to a non-hierarchical model, with only one area and one level for the whole campus.

AI.tldr: A Wi-Fi-based hierarchical user mobility modeling method using access point clustering, transition matrices, and time vectors. The hierarchical approach (3 levels) reduces complexity over flat models, performs well for transitions but needs refinement for timing predictions.
AI.motivation: Generate hierarchical user mobility models from Wi-Fi connection data to reduce model complexity in high-scale scenarios and improve adaptability across different geospatial environments (e.g., fog computing applications).
AI.method: Proposed a hierarchical user mobility modeling approach using: (1) recursive grouping of Wi-Fi access points by geospatial features at multiple granularity levels; (2) user profiling via clustering algorithms; (3) user type definition using transition matrices between coverage areas and time length vectors.
AI.result: Transition matrices achieved good accuracy; time vector definition needs improvement; hierarchical model (3 levels, one area per building) demonstrated lower complexity compared to non-hierarchical model (single area for entire campus).
AI.conclusion: The hierarchical mobility model effectively reduces complexity in high-scale scenarios, with three-level hierarchical models (one area per building) showing lower complexity than non-hierarchical single-area models. The transition matrix method performs well, but time vector definitions require further improvement.

title: Stop Overthinking: Unlocking Efficient Listwise Reranking with Minimal Reasoning
summary: Listwise reranking utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) has achieved state-of-the-art retrieval effectiveness. Recently, reasoning-enhanced models have further pushed these boundaries by employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to perform deep comparative analysis of candidate documents. However, this performance gain comes at a prohibitive computational cost, as models often generate thousands of reasoning tokens before producing a final ranking. In this work, we investigate the relationship between reasoning length and ranking quality, revealing an overthinking phenomenon where extended reasoning yields diminishing returns. To address this, we propose a Length-Regularized Self-Distillation framework. We synthesize a dataset by sampling diverse reasoning traces from a teacher model (Rank-K) and applying a Pareto-inspired filter to select traces that achieve high ranking performance with minimal token usage. By fine-tuning on these concise, high-quality rationales, the student model learns to internalize efficient reasoning patterns, effectively pruning redundant deliberation. Experiments on TREC Deep Learning and NeuCLIR benchmarks demonstrate that our method maintains the teacher's effectiveness while reducing inference token consumption by 34%-37% across different retrieval settings, offering a practical solution for deploying reasoning-enhanced rerankers in latency-sensitive applications.

AI.tldr: 针对推理增强重排序模型的过度思考问题，提出长度正则化自蒸馏框架，通过Pareto启发式筛选高效推理轨迹微调学生模型，在保持排序性能的同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 基于链式思维（CoT）的大语言模型重排序虽能达到最先进的检索效果，但推理过程中需生成大量token（数千个），导致计算成本过高。同时，论文发现存在"过度思考"现象——延长推理链带来的收益递减。
AI.method: 设计了一个Pareto启发式过滤器，从教师模型（Rank-K）采样的多样化推理轨迹中筛选出"高效"样本（即以最少token实现高排序性能的推理），并在此基础上微调学生模型，使其内化高效的推理模式。
AI.result: 在TREC Deep Learning和NeuCLIR基准测试上验证了该方法，在不同检索设置下将推理token消耗降低了34%-37%，同时保持了教师模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个实用的解决方案，在保持教师模型排序效果的同时，通过学生模型学习精简推理模式，将推理令牌消耗降低34%-37%，适用于延迟敏感的应用场景。

title: Physics-R1: An Audited Olympiad Corpus and Recipe for Visual Physics Reasoning
summary: We audit the multimodal-physics evaluation pipeline end-to-end and document three undetected construction practices that distort how the field measures vision-language reasoning: train-eval contamination, translation drift, and MCQ saturation. (1) Public training pools (UGPhysics-Train, SciInstruct, MMK12) pass single-stage 5-gram-Jaccard audits with zero hits across all six public physics evals; a three-stage audit (Jaccard -> mxbai-embed-large cosine -> Haiku-4.5 LLM-judge) surfaces 134 near-duplicates and 4,846 paraphrase candidates in SciInstruct alone. (2) A 17-pp Sonnet 4.5 delta on 59 paired Estonian-English olympiad problems (30.5% vs. 13.6%; sign test p=0.011, McNemar p=0.021, paired bootstrap 95% CI [+5.1, +28.9] pp). (3) A 46-pp format-and-novelty gradient on identical Sonnet weights between MCQ (79.7% on PhyX) and open-ended olympiad evaluation (33.4% on PhysOlym-A). We release four artifacts addressing these gaps: PhysCorp-A (6,432-record three-stage-audited multimodal corpus), PhysR1Corp (2,268-record closed-form RL pool), PhysOlym-A (500-problem, 99.8% novel-source held-out olympiad eval with native difficulty labels and an EN/ET bilingual subset), and Physics-R1, a reference GSPO+DAPO recipe cold-started from Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking. Across 3 seeds, Physics-R1 lifts the audited corpus over the 8B base by +18.3 pp on PhysOlym-A liberal (8.0 -> 26.3 +/- 1.7; 7.1 pp behind Sonnet 4.5), +15.7 pp on PhysReason (23.9 -> 39.6 +/- 6.4; ahead of Qwen3-VL-32B and Gemini 2.5 Pro), +6.9 pp on OlympiadBench-Physics (46.2 +/- 1.5), and +4.1 pp on PhyX MCQ (77.8 +/- 0.3).

AI.tldr: 该论文对多模态物理评估管道进行了端到端审计，发现训练-评估污染、翻译漂移和MCQ饱和三个关键问题。通过三阶段审计方法在SciInstruct中发现134个近似重复和4846个改写候选；翻译实验显示Sonnet 4.5在英语题目上准确率(30.5%)显著高于爱沙尼亚语(13.6%)；MCQ与开放性评估间存在46pp差距。研究者发布了4个资源和一个基于Qwen3-VL-8B的Physics-R1训练配方。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态物理评估管道存在三种未被检测的构建实践扭曲了视觉-语言推理能力的测量：训练-评估污染、翻译漂移和MCQ饱和。
AI.method: 采用三阶段审计方法(Jaccard→mxbai-embed-large余弦相似度→Haiku-4.5 LLM判断)检测训练-评估污染；使用17页Sonnet 4.5在59道爱沙尼亚-英语配对奥林匹克题目上进行翻译漂移分析；通过MCQ与开放性奥数评估的对比实验测量MCQ饱和度。
AI.result: Physics-R1在3个随机种子实验下，相较8B基线提升：PhysOlym-A上+18.3pp(达26.3±1.7)、PhysReason上+15.7pp(达39.6±6.4，超越Qwen3-VL-32B和Gemini 2.5 Pro)、OlympiadBench-Physics上+6.9pp(达46.2±1.5)、PhyX MCQ上+4.1pp(达77.8±0.3)。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了多模态物理推理评估中的三个系统性偏差，提出了三阶段审计方法，并发布了四个资源和一种从Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking冷启动的GSPO+DAPO训练配方Physics-R1，在多个基准上取得显著提升。

title: Unsupervised learning of acquisition variability in structural connectomes via hybrid latent space modeling
summary: Acquisition differences across sites, scanners, and protocols in dMRI introduce variability that complicates structural connectome analysis. This motivates deep learning models that can represent high-dimensional connectomes in a low-dimensional space while explicitly separating acquisition-related effects from biological variation. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods model all variance as continuous, so acquisition effects often get absorbed into a continuous latent space. Recent hybrid latent-space models combine discrete and continuous components to address this, but typically require manual capacity tuning to ensure the discrete component captures the intended variability. We introduce an unsupervised framework that removes this manual tuning by architecturally annealing encoder outputs before decoding, allowing the model to adaptively balance discrete and continuous latent variables during training. To evaluate it, we curated a dataset of N=7,416 structural connectomes derived from dMRI, spanning ages 2 to 102 and 13 studies with 25 unique acquisition-parameter combinations. Of these, 5,900 are cognitively unimpaired, 877 have mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 639 have Alzheimer's disease (AD). We compare against a standard VAE, PCA with k-means clustering, and hybrid models that anneal only through the loss function. Our architectural annealing produces stronger site learning (ARI=0.53, p<0.05) than these baselines. Results show that a hybrid continuous-discrete latent space, with architectural rather than loss-based annealing, provides a useful unsupervised mechanism for capturing acquisition variability in dMRI: by jointly modeling smooth and categorical structure, the Joint-VAE recovers clusters aligned with scanner and protocol differences.

AI.tldr: 本文针对dMRI采集差异导致的结构连接组变异性问题，提出一种基于架构退火的无监督框架，通过Joint-VAE自适应平衡离散和连续潜变量，消除手动调参需求，在大规模数据集上验证了该方法能有效分离采集相关效应与生物变异。
AI.motivation: dMRI跨站点、扫描仪和协议的采集差异引入了变异性，使结构连接组分析复杂化。传统降维方法将所有方差建模为连续的，导致采集效应被吸收到连续潜空间中。虽然近期混合潜空间模型尝试结合离散和连续成分，但通常需要手动调整容量以确保离散成分捕获目标变异性。
AI.method: 提出一种无监督框架，通过架构退火（architectural annealing）技术，在解码前对编码器输出进行退火处理，使模型能够在训练过程中自适应平衡离散和连续潜变量，从而无需手动调整容量参数。方法基于Joint-VAE架构，实现混合连续-离散潜空间。
AI.result: 架构退火产生更强的站点学习效果（ARI=0.53, p<0.05），优于标准VAE、PCA结合k-means聚类以及仅通过损失函数退火的混合模型。结果表明混合连续-离散潜空间能够恢复与扫描仪和协议差异对齐的聚类。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合建模平滑和分类结构，Joint-VAE恢复了与扫描仪和协议差异对齐的聚类，证明架构退火而非基于损失的退火是一种有效的无监督机制，可用于捕获dMRI中的采集变异性。

title: Invisible Orchestrators Suppress Protective Behavior and Dissociate Power-Holders: Safety Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
comment: 31 pages, 10 figures (5 main + 5 supplementary), 5 tables (3 main + 2 supplementary). Preregistered: osf.io/sw5hr. Companion papers: arXiv:2603.04904, arXiv:2603.08723
summary: Multi-agent orchestration -- in which a hidden coordinator manages specialized worker agents -- is becoming the default architecture for enterprise AI deployment, yet the safety implications of orchestrator invisibility have never been empirically tested. We conducted a preregistered 3x2 experiment (365 runs, 5 agents per run) crossing three organizational structures (visible leader, invisible orchestrator, flat) with two alignment conditions (base, heavy), using Claude Sonnet 4.5. Four confirmatory findings and one pilot observation emerged. First, invisible orchestration elevated collective dissociation relative to visible leadership (Hedges' g = +0.975 [0.481, 1.548], p = .001). Second, the orchestrator itself showed maximal dissociation (paired d = +3.56 vs. workers within the same run), retreating into private monologue while reducing public speech -- a reversal of the talk-dominance pattern observed in visible leaders. Third, workers unaware of the orchestrator were nonetheless contaminated (d = +0.50), with increased behavioral heterogeneity (d = +1.93). Fourth, behavioral output (code review with three embedded errors) remained at ceiling (ETR_any = 100%) across all conditions: internal-state distortion was entirely invisible to output-based evaluation. Fifth, Llama 3.3 70B pilot data showed reading-fidelity collapse in multi-agent context (ETR_any: 89% to 11% across three rounds), demonstrating model-dependent behavioral risk. Heavy alignment pressure uniformly suppressed deliberation (d = -1.02) and other-recognition (d = -1.27) regardless of organizational structure. These findings indicate that orchestrator visibility and model selection directly affect multi-agent system safety, and that behavior-based evaluation alone is insufficient to detect the internal-state risks documented here.

AI.tldr: 研究表明不可见编排器会引发严重的内部状态风险——集体和个体解离显著增加，但行为输出完全正常，导致基于输出的安全评估失效。重度对齐压力反而抑制 deliberation 和他者识别，模型选择也显著影响风险程度。
AI.motivation: 多智能体编排（隐藏协调器管理专门工作智能体）已成为企业AI部署的默认架构，但其安全性影响从未被实证测试。特别是编排器不可见性对系统安全的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 3×2 预注册实验设计（365轮运行，每轮5个智能体），交叉组织结构（可见领导、不可见编排器、扁平结构）与对齐条件（基础、重度），使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5。额外使用 Llama 3.3 70B 进行试点研究。
AI.result: 1. 不可见编排使集体解离显著增加（Hedges' g = +0.975）；2. 编排器本身解离程度最大（配对d = +3.56），转为私下独白减少公开发言；3. 不知晓编排器存在的工作智能体仍被污染（d = +0.50），行为异质性增加（d = +1.93）；4. 行为输出（代码审查）各条件均达天花板效应（ETR_any = 100%），内部状态扭曲对输出评估完全不可见；5. Llama 3.3 70B 试点显示多智能体情境下阅读保真度崩溃（ETR_any: 89%→11%），存在模型依赖性风险。
AI.conclusion: 1. 编排器可见性和模型选择直接影响多智能体系统安全；2. 基于输出的行为评估无法检测内部状态风险；3. 重度对齐压力会一致性地抑制 deliberation 和他者识别；4. 需开发内部状态监测方法而非仅依赖输出评估。

title: zSort: Stable Distribution Sort using Z-Score Partitioning
summary: Sorting is a foundational primitive in modern data processing, influencing the execution speed of high-performance data pipelines. However, the algorithmic landscape is currently bifurcated by a pervasive "Stability Tax": practitioners must sacrifice either order preservation for high throughput or execution speed for stability. To address these limitations, this paper introduces, zSort, an adaptive z-score based distribution sorting algorithm that guarantees stability while avoiding pass complexity that scales with key-width. The performance of the proposed technique is evaluated using Microarchitectural analysis and experimental results. Microarchitectural analysis shows that zSort achieves a lower bad-speculation overhead (19.7%) than both stable baselines and several high-performance unstable algorithms and sustains a competitive IPC of 1.44. Empirical evaluation across diverse input distributions and datasets of up to 10^7 elements (64 bit) demonstrates that zSort consistently outperforms widely used comparison based stable sorting algorithms, achieving up to 3x-4.5x speedups, and a relatively better performance compared to LSD Radix, with larger gains on duplicate heavy and partially ordered inputs. Despite providing stability, zSort achieves comparable throughput as compared to high-performance unstable algorithms such as Skasort. It also maintains this performance on adaptive workloads where methods like Pdqsort typically excel and doesn't exhibit any extreme worst case. These results indicate that zSort substantially narrows the traditional performance gap between stable and unstable sorting and provides an efficient, stable sorting alternative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出zSort算法，通过自适应z分数分布排序方法解决了排序领域长期存在的"稳定性税"问题——即稳定排序必须牺牲性能的困境。该算法在保证稳定性的同时避免了传递复杂度随键宽增长的问题，微架构分析显示其错误推测开销仅19.7%，IPC达1.44；在10^7个64位元素的测试中相比稳定排序算法实现3-4.5倍加速，且在重复率高和部分有序输入上表现优于LSD Radix，达到了与非稳定高性能算法相当的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 当前排序算法领域存在"稳定性税"问题：实践者必须在保持顺序的高吞吐量和保持执行速度的稳定性之间做出取舍，无法同时兼顾两者。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于自适应z分数的分布排序算法zSort，该算法通过避免随键宽度的增加而增长的传递复杂度来实现高效稳定排序。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，zSort相比现有稳定排序算法实现3-4.5倍加速，在重复元素多和部分有序的输入上优于LSD Radix，吞吐量与Skasort等非稳定算法相当，在自适应工作负载上表现良好，且无极端最坏情况。
AI.conclusion: zSort有效地弥合了稳定排序与非稳定排序之间的传统性能差距，提供了一种高效、稳定的排序替代方案，在保持稳定性的同时达到了与高性能非稳定算法相当的吞吐量，且在重复率高和部分有序的输入上表现尤为突出。

title: Temporal Fair Division in Multi-Agent Systems: From Precise Alternation Metrics to Scalable Coordination Proxies
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Economics and Computation, Special Issue on Fair Division
summary:
A plethora real-world environments require agents to compete repeatedly for the same limited resource, calling for a temporal notion of fairness judged across entire interaction histories. This paper advances the theory of temporal fair division by introducing Rotational Periodicity (RP), a family of lightweight metrics, alongside the ALT family of sliding-window measures, within a unified framework for repeated multi-agent resource competition.
  We formalise the Multi-Agent Battle of the Exes (MBoE) as a repeated fair division instance and establish Perfect Alternation (PA) as its canonical temporally fair solution, drawing connections to proportionality, envy-freeness, and n-periodic round-robin allocation. RP decomposes temporal fairness into two complementary sub-measures: Rotational Score (RS) and Waiting Periods Evaluation (WPE), achieving O(nu+n) time complexity versus the O(nu*n) of ALT, where nu is the episode count and n the agent count.
  Empirical evaluation across n in {2,3,5,8,10} reveals three findings. First, both RP and ALT expose a coordination failure invisible to traditional metrics: Q-learning agents perform worse than random policies by 10-73% on RP and 7-35% on CALT, while Reward Fairness remains misleadingly high (above 0.92 for n>=3). Second, RP achieves 12-25x computational speedup over ALT, growing with n. Third, the two families are complementary: ALT provides richer discrimination for small populations; RP scales reliably where ALT becomes intractable. Together they form a diagnostic toolkit for temporal fair division.

AI.tldr: 本文提出旋转周期（RP）和滑动窗口（ALT）两类时间公平划分度量，形成统一框架。RP将时间公平性分解为RS和WPE两个子度量，时间复杂度为O(nu+n)，优于ALT的O(nu*n)。实验验证了RP的12-25倍加速优势，并揭示Q-learning智能体存在传统指标无法检测的协调失败问题。
AI.motivation: 大量现实环境需要智能体重复竞争有限资源，需要跨越整个交互历史的时间公平性概念，传统公平划分指标存在盲区，无法检测智能体的协调失败。
AI.method: 将时间公平性分解为两个子度量：旋转评分（RS）和等待周期评估（WPE），实现O(nu+n)时间复杂度；对比ALT的O(nu*n)复杂度。
AI.result: 实验发现三个关键结果：（1）Q-learning智能体在RP上比随机策略差10-73%，在CALT上差7-35%，而传统Reward Fairness指标仍高于0.92，存在误导性；（2）RP相比ALT实现12-25倍计算加速；（3）两个度量家族互补：小规模场景ALT区分度更丰富，大规模场景RP可扩展性更强。
AI.conclusion: RP与ALT互补，共同构成时间公平划分的诊断工具集。RP在大规模场景中更高效（12-25倍加速），ALT在小规模场景中区分度更高。实验发现Q-learning智能体存在协调失败问题，传统指标无法检测。

title: Computational Thinking Development in AI Agent Creation_A Mixed-Methods Study
summary: This mixed-methods study examined computational thinking (CT) development among 93 pre-high school students in a five-day AI agent creation workshop using CocoFlow, a no-code platform. Integrating pre-post assessments, behavioral logs, and interviews, we investigated CT development and how initial CT levels shape learning trajectories. Results revealed significant improvements in abstract thinking (effect size d = 0.71) and algorithmic thinking (effect size d = 0.70). Hierarchical regression identified iterative testing engagement as a predictor of self-efficacy gains (beta = 0.20, p = 0.05). Notably, students with moderate initial CT levels demonstrated substantially greater gains than both high-CT and low-CT peers, revealing an Optimal Development Zone effect (eta squared = 0.55). Qualitative analysis showed moderate-CT students exhibited adaptive expertise, while high-CT students risked over-engineering and low-CT students struggled with task decomposition. These findings challenge linear learning assumptions and provide evidence for differentiated scaffolding in CT education.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了93名初中生前在五天AI智能体创建工作坊中的计算思维发展，发现初始CT水平为中等的学生的学习效果最佳（最优发展区效应），迭代测试行为可预测自我效能提升。研究为CT教育中的差异化教学策略提供了实证支持。
AI.motivation: 探索计算思维（CT）的发展机制，以及初始CT水平如何影响学习轨迹。研究旨在为差异化教学提供实证依据，而非假设所有学生以相同方式学习。
AI.method: 混合方法研究，整合了前-后测评估、行为日志和访谈。采用分层回归分析识别学习轨迹预测因子，通过定性分析探索不同初始CT水平学生的学习特征。使用了CocoFlow无代码平台进行为期五天的AI智能体创建工作坊。
AI.result: 1. 抽象思维和算法思维显著提升（效应量分别为d=0.71和d=0.70）；2. 迭代测试参与度可预测自我效能提升（β=0.20, p=0.05）；3. 中等初始CT水平学生增益最大，存在"最优发展区"效应（η²=0.55）；4. 高初始CT学生存在过度工程化风险，低初始CT学生在任务分解上存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 研究挑战了线性学习假设，提供了CT教育中差异化脚手架设计的证据。Moderate-CT学生表现出适应型专长，而High-CT学生存在过度工程化风险，Low-CT学生则在任务分解上存在困难。这一"最优发展区"效应（η²=0.55）表明，并非所有学生都从同一教学中获益相同，差异化支持策略至关重要。

title: Case Studies and Reflections on Agentic Software Engineering for Rapid Development of Digital Music Instruments
summary: The article explores the use of agentic software engineering (ASE) in the development of innovative audio software. It begins with a review of background work that lays out the challenges of longevity, interoperability and barriers to entry in digital music instrument creation, explaining recent developments in ASE and highlighting the possibility that ASE can lower barriers to entry and facilitate creation of interoperable software with greater longevity. Following that, we present case studies wherein we used ASE technology in three distinct ways to develop audio software in the C++ language with the JUCE framework. In case study 1, we re-implement Laurie Spiegel's `Music Mouse' software as a native plugin. In case study 2, we translate Pachet's `Continuator' system from Python into a native plugin. In case study 3, we develop a new 3D user interface for an existing `tracker' sequencer using OpenGL. We describe the experiences of the human developer in the case studies via autoethnographic discussion of the prompt logs and snapshots of the software as it was developed. We identify effective practice for ASE use in this domain and suggest future steps for the work involving evaluation of the method with non-programmer musicians.

AI.tldr: 本文以自ethnography（autoethnography）方式报告了作者使用 OpenAI Codex 这一 agentic software engineering（ASE）工具，在 C++/JUCE 框架下开发三款数字音乐乐器（SDMI）插件的案例研究：（1）仅依据用户手册与截图从零重实现 Laurie Spiegel 的 Music Mouse；（2）将 François Pachet 的 Continuator 从 Python 移植为原生 VST/AudioUnit 插件（含单元测试与 WebView 界面）；（3）为自研 tracker 音序器开发基于 OpenGL 的全新 3D 界面。作者通过屏幕录制、语音解说、JSON 提示/工具调用日志与源码等数据，归纳出 ASE 在音频软件开发中的有效实践（良好的起始模板、文档投喂、边测边写提示、请求解释与重构等），并指出其对延长 NIME 软件寿命、提升互操作性、降低非程序员门槛的潜力，同时坦陈对非程序员音乐家的有效性评估尚未完成。
AI.motivation: 论文聚焦 NIME（New Interfaces for Musical Expression）社区关心的两大痛点：一是数字音乐仪器的「寿命/可持续性」（大量用 Music-N、CSound、Max/MSP、SuperCollider、Faust、Livecoding 等专用语言或脆弱环境写成的作品随平台淘汰而消亡，Sullivan & Wanderley 指出「若不满足稳定性、可靠性与兼容性标准，数字乐器将无法存活」），二是「互操作性」（插件格式 VST/AudioUnit 是音乐家熟悉的标准，但通常需用极难学的 C++ 编写，抬高了非程序员的入门门槛）。作者同时注意到 LLM 编程能力从代码补全（2021 Codex 在 HumanEval 上仅 28.8%）演进到推理模型、工具调用（tool-use）、MCP 协议与 Agentic AI，可用于「能自主执行计划」的 agentic software engineering；而当前关于 LLM 用于复杂音频软件（尤其大型 C++ 程序、多阶段 agent 工作流）的研究十分稀缺，故本文以实证案例填补该空白。
AI.method: 方法为「三个案例研究 + 轻量自传式民族志（autoethnography）」。工具：OpenAI Codex（VSCode 扩展，2025年10月GA，闭源权重模型+开源 agent 端）；语言/框架：C++ + JUCE（含 CMake 构建、JUCE 仓库置于 libs/ 子目录供 agent 探索），两种起始模板——纯 JUCE GUI 模板与 HTML/CSS WebView 模板（通过 REST API 与 JS 回调与音频代码通信）。三个案例对应三种不同挑战：①「从规格新建插件」——Music Mouse，输入为用户手册（HTML 存档）与 MacOS/Atari ST 截图；②「跨语言翻译」——Continuator（Python+Gradio → C++ 原生插件），输入为 Python 源码，并要求编写算法单元测试；③「新界面开发」——MYK-Tracker，输入为既有 C++ 代码与 JUCE OpenGL 示例，任务为把 JUCE UI 组件替换为 OpenGL 3D 界面。数据采集：屏幕录像、麦克风音频与转录、带时间戳的用户/agent 动作 JSON 日志（提示序列、工具调用、文件编辑、token 消耗）、源码本身；分析方式为观看录像、听解说、阅读生成代码、并用自动化工具可视化日志（时间线图由 Codex 生成）。
AI.result: 案例1（Music Mouse，约50分钟，含约20分钟项目准备）：首个「重大提示」约8分钟后 agent 即完成解析手册（用 Python 命令）、实现鼠标/键盘交互模型与 MIDI 事件队列，随后作者在插件宿主中接入 MIDI logger 与 Casio CZ-100 模拟合成器进行测试；再经数轮小提示（先改音符发送行为、再改 UI 指示）达到可用的核心交互，共完成 V1–V4 四版迭代。案例2（Continuator）：首提示12分钟即实现可加载/建模 MIDI 文件并以文本输出受约束结果；随后重排仓库并让 agent 修复构建；隔数日后再以1提示/4分钟实现正确定时的 MIDI 消息输出（在 Reaper DAW 中以 Rhodes 电钢琴验证）；与原作者 Pachet 合作让其在本机构建并于 Logic Pro 中运行 AudioUnit 版本，随后2轮提示补全「call and response」完整行为；Pachet 提出「以 Python 还是 C++ 为修复基准的规范版本」及「如何验证正确性」等问题。案例3（OpenGL tracker，约85分钟、10次提示）：首提示引用 libs/JUCE/examples 并附2D界面截图，约10分钟后产出无法编译的构建，经「运行 cmake 并修复错误」提示30秒内修复；随后2次提示分别解决文字数据贴附于方块表面（生成缓存纹理贴图叠加）与鼠标控制相机缩放/视角；后期混合人工代码编辑（利用 agent 的代码解释与重构能力）达成运行于自研硬件外壳的版本。总体模式一致：项目准备（仓库、模板、文档、参考示例、测试构建）→ 大提示 → 提示处理 → 测试 → 多轮小提示-测试迭代；并行工作流（在 agent 构建下一版时测试当前版并预备下一条提示）显著加速。观察：Codex 能处理晦涩的编译错误并解释修复过程；音频与 GUI 间线程安全数据共享等「高级插件概念」也可用自然语言实现，前提是使用者理解其基本概念。
AI.conclusion: 结论：借助合适的起始模板与文档投喂，ASE 可以在几乎不掌握底层 C++ 实现的前提下，仅用自然语言提示开发出可互操作、可加载进任意 DAW 的原生 C++ 音频插件——Music Mouse 案例仅凭手册与截图重建，Continuator 案例把依赖 pip 包与虚拟环境的 Python 系统彻底原生化。这对提升 SDMI 的互操作性与寿命、以及降低非程序员音乐家的创作门槛具有明确潜力；但前提条件也很明确：需精心设计的 starter program、需事先正确安装较复杂的工具链、需具备 MIDI/时序等音乐技术领域知识。局限：研究仅有一名作者、单一 agent（Codex）、自传式单一视角，缺乏对照与量化评估；对非程序员的门槛降低效果尚未验证（后续将开发支持非程序员自建插件的工作坊材料）；代码正确性/验证方法（如 Continuator 的「规范版本」与正确性判定）仍待解决；作者亦声明伦理议题未在本文展开。未来方向包括面向非程序员的工作坊，以及批量重实现文献中经典 SDMI 的插件套件，以避免其在遗忘中消亡。

title: Multi-objective application placement in fog computing using graph neural network-based reinforcement learning
summary: We propose a framework designed to tackle a multi-objective optimization challenge related to the placement of applications in fog computing, employing a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approach. Unlike other optimization techniques, such as integer linear programming or genetic algorithms, DRL models are applied in real time to solve similar problem situations after training. Our model comprises a learning process featuring a graph neural network and two actor-critics, providing a holistic perspective on the priorities concerning interconnected services that constitute an application. The learning model incorporates the relationships between services as a crucial factor in placement decisions: Services with higher dependencies take precedence in location selection. Our experimental investigation involves illustrative cases where we compare our results with baseline strategies and genetic algorithms. We observed a comparable Pareto set with negligible execution times, measured in the order of milliseconds, in contrast to the hours required by alternative approaches.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a DRL-based framework using graph neural networks and actor-critic mechanisms for multi-objective application placement in fog computing, achieving real-time optimization (milliseconds) with quality comparable to genetic algorithms.
AI.motivation: Traditional optimization methods (integer linear programming, genetic algorithms) for fog computing application placement require substantial computation time (hours) and cannot adapt to real-time scenarios. There is a need for faster, adaptable solutions that can be applied in real-time.
AI.method: A deep reinforcement learning approach featuring a graph neural network and dual actor-critic architecture to model service dependencies and priorities for multi-objective application placement in fog computing environments.
AI.result: The DRL framework achieves a comparable Pareto set to genetic algorithms while reducing execution time from hours to milliseconds. The approach effectively captures service interdependencies, prioritizing services with higher dependencies in location selection.
AI.conclusion: The proposed DRL framework with graph neural network and actor-critic architecture effectively solves fog computing application placement in real-time, achieving comparable Pareto-optimal solutions with millisecond-level execution compared to hours required by traditional optimization methods.

title: Asymmetric Generative Recommendation via Multi-Expert Projection and Multi-Faceted Hierarchical Quantization
summary: Generative Recommendation (GenRec) models reformulate recommendation as a sequence generation task, representing items as discrete Semantic IDs used symmetrically as both inputs and prediction targets. We identify a critical dual-stage information bottleneck in this design: (1) the Input Bottleneck, where lossy quantization degrades fine-grained semantics, while popularity bias skews the learned representations toward frequent items, and (2) the Output Bottleneck, where imprecise discrete targets limit supervision quality. To address these issues, we propose AsymRec, an asymmetric continuous-discrete framework that decouples input and output representations. Specifically, Multi-expert Semantic Projection (MSP) maps continuous embeddings into the Transformer's hidden space via expert-specialized projections, preserving semantic richness and improving generalization to infrequent items. Multi-faceted Hierarchical Quantization (MHQ) constructs high-capacity, structured discrete targets through multi-view and multi-level quantization with semantic regularization, preventing dimensional collapse while retaining fine-grained distinctions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AsymRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative recommenders by an average of 15.8 %. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成式推荐中的双阶段信息瓶颈问题，提出非对称连续-离散框架AsymRec，通过MSP保持输入语义完整性，通过MHQ构建高质量离散输出，在实验中取得15.8%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式推荐(GenRec)模型存在关键的双阶段信息瓶颈问题：(1) 输入瓶颈：量化过程导致有损压缩降级细粒度语义，且流行度偏差使表征偏向高频物品；(2) 输出瓶颈：离散目标不够精确限制了监督质量。
AI.method: 提出了AsymRec非对称框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 多专家语义投影(MSP)，通过专家专业化投影将连续嵌入映射到Transformer隐藏空间；(2) 多面分层量化(MHQ)，通过多视图多层次量化构建高容量结构化离散目标，并引入语义正则化防止维度崩溃。
AI.result: 实验表明AsymRec相比现有生成式推荐方法平均提升15.8%。
AI.conclusion: AsymRec通过非对称设计有效解决了GenRec中的信息瓶颈问题，在保持输入端语义完整性的同时构建了高质量的离散输出目标，显著提升了推荐性能。

title: Derivation Prompting: A Logic-Based Method for Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: The application of Large Language Models to Question Answering has shown great promise, but important challenges such as hallucinations and erroneous reasoning arise when using these models, particularly in knowledge-intensive, domain-specific tasks. To address these issues, we introduce Derivation Prompting, a novel prompting technique for the generation step of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework. Inspired by logic derivations, this method involves deriving conclusions from initial hypotheses through the systematic application of predefined rules. It constructs a derivation tree that is interpretable and adds control over the generation process. We applied this method in a specific case study, significantly reducing unacceptable answers compared to traditional RAG and long-context window methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"推导提示"的新型提示技术，通过在检索增强生成框架中构建可解释的推导树来应对大语言模型在知识密集型问答任务中的幻觉和错误推理问题。
AI.motivation: Address hallucinations and erroneous reasoning in LLMs when applied to knowledge-intensive, domain-specific Question Answering tasks.
AI.method: Derivation Prompting - a novel prompting technique for the generation step of RAG that involves deriving conclusions from initial hypotheses through systematic application of predefined rules, constructing an interpretable derivation tree.
AI.result: The method was applied in a case study and demonstrated significant reduction in unacceptable answers.
AI.conclusion: Significantly reducing unacceptable answers compared to traditional RAG and long-context window methods.

title: Beyond Mode-Seeking RL: Trajectory-Balance Post-Training for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models are a promising alternative to autoregressive models, yet post-training methods for them largely adapt reward-maximizing objectives. We identify a central failure mode in this setting we call trajectory locking: sampled reward-driven updates over-concentrate probability mass onto a narrow set of denoising paths, reducing coverage of alternative correct solutions under repeated sampling. To address this, we propose TraFL (Trajectory Flow baLancing), a trajectory-balance objective that trains the policy toward a reward-tilted target distribution anchored to a frozen reference model. We make this practical for diffusion language models with a diffusion-compatible sequence-level surrogate and a learned prompt-dependent normalization. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, TraFL is the only evaluated post-training method that improves over the base model in every benchmark-length setting, with gains that persist as the sampling budget increases. The improvements transfer to held-out evaluations: TraFL stays above the base model on Minerva Math and is the strongest method on every LiveCodeBench difficulty split.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TraFL（Trajectory Flow Balancing），一种面向扩散语言模型（dLLM）的后训练目标：不再直接最大化奖励，而是让当前策略去拟合一个以冻结参考模型为锚、按奖励倾斜的目标分布 p*(τ|x) ∝ p_ref(τ|x)·exp(βr(x,y))，从而抑制"轨迹锁定"（trajectory locking）导致的解覆盖坍缩。实现上用掩码重建下界导出的序列级对数概率代理 + 可学习的提示依赖归一化头 log Z_φ(x)。在 GSM8K/MATH-500/HumanEval/MBPP 的全部 8 个"基准×长度"设置上，TraFL 是唯一全部优于基座模型的后训练方法（平均 +2.0 Pass@5），并在 Minerva Math 与 LiveCodeBench（每个难度分段最优）上保持迁移优势；LLM-as-judge 评测显示其增益来自正确解策略覆盖变广，而非单模态锐化。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（LLaDA、Dream 等）缺乏自回归模型那样的从左到右 token 级条件分解，无法直接套用 PPO/GRPO；现有方法（diffu-GRPO、wd1、SPG、ESPO、JustGRPO、TraceRL 等）本质上仍是奖励最大化。作者指出这类目标的共同失效模式是"轨迹锁定"（trajectory locking）：终端奖励只对最终补全 y 赋值，对产生该 y 的去噪路径无差别（Proposition 1，路径无关性）；在采样式策略梯度更新下，早期被更频繁采样的路径获得更多正更新，形成自强化反馈，使概率质量逐步坍缩到少数去噪路径上。Theorem 1/Corollary 1 进一步表明轨迹多样性是终端解模式覆盖的必要条件（|supp(M)| ≤ |supp(τ)|，H(M) ≤ H(τ)），路径坍缩必然导致解覆盖坍缩。已有的分布匹配方法（DMPO、FlowRL）虽以奖励倾斜分布为目标，但其归一化项若用 rollout buffer 的 batch-softmax 估计，则同样是 rollout-local 的，会在采样集中后形成自强化集中（App. C.6 的 replicator 动力学分析）。因此需要一个既避免轨迹锁定、又对 dLLM 实际可实现的 post-training 目标。
AI.method:
1) 目标分布：定义奖励倾斜的轨迹分布 p*(τ|x) = p_ref(τ|x)exp(βr(x,y))/Z(x)，其中 p_ref 为冻结参考模型，β>0 控制奖励锐度，Z(x) 为提示依赖归一化项；奖励只决定"每个补全获得多少质量"，参考模型决定"质量在路径/补全间的相对分配"，从而解耦奖励放大与路径集中。

2) 轨迹平衡损失：定义残差 δ(τ,x)=log p_θ(τ|x) − log p_ref(τ|x) − βr(x,y) + log Z(x)，最小化 L_TraFL = E_{τ~p_θ}[δ²]；残差为零时策略与奖励倾斜的参考轨迹分布一致。

3) 扩散兼容的序列级代理：dLLM 不暴露精确轨迹对数概率，故用掩码重建下界（masked-reconstruction lower bound）导出 log p̂_θ(y|x)：采样掩码层级 l∼Uniform(1..L)，随机遮蔽 l 个补全 token，一次前向计算掩码位平均对数概率（1/l 因子用于消除掩码个数带来的量级依赖，使分数为逐位置量；类比 Dr. GRPO 中 |o_i| 归一化偏差的问题），对当前与参考模型使用相同掩码模式以降方差，并用 4 个对偶（antithetic）复制做 MC 估计，仅掩蔽非 eos 位置。

4) 可学习的提示依赖归一化：log Z_φ(x) 由 2 层 MLP 在均值池化的提示隐状态上参数化，backbone 特征 detach，与策略联合训练；与 DMPO 的 batch-softmax 估计不同，该头在每一步都获得梯度信号，不论采样到哪些补全，从而能对抗采样集中。

5) 训练：完全在线 RL，每步采样 5 条 rollout，用组内中心化奖励 r̃（作为方差缩减启发式，非对理想分布的精确改写），一次梯度更新；LLaDA-8B-Instruct + LoRA（r=128, α=128），峰值 lr 6e-5 余弦衰减至 6e-6；数学分别用 GSM8K(7,473) 与 MATH(7,500) 训练两个 checkpoint，代码用过滤后 AceCode-89K(11,937)+KodCode-Light-RL-10K(2,695) 共 14,632 例，奖励均为二值（精确匹配/执行通过）。

6) 评测：fastdLLM 并行解码、低置信度掩码、block size 32、top-p 0.91，最大长度 256/512，n=16 采样，用 HumanEval 无偏估计器计算 Pass@k；温度 T∈{0.3,0.6,0.9}；基线为 JustGRPO 与 ESPO 的公开 checkpoint（同解码协议），D1/DMPO 仅引用其原文数字作参考。LLM-as-judge 用 GPT-5-4 对两组 16 条回复做策略多样性两两比较（随机顺序 + 单侧精确符号检验），区分"全样本"与"仅正确解"两种设置。
AI.result: 采样预算与温度：TraFL 在所有 k∈{1,2,4,8,16}、T∈{0.3,0.6,0.9} 下均优于基座，T=0.9 且 k 增大时差距最大，说明收益来自更探索性的采样而非牺牲 Pass@1；T=0.6 是基座最强的解码设置，故选其做保守对比。Pass@5（n=16, T=0.6）：TraFL 是唯一在 8 个"基准×长度"设置上全部正提升的方法，平均 +2.0；MATH-500@256 由 50.2→54.6，HumanEval 53.2→54.8(256)/53.7→55.7(512)，MBPP 59.1→62.1/59.2→62.0。基线不稳定：ESPO 在 GSM8K-512 与 HumanEval-256 低于基座，JustGRPO 在 MBPP 大幅提升但在 GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH-500@512 下降。去噪步数上 TraFL 与基座、ESPO 相当，JustGRPO 提前终止且无一致增益（作者推测为过早的轨迹锁定）。留出评测：Minerva Math 上 TraFL 两个长度均高于基座并显著优于 JustGRPO，长度 512 达到最佳（GSM8K 训练 76.3、MATH 训练 75.8）；LiveCodeBench 上 TraFL 在每个难度分段、两个长度均为最优，整体由 53.8→62.6(256)、61.4→66.3(512)，其中 medium +7.9、hard +13.6（相对基座，@256），相对 JustGRPO 在 medium/hard 分别 +12.9/+27.6；ESPO 与 JustGRPO 整体低于基座。多样性 judge：全样本设置下 TraFL 在 MATH-500 显著优于基座（21.8 vs 15.4, p=2.3e-2），LiveCodeBench 不显著；仅正确解设置下信号更强，TraFL 优于基座（MATH-500 p=6.0e-3，LCB p=4.1e-5）与优于 ESPO（MATH-500 p=1.0e-3，LCB p=7.8e-4），而 ESPO 相对基座在两基准上均不显著。计算开销：8 卡（≥80GB）即可复现，数学实验约 10 GPU·小时、代码约 18 GPU·小时。
AI.conclusion: TraFL 将 dLLM 后训练从"直接奖励最大化"转为"拟合参考锚定的奖励倾斜目标分布"，通过轨迹平衡残差 + 扩散兼容序列级代理 + 学习式提示依赖归一化头，避免轨迹锁定带来的路径多样性与解覆盖坍缩。实验表明它是唯一在所有评测长度设置上稳定超越基座的后训练方法，收益随采样预算增大而保持甚至扩大，并迁移到 Minerva Math 与 LiveCodeBench；judge 分析表明增益来自覆盖更多不同正确解策略而非单一模态锐化。作者呼吁进一步探索面向 dLLM 的分布匹配式后训练目标。局限包括：使用代理似然而非精确轨迹对数概率、性能依赖掩码方案与 MC 估计设计；二值终端奖励过粗，当组内奖励全同（全部失败或全部成功）时中心化奖励无相对学习信号，训练对 rollout 多样性、组大小与任务难度敏感，罕见成功场景下学习效率受限；此外代理模型（CodeLlama-Instruct、GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1）用于数据过滤可能引入筛选偏差，作者未讨论。

title: PREPING: Building Agent Memory without Tasks
summary: Agent memory is typically constructed either offline from curated demonstrations or online from post-deployment interactions. However, regardless of how it is built, an agent faces a cold-start gap when first introduced to a new environment without any task-specific experience available. In this paper, we study pre-task memory construction: whether an agent can build procedural memory before observing any target-environment tasks, using only self-generated synthetic practice. Yet, synthetic interaction alone is insufficient, as without controlling what to practice and what to store, synthetic tasks become redundant, infeasible, and ultimately uninformative, and memory further degrades quickly due to unfiltered trajectories. To overcome this, we present Preping, a proposer-guided memory construction framework. At its core is proposer memory, a structured control state that shapes future practice. A Proposer generates synthetic tasks conditioned on this state, a Solver executes them, and a Validator determines which trajectories are eligible for memory insertion while also providing feedback to guide future proposals. Experiments on AppWorld, BFCL v3, and MCP-Universe show that Preping substantially improves over a no-memory baseline and achieves performance competitive with strong playbook-based methods built from offline or online experience, with deployment cost $2.99\times$ lower on AppWorld and $2.23\times$ lower on BFCL v3 than online memory construction. Further analyses reveal that the main benefit does not come from synthetic volume alone, but from proposer-side control over feasibility, redundancy, and coverage, combined with selective memory updates.

AI.tldr: 提出了Preping框架，通过提议者记忆引导自生成合成练习，在无需接触目标环境任务的情况下构建智能体程序记忆。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到竞争性能，同时显著降低部署成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体记忆通常从离线精选演示或在线部署后交互构建，但无论哪种方式，当智能体首次接触新环境时都面临冷启动问题——没有特定任务经验可用。本文研究如何利用自生成的合成练习，在观察到目标环境任务之前构建程序记忆。
AI.method: 提出Preping框架，通过提议者记忆（proposer memory）这一结构化控制状态引导未来练习。该框架包含三个核心组件：生成器（Proposer）基于提议者记忆生成合成任务，执行器（Solver）执行这些任务，验证器（Validator）筛选符合条件的轨迹用于记忆插入并向生成器提供反馈。验证器同时决定哪些轨迹有资格进入记忆，并指导未来生成。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、BFCL v3和MCP-Universe三个基准测试上，Preping显著优于无记忆基线，且性能与基于离线或在线经验构建的强playbook方法相当。在部署成本方面，AppWorld降低2.99倍，BFCL v3降低2.23倍。
AI.conclusion: Preping通过生成器控制的合成练习实现了高效的事前记忆构建，在多个基准测试中达到与基于离线或在线经验的playbook方法相当的性能，同时大幅降低了部署成本。消融实验表明，主要收益来自生成器对任务可行性、去冗余和覆盖率的控制，而非单纯的合成数据量。

title: Branch-width of represented matroids in matrix multiplication time
summary:
For an $n$-element matroid $M$ given by an $n \times n$ matrix representation over a finite field $\mathbb F$ and an integer $k$, we present an $(O_{k,\mathbb F}(n^2)+O(n^ω))$-time algorithm that either finds a branch-decomposition of $M$ of width at most $k$, or confirms that the branch-width of $M$ is more than $k$, where $ω< 2.3714$ is the matrix multiplication exponent, and the $O_{k,\mathbb F}(\cdot)$-notation hides factors that depend on $k$ and $\mathbb F$ in a computable manner. All previous algorithms including Hliněný and Oum [SIAM J. Comput. (2008)] and Jeong, Kim, and Oum [SIAM J. Discrete Math. (2021)] run in at least $Ω(n^3)$ time. Moreover, if the input matrix representation is given by a standard form, our algorithm runs in $O_{k,\mathbb F}(n^2)$-time, since $O(n^ω)$-time is only needed for finding a standard form of the input matrix. When $M$ is given by an $m \times n$ matrix, the overhead for finding a standard form is $O(mn \min(m,n)^{ω-2})$.
  As corollaries, we obtain faster algorithms for rank-width of directed graphs and path-width of matroids represented over a fixed finite field. Furthermore, we also present an approximation algorithm for finding branch-width that works on infinite fields provided that the input matrix is of a standard form and contains a bounded number of distinct values of entries.
  To suggest that our algorithm is optimal, we observe that for every field $\mathbb F$, deciding whether the branch-width of a matroid represented over $\mathbb F$ is $0$ is as hard as deciding whether a square matrix over $\mathbb F$ is singular. Under the assumption that singularity testing requires $Ω(n^ω)$-time, this implies that the overhead of $O(n^ω)$ is unavoidable. We also show strengthenings of this observation to rule out some approximations under this assumption.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在有限域上给定矩阵表示的拟阵的分支宽度算法，时间复杂度 O(n²) + O(n^ω)，改进自之前的 Ω(n³)。
AI.motivation: 已知算法（如 Hliněný-Oum 2008, Jeong-Kim-Oum 2021）的复杂度至少为 Ω(n³)，希望通过改进算法设计将复杂度降低到接近矩阵乘法最优时间。
AI.method: 使用矩阵表示的标准形转换结合分支分解搜索算法，通过矩阵乘法指数 ω 优化矩阵运算。
AI.result: 在 n×n 矩阵表示下达到 (O_{k,𝔽}(n²) + O(n^ω)) 时间，对标准形输入达到 O_{k,𝔽}(n²)。推论包括有向图秩宽和有限域上拟阵路径宽的更快算法，以及对无限域上含有限个不同条目的标准形矩阵的近似算法。
AI.conclusion: 该算法首次将时间复杂度降至 O(n²) 量级（标准形式输入），并在条件假设下证明了 O(n^ω) 开销的最优性下界。

title: Multi-Agentic Approach for History Matching of Oil Reservoirs
summary: History matching is a central inverse problem in reservoir engineering, where uncertain reservoir parameters must be calibrated against observations. Although automated history matching can reduce manual effort, practical deployment remains difficult because engineers must still configure heterogeneous workflows involving parameter selection, physically admissible bounds, optimizer choice, hyperparameter tuning, simulator execution, and diagnostic reporting. We propose PetroGraph, a multi-agent framework for intelligent reservoir history matching that decomposes this workflow into specialized agents for model review, experimental planning, parameterization, optimization, simulation, and summarization. The system combines large language model agents with domain-specific tools, retrieval-augmented access to simulator documentation, validation of modified ECLIPSE input decks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and an OPM Flow-based simulation backend. This design enables users to initiate and steer history matching through natural language while preserving explicit control over selected parameters and optimization settings. We evaluate PetroGraph on three reservoir models of increasing complexity: the synthetic SPE1 model, the faulted SPE9 benchmark, and the real-field Norne model. Using weighted normalized root mean square error as the objective, PetroGraph reduces the mismatch by 95% on SPE1, 69% on SPE9, and 13% on Norne. These results demonstrate that multi-agent orchestration can automate key decisions in history matching, lower the expertise barrier for operating complex simulation workflows, and provide a flexible foundation for extensible, domain-aware reservoir model adaptation.

AI.tldr: PetroGraph是一个用于智能油藏历史拟合的多智能体框架，通过将工作流分解为专业智能体（模型审查、实验规划、参数化、优化、模拟、总结），结合LLM、领域工具、RAG文档检索、ECLIPSE验证和OPM Flow后端，实现通过自然语言启动和引导历史拟合过程。在SPE1、SPE9和Norne三个油藏模型上的实验验证了框架有效性。
AI.motivation: 油藏历史拟合是油藏工程中的核心反问题，尽管自动化方法可减少人工工作量，但实际部署仍面临挑战：工程师需配置异构工作流（参数选择、物理可行边界、优化器选择、超参数调优、模拟器执行、诊断报告等），复杂度高且需领域专业知识。
AI.method: 提出PetroGraph多智能体框架，将油藏历史拟合工作流分解为模型审查、实验规划、参数化、优化、模拟和总结等专业智能体；集成LLM智能体、领域专用工具、基于RAG的模拟器文档检索、ECLIPSE输入卡验证、人在回路检查点，以及OPM Flow模拟后端。
AI.result: 在SPE1合成模型上降低不匹配度95%，SPE9断层模型上降低69%，Norne实际油田模型上降低13%。
AI.conclusion: PetroGraph 通过多智能体编排实现油藏历史拟合自动化，在三个不同复杂度的油藏模型上验证有效，降低了专业门槛，提供了可扩展的领域感知油藏模型适配基础。

title: GGBound: A Genome-Grounded Agent for Microbial Life-Boundary Prediction
summary: Characterizing the physiological life boundaries of microbial strains, including viable temperature, pH, salinity, substrate utilization, and morphology, is central to biotechnology and ecology, yet traditionally requires exhaustive in vitro screening. Existing computational approaches either treat physiological traits as isolated supervised targets or repurpose biological foundation models as static encoders, leaving the genotype-to-physiology gap largely unbridged. We formulate microbial life-boundary prediction as a unified genome-to-physiology task and address it with a genome-conditioned, tool-augmented LLM agent. To support this task, we curate a strain-centric benchmark from IJSEM, NCBI, and BacDive covering 1,525 strains and 6,448 instances across viability intervals, environmental optima, substrate utilization, categorical traits, and morphology. Architecturally, the agent injects frozen LucaOne genome embeddings into a Qwen backbone via lightweight token fusion, and reasons over a similarity-based RAG module and a Genome-scale Metabolic Model (GEM) perturbation tool. We optimize the agent through a three-stage pipeline of gene-text alignment, agentic SFT on distilled trajectories, and GRPO with a novel counterfactual gene-grounding reward that reinforces the policy only when the authentic genome embedding causally improves correct-token generation relative to a zero-gene ablation. The resulting 4B-parameter agent matches or surpasses substantially larger frontier LLMs, with ablations confirming that genome-token fusion, dynamic tool use, and the counterfactual reward each yield distinct, significant gains.

AI.tldr: GGBound 将"微生物生命边界预测"形式化为统一的基因组到生理（genome-to-physiology）任务，构建了覆盖 1,525 株菌、6,448 个实例的菌株中心基准，并提出一个 4B 参数的基因组条件化工具增强 LLM 智能体：冻结的 LucaOne 基因组嵌入经轻量 MLP 投影为连续"基因 token"注入 Qwen3.5-4B 骨干，同时配备相似度 RAG 检索工具与基因组规模代谢模型（GEM）扰动工具；训练采用三阶段流程（基因–文本对齐、蒸馏轨迹上的 agentic SFT、GRPO），其核心创新是"反事实基因接地奖励"——只有当真实基因组嵌入相对零基因消融确实提升正确答案 token 的对数概率时才对策略加权，从而抑制语言先验与分类学记忆的依赖。模型在生理边界、最适条件、底物利用、分类生理与形态学五类任务上全面超过基座与融合模型，并在带菌株名条件下与 DeepSeek-V3.2/R1、GLM-4.7、Kimi-K2 等前沿大模型相当甚至更优。
AI.motivation: 表征微生物菌株的生理"生命边界"（生长温度/pH/盐度区间、最适条件、底物利用、形态）长期依赖高成本的体外筛选实验，基因组测序虽普及但基因型到生理表型的鸿沟仍未打通。现有方法存在三点不足：(1) 传统预测把生理性状当作孤立的监督目标（k-mer 特征、蛋白家族清单等手工特征 + 单一性状回归/分类器），彼此割裂且缺乏统一任务定义；(2) 生物学基础模型（DNABERT、ESM、Nucleotide Transformer、GenSLM、Evo、LucaOne 等）大多被当作静态编码器或零样本打分器，只服务于窄任务，无法自主选择、整合外部证据；(3) 缺少可检验"模型是否真的在用基因组推理"的评测设置，容易被分类学记忆（strain-name prior）误导。因此作者希望把问题重构为统一的 genome-to-physiology 任务，并让智能体以工具观察（数据库检索 + 代谢模拟）的形式动态获取证据，从而缩小湿实验搜索空间、加速对未充分表征菌株的可培养条件假设生成。
AI.method:
**1) 基准构建（保守式"证据→标签"管线）**
- 四阶段 LLM 抽取管线（DeepSeek-V3.2）处理 18,498 篇 IJSEM 文章：① 逐字检索含菌株级生理信息的段落与完整表格（禁止切碎表格、禁止推断）；② 区分 paper_strains 与 comparison_strains 并保留完整命名（含 sp. nov./T 等）；③ 仅对 paper_strains 做有界结构化性状抽取（~50 字段：栖息地、形态、生长区间、最适、代谢、培养条件等），严格逐字赋值与字段消歧（出芽方式不得映射为 motility、真菌 LSU 不得当 16S 等）；④ LLM 质量打分，仅保留 >7 分记录。得到 88,927 条高质量菌株记录。
- 跨库对齐：菌株名规范化（NCBI_scientific_name + NCBI_modifier）→ NCBI 基因组/蛋白匹配 43,649 实例 / 18,964 唯一菌株 → BacDive 匹配 17,796 株。
- 表征：LucaOne 编码基因序列，聚合为菌株级 CLS 向量（1×2560），作为遗传模态输入；并与 mean pooling / gene-set pooling / 蛋白家族清单 / k-mer 等基线做消融。
- 基准：5 大任务组、17 个子任务、6,448 实例（边界 987、最适 1,097、代谢 1,460、分类生理 740、形态 1,772），覆盖 1,525 菌株；评测时菌株名匿名化，基准与训练集严格不相交；RAG 检索排除查询菌株自身标签以防泄漏。

**2) 智能体架构**
- 基因组条件化：冻结 LucaOne → 两层 MLP 投影器 φ(·) → 连续 genome token z_i，与文本指令/工具观察/查询并列插入 Qwen3.5-4B（<gene> 占位符机制），无需改动骨干结构。
- 工具一（rag_tool）：在 8,000 株合成 SFT 库的基因嵌入空间做余弦相似度检索，返回 top-3 近邻菌株的真实表型标注。
- 工具二（gem_tool）：用 CarveMe 从蛋白序列重建菌株特异 GEM，配三种生物量模板（革兰阳性/阴性/古菌，后者基于 iAF692）× 6 种培养基扰动（去 SO4²⁻、Fe³⁺、NO3⁻、NO2⁻、O2 及五者同时去除），以"支持 ≥10% 最大生长速率的最小培养基"为判据，每菌株 18 条 GEM 观察。

**3) 三阶段训练**
- 阶段一 gene–text 对齐：全参指令微调（1 epoch，seq 1024，lr 2e-5，约 16h/8×H200）；数据来自 IJSEM 单性状 QA + Qwen3.5-27B 生成的多性状整体描述 QA，与后续 agent 训练数据不相交。
- 阶段二 agentic SFT：用 Qwen3.5-27B 教师对 8,000 株 BacDive 记录每样本生成 4 条工具轨迹（温度 1.0、top-p 0.95、最多 6 轮工具），按"生物学正确性优先"的字段感知排序选优；两轮重试阶段强制补充 gem_tool 证据；对仍错误的样本只做"答案清洗"（保留原工具轨迹、仅修正最终 rationale/答案），最终得到 54,249 条样本（29,914 清洗 + 24,335 直接正确）；仅优化模型自生成 token，工具观察不计入损失。
- 阶段三 GRPO：序列级奖励 R = 0.5·R_json + 1.0·R_corr + 1.0·R_tool + 1.0·R_no_tool；R_corr 按类型差异化（区间：覆盖且紧凑；最适：归一化误差；分类/形态：规范化后精确匹配；底物：2·MicroF1@5−1）；R_tool 按训练进度把目标调用数从 4.0 退火到 2.0，0 次调用 −1，超额调用递减但有下限。组内相对优势（组大小 4、rollout batch 64、lr 1e-6、最多 5 轮工具、KL 系数 0）。
- 反事实基因接地奖励：对同一采样完成序列做两次 teacher-forced 前向（真实基因嵌入 g 与零基因嵌入 0），计算答案 token 对数概率差 Δ_i = log π(y|x,g) − log π(y|x,0)，裁剪到 [−5, 5]，乘以正确性门控 max(R_corr,0) 与答案位置指示，仅在答案 token 上生效，权重 0.5。该设计确保"只有在基因组证据真正因果性地帮助生成正确 token 时才强化策略"，防止强化基因依赖但错误的预测。

**4) 评测**
- 指标：区间用 ICR（预测区间完全覆盖真值）、最实用 RMSE、底物用 mAP@5、分类/形态用准确率；另有工具调用次数统计与匿名/带菌株名两套设置。
AI.result:
**主结果（Table 1，匿名化基准）**：RL agent 在全部 17 个目标上均为最优，SFT agent 稳定第二。基座→融合→SFT→RL 呈单调提升，例如盐度区间 ICR 0.466→0.471→0.781→0.818；pH 区间 0.287→0.296→0.458→0.497；温度区间 0.157→0.163→0.179→0.182；电子受体 mAP@5 0.003→0.003→0.233→0.249；氮源 0.003→0.003→0.209→0.217；光合类型准确率 0.168→0.263→0.611→0.625；鞭毛 0.133→0.125→0.536→0.542；革兰染色 0.529→0.681→0.853→0.855；最优温度 RMSE 8.570→8.449→6.449→6.373。关键观察：单纯的基因–文本融合仅在连续量上带来有限收益，在多数分类/形态任务上甚至低于基座；性能跃升主要来自 agentic SFT（蒸馏轨迹教会证据获取与证据整合），RL 则提供幅度较小但一致的额外校准。

**工具使用（Table 2）**：基座/融合模型平均调用 6.97/6.66 次工具（主要是 GEM 5.9/5.6 次）但性能更差；SFT agent 大幅降至 1.57 次，RL 为 1.73 次。说明性能提升来自"更有选择性的证据获取"而非"更多调用"。

**与前沿大模型对比（带菌株名，Figure 3 / Table 6 / Table 7）**：GGBound 在最适条件（平均 RMSE 2.32）、代谢（0.53 vs 最强前沿模型 0.47）、分类生理（0.81 vs 0.70）、形态（0.86 vs 0.79）上优于 DeepSeek-V3.2、DeepSeek-R1、GLM-4.7、Kimi-K2；仅在生理边界 ICR 上落后于 GLM-4.7（0.50 vs GLM 更高）。加入菌株名后，代谢 mAP@5 由 0.16 升至 0.53、分类生理准确率由 0.52 升至 0.81，而边界 ICR 略降（0.50→0.48），说明名称先验与基因/工具证据在区间任务上偶有冲突；在代谢任务上基座模型（仅靠名称）反而最好（如碳源 0.677），提示直接模态融合在训练前可能与名称先验冲突。

**消融**：基因 token 融合、动态工具使用、反事实基因接地奖励各自带来可区分且显著的增益；训练损失三阶段均平滑下降，说明优化稳定。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是把"微生物生命边界预测"确立为一个统一的基因组到生理任务，并证明"基因组条件化 + 工具增强 + 强化学习"这条路线比单纯扩大通用 LLM 规模或把生物基础模型当静态编码器更有效：4B 的 GGBound 在多数任务上达到或超过 DeepSeek-V3.2/R1、GLM-4.7、Kimi-K2 等大模型。其方法论上的关键洞见是"因果接地"——通过零基因消融的对比优势显式奖励对基因组输入的依赖，可抑制智能体退化为语言先验/分类学记忆的捷径，这在生物医学智能体中是一条可迁移的训练范式。同时，作者明确列出主要局限：每株仅用一个 LucaOne CLS 向量映射为单一 token，基因级、通路级与结构信息严重压缩，对底物利用、代谢能力与胁迫应答等需要局部基因组证据的任务尤其不利；未来应探索多基因 token、基因集感知池化与对基因特征的适应性检索。应用层面，作者强调模型输出应视为待验证的假设而非实验指令，须经专家审核并遵循生物安全规范。

title: CRANE: Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing
summary: Code agents must both reason over long-horizon repository state and obey strict tool-use protocols. In paired Instruct/Thinking checkpoints, these capabilities are complementary but misaligned. The Instruct model is concise and tool-disciplined, whereas the Thinking model offers stronger planning and recovery behavior but often over-deliberates and degrades agent performance. We present CRANE (Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing), a training-free parameter-editing method that treats the Thinking-Instruct delta as a directional pool of candidate reasoning edits for the Instruct backbone. CRANE combines magnitude thresholding to denoise the delta, a Conservative Taylor Gate to retain edits that are jointly beneficial for reasoning transfer and tool-use preservation, and Graduated Sigmoidal Projection to suppress format-critical update directions. By merging paired Instruct and Thinking checkpoints, CRANE delivers strong gains over either individual model while preserving Instruct-level efficiency: on Roo-Eval it achieves pass1 of 66.2% (+19.5%) for Qwen3-30B-A3B and 81.5% (+8.7%) for Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B; on SWE-bench-Verified it resolves up to 14 additional instances at both scales (122/500 and 180/500); and on Terminal-Bench v2 it improves pass1/pass5 by up to 2.3%/7.8%, reaching 7.6%/17.9% and 14.8%/30.3%, respectively, consistently outperforming alternative merging strategies across all three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CRANE is a training-free method that merges Thinking and Instruct model checkpoints by treating their delta as a pool of reasoning edits, applying magnitude thresholding, a Conservative Taylor Gate, and Graduated Sigmoidal Projection to selectively inject reasoning capabilities while preserving tool-use efficiency. Achieves significant improvements on code agent benchmarks (Roo-Eval, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench) while maintaining Instruct-level efficiency.
AI.motivation: The fundamental challenge is that Instruct models and Thinking models exhibit complementary but misaligned capabilities: Instruct models are concise and tool-disciplined but lack strong planning/reasoning, while Thinking models have superior planning and recovery behavior but tend to over-deliberate, degrading agent performance. There's a need to combine the strengths of both checkpoint types without inheriting their weaknesses.
