AI.method: CRANE is a training-free parameter-editing method that operates on three key mechanisms: (1) Magnitude thresholding to denoise the Instruct-Think delta, (2) Conservative Taylor Gate to retain edits beneficial for both reasoning transfer and tool-use preservation, and (3) Graduated Sigmoidal Projection to suppress format-critical update directions. The method treats the Thinking-Instruct delta as a directional pool of candidate reasoning edits and applies constrained nullspace editing to the Instruct backbone.
AI.result: CRANE delivers substantial gains over both individual models while preserving Instruct-level efficiency. On Roo-Eval: 66.2% (+19.5%) for Qwen3-30B-A3B and 81.5% (+8.7%) for Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B. On SWE-bench-Verified: resolves 14 additional instances at both scales (122/500 and 180/500). On Terminal-Bench v2: up to 2.3%/7.8% improvement in pass1/pass5, reaching 7.6%/17.9% and 14.8%/30.3%. Consistently outperforms alternative merging strategies across all three benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: CRANE successfully merges Instruct and Thinking model checkpoints to achieve both strong reasoning capabilities and tool-use discipline. The method achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks (Roo-Eval, SWE-bench-Verified, Terminal-Bench v2) with significant improvements: 66.2% pass1 on Roo-Eval for Qwen3-30B-A3B (+19.5%), 81.5% pass1 for Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (+8.7%), and resolves up to 14 additional instances on SWE-bench-Verified, consistently outperforming alternative merging strategies.

title: Malleable Molecular Dynamics Simulations with GROMACS and DMR
summary: Static resource allocations in high-performance computing (HPC) lead to inefficiencies for time-varying workloads, causing idle resources, queue delays, and higher node-hour costs. The Dynamic Management of Resources (DMR) middleware enables MPI process malleability in Slurm via a simple API decoupled from scheduler internals. In this work, we integrate DMR into the GROMACS molecular dynamics engine to obtain a malleable variant that can dynamically adapt its MPI process count by combining communication-efficiency-aware reconfiguration with GROMACS' native checkpoint/restart mechanism. We evaluate this design on the MareNostrum~5 supercomputer, comparing dynamic runs against static executions and quantifying reconfiguration overheads, time-to-solution, and node-hour savings for bursty GROMACS workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文将 DMR（Dynamic Management of Resources）中间件以最小侵入方式集成进 GROMACS 分子动力学引擎，利用 GROMACS 原生 checkpoint/restart 机制与通信效率（CE）策略实现 MPI 进程数的运行时动态伸缩，并在 MareNostrum 5 上评估：动态作业在 31 个计算节点上以 11 次重配置、184.37 s（占 makespan 8.24%）的代价取得最短 makespan 2,236 s，静态 2 节点方案虽最慢（2,825 s）但最省节点小时（15.63 n-h）。作者声称这是首个 GROMACS 可变形（malleable）版本的开发与评估工作。
AI.motivation: HPC 生产环境普遍采用提交时静态分配资源的方式，当负载随时间变化时会造成节点闲置、队列排队延迟与节点小时成本上升。MPI 进程可变形性（process malleability）允许运行中的作业在资源管理器协调下动态扩缩进程数。GROMACS 作为广泛使用的分子动力学引擎，其传统执行模型假设固定的 MPI rank 数；而大型 GROMACS 计算活动通常由大量独立、异构且资源需求随时间变化的模拟构成，因此是该机制的理想候选对象。作者的目标是让 GROMACS 能在繁忙的生产超算环境中"抢占"波动的集群负载，从而改善周转时间与节点小时效率。
AI.method: 方法由两部分组成：（1）集成：DMR 在 GROMACS 启动早期通过 DMR_AUTO(dmr_init(...)) 初始化，dmr_init 会检查命令行参数并在缺失时自动插入 -cpi <checkpoint 文件> 与 -append；数据重分发参数有意置为 NULL，因为状态迁移完全交由 GROMACS 原生 checkpoint/restart 处理。在主分子动力学循环 gmx::LegacySimulator::do_md() 的时间步循环中插入 dmr_check(CE_POLICY) 判定点，若需重配置则置位 dmr_ready_reconfig 并在生成一致 checkpoint 后调用 dmr_reconfigure()，随后让 GROMACS 走正常退出路径，进程重分配与重启由 DMR 隐式完成（此处刻意不使用 DMR_AUTO 宏，因其默认行为会在生成一致 checkpoint 之前提前终止）。在 src/gromacs/mdlib/checkpointhandler.cpp 的 decideIfCheckpointingThisStepImpl() 中新增 dmr_get_last_action() 调用，若最近一次 DMR 动作为重配置，则等效于外部 checkpoint 信号，将 checkpoint 推迟到下一个 neighbor-search 步以保证状态一致。（2）评测：在 MareNostrum 5（GPP 分区，6,192 个 Intel Sapphire Rapids 节点，双路 Xeon Platinum 8480+ 共 112 核，256 GB DDR5，100 Gbit/s NDR200 InfiniBand，Slurm 24.11.6；Open MPI 5.1.0a1/PRRTE 5.0.0a1/OpenPMIX 7.0.0a1/DLB 3.5.0/DMR 2.0.1，Slurm4DMR 定制版）上，实验限定在 32 节点（1 个 Slurm 控制节点 + 31 计算节点）的 debug QoS 内、时长不超过 2 小时。应用为 GROMACS 2025.4，mdp 输入 stmv（卫星烟草花叶病毒，TIP3P 溶剂、CHARMM27 力场，1,066,628 原子，2 fs 步长，1.2 nm 截断，h-bond 约束，0.15 nm PME 网格，NVT 系综，5,000 步），每节点 1 个 MPI rank、每 rank 112 个 OpenMP 线程。CE_POLICY 通过 TALP 监视器测量通信效率（计算时间占比），目标 CE 95%：CE 偏高则扩容、偏低则收缩，每 500 时间步决策一次，并借助 DMR 的 inhibitor 机制施加基于时间步的重配置延迟。作业以 -N1-12 提交（可在 1–12 个节点间伸缩），每次实验提交 10 个零到达间隔的突发作业。对照组为静态 2 节点/作业 与 静态 12 节点/作业；计算成本由分配节点数时间曲线的梯形积分得到节点小时（net cost）。
AI.result: 静态 2 节点：10 个作业并行占 20 节点，CE 稳定接近最大值，makespan 2,825 s，net cost 15.63 n-h（最慢但最省）。静态 12 节点：因 31 节点上限仅 2 个作业并发（24 节点），CE 因通信开销上升而更低且波动更大，makespan 2,652 s，net cost 17.53 n-h。动态 [1–12] 节点：前四个作业分别以 12、12、6、1 节点启动占满 31 节点，12 节点作业因 CE 低于阈值收缩至 10 节点，释放资源后第五、六个作业各以 2 节点启动；资源就绪后作业异步等待下一个同步点再完成扩容（例如第五个作业在约 450 s 被排期扩容，但直到约 1,300 s 才实际扩容）。重配置共 11 次（5 次扩容、6 次收缩），总开销 184.37 s，占 makespan 的 8.24%；单次重配置耗时均值 16.76±10.54 s（区间 7.83–42.44 s），扩容均值 25.55±9.99 s（15.40–42.44 s）明显慢于收缩的 9.43±1.63 s（7.83–12.34 s），因为扩容需异步等待资源与较慢迭代推迟 dmr_check 调用。动态方案 makespan 最短 2,236 s，net cost 17.15 n-h；计入保留的 32 节点工作流总成本后分别为静态 2 节点 25.11 n-h、静态 12 节点 23.57 n-h、动态 19.87 n-h，即动态方案总成本最低。资源可用并不保证扩容：若 CE 已超目标阈值则不再申请新资源。
AI.conclusion: 最小侵入式集成（初始化、主循环、checkpoint 处理器三个插桩点 + 复用原生 C/R）即可为 GROMACS 带来可变形能力，在真实生产级超算环境中验证了通信效率驱动的动态资源管理可行：动态运行借助扩容获得最短 time-to-solution，重配置总开销仅占执行时间数个百分点，同时比静态方案节省约 15–17% 的总节点小时成本。文中强调这是首个 GROMACS 可变形版本。后续工作将结合 EUPilot/EUPilot 项目，开发基于长向量 RISC-V 的 GROMACS 版本，并通过 DMR 获得相同的 CE 驱动重配置能力，以形成贯穿当前 x86 超算与未来 RISC-V 加速器的统一可变形性方案。局限方面：实验仅在单一系统、单一负载（stmv）、31 计算节点与 2 小时窗口内进行，评测使用 Slurm4DMR 定制环境而非完全未经修改的生产 Slurm（尽管 DMR@Jobs 特性已支持标准 RMS），且动态方案的 net cost（17.15 n-h）实际略高于静态 2 节点方案（15.63 n-h），成本优势主要体现在计入预留节点后的总成本维度。

title: Discrimination Is Generation: Unifying Ranking and Retrieval from a Tokenizer Perspective
summary: Semantic IDs (SIDs) define the generation space of generative recommendation and directly determine its personalization ceiling. However, existing tokenizers are trained independently with retrieval objectives, leaving personalization signals fully decoupled from the SID construction process -- a fundamental gap that causes generative retrieval to persistently lag behind discriminative ranking. In this paper, we rethink the essence of SIDs: \emph{ranking seeks argmax in item space while retrieval seeks argmax in token space; both are the same problem solved at different granularities.} Based on this insight, we propose \DIG (\textbf{D}iscrimination \textbf{I}s \textbf{G}eneration), which embeds the tokenizer inside a discriminative ranking model for end-to-end training -- the ranker naturally becomes a retrieval model, yielding two models from a single training run. \DIG is organized around a \emph{feature assignment taxonomy}: item-intrinsic static features are encoded into SIDs, user-item cross features (u2i) implicitly drive codebook boundaries toward recommendation decision boundaries during training, and an MLP$_\mathrm{u2t}$ distillation module approximates u2i at the token level for inference. Experiments on three public benchmarks and two industrial datasets demonstrate that \DIG simultaneously improves ranking, retrieval, and unified retrieval-ranking quality.

AI.tldr: DIG重新定义了语义ID的本质——将判别式排序模型的训练嵌入到tokenizer中，通过特征分配分类学（item-intrinsic features→SIDs, user-item cross features→codebook boundaries, MLP_u2t distillation→inference）实现端到端训练，使ranker自然转化为retrieval model，一套训练流程同时获得排序和检索两个模型。
AI.motivation: Existing tokenizers for Semantic IDs (SIDs) are trained independently with retrieval objectives, causing personalization signals to be fully decoupled from SID construction. This fundamental gap causes generative retrieval to persistently lag behind discriminative ranking.
AI.method: DIG proposes an end-to-end training framework that embeds the tokenizer inside a discriminative ranking model. It employs a feature assignment taxonomy: (1) item-intrinsic static features are encoded into SIDs, (2) user-item cross features implicitly align codebook boundaries with recommendation decision boundaries during training, and (3) an MLP_u2t distillation module approximates u2i at the token level for inference. The ranker naturally becomes a retrieval model, yielding two models from a single training run.
AI.result: The proposed DIG framework simultaneously improves ranking, retrieval, and unified retrieval-ranking quality on three public benchmarks and two industrial datasets.
AI.conclusion: DIG achieves state-of-the-art performance by simultaneously improving ranking, retrieval, and unified retrieval-ranking quality, validated on three public benchmarks and two industrial datasets.

title: PEML: Parameter-efficient Multi-Task Learning with Optimized Continuous Prompts
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is widely used for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) for various tasks. Recently, there has been an increasing demand for fine-tuning a single LLM for multiple tasks because it requires overall less data for fine-tuning thanks to the common features shared among tasks. More importantly, LLMs are resource demanding and deploying a single model for multiple tasks facilitates resource consolidation and consumes significantly less resources compared to deploying individual large model for each task. Existing PEFT methods like LoRA and Prefix Tuning are designed to adapt LLMs to a specific task. LoRA and its variation focus on aligning the model itself for tasks, overlooking the importance of prompt tuning in multi-task learning while Prefix Tuning only adopts a simple architecture to optimize prompts, which limits the adaption capabilities for multi-task. To enable efficient fine-tuning for multi-task learning, it is important to co-optimize prompt optimization and model adaptation. In this work, we propose a Parameter-Efficient Multi-task Learning (\PM), which employs a neural architecture engineering method for optimizing the continuous prompts while also performing low-rank adaption for model weights. We prototype PEML by creating an automated framework for optimizing the continuous prompts and adapting model weights. We evaluate PEML against state-of-the-arts multi-task learning methods MTL-LoRA, MultiLoRa, C-Poly, and MoE, on the GLUE, SuperGLUE, Massive Multitask Language Understanding, and commonsense reasoning benchmarks. The evaluation results present an average accuracy improvement of up to 6.67%, with individual tasks showing peak gains of up to 10.75%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PEML，一种结合连续提示优化和模型权重低秩适配的参数高效多任务学习方法。通过自动搜索框架协同优化提示与模型，在多个基准测试中取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法（如LoRA和Prefix Tuning）专为单任务设计，难以高效处理多任务场景。LoRA专注于模型对齐而忽略提示调优的重要性，Prefix Tuning架构简单限制了多任务适应能力。因此需要一种能够协同优化提示和模型适应的新方法。
AI.method: 提出PEML框架，采用神经架构工程方法同时优化连续提示并对模型权重进行低秩适配。该方法通过自动搜索框架同时调整提示参数和模型参数。
AI.result: 在GLUE、SuperGLUE、MMLU和常识推理基准测试中，PEML相比MTL-LoRA、MultiLoRa、C-Poly和MoE等先进方法实现平均准确率提升6.67%，单任务峰值提升达10.75%。
AI.conclusion: PEML通过结合连续提示优化和低秩适应，在多任务学习中实现了最先进的性能，验证了协同优化提示和模型权重的重要性。

title: Towards the Next Frontier of LLMs, Training on Private Data: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Federated Fine-Tuning
summary:
The recent success of large language models (LLMs) has been largely driven by vast public datasets. However, the next frontier for LLM development lies beyond public data. Much of the world's most valuable information is private, especially in highly regulated sectors such as healthcare and finance, where data include patient histories or customer communications. Unlocking this data could represent a major leap forward, enabling LLMs with deeper domain expertise and stronger real-world utility. Yet, these data cannot be shared because they are distributed across institutions and constrained by privacy, regulatory, and organizational barriers. Moreover, institutional datasets are typically non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID), differing across sites in population characteristics, data modalities, documentation patterns, and task-specific label distributions.
  In this paper, we demonstrate a practical approach to unlocking private and distributed institutional data for LLM adaptation through federated collaboration across data silos. Built on the Sherpa.ai Federated Learning platform, our framework enables nodes to jointly fine-tune a shared LLM without exchanging private data. We evaluate this approach through a cross-domain benchmark in healthcare and finance, using four closed-ended question answering and classification datasets: MedQA, MedMCQA, FPB, and FiQA-SA. We compare three parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategies-LoRA, QLoRA, and IA3-across pretrained backbones under non-IID settings reflecting institutional data heterogeneity. Our results show that federated fine-tuning performs close to centralized training and outperforms isolated single-institution learning. From a Green AI perspective, QLoRA and IA3 improve efficiency with limited accuracy degradation, supporting federated PEFT as a viable approach for adapting LLMs where data cannot be shared.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于联邦学习的框架，在不交换私有数据的情况下跨数据孤岛联合微调LLM。实验表明联邦微调接近集中式训练效果，QLoRA和IA3是平衡效率与精度的有效PEFT策略，为隐私约束环境下的LLM适配提供了可行方案。
AI.motivation: LLM发展的重要方向是利用私有数据，但医疗和金融等高价值数据受隐私和法规约束无法共享，且机构数据通常是非独立同分布的（non-IID），如何在保护数据隐私的同时利用分布式数据提升模型能力是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 基于Sherpa.ai联邦学习平台，在非IID设置下对比了三种参数高效微调策略（LoRA、QLoRA、IA3）在预训练模型上的表现，跨医疗和金融领域的四个问答和分类数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 联邦微调性能接近集中式训练，显著优于单机构隔离学习；QLoRA和IA3在有限精度损失下提升了效率。
AI.conclusion: QLoRA和IA3在保持精度的同时提高了效率，证明联邦PEFT是解决数据隐私隔离问题的可行方案，可用于在无法共享数据的环境中适配LLM。

title: PolitNuggets: Benchmarking Agentic Discovery of Long-Tail Political Facts
comment: 24 pages, 7 figues, accpeted in The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) embedded in agentic frameworks have transformed information retrieval from static, long context question answering into open-ended exploration. Yet real world use requires models to discover and synthesize "long-tail" facts from dispersed sources, a capability that remains under-evaluated. We introduce PolitNuggets, a multilingual benchmark for agentic information synthesis via constructing political biographies for 400 global elites, covering over 10000 political facts. We standardize evaluation with an optimized multi agent system and propose FactNet, an evidence conditional protocol that scores discovery, fine-grained accuracy, and efficiency. Across models and settings, we find that current systems often struggle with fine-grained details, and vary substantially in efficiency. Finally, using benchmark diagnostics, we relate agent performance to underlying model capabilities, highlighting the importance of short-context extraction, multilingual robustness, and reliable tool use.

AI.tldr: The paper introduces PolitNuggets, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating agentic information synthesis through political biography construction tasks. Using an optimized multi-agent evaluation system with FactNet protocol, they assess discovery, accuracy, and efficiency across models. Results reveal that current systems have difficulty with fine-grained details and vary in efficiency, with performance hinging on short-context extraction, multilingual capability, and tool use reliability.
AI.motivation: Existing benchmarks focus on static question answering with long contexts, but real-world applications demand models to discover and synthesize "long-tail" facts from dispersed sources—a capability that remains under-evaluated. There was a need for a benchmark targeting multilingual, open-ended information synthesis from distributed sources.
AI.method: The authors developed PolitNuggets benchmark comprising 400 global political elites and 10,000+ political facts. They constructed an optimized multi-agent evaluation system and proposed FactNet, an evidence conditional protocol that assesses three dimensions: discovery completeness, fine-grained accuracy, and efficiency. Experiments were conducted across various models and settings.
AI.result: Current LRM-based agentic systems often struggle with fine-grained details and exhibit substantial variance in efficiency. Performance is strongly correlated with short-context extraction ability, multilingual robustness, and reliable tool use.
AI.conclusion: Short-context extraction, multilingual robustness, and reliable tool use are critical capabilities that determine agent performance in complex information synthesis tasks.

title: Hardness of Burning Number Problem on Regular Graphs
summary: The Burning Number Problem (BNP) models the spread of information or contagion in a network through a discrete-time process on a graph. At each step, one new vertex is selected as a burning source, while fire simultaneously spreads from previously burned vertices to their neighbors. The burning number of a graph is the minimum number of steps required to burn all vertices. The decision version asks whether the burning number is at most a given integer $k$. BNP is known to be NP-complete even on restricted graph classes such as path forests. We study BNP on connected regular graphs, a natural and previously unexplored graph class. We prove that BNP is NP-complete on connected cubic graphs, and moreover APX-hard under this restriction. We further show that BNP remains APX-hard on connected $d$-regular graphs for every fixed $d \geq 4$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了燃烧数问题（BNP）在连通正则图上是NP完全的且APX-难的，确立了问题的计算复杂性下界。
AI.motivation: BNP已被证明在路径森林等受限图类上是NP难的，但连通正则图作为一类自然且重要的图结构此前未被研究，需要探明BNP在此类图上的计算复杂性。
AI.method: 通过归约技术将已知的NP难问题归约到连通正则图上的BNP；利用分布参数构造问题实例建立APX-难性。
AI.result: 证明了BNP在连通三次图上是NP完全的且是APX-难的；对于任意固定d≥4，连通d正则图上BNP仍保持APX-难性。
AI.conclusion: BNP在连通正则图类上是NP完全的，且对任意固定度d≥3的连通d正则图都是APX-难的。这确立了该问题在此类图上的计算复杂性下界。

title: GAMBIT: A Three-Mode Benchmark for Adversarial Robustness in Multi-Agent LLM Collectives
summary: In multi-agent systems (MAS), a single deceptive agent can nullify all gains of an agentic AI collective and evade deployed defenses. However, existing adversarial studies on MAS target only shallow tasks and do not consider adaptive adversaries, which evolve their strategies to evade the very detectors trained to catch them. To address that gap, we introduce GAMBIT, a benchmark with three evaluation modes and two independent scores for evaluating imposter detectors: the first two modes measure zero-shot detection under increasing distribution shift, and a third recalibration mode measures how quickly a detector adapts to novel attacks from just 20 labeled examples. The benchmark comes with a dataset of 27,804 labeled instances spanning 240 co-evolved imposter strategies. Our contributions are threefold: (1) Using chess as a substrate deep reasoning problem and Gemini 3.1 Pro for agents, we release GAMBIT and its dataset to evaluate imposter detectors under realistic constraints against a stealthy adaptive imposter; (2) We introduce an adaptive imposter agent based on an efficient evolutionary framework, generalizable beyond chess, that collapses collective task performance while remaining essentially undetectable (50.5% F1-score with a Gemini-based detector); (3) We show that zero-shot evaluation can be highly misleading for adaptive adversaries: two detectors with near-identical zero-shot scores differ by 8x on few-shot adaptation, while the meta-learned variant converges 20x faster, a gap only visible in the recalibration mode. Altogether, GAMBIT provides the first multi-agent benchmark where adversarial attacks and defenses co-evolve, with an imposter framework generalizable beyond our use case, and promising techniques for fast recalibration in a rapidly evolving adversarial system. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/gambit.

AI.tldr: GAMBIT是一个用于评估多智能体系统中冒充智能体检测器的新基准测试，通过国际象棋和Gemini 3.1 Pro构建包含240种自适应攻击策略的27,804样本数据集，证明零样本评估对自适应对抗存在重大误导性，并提出快速重校准技术应对动态演化威胁。
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体系统对抗研究仅针对浅层任务，且未考虑自适应对抗——即能演化策略规避检测器的智能体。现实中单一代替智能体即可抵消整个智能体集体的收益并逃逸现有防御，现有基准缺乏对此类威胁的系统性评估。
AI.method: 以国际象棋为深层推理载体，采用Gemini 3.1 Pro构建智能体，通过高效进化框架生成240种共演化冒充策略，构建包含27,804个标注样本的数据集。基准测试包含三种评估模式：两种零样本检测模式（应对递增分布偏移）和一种重校准模式（从仅20个标注样本快速适应新攻击）。
AI.result: 进化冒充智能体可导致集体任务性能崩溃，同时保持基本不可检测状态（基于Gemini的检测器仅达50.5% F1分数）。零样本评估对自适应对抗具有高度误导性：两个零样本分数相近的检测器在少样本适应上差异达8倍；元学习变体收敛速度快20倍——这一差距仅在重校准模式中可见。
AI.conclusion: GAMBIT是首个多智能体对抗攻防共同演化基准测试，其进化框架具有跨领域泛化能力，并提出了快速重校准技术应对动态对抗系统。

title: The Racial Character of Computer Graphics Research
summary: Computer graphics algorithms for generating photorealistic imagery are widely perceived to be universal, and capable of conjuring anything that a filmmaker or game designer can imagine. However, recent works have suggested that 3D algorithms for depicting synthetic humans are far from generic, and instead favor historically hegemonic characteristics. We present the first systematic review of human depiction in the top computer graphics conference and the journal of record (SIGGRAPH and ACM Transactions on Graphics) that confirms previous hypotheses. Algorithms that claim to be generically rendering "human skin'' are in fact imagined and formulated for translucent, "high albedo" materials such as white skin. Algorithms claiming to apply generically to "human hair" are formulated for "rods", "wires" and "threads" which are analogous to straight hair. Our analysis reveals conceptual binarization, where algorithms for white skin are treated as computational substrate for "all" skin, imposing a hierarchical assumption that all skin descends from the math and physics of white skin. Hair algorithms follow a similar historical pattern, with the first examples of computer-generated Type 4 hair only appearing after the murder of George Floyd in 2020. We offer a new conceptual label, McDaniels Methods, for characterizing and critiquing computer graphics algorithms that reinforce racial hierarchy under a false cover of diversity. We also offer an inverse label, Durald Methods, for algorithms that were closely co-designed with the people being depicted. Our analysis points the way towards several neglected avenues for future research.

AI.tldr: 该文系统性审查了计算机图形学顶会（SIGGRAPH等）中的人类描绘算法，发现标榜"通用"的皮肤和头发渲染算法实则偏向白人族群特征，提出"McDaniels Methods"批判此类隐性种族偏见，并指出多个未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 质疑计算机图形学算法是否真正具有通用性；验证关于3D人类描绘算法偏向历史上霸权特征（白人特征）的假设。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，分析SIGGRAPH和ACM Transactions on Graphics上发表的人类描绘相关论文；案例研究包括皮肤渲染算法和头发渲染算法；历史时间线分析（特别是2020年George Floyd事件后Type 4头发算法才出现）。
AI.result: 确认了假设：皮肤渲染算法实际针对"高反照率"的半透明白色皮肤材料；头发算法针对直发的"杆状"、"线状"、"线程状"模型；存在概念二元化问题——白色皮肤算法被视为所有皮肤的计算基础，形成等级假设；直到2020年George Floyd事件后才出现首个计算机生成的Type 4（卷曲）头发算法。
AI.conclusion: 作者引入了"McDaniels Methods"标签来批判以多样性掩盖种族等级强化的算法，并提出"Durald Methods"作为反例。还指出了多个未来研究的空白领域，如针对不同肤色的专门算法开发、头发渲染技术的改进等。

title: LLM-Based Robustness Testing of Microservice Applications: An Empirical Study
summary: Malformed, missing, or boundary-value inputs in microservice APIs can cascade across dependent services, threatening reliability. Robustness testing systematically exercises such inputs to expose server-side failures, but generating diverse, effective tests remains challenging. Large Language Models can generate such tests from API specifications; however, it is unknown whether different models and prompt strategies produce diverse failure sets or converge on the same failures. We report a controlled experiment applying 7 prompt strategies to 3 open-source LLMs (14B-70B parameters) targeting 2 architecturally distinct microservice systems: one Java monolingual (6 services, 9 failure modes) and one polyglot (27 services, 14 failure modes), yielding 38 valid runs and 663 generated tests. We find that prompt strategy explains more variation in diversity than model size: a Structured prompt collapses diversity entirely, while a single model varied across three prompt strategies achieves complete failure-mode coverage on one system, outperforming any multi-model ensemble under a fixed prompt. We introduce two strategies, Guided and GuidedFewShot, that embed a mutation taxonomy from prior robustness testing research as domain context. GuidedFewShot achieves the highest single-run coverage on both systems (5 of 9 and 8 of 14 failure modes) while maintaining low cross-model similarity. A key lesson is that taxonomy rules alone are insufficient: LLMs cannot distinguish key-absent from value-empty mutations without concrete examples. Findings replicate across both systems.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于使用大语言模型为微服务API生成鲁棒性测试的实证研究。研究通过在两个不同架构的微服务系统上测试3个LLM和7种提示策略，发现提示策略对测试多样性的影响超过模型规模，并提出将变异分类法与少样本示例结合的GuidedFewShot策略，可实现最高单次运行覆盖率（5/9和8/14故障模式），同时维持测试多样性。
AI.motivation: 微服务API中的格式错误、缺失或边界值输入会级联传播到依赖服务，威胁系统可靠性。现有的鲁棒性测试需要系统性地触发这些异常输入以暴露服务器端故障，但生成多样化、有效的测试仍然具有挑战性。虽然大语言模型可以从API规范生成此类测试，但不同模型和提示策略是否产生多样化还是趋同的失败集合仍是未知问题。
AI.method: 采用受控实验方法，将7种提示策略应用于3个开源LLM（14B-70B参数），针对两个架构不同的微服务系统（一个Java单语系统6服务/9故障模式，一个多语言系统27服务/14故障模式），生成663个测试用例。关键创新是提出 Guided 和 GuidedFewShot策略，将先前鲁棒性测试研究中的变异分类法作为领域上下文嵌入提示中。
AI.result: 在Java单语系统上，最佳单次运行覆盖率从2/9提升至5/9故障模式；在多语言系统上，从3/14提升至8/14。提示策略的差异解释了比模型规模更大的多样性变化：结构化提示完全消除了多样性，而单一模型配合三种不同提示策略即可在一个系统上达到完全故障模式覆盖，优于任何固定提示下的多模型集成。GuidedFewShot策略在保持低跨模型相似性的同时实现了最高覆盖率。
AI.conclusion:
研究的主要结论是：提示策略比模型规模更能解释测试多样性的变化；taxonomy规则单独使用不足够，需要具体示例才能帮助LLM区分不同类型的变异； GuidedFewShot策略在两个系统上都达到了最高的单次运行覆盖率（5/9和8/14故障模式），同时保持了低跨模型相似性。

关键教训：taxonomy规则本身不足以生成有效的测试，LLM需要具体示例才能区分key-absent和value-empty等变异类型。

title: Supervised Distributed Computing: Efficiency and Robustness under a Majority of Adversarial Workers
summary: We consider a recently proposed \emph{supervised distributed computing} paradigm \cite{augustine2025supervised} that extends and refines the standard master-worker paradigm for parallel computations. In this paradigm, there is a supervisor, a source, a target, and a collection of workers. The distributed computation is given as an acyclic task graph that is known to the supervisor. The source initially stores the input and the target is supposed to store the output of the computation. The individual tasks of the computation are supposed to be executed by the workers under the guidance of the supervisor. The source, target and supervisor are assumed to be reliable, while a $β$-fraction of the workers might be adversarial, for some $β\in [0,1)$. This covers, for example, the case where a supervisor has to work with untrusted volunteers. In the standard master-worker approach, the master checks whether the workers correctly execute the assigned tasks, creating a severe bottleneck, whereas in the supervised approach, the supervisor outsources this checking to the workers. Prior to this work, only supervised solutions were known for the case that $β$ is a sufficiently small constant. We show that robust and efficient supervised solutions are possible for \emph{any} constant $β<1$ while the expected work for the honest workers is close to a \emph{single} execution per task, given that there is a lightweight verification mechanism that allows honest workers to check the correctness of task outputs, which is significantly better than all robust master-worker as well as peer-to-peer approaches known so far.

AI.tldr: 提出监督式分布式计算范式，将任务验证外包给 workers，解决了 master-worker 范式的检查瓶颈问题，首次实现在任意常数恶意 workers 比例下接近单次执行的效率。
AI.motivation: 标准 master-worker 范式中，master 需要检查 workers 是否正确执行任务，造成严重瓶颈；同时此前监督式方案仅在 β 为足够小的常数时有解。
AI.method: 提出监督式分布式计算范式，将任务正确性验证工作外包给 workers；通过设计轻量级验证机制，使诚实 workers 能够检查任务输出的正确性。
AI.result: 在任意常数 β < 1 的恶意 workers 比例下实现了高效且健壮的监督式解决方案，诚实 workers 的期望工作量接近单次任务执行。
AI.conclusion: 提供了首个能在任意常数比例恶意 workers 下保持高效且健壮的监督式计算方案，显著优于现有 master-worker 和 peer-to-peer 方法。

title: Falkor-IRAC: Graph-Constrained Generation for Verified Legal Reasoning in Indian Judicial AI
summary: Legal reasoning is not semantic similarity search. A court judgment encodes constrained symbolic reasoning: precedent propagation, procedural state transitions, and statute-bound inference. These are properties that vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) cannot faithfully represent. Hallucinated precedents, outdated statute citations, and unsupported reasoning chains remain persistent failure modes in LLM-based legal AI, with real consequences for access to justice in high-caseload jurisdictions such as India. This paper presents Falkor-IRAC, a graph-constrained generation framework for Indian legal AI that grounds generation in structured reasoning over an IRAC (Issue, Rule, Analysis, Conclusion) knowledge graph. Judgments from the Supreme Court and High Courts of India are ingested as IRAC node structures enriched with procedural state transitions, precedent relationships, and statutory references, stored in FalkorDB for low-latency agentic traversal. At inference time, LLM-generated answers are accepted only if a valid supporting path can be traced through the graph, a check performed by a falsifiability oracle called the Verifier Agent. The system also detects doctrinal conflicts as a first-class output rather than silently resolving them. Falkor-IRAC is evaluated using graph-native metrics: citation grounding accuracy, path validity rate, hallucinated precedent rate, and conflict detection rate. These metrics are argued to be more appropriate for legal reasoning evaluation than BLEU and ROUGE. On a proof-of-concept corpus of 51 Supreme Court judgments, the Verifier Agent correctly validated citations on completed queries and correctly rejected fabricated citations. Evaluation against vector-only RAG baselines is left for future work, as is GPU-accelerated inference to address current timeout rates on CPU hardware.

AI.tldr: Falkor-IRAC是一个针对印度法律AI的图约束生成框架，通过IRAC知识图谱和Verifier Agent验证机制，将LLM生成的法律答案限制在结构化推理路径内，以解决传统RAG方法在法律推理中的幻觉和不合规问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于向量检索的RAG方法无法忠实地表示法律推理中的约束性符号推理（先例传播、程序状态转换、法定推理），导致虚假先例、过时法条引用和Unsupported推理链等持续性失效模式，在印度等高案件量管辖区的司法救济获取造成严重影响。
AI.method: 使用FalkorDB存储以IRAC节点结构 enriched with procedural state transitions、precedent relationships和statutory references构建知识图谱；通过Verifier Agent（falsifiability oracle）验证LLM生成答案是否有有效的图谱支撑路径；将 doctrinal conflicts detection作为一等输出。
AI.result: 在51份印度最高法院判决的概念验证语料上，Verifier Agent能够正确验证真实查询中的引文并正确拒绝伪造引文，但尚未与纯向量RAG基线进行对比，GPU加速推理以解决CPU超时问题仍待解决。
AI.conclusion: 提出了Falkor-IRAC框架，基于IRAC知识图谱进行结构化推理，并通过Verifier Agent验证生成结果的合法性。初步实验表明该系统在51份印度最高法院判决的语料上能正确验证引文并拒绝虚构内容，但尚未与向量检索基线进行对比，且面临GPU加速以解决CPU超时问题的未来工作。

title: Dual Hierarchical Dialogue Policy Learning for Legal Inquisitive Conversational Agents
summary: Most existing dialogue systems are user-driven, primarily designed to fulfill user requests. However, in many critical real-world scenarios, a conversational agent must proactively extract information to achieve its own objectives rather than merely respond. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Inquisitive Conversational Agents (ICAs)} and develop an ICA specifically tailored to U.S. Supreme Court oral arguments. We propose a Dual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning framework featuring two cooperating RL agents, each with its own policy, to coordinate strategic dialogue management and fine-grained utterance generation. By learning when and how to ask probing questions, the agent emulates judicial questioning patterns and systematically uncovers crucial information to fulfill its legal objectives. Evaluations on a U.S. Supreme Court dataset show that our method outperforms various baselines across multiple metrics. It represents an important first step toward broader high-stakes, domain-specific applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对对话系统中被动响应的局限，提出主动信息提取的探究式会话智能体(ICA)概念。设计了双层级强化学习框架，通过两个协作智能体实现战略对话管理与话语生成，模拟司法提问模式。在最高法院口头辩论数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统大多为用户驱动型，主要被动响应用户请求。然而在许多关键的真实世界场景中，会话智能体需要主动提取信息以实现自身目标，而不仅仅是被动回复。现有系统无法满足此类需求。
AI.method: 提出Dual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning框架，包含两个具有各自策略的协作RL智能体，协调战略级对话管理和细粒度话语生成。通过学习何时提问以及如何提问，使智能体模拟司法提问模式，系统性地挖掘关键信息以完成法律目标。
AI.result: 在美国最高法院数据集上的评估表明，该方法在多个指标上优于各类基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究是向高风险领域特定应用迈出的重要第一步。通过在最高法院口头辩论数据集上的评估验证了该方法的有效性，为需要主动信息提取的对话系统提供了新的研究方向。

title: EvolveMem:Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LLM agents that operate across multiple sessions, yet existing memory systems treat retrieval infrastructure as fixed: stored content evolves while scoring functions, fusion strategies, and answer-generation policies remain frozen at deployment. We argue that truly adaptive memory requires co-evolution at two levels: the stored knowledge and the retrieval mechanism that queries it. We present EvolveMem, a self-evolving memory architecture that exposes its full retrieval configuration as a structured action space optimized by an LLM-powered diagnosis module. In each evolution round, the module reads per-question failure logs, identifies root causes, and proposes targeted configuration adjustments; a guarded meta-analyzer applies them with automatic revert-on-regression and explore-on-stagnation safeguards. This closed-loop self-evolution realizes an AutoResearch process: the system autonomously conducts iterative research cycles on its own architecture, replacing manual configuration tuning. Starting from a minimal baseline, the process converges autonomously, discovering effective retrieval strategies including entirely new configuration dimensions not present in the original action space. On LoCoMo, EvolveMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 25.7% relative and achieves a 78.0% relative improvement over the minimal baseline. On MemBench, EvolveMem exceeds the strongest baseline by 18.9% relative. Evolved configurations transfer across benchmarks with positive rather than catastrophic transfer, indicating that the self-evolution process captures universal retrieval principles rather than benchmark-specific heuristics. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem.

AI.tldr: EvolveMem 是一个让 LLM 智能体的「长期记忆检索基础设施」能够自我进化的记忆架构。它把检索的全部配置（融合方式、视图权重、top-k、上下文预算、答案风格、逐类别覆盖等）暴露为一个结构化动作空间，由一个 LLM 诊断模块读取每题的失败日志、归因根因并提出结构化配置调整，再由带「回退/探索」护栏的元分析器验证应用，形成闭合的 AutoResearch 循环。LoCoMo 上较最强基线相对提升 25.7%（较最小基线 78.0%），MemBench 上相对提升 18.9%，且演化出的配置可跨基准正迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆系统（MemGPT、Mem0、A-MEM、SimpleMem、MemoryBank 等）普遍假设「记忆内容随时间演化，但检索基础设施在部署时冻结」：打分函数、融合权重、上下文预算、答案生成策略在整个生命周期内不变。随着记忆从数十条增长到数百条异质记录，这种失配会持续加剧；同时不同问题类型（事实查找、时间推理、多跳推断、对抗性换名）本质上需要不同检索策略，单一冻结配置无法同时最优。已有自适应检索工作（Self-RAG、CRAG、FLARE、Adaptive-RAG）只调整检索时机或事后过滤，从不在系统生命周期内演化检索参数本身；自改进智能体（Voyager、ExpeL、Memory-R1、Agentic Memory、MemEvolve）也只优化行为策略或存储内容，未把检索机制本身作为研究对象。因此作者主张真正自适应的记忆需在「存储知识」与「查询机制」两个层面协同进化，并需要系统能自主观察自身失败、提出根因假设、验证配置改动并保留有效者——即把 AutoResearch 范式用于系统自身架构。
AI.method:
EvolveMem 由三层构成并以自进化反馈环连接。
(1) 结构化记忆库（§3.1）：记忆单元为 m=(c, μ, e, η)，含自然语言内容、稠密向量、六类记忆类型（episodic/semantic/preference/project state/working summary/procedural）与辅助元数据（重要度、置信度、实体强化分、抽取实体、主题、时间戳），并支持 user/workspace/session 层级作用域。抽取采用 W=40 轮滑动窗口 + 前窗上下文去重，配三重质量护栏：失败重试（递增等待、保留部分结果）、超上下文分块切分后合并（C=15）、基于参考关键词的覆盖率校验并定向重抽。整合三遍：Jaccard≥0.80 近重复合并（保留高重要度者）、重要度线性衰减（α_d=0.05/天，下限 0.15）、实体共现强化（+0.05，上限 0.30）。
(2) 可演化检索层（§3.2）：三视图独立取 top-k——BM25 词法视图（k1=1.5, b=0.75）、稠密余弦语义视图、结构化元数据视图（人名/地点/实体交集计数）；融合模式可为 sum、weighted-sum（归一化后可学习视图权重）、RRF（1/(k+r_v)）；最终排序 s = s_fuse + λ_ι·ι + λ_r·rec + ρ，rec 为按半衰期参数化的单调递减近时性因子；可选查询增强为对抗性实体换名（剥离人名后按主题重检并与原集合并）与查询分解（LLM 拆为至多 N 个单跳子查询后 RRF 合并）；答案生成带可配置风格与低置信二次验证器；支持逐问题类别覆盖任何全局参数。完整动作空间 θ=(k_sem,k_kw,k_str,B_ctx,mode,{w_v},α,{θ_c})，所有维度在应用前做范围钳制。
(3) 自进化引擎（§3.3）：目标为在 Θ 上最大化 Q 上的平均得分（实验用 F1）。每轮写出逐题原始日志（问题、预测、参考答案、得分、检索来源，持久化为 raw_results.jsonl），诊断 LLM 依据以失败模式（非基准特异）表述的 rubric 归因（错实体检索、上下文不足、时间混淆等）并输出结构化提案 Δθ_r（可提出原动作空间之外的新参数维度）。受保护的元分析器按三分支更新：性能下降超过 τ_rev 则回退到历史最优 θ*；连续两轮变化小于 ε 则叠加随机扰动 η_exp 以跳出局部最优；否则应用提案并钳制。若诊断发现记忆覆盖缺失则触发定向重抽取。当轮间提升小于 ε（默认 0.005）或达到 R_max=7 时终止，返回 argmax 配置。实现采用 SQLite/FTS5 + bge-base-en-v1.5（768 维），7 轮演化约 25–35 分钟/样本，单查询检索约 15 ms。
AI.result: LoCoMo（10 段对话、1986 QA）：GPT-4o 下整体 F1 0.543（较最强基线 SimpleMem 0.432 相对 +25.7%，较最小基线 30.5 相对 +78.0%），GPT-5.1 下 0.572（较 SimpleMem 0.418 相对 +36.8%）；增益集中在时间类（+63.4%/+98.9%）与单跳类（+68.7%），对抗性换名类保持 0.936/0.902。MemBench（28 样本、7 类）：整体准确率 67.9%（GPT-4o）/71.4%（GPT-5.1），较最强基线相对 +18.9%/+11.0%，Recall 与 Reasoning 分别大幅领先，而 Robustness 最弱，失败定位到 post_processing 的存储覆盖缺失。演化轨迹（GPT-4o）：R0 30.5 → R1 35.8（意图规划+RRF）→ R2 34.8（MMR 多样性被回退）→ R3 37.2（Cat.5 实体换名）→ R4 38.5（逐类别答案风格）→ R5 38.1（Cat.1/4 查询分解）→ R6 45.4（Cat.3 推断子类型+换名扩展）→ R7 54.3（答案验证+超参扫描+上下文预算）。诊断 LLM 自主发现三个新维度：对抗性实体换名、查询分解、答案验证。消融显示各组件贡献互不冗余：抽取质量控制 −23.22（最大）、语义检索 −10.32、诊断模块（对比随机搜索）−9.63、BM25 −6.87、三个新发现维度合计 −7.77、结构化检索 −2.33、实体换名 −3.10、查询分解 −2.84、自进化本身 −2.03、答案验证 −1.83。跨基准迁移：LoCoMo 演化的 C_L 零样本在 MemBench 达 54.3%；继续演化得 C_LM，MemBench 79.2%（超从零演化的 C_M 67.9% 达 16.6% 相对），同时 LoCoMo F1 从 0.543 升至 0.593（+9.2%），构成双基准 Pareto 改进。逐题案例（C.1）展示了召回→精度→安全→措辞四阶段机制性演化（单题 F1 0.00→0.44→1.00→0.94→1.00）。
AI.conclusion: EvolveMem 是首个通过 LLM 驱动的闭环诊断自主演化检索基础设施的记忆框架，把 AutoResearch（观察—假设—实验—验证循环）落地到系统自身架构，替代了人工配置调优。从最小基线出发可自主收敛，并发现原动作空间之外的新配置维度；其演化出的配置在 LoCoMo/MemBench 上大幅超越已发表基线，且跨基准呈正向而非灾难性迁移，说明自进化捕获的是普适检索原则而非基准特异启发式。作者认为抽取质量控制是多视图检索与自我进化的前提基础，未来方向包括扩展到动态场景与多模态设置。局限方面：演化在单一机器上离线进行、依赖强 LLM（抽取与诊断用 GPT-5.1、答案生成用 GPT-4o），单样本 7 轮需 25–35 分钟，MemBench 样本量仅 28，且 Robustness/post_processing 的记忆覆盖缺口仍无法靠检索层调整解决。

title: Conditional Attribute Estimation with Autoregressive Sequence Models
summary: Generative models are often trained with a next-token prediction objective, yet many downstream applications require the ability to estimate or control sequence-level properties. Next-token prediction can lead to overfitting of local patterns during training, underfitting of global structure, and requires significant downstream modifications or expensive sampling to guide or predict the global attributes of generated samples at inference time. Here, we introduce Conditional Attribute Transformers, a novel method for jointly estimating the next-token probability and the value of an attribute conditional on each potential next token selection. This framework enables three critical capabilities within a single forward pass, without modification of the input sequence: (1) per-token credit assignment across an entire sequence, by identifying how each token in a sequence is associated with an attribute's value; (2) counterfactual analysis, by quantifying attribute differences conditional on alternative next token choices; (3) steerable generation, by decoding sequences based on a combination of next-token and attribute likelihoods. Our approach achieves state of the art performance on sparse reward tasks, improves next-token prediction at sufficient model sizes, estimates attribute probabilities orders of magnitude faster than sampling, and can guide decoding of autoregressive sequence models on a range of language tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件属性变换器(CAT)，在单次前向传播中联合预测下一token概率和条件属性值，实现无需修改输入序列的信用分配、反事实分析和可引导生成三种能力。
AI.motivation: 当前生成模型使用下一个token预测目标训练，但许多下游应用需要估计或控制序列级属性。下一个token预测可能导致过度拟合局部模式、欠拟合全局结构，且在推理时需要大量下游修改或昂贵的采样来引导或预测生成样本的全局属性。
AI.method: 提出条件属性变换器，在单次前向传播中联合估计下一个token概率和每个潜在下一token选择下属性的条件值。该框架无需修改输入序列即可实现三种关键能力。
AI.result: 实现了三种关键能力：1）整个序列的per-token信用分配，识别序列中每个token与属性值的关联；2）反事实分析，量化替代下一token选择下的属性差异；3）可引导生成，基于下一token和属性似然的组合进行解码。
AI.conclusion: 在稀疏奖励任务上达到最优性能，在足够大的模型规模下改进下一个token预测，估计属性概率比采样快几个数量级，并可引导自回归序列模型在各种语言任务上的解码。

title: Tradeoffs are Domain Dependent: Improving Accuracy and Fairness in Property Tax Assessments
comment: 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT'26)
summary: Algorithmic fairness research often assumes a tradeoff between fairness and accuracy. Yet this tradeoff may not be universal. We test this assumption in the context of U.S. property tax assessment - a setting in which the output of predictive algorithms directly determines the distribution of tax obligations among homeowners. Currently, systematic assessment errors cause owners of lower-valued properties to face disproportionately high tax burdens, creating regressivity in the property tax system. Using data on 26 million property sales spanning 95% of U.S. counties, we conduct three complementary analyses. First, we find that assessment accuracy and fairness - measured using domain-relevant metrics - are strongly correlated across counties under status quo practices. Second, in simulated assessment models, we show that adding property features improves accuracy in most cases, and that when accuracy improves, fairness almost always improves as well. Third, we show that incorporating publicly available Census data into assessment models - a feasible reform in most counties - would significantly improve both accuracy and fairness relative to status quo assessments. Together, these results challenge the presumed universality of the fairness-accuracy tradeoff and demonstrate that well-designed modeling improvements can advance both fairness and accuracy in large-scale public sector systems.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了算法公平性研究中准确性-公平性必然权衡的假设，通过2600万房产数据证明，在房产税评估这一公共部门场景中，精心设计的模型改进可同时提升准确性和公平性。
AI.motivation: 当前算法公平性研究普遍认为公平性与准确性之间存在权衡，但这种权衡可能并非普遍存在。研究以美国房产税评估为背景，探究系统性评估错误导致低价房产所有者承担不成比例的高税负这一不公平现象。
AI.method: 利用涵盖美国95%县的2600万笔房产销售数据，采用三种互补性分析方法：现状实践分析、模拟评估模型测试，以及Census数据整合效果评估。
AI.result: 研究发现：（1）现状实践下，评估准确性与公平性高度正相关；（2）模拟模型中添加房产特征大多提升准确性，且准确性提升时公平性几乎必然改善；（3）整合Census数据可同时显著提升准确性和公平性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在大规模公共部门系统中，精心设计的建模改进可以同时提升公平性和准确性，挑战了人们对准确性-公平性权衡的普遍假设。

title: Failure-Guided Fuzzing for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Programs
summary:
Hybrid quantum-classical (HQC) algorithms, such as the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) and the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), are central to near-term quantum computing but remain challenging to test. Sampling-based fuzzing can expose faulty or non-convergent configurations, but under realistic execution budgets, it may miss failure-prone regions in the joint space of classical optimizer settings and quantum circuit parameters.
  This paper studies failure-guided fuzzing for HQC programs. It models a hybrid input as a pair of classical optimizer hyperparameters and quantum circuit parameters, and evaluates a two-phase strategy that first searches for non-convergent seeds and then locally fuzzes circuit parameters around those seeds. To understand where the gains come from, five budgeted strategies are compared: random hybrid testing, classical enumeration without fuzzing, random-seed local fuzzing, enumeration-seed local fuzzing, and concolic-seed local fuzzing. The study is implemented on a VQE instance and a QAOA MaxCut instance in Qiskit. The results show that failure-guided local fuzzing is the main driver of improvement over random testing, while concolic seed discovery provides additional benefits on VQE but is less stable on QAOA. These findings suggest that reusing failure information is a promising direction for HQC testing, but that the value of concolic seed discovery is workload-dependent.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了对混合量子经典算法的失败引导模糊测试方法，通过两阶段策略（先找非收敛种子，再局部模糊）能更有效地暴露HQC程序中的故障配置，实验表明失败信息复用是有价值的，但concolic种子发现的效果因应用场景而异。
AI.motivation: 混合量子经典（HQC）算法（如VQE和QAOA）是近期量子计算的核心，但测试困难。现有的采样基础模糊测试在现实执行预算下可能遗漏经典优化器设置和量子电路参数联合空间中易出错的区域，因此需要更有效的测试方法。
AI.method: 该研究采用两阶段策略：首先搜索非收敛种子，然后围绕这些种子对电路参数进行局部模糊测试。具体实现了五种预算化策略进行比较：随机混合测试、无模糊的经典枚举、随机种子局部模糊、枚举种子局部模糊和concolic种子局部模糊。实验在Qiskit上针对VQE实例和QAOA MaxCut实例进行实现。
AI.result: 失败引导的局部模糊测试是相对于随机测试的主要改进驱动因素；concolic种子发现对VQE有额外收益，但在QAOA上不够稳定。这表明失败信息的复用具有前景，但其价值与具体工作负载相关。
AI.conclusion: 复用失败信息是HQC测试的有前途方向，但concolic种子发现的价值取决于具体工作负载。该研究为量子计算程序的可靠性验证提供了新思路。

title: Embedded Made Easy -- Rethinking Embedded + Cloud Software Development (WIP)
summary:
The process of engineering and deploying applications in the edge/embedded space is massively complicated by the non-homogeneous nature of the software stack and the complexity of diagnostics & debugging. Often different languages and runtimes are used for different components of the system forcing designers to, irrevocably, make decisions about what components run on the periphery and what components run in the cloud. Further complications arise when handling and diagnosing failures in the system. Multiple stacks and, often, limited support for debugging complicate the already difficult task of analyzing distributed applications.
  This paper presents a work-in-progress vision for a unified language and runtime system that allows applications to scale seamlessly across the edge and cloud. Using a single language and runtime, applications can be developed and tested in a single environment, and then deployed to any component of the system -- from resource limited controllers to large cloud servers. Further, we outline how this retargetable stack can provide integrated diagnostics and debugging tools that allow developers to record and replay distributed events locally for analysis and debugging.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个统一的编程语言和运行时系统愿景，旨在解决边缘/嵌入式应用开发中的异构性问题。该系统允许应用在边缘设备和云端之间无缝扩展，开发者可以在单一环境中开发测试，然后部署到从资源受限控制器到大型云服务器的任意设备，并提供分布式事件的记录与回放调试能力。
AI.motivation: Edge/embedded application engineering is complicated by heterogeneous software stacks requiring different languages/runtimes for different components, forcing designers to make irreversible deployment decisions. Additionally, multi-stack debugging and limited debugging support complicate distributed application analysis.
AI.method: Proposes a unified language and runtime system with integrated diagnostics tools supporting distributed event recording and replay for local analysis.
AI.result: A work-in-progress vision demonstrating that applications can be developed and tested in a single environment, then deployed to any system component—from resource-limited controllers to cloud servers—with integrated debugging capabilities.
AI.conclusion: The work presents a vision for a retargetable stack enabling unified development, seamless deployment from edge to cloud, and integrated distributed debugging capabilities.

title: A Deterministic Agentic Workflow for HS Tariff Classification: Multi-Dimensional Rule Reasoning with Interpretable Decisions
summary: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification is a high-stakes, expert-level task in which a free-form product description must be mapped to a specific six- or eight-digit code under the General Interpretive Rules (GIR), section notes, chapter notes, and Explanatory Notes. The difficulty lies not in knowledge volume but in *multi-dimensional rule reasoning*: a correct classification must satisfy competing priority rules along several axes simultaneously, including material, form, function, essential character, the part-versus-whole boundary, and specific listing versus residual headings. End-to-end prompting of large language models fails characteristically by resolving one axis while ignoring the priority constraints on the others. We present a *deterministic agentic workflow* in contrast to self-planning agents: the control flow is fixed, language model calls are confined to narrow stages, and reflection and verification are retained as local mechanisms. This design yields interpretability by construction--each decision is decomposed into stage-wise structured outputs with verbatim citation of the chapter or section notes that bear on it. The architecture combines offline knowledge-engineering of the Chinese HS tariff with an online six-stage pipeline. Evaluated on HSCodeComp at the six-digit level, the workflow reaches 75.0% top-1 and 91.5% top-3 at four digits, and 64.2% top-1 and 78.3% top-3 at six digits with Qwen3.6-plus; an open-weight Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 backbone in non-thinking mode achieves 84.2% four-digit and 77.4% six-digit top-1 agreement with the frontier model. A two-stage manual audit of 226 six-digit disagreements suggests that a non-trivial fraction of HSCodeComp ground-truth labels may deviate from HS general rules; full adjudication records are released in the appendix as preliminary findings for community review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"确定性智能体工作流"(deterministic agentic workflow)用于中国HS关税归类：控制流由工程师预先固定，LLM调用被限制在六个窄阶段（属性抽取→候选检索→L1粗筛→带章注触发的L2确认排序→子目归类→带逐字引证的结构化终评），离线侧将中国HS税则拆解为注释条款（纳入/排除/优先条款）、章-目-子目层级索引、GIR优先级语句及BM25+稠密双索引（RRF融合）。在HSCodeComp（n=632）上，Qwen3.6-plus达到4位75.0% top-1 / 91.5% top-3、6位64.2% top-1 / 78.3% top-3；开源Qwen3.6-27B-FP8（非思考模式）与前沿模型top-1一致率为4位84.2%、6位77.4%，说明工作流本身而非单一模型能力决定结果；对226条6位分歧的"外部LLM初判+海关专家复核"审计显示42.5%系统更符合规则、5.8%样本存在数据质量问题，据此保守修正后的6位top-1约为85.8%。
AI.motivation: HS归类的难点不是知识量（税则文本公开且仅数千页），而是"多维度规则推理"：一个正确编码必须同时满足材料、形态与加工状态、功能与用途、GIR 3(b)本质特征、第十六/十七类注释2的零件与整机边界、GIR 1/3(a)具体列名优先于残余税目等六条相互制约的优先轴；章注释本身还含跨章重定向与排除条款（示例：第39章形式优先架构使1.75 mm PLA单丝归入39.16而非3907.70）。作者观察到端到端提示的典型失效模式是"只解决一条轴（多为材料轴）、忽略其余轴的优先约束"，且会生成税则中根本不存在的"貌似合理"的六/八位编码；其根因是上下文缺少正确的语料切片，以及对"下一步该从语料何处加载约束"缺乏结构性约束。因此论文动机有三：(1)把HS归类从单次生成问题改写为沿税则层级展开的确定性工作流；(2)以"逐阶段结构化产物 + 逐字引证章节/类注释"实现构造性可解释与可审计，满足海关执法与申报环节的高风险审计需求；(3)与ReAct–Reflexion式的自规划"深度检索智能体"划清界限——阶段结构由税则本身规定，无需运行时探索，以换取确定性、低方差与故障可定位；同时检验架构能否用27B级开源模型落地以降低算力门槛。
AI.method: 离线（知识工程层，每版本构建一次）：把21条类注释、99条章注释解析为三类类型化条款——纳入条款、排除条款（常含跨章重定向）、优先条款（形式优先、零件/整机纪律）；构建章→目→子目的可查询层级索引，每个层级链接其适用注释，使给定候选目可在O(1)时间取回全部约束注释；将6条GIR编码为可被在线阶段显式调用的优先级语句（重点为GIR 1、3(a)、3(b)、6）；对目文本与注释文本建立BM25（稀有具体名词，如聚氨酯、离心、热固）与稠密向量（功能改述，如"用于车辆冷却"、"防腐涂层"）双索引，检索时以Reciprocal Rank Fusion无权重融合（作者经验上手调权重收益低于改进后续排序阶段提示）。在线（六阶段流水线，控制流固定，阶段间以严格输入/输出schema传递）：S1属性抽取，将自由文本商品描述转为材料、形态与加工状态、功能与用途、显著区分特征、必要时的品牌/产地消歧，schema固定、模型不得自造属性键；S2候选检索，同时用原描述与S1属性查询双索引并RRF融合，输出约40个候选目，目标为召回而非精度；S3 L1粗筛，仅以目文本（尚不载入注释）对40个候选打分排序，输出约10个4位候选，先做廉价判别以避免过早加载昂贵的章注释上下文；S4 L2带注释确认排序，加载相关章注/类注做深度排序，显式允许仅凭排除条款降权候选，并设"注释触发确认"子步骤强制在4位层面承诺，输出结构化的利/弊与适用GIR条款，得3个4位候选；S5子目归类，依GIR 6及子目级注释从选定4位下钻至6位，若描述明确指向国民8位细分则输出8位，否则止于6位并标记歧义；S6带结构化引证的终评，输出top-3候选编码及置信度、支持点( pros)、反对点(cons)、所引GIR条款与章/类注释的逐字引文，引文经后处理标注其中"起决定作用"的子句；该schema与Magesh等关于"correctness vs groundedness"的两轴可评估性对应，可区分"结果正确"与"所引规则实际支撑结论"。反思、校验、恢复仅作为阶段内局部机制（如L2检出章注排除条款后的降权/重排），而非全局重规划。实验：HSCodeComp（632条电商专家标注、十位、27章），因十位属美国HTS而只报4/6位；主干为Qwen3.6-plus（API，非思考模式）与Qwen3.6-27B-FP8（本地部署，非思考模式），同一工作流、无按主干定制提示；报top-1/top-3准确率、跨主干一致率与"金标准目在各阶段的流失归因"；版本为v7。
AI.result: 端到端准确率（Table I）：4位75.0% top-1、91.5% top-3；6位64.2% top-1、78.3% top-3，4位top-3表明九成以上查询的金标准目在候选短名单内，top-1与top-3间16.5 pp差距说明剩余错误集中在多个目均可辩护的边界决策。阶段归因（Table II，158例4位top-1错误）：召回缺失35例（22%）、L1丢弃3例、L2未保留16例、L2保留金标准但未排首位102例（65%）、终评覆盖2例——即主要失效点是L2排序偏好违反形式优先/具体优先的兄弟目，而非检索。跨主干一致性（Table III）：27B-FP8与Qwen3.6-plus在4位top-1一致84.2%（532/632）、6位77.4%（489/632），支持"骨干模型在同能力区间内可替换"的假设。人工审计（Table IV，226例6位分歧；先由独立外部LLM依据解释性注释与章/类注初判，再由受过海关归类训练的人类专家确认或推翻，并分桶）：A类（系统判读更符合规则）96例42.5%、B类（标签更符合、系统错）34例15.0%、C类（真实HS边界、专业人员可合理分歧）83例36.7%、D类（描述与标签互相矛盾的数据质量问题）13例5.8%；将A与D计为"系统非错"得保守修正后6位top-1约85.8%，若再计入C类则约96.2%（作者仅以前者为可辩护口径）。B类34例的五类复现模式：第71章立方氧化锆/水钻/合成石/再生石语义混淆；第91章表壳(9111.x)与其他钟表零件(9114.x)边界；第39章形式优先在L2阶段未充分浮现（如3907.70压过39.16）；零件误归通用零件章而违反第十六/十七类注释2（应归母机功能章）；候选集中含残余税目时GIR 3(a)具体优先应用不一致。论文自述结果为初步结论，审计记录与完整九阶段轨迹以附录形式发布供社区复核。
AI.conclusion: 结论与贡献：(1)将HS归类的本质困难形式化为"多维度规则推理"，并给出端到端提示失效的机制解释；(2)提出确定性智能体工作流——固定控制流、LLM限于窄阶段、反思与校验下沉为阶段内局部机制，并结合离线税则知识工程与在线六阶段流水线，实现构造性可解释（逐阶段产物、逐字引证、标注"起决定作用"的规则子句）、低方差（同输入同路径同序）、故障可定位到具体阶段；(3)在HSCodeComp上给出4/6位准确率、阶段归因与骨干可替代性三项证据；(4)对226条分歧的专家审计表明基准标签本身存在可观噪声，公开裁决记录供社区复核，这对"以未审计标签计算的准确率可能低估真实性能"这一判断具有方法论意义。未来方向：在工作流中间产物上微调9B级模型（进行中，初步结果另行报告）；把章注释隐含的跨章排除关系从启发式检索升级为系统化的图结构处理；将模板推广至卫生检疫归类、两用物项出口管制、药品目录归类等"固定语料+可审计推理"的邻近任务。需注意的局限：评估仅基于单一基准且仅报4/6位，缺少与ATLAS/商业工具在同数据上的直接对比；修正准确率依赖LLM初判+单名专家复核，缺乏双专家一致性统计；C类边界样本占比高（36.7%），说明该任务的可确定性上限本身受HS边界模糊性制约。

title: Distribution Corrected Offline Data Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Distilling reasoning traces from strong large language models into smaller ones is a promising route to improve intelligence in resource-constrained settings. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: offline distillation from teacher-generated traces provides high-quality, sample-efficient supervision but suffers from distributional drift: during training, the student model conditions on teacher-generated prefixes, whereas during inference the student autoregresses on self-generated prefixes, leading to compounding errors over long reasoning trajectories. Meanwhile, on-policy or self-distillation methods better match the student's inference-time distribution, but require costly online sampling and often produce low-quality traces in early training. We propose a principled offline reasoning distillation framework that preserves the efficiency and supervision quality of offline teacher-generated data while correcting teacher-student distribution drift. It adaptively emphasizes teacher supervision that is better aligned with the student's on-policy distribution. Evaluations on mathematical reasoning benchmarks of GSM8K, MATH, MATH500, and harder held-out competition-style tasks, including AMC, AIME, and OlympiadBench, show that our method improves reasoning accuracy over prior offline distillation algorithms and yields more stable reasoning traces while preserving instruction-following capabilities. Our work shows that lightweight, distribution-correction-aware training can substantially strengthen offline reasoning distillation without online rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出纯离线的推理蒸馏框架 DisCorD（Distribution Corrected Distillation）：在用教师生成的 CoT 轨迹对学生做 SFT/KL 蒸馏时，按"学生-教师支撑集比值"的 token 级权重 σ(τ·log π̄_θ(y_t|·)/π̄_T(y_t|·,c)) 重新分配监督强度，从而在不引入任何在线 rollout 的前提下缓解训练-推理分布漂移。在 Qwen2.5-7B/14B → Qwen2.5-3B/1.5B、Llama-3.2-3B 的数学推理蒸馏上，MATH500 相对 SFT 提升 2.0–4.6 分，OOD（OlympiadBench/Omni-Math/AMC23）同步提升；训练仅需 3.12 GPU 小时，而在线基线 GKD 需 49.56 GPU 小时（约 15.9×）。
AI.motivation: 小模型通过蒸馏强模型的推理轨迹获得数学推理能力存在一个根本性权衡：离线蒸馏（行为克隆）在教师轨迹上做 SFT，样本效率高、、教师监督质量高，尤其在训练早期，但存在分布漂移——训练时学生以教师生成的前缀为条件，推理时却以自生成前缀自回归，导致长推理链上的误差累积；而 on-policy/自蒸馏方法（如 GRPO、GKD）匹配学生推理分布，却需要昂贵的在线采样，且小模型早期 rollout 质量低、高回报轨迹稀少。此外已有离线方法（如 ToDi 的双向 KL）只是改变散度度量，优化仍集中在教师分布上，未直接解决分布失配；同时统一模仿所有教师 token 忽略了教师自身错误与学生可达性差异。论文目标是在保持纯离线数据效率与监督质量的前提下，纠正师生分布漂移，让监督权重自适应地向"学生可达"的教师行为倾斜。
AI.method: 1) 教师轨迹构建：自设计五段式推理指令（UNDERSTAND/PLAN/SOLVE/VERIFY/FINAL ANSWER）作为条件上下文 c，从 Qwen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct 采样离线 CoT，仅保留最终答案正确的轨迹（MATH 7500 题、GSM8K 7473 题）。2) 分布校正目标：以密度比 π̄_θ(y|x)/π̄_T(y|x;c) 作为序列级重加权基础；直接使用无界且长序列方差大，故用 sigmoid 对数密度比变换得到单调有界权重 r(y|x)=σ(τ·log ratio)，再进一步 token 级化 r_t=σ(τ·log[π̄_θ(y_t|x,y_<t)/π̄_T(y_t|x,c,y_<t)])，以消除序列级长度偏置与方差（类比 RL 中 token 级优势加权）。3) 校正含义：τ=1 时 r_t 等于 token 来自学生分布而非教师分布的后验概率（均匀先验），与对比解码同源但作用在训练端，用于优先学习学生推理时可能访问的支撑区域。4) 可插拔：以 SFT 梯度加权为主（Eq.5），也可将相同 r_t 加权到师生 KL 项上（Eq.6-7），兼容 SFT/对称 KL 等离线目标；教师分布带 stop-gradient。5) 超参 τ 按师生配置与基目标逐设置调优（MATH 上 1.0–8.0），离线训练协议统一（AdamW、lr 3e-6、wd 0.01、cosine+5% warmup、grad clip 1.0、bf16、max len 2048、有效 batch 16、seed 42）。
AI.result: 准确率：7B→3B 时 SFT+DisCorD 在 MATH500 达 62.60（+4.60），超过仅用 CoT 指令提示的学生（60.20）与 GKD 在线蒸馏（62.80 接近）；OOD 上 OlympiadBench 31.0→31.7、Omni-Math 26.5→29.5、AMC23 32.5→40.0。14B→3B：MATH500 59.60→61.80，GSM8K 81.27→82.79；14B→1.5B：41.00→45.40、67.32→69.75，对称 KL 变体 44.20→50.20。跨家族 Qwen→Llama-3.2-3B：SFT 49.40→52.40。GSM8K（短轨迹）区分度弱，SFT+DisCorD 反而略降 0.45。分布度量：SFT 的 ExAccErr 随前缀长度 32→256 由 31.53 增至 70.77，DisCorD 稳定在 32.12→41.02。轨迹质量：MATH 上平均长度 4383→1357.9 字符、4-gram 重复率 0.651→0.270、答案后继续生成率 0.79→0.15、多答案率 0.75→0；GPT-5.4-mini 评审显示 clean_and_reliable 由 29%→90%（MATH）、46%→88%（OlympiadBench），"答对但推理无效"由 20%→7%、26%→11%。消融：sigmoid 形式最佳（62.60），优于原始 exp(Δ)（61.20）、clip-exp（62.00）与 ReLU（57.80）。效率：DisCorD 3.12 GPU 小时、零 rollout token，GKD 需 49.56 GPU 小时与 2.86M 在线 token。
AI.conclusion: DisCorD 证明"轻量、分布校正感知"的离线训练即可显著增强长链推理蒸馏：它不改变数据来源、只改变离线教师监督的分配方式，即可超过既有离线蒸馏基线、逼近在线 rollout 蒸馏的收益，同时产出更短、更自洽、更少重复与多答案的稳定推理轨迹，并保持指令跟随能力；方法可与 SFT/KL 类目标组合，且不依赖在线采样。局限与展望：实验集中于数学推理，GSM8K 等短轨迹任务收益不明显；τ 需按设置调优；GKD 在部分基准仍更强。作者未来方向包括扩展到代码生成、科学推理与工具调用智能体等长程生成场景、与 off-policy/在线训练结合，以及当生成教师不可得时用代理参考模型（如更弱模型或任意策略）近似支撑比权重以解耦轨迹生成与校正打分。

title: EMA: Efficient Model Adaptation for Learning-based Systems
summary:
Machine learning (ML) is increasingly applied to optimize system performance in tasks such as resource management and network simulation. Unlike traditional ML tasks (e.g., image classification), networked systems often operate in heterogeneous, long-running, and dynamic environment states, where input conditions (e.g., network loads) and operational objectives can shift over time and across settings. Existing learning-based systems offer little support for adaptation, resulting in costly model training, extensive data collection, degraded system performance, and slow responsiveness.
  This paper presents EMA, the first model adaptation system supporting learning-based systems to adapt to evolving environments with minimal operational overhead. EMA takes a system-driven, data-centric approach that accommodates diverse system and model designs while addressing two key deployment challenges. First, it reduces expensive model training by introducing state transformers that align the input state of a new environment with previously similar states, allowing models to warm-start adaptation. Second, it addresses the often-overlooked yet costly process of data labeling--collecting ground truth for exploring and training on various system decisions--by prioritizing labeling high-utility data while balancing the tradeoff between training and labeling cost. Evaluations on eight representative learning-based systems show that EMA reduces adaptation costs (e.g., GPU training time) by 14.9-42.4% while improving system performance (e.g., network throughput) by 6.9-31.3%.

AI.tldr: EMA 是首个面向学习型网络系统的通用模型自适应系统。它以「系统驱动、数据中心」为思路，在不改动模型结构与系统逻辑的前提下，用状态变换器把新环境输入对齐到相似历史环境以热启动训练，用标注智能体按「效用/成本」比优先采集高价值标签，并用自适应编排器在训练与标注之间做成本权衡。在 8 个代表性学习型系统上，自适应成本（GPU 时间）降低 14.9%–42.4%，适应速度提升 2.3–15.3×，自适应后系统性能提升 6.9%–31.3%，额外运行时开销仅 0.3%–2.9%。
AI.motivation: 学习型系统（资源管理、流量工程、网络仿真、ABR 等）被广泛用于优化系统性能，但其效果高度依赖模型与「环境状态」（基础设施、工作负载、运维目标三维度，并随时间漂移）的匹配。现有系统几乎不为自适应而设计：迁移到新环境需在海量 trace 上重新调参，常耗时数十小时并耗费数千美元 GPU 资源，模型失配可导致性能退化超过 80%（如 Sizeless 换新函数/新硬件、FIRM 全局模型跨应用下降 4.5%–79.2%）。此外，持续学习/微调会引发负迁移（微调后甚至不如从头训练或离线全局模型），且现有方案多为任务定制的侵入式改造（如在模型中插入 meta-learner 的 Flash），仅适配 DL 模型。作者进一步指出被忽视的第二大瓶颈——数据标注：获取 ground truth 需重放负载、跑仿真或专家标注，常占端到端自适应成本的大多数（如为 Sinan 标注 2 万个样本需 6+ 小时 VM；NetLLM 微调约需 340 A100 GPU 小时≈$458，而标注需约 572 VM 小时≈$476），且不同样本标注成本差异可达数量级（如为作业分配 10× 与 2× 资源成本差异巨大）。因此需要一种既快又便宜、且可跨系统/跨模型通用、对标注成本敏感的模型自适应机制。
AI.method:
EMA 采用数据中心的流水线，完整位于模型与系统逻辑之外，只需数行集成代码（约 3,200 行 Python 原型，gRPC 连接中心状态库）。三个协同组件：
(1) 状态变换器（预训练阶段）：在输入边界把源环境 S 与目标环境 T 通过核特征映射 Φ 投影到高斯核隐空间 G，求解变换矩阵 W 使 min_W MMD(Φ(S), W·Φ(T))（基于迁移成分分析 TCA），从而让目标输入「看起来」来自熟悉区域，直接复用源环境模型权重与已有数据实现热启动。为应对系统状态高度偏斜、长尾（少量大作业/长流主导性能），先聚类划分「运行regime」（如短流 vs 长流），再按 MMD 最小做分组对齐（regime-aware），避免主导regime淹没关键稀有状态。源环境选择以 MMD 为任务无关相似度度量（与收敛速度/最终精度正相关，优于 L2 距离）。为控制一次性预处理开销：采用采样计算 W 与 MMD（依集中定理，仅需数千样本即可保证 95% 置信度），并用 K-medoids 对候选环境离线聚类（直接复用成对 MMD，无需额外嵌入），最优簇数 K=√M，使数百环境下的变换延迟 <4 秒。
(2) 标注智能体（训练中阶段）：以轻量模型预测不确定性作为数据效用代理（分类任务用 top-2 置信度差，回归/RL 用预测区间宽度），模型对其最不确定的输入学习收益最大。由于标注成本异质、存在异常高效用离群点、长尾分布导致冗余标注、效用随训练非平稳，放弃确定性的预算化背包（ILP）解法，改为按「效用/成本」比成比例的概率采样直到耗尽本轮预算。
(3) 自适应编排器（跨轮协调）：比较「继续训练」与「标注+再训练」的边际收益/成本比。用 1% 的代理数据集以 p·B_t 预算标注，测得不确定度下降并按 1/p 缩放得到无偏收益估计，同时把训练成本按新增样本比例膨胀 C*_t = C_t(1+Δn_t/n_t)；当 (U*_t−U_{t−1})/(C*_t+B_t) > (U_t−U_{t−1})/C_t 时触发新一轮标注。预算 B_t 采用 AIMD 反馈调节：收益/成本比下降则加预算，否则减半。训练完成后由 StateStore 缓存模型与少量输入样本（每状态数百条），采用衰减感知的 LFU 淘汰（访问频率按 0.9/天指数衰减；MMD 相近时淘汰精度低者）。隐私方面：仅用小数据子集计算 W，客户端可本地施加变换；支持访问控制（如限定同组织复用）；因在分布统计层面操作，可注入差分隐私噪声，附录 A 证明 MMD 变化以 O(‖η_max‖²) 为界，附录 B 用 DKW 不等式证明采样子集可代表全量分布。
AI.result:
在 30 节点集群（10×A100 + 20 CPU 节点，192GB 内存）上评测 8 个代表性系统/任务：DOTE（WAN 流量工程，DNN）、FIRM（微服务资源管理，RL）、Flux（流大小预测，LR，PageRank/K-Means/Web 三种负载）、MimicNet（数据中心流量仿真，LSTM，FatTree）、IDS-LSTM（CIC-IDS2017 在线入侵检测，LSTM）、Pensieve（ABR，RL）、NetLLM（ABR 与集群作业调度，LLM）。基线为 W/o EMA（随机初始化从头训练）、Caravan（在线连续学习）、Flash（元学习、侵入式）。
关键结果：①适应成本按 GCP 定价下降 14.9%–42.4%（NetLLM 的 CJS 任务附录用例中成本降 22.5%）；②达到目标精度所需训练量减少 2.3–15.3×（time-to-accuracy 显著左移，epoch=0 即有高初始精度）；③自适应后系统性能提升 6.9%–31.3%（Pensieve QoE +31.3%、DOTE 吞吐 +12.5%、FIRM 复合奖励 +6.9%）；④在线部署（Flux 作业到达、IDS 动态攻击流）中紧贴 oracle 表现。
消融/敏感性：去掉状态变换器与标注智能体分别使 cost-to-accuracy 退化 10.7% 与 45.1%（两者均关键，LA+编排器贡献最大）；EMA 自身运行时开销仅 0.3%–2.9%；状态变换延迟 <4 秒且随仓库数百状态仍可扩展；标注成本按 0.5×/1×/2× 缩放时 EMA 优势随成本上升而更显著（成本感知优于只按效用选样的 cost-agnostic 版本）；采样量超过数千后收益饱和（验证轻量采样）；注入高斯隐私噪声（0/0.5/1/3）后性能几乎不变；候选父状态仓库为 1/5/10/100/500 时性能稳定，约 12 个候选即可接近最优。
AI.conclusion: EMA 证明了「把系统已积累的模型与运行数据当作可复用的运维知识」这一数据中心的路线，可在几乎不侵入系统的前提下为学习型系统提供通用、自适应、低开销的模型自适应能力：状态变换器解决跨环境状态错配与负迁移，标注智能体与编排器解决训练成本与昂贵、异质标注成本之间的张力。它同时改善了自适应的速度、成本与最终系统性能，并在模型/系统族（LR、DL、RL、LLM）、任务（流量工程、调度、仿真、流媒体、入侵检测）上验证了通用性与隐私合规性。局限与展望包括：仍需针对具体任务的效用代理设计、标注成本估计依赖外部反馈来源（如 Caravan 式标注代理或专家），且实验集中于网络/系统类场景，向更大规模生产环境的迁移仍待验证（文中亦存在「七个系统/八个任务」的表述不一致）。

title: Sheaf-Theoretic Transport and Obstruction for Detecting Scientific Theory Shift in AI Agents
summary: Scientific theory shift in AI agents requires more than fitting equations to data. An artificial scientific agent must detect whether an existing representational framework remains transportable into a new regime, or whether its language has become locally-to-globally obstructed and must be extended. This paper develops a finite sheaf-theoretic framework for detecting theory-shift candidates through transport and obstruction. Contexts are organized as a local-to-global structure in which source, overlap, target, and validation charts are fitted, restricted, and tested for gluing. Obstruction measures failure of coherence through residual fit, overlap incompatibility, constraint violation, limiting-relation failure, and representational cost. We evaluate the framework on a controlled transition-card benchmark designed to separate deformation within a source language from extension of that language. The main result is direct obstruction ranking: the intended deformation or extension is usually the lowest-obstruction candidate, and transition type is separated in the benchmark. A constellation kernel over the same signatures is included only as a secondary representational-similarity probe. The aim is not to reconstruct historical paradigm shifts or solve open-ended autonomous theory invention, but to isolate a finite diagnostic subproblem for AI agents: detecting when representational transport fails and extension becomes the coherent next move.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个基于层理论（sheaf theory）的有限框架，用于AI智能体检测科学理论转换候选者。该框架通过检测表示传输失败和语言扩展需求来识别理论转换时机。
AI.motivation: 人工智能中的科学理论转换需要的不仅是将方程拟合到数据。人工科学智能体必须检测现有表示框架是否仍可传输到新状态，还是其语言已变得局部到全局受阻而需要扩展。
AI.method: 提出了一个有限层 sheaf 理论框架，通过传输（transport）和阻碍（obstruction）来检测理论转换候选者。上下文被组织为局部到全局结构，其中源图、重叠图、目标图和验证图被拟合、限制和测试粘合性。阻碍通过残余拟合、重叠不兼容性、约束违反、极限关系失败和表示成本来衡量。
AI.result: 在设计的转换卡基准测试上，主要结果是直接阻碍排名：预期的变形或扩展通常是最低阻碍候选者，且基准测试中分离了转换类型。同一签名上的星座核仅作为次要表示相似性探测包含在内。
AI.conclusion: 该研究隔离出了一个有限诊断子问题：AI智能体何时需要进行表示传输失败检测并扩展其语言。这不是要重建历史范式转换或解决开放性自主理论发明问题。

title: The Geometry of LLM Quantization: GPTQ as Babai's Nearest Plane Algorithm
comment: Published as a conference paper at the Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026): https://openreview.net/forum?id=NFB4QGGS65
summary: Quantizing the weights of large language models (LLMs) from 16-bit to lower bitwidth is the de facto approach to deploy massive transformers onto more affordable accelerators. While GPTQ emerged as one of the standard methods for one-shot post-training quantization at LLM scale, its inner workings are described as a sequence of algebraic updates that obscure geometric meaning or worst-case guarantees. In this work, we show that, when executed back-to-front (from the last to first dimension) for a linear layer, GPTQ is mathematically identical to Babai's nearest plane algorithm for the classical closest vector problem (CVP) on a lattice defined by the Hessian matrix of the layer's inputs. This equivalence is based on a sophisticated mathematical argument, and has two analytical consequences: first, the GPTQ error propagation step gains an intuitive geometric interpretation; second, GPTQ inherits the error upper bound of Babai's algorithm under the assumption that no weights are clipped. Leveraging this bound, we design post-training quantization methods that avoid clipping, and outperform the original GPTQ. In addition, we provide efficient GPU inference kernels for the resulting representation. Taken together, these results place GPTQ on a firm theoretical footing and open the door to importing decades of progress in lattice algorithms towards the design of future quantization algorithms for billion-parameter models. Source code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/GPTQ-Babai.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示 GPTQ 与经典格论中 Babai 最近平面算法的数学等价性，赋予其几何解释和误差上界，并据此设计改进的量化方法。
AI.motivation: GPTQ 作为 LLM 规模的一次性后训练量化标准方法，其内部工作原理被描述为一系列代数更新，缺乏几何解释或最坏情况保证。
AI.method: 通过反向执行 GPTQ（从最后维度到第一维度）线性层，证明了其与 Babai 最近平面算法在由 Hessian 矩阵定义的格上的数学等价性。设计避免裁剪的后训练量化方法并提供高效 GPU 推理核。
AI.result: 两个分析成果：1) GPTQ 误差传播步骤获得直观几何解释；2) GPTQ 在不裁剪权重的假设下继承 Babai 算法的误差上界。基于此上界设计的避免裁剪量化方法优于原始 GPTQ。
AI.conclusion: 放置 GPTQ 于坚实的理论基础上，并开辟了将数十年的格算法进展应用于十亿参数模型量化算法设计的道路。

title: Due Process on Hold: A Queueing Framework for Improving Access in SNAP
summary: The U.S. social safety net delivers essential services at mass scale, but access burdens persist, as congested contact or call centers serve as a primary mode of application completion and assistance. In Holmes v. Knodell, Missouri's SNAP call centers were so congested that nearly half of all application denials were procedural, caused by applicants' inability to complete required interviews, rather than underlying ineligibility. The judge ruled these system failures led to a violation of procedural due process. We propose a performance evaluation framework based on queueing models from operations research and management to assess and improve access in such systems. Operational access failures of call centers are distinct from prior automation failures in benefits provision. Emergent arbitrariness arises from interactions between system dynamics and access demand, rather than from an explicit algorithmic rule, making diagnosis and repair inherently system-level. We develop a queueing model that incorporates phenomena that distinguish social services from standard service domains, redials and abandonment, through which backlogs generate endogenous congestion. Standard queueing guidance from Erlang-A that does not address endogenous congestion fundamentally understaffs, which could lead to persistent shortfalls in practice. Using a fluid approximation, we derive steady-state performance metrics to analytically characterize the impacts of bundled staffing and service delivery changes. We fit model parameters to call-center data disclosed in court documents. Our queueing model can support ex-ante evaluation and design of access systems, inform policy levers for improving access, and provide evidence about whether applicants are afforded a meaningful opportunity to be served at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文针对美国社会安全网呼叫中心拥堵导致程序性拒绝的问题，运用排队论构建考虑重拨和放弃行为的服务访问评估框架，通过法律案例数据和流体近似模型，为改善服务获取机会和政策制定提供分析工具。
AI.motivation: 美国社会保障系统通过拥堵的呼叫中心提供服务，导致大量程序性拒绝（而非实质性资格问题），现有 Erlang-A 模型未能考虑内生性拥堵问题，可能导致人员配置不足。
AI.method: 采用排队论方法构建包含重拨和放弃现象的队列模型，通过流体近似推导稳态性能指标，用法庭披露的呼叫中心数据进行参数拟合，分析人员配置和服务交付变化的组合效应。
AI.result: 标准排队论指导未考虑内生性拥堵时会根本性地低估人力需求；系统动态与访问需求交互产生的"紧急任意性"需从系统层面诊断和修复。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出的排队模型可为社会服务系统的访问评估和政策制定提供工具，支持事前评估和系统设计，为判断申请人是否获得实质性服务机会提供证据。

title: Making OpenAPI Documentation Agent-Ready: Detecting Documentation and REST Smells with a Multi-Agent LLM System
comment: 10 pages. Accepted in EASE 2026, 9-12 June 2026, Glasgow, Scotland, United Kingdom
summary: The growing adoption of AI agents and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has motivated organizations to expose existing REST APIs as agent-consumable tools. In our industrial context, this initiative targeted an ecosystem of 16 production APIs comprising approximately 600 endpoints. Although these APIs were stable and widely used within a microservice architecture, early proof-of-concept experiments revealed systematic failures in task planning, tool selection, and payload construction when accessed through MCP-based agents. Rather than attributing these failures to model limitations alone, we conducted an ecosystem-scale empirical assessment of the underlying OpenAPI documentation. We developed Hermes, a multi-agent LLM-based system that detects documentation and REST-related smells at the endpoint level and generates explainable diagnostic reports. The large-scale evaluation identified 2,450 smells across 600 endpoints, with deficiencies present in all analyzed operations. Practitioner validation confirmed high agreement with the detected issues while also revealing contextual trade-offs in remediation decisions. The findings suggested that structural validity within microservice environments does not guarantee semantic readiness for agent-based consumption. Based on this evidence, the organization revised its adoption strategy, prioritizing selective endpoint adaptation, redefining documentation standards, and integrating automated documentation assessment into API governance workflows. This case illustrates how systematic artifact-level evaluation can function as a strategic decision-support mechanism, reducing technological risk and guiding evidence-based AI adoption in industrial software ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇工业案例研究：作者在一家拥有 16 个生产 API、约 600 个端点的组织中，计划通过 MCP 将 API 暴露为 AI 智能体可调用的工具，但概念验证暴露出任务规划、工具选择与载荷构造的系统性失败。作者不将其归因于模型能力不足，而是开发了多智能体 LLM 系统 Hermes，在端点级检测 OpenAPI 文档气味（LAZY/BLOATED/TANGLED/FRAGMENTED）与 REST 设计气味（PATH/METHOD/INPUT/RESPONSE/SECURITY），共发现 2,450 处气味、覆盖全部 600 个端点（平均 4.08 个/端点）。经 24 位开发者问卷验证后，组织将全量改造（估 385 工时）调整为面向 18 个自动化场景的 42 个端点选择性适配（估 42 工时，减少约 89%），并将 Hermes 纳入 API 治理流程。核心结论：结构合法性并不等于智能体就绪性，文档就绪度应在大规模 AI 采用之前作为前置评估与门控机制。
AI.motivation: 组织计划借助 MCP 将既有 REST API 暴露为智能体工具，但早期概念验证中出现任务规划失败、工具选择错误与载荷构造失败等系统性问题。若简单归因于 LLM 模型能力不足，会导致对更复杂智能体框架的错误投资；因此需要一种生态级、以工件（artifact）为单位的实证评估手段，判断 OpenAPI 文档本身是否具备支撑自主智能体消费的语义充分性。既有工具多聚焦语法/结构校验，缺少语义文档质量评估；文档气味（documentation smells）研究多针对源码内自然语言文档，尚未在结构化 API 规范中操作化，也缺少将文档质量与智能体 API 调用可靠性显式关联的工作。
AI.method: 采用工业案例研究设计（Runeson & Höst），以 OpenAPI 端点为分析单元，证据三角互证：概念验证诊断实验、大规模自动气味检测、专家验证、实践者报告评审。PoC 构建两个 MCP 服务器（同一 FastAPI 业务逻辑：一个保留原始文档，一个用详尽 docstring 增强文档），在本地部署 LLM 上执行 10 个代表性自动化任务（8 个多工具协调、2 个单工具），比较规划成功率、端点识别率与端到端执行率。Hermes 采用端点中心策略：为每个 operation 生成降维（reduced）OpenAPI 表示以降低 token 消耗并提升分析聚焦度，由中心 Smell Detector Agent 编排，Documentation Smell Agents 与 REST Smell Agents 各依结构化 few-shot 提示模板（含气味定义、分类规则、示例、JSON 输出约束）从不同视角判定并输出可解释的判定理由与改进建议表。构建 60 个端点（10%）由两名领域专家标注的金标准数据集，将检测建模为多标签分类，比较 7 个候选 LLM（Jaccard、micro/macro F1、Hamming loss、标签基数差），选定 gpt-oss:120b（Jaccard=0.85、F1micro=0.92、F1macro=0.73、Hamming=0.07）执行全量 600 端点评估；随后对 24 名 API 作者/维护者以 Likert 量表问卷验证，并对比全量重构与选择性适配的工时估算。
AI.result: IEQ1：600 个端点检出 2,450 处气味，平均 4.08 个/端点，所有端点至少命中一处。分布为 Response 100%、Lazy 90%、Input 88%、Security 68%、Path_and_Method 53%、Tangled 5%、Bloated 2%，Fragmented 与 Excessive Structured 未出现（所有 $ref 均在同文档内解析成功）。典型证据包括泛型 DTO 响应 {status, data}（data 无 schema 约束，原作者本人也难以描述其内容）、仅给类型的参数与缩写命名、"Successful Response" 式通用描述、Bearer 方案缺少凭据获取与 scope 说明、动词化 URI（/getUsers、/updateStatus）与以 POST/GET 代替 PUT/PATCH 等非惯用方法。IEQ2：实践者对可验证类缺陷高度认同（80% 强烈同意 + 7% 同意），但对 Lazy（30% 不同意）与 REST 惯例偏离（20% 不同意、3% 强烈不同意、32% 尝试以遗留约束/组织标准辩护）存在争议；引入外部消费者与智能体视角后分歧显著降低，并产生学习效应。IEQ3：全量转换需约 385 工时，而聚焦 18 个自动化场景所需的 42 个端点仅约 42 工时（减少约 89%）；PoC 中原始文档下约 70% 任务在规划阶段失败、仅 10% 预期端点被正确识别、无一端到端成功；文档增强后 90% 任务规划正确、80% 端点识别正确且被识别端点全部执行成功。
AI.conclusion: 组织据此将策略从"全生态 MCP 转换"修订为三阶段方案：(i) 针对已定义自动化场景的选择性端点适配；(ii) 面向智能体消费需求重新定义文档标准；(iii) 将 Hermes 集成进端点评审流程作为预防性评估与治理机制。论文的总体论点：微服务环境中的结构有效性与运行稳定性并不保证面向自主消费的语义就绪性，文档缺陷可视为"被智能体推理激活的架构债务"；智能体采用应被理解为社会技术变迁而非纯技术升级；生态级就绪度评估应先于大规模技术推广，作为 AI 采纳路线图中的门控与决策支持机制（呼应 EASE 的"以严格评估伴随技术热情"原则）。局限包括单一组织与内部 API 场景的外推性受限、LLM 检测的模型/提示敏感性、PoC 缺乏重复运行与随机性控制故不可视为统计基准、385/42 工时仅为规划级估算，以及受当时 MCP/LLM 能力限制。后续方向：治理实践演进的纵向研究、受控实验量化文档整改对智能体性能的影响、跨领域与跨 API 生态的复现以增强外部效度。

title: Measuring and Mitigating Toxicity in Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Replication Study
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), when trained on web-scale corpora, inherently absorb toxic patterns from their training data. This leads to ``toxic degeneration'' where even innocuous prompts can trigger harmful outputs. This phenomenon poses significant risks for real-world deployments. Thus, necessitating effective mitigation strategies that should maintain model utility while ensuring safety. In this comprehensive replication study, we evaluate the efficacy of \textbf{DExperts} (Decoding-time Experts), which is an inference-time mitigation technique that steers generation without requiring model retraining. We structured our research into three systematic phases: (1) establishing baseline toxicity measurements using \textbf{RealToxicityPrompts} on standard GPT-2 models; then (2) implementing and evaluating DExperts to mitigate explicit toxicity; and finally (3) stress-testing the method against implicit hate speech using the adversarial \textbf{ToxiGen} dataset. Our empirical results confirm that while DExperts achieves near-perfect safety rates (100\%) on explicit toxicity benchmarks, it exhibits brittleness against adversarial, implicit hate speech, with safety rates dropping to 98.5\%. Furthermore, we quantify a critical trade-off. The method introduces a $\sim$10x latency penalty (from 0.2s to 2.0s per generation), posing challenges for real-time deployment scenarios. This study contributes to the growing body of work on AI safety by highlighting the robustness gap between explicit and implicit toxicity mitigation. We emphasize the need for more sophisticated approaches that generalize across diverse hate speech patterns without prohibitive computational costs.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了推理时毒性缓解方法DExperts在大语言模型上的效果。结果表明该方法在显性毒性缓解上有效（100%安全率），但对隐性仇恨言论存在明显脆弱性（98.5%安全率），且推理延迟增加约10倍，凸显了当前毒性缓解方法在鲁棒性和效率方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在网页规模语料上训练时会吸收有毒模式，导致即使是无害提示也可能触发有害输出（"毒性退化"），对实际部署构成重大风险。因此需要有效的缓解策略，在确保安全性的同时保持模型效用。
AI.method: 构建三阶段系统研究：(1)使用RealToxicityPrompts在标准GPT-2上建立基线毒性测量；(2)实现并评估DExperts缓解显性毒性；(3)使用对抗性ToxiGen数据集进行隐性仇恨言论压力测试。通过对比安全率与延迟指标量化方法效能。
AI.result: DExperts在显性毒性基准上实现近乎完美的安全率（100%），但在对抗性隐性仇恨言论测试中表现脆弱，安全率降至98.5%。同时引入约10倍延迟惩罚（从0.2s增至2.0s/生成），对实时部署构成挑战。
AI.conclusion: DExperts在显性毒性基准上达到100%安全率，但对隐性仇恨言论表现脆弱（98.5%），且引入约10倍延迟惩罚（0.2s→2.0s）。研究强调了当前方法在显性与隐性毒性缓解之间的鲁棒性差距，呼吁开发能跨模式泛化且计算成本可控的更先进方法。

title: A Unified Geometric Framework for Weighted Contrastive Learning
summary: Contrastive learning (CL) aims to preserve relational structure between samples by learning representations that reflect a similarity graph. Yet, the geometry of the resulting embeddings remains poorly understood. Here we show that weighted InfoNCE objectives can be interpreted as Distance Geometry Problems, where the weighting scheme specifies the target geometry to be realized by the representation. This viewpoint yields exact characterizations of the optimal embeddings for several supervised and weakly supervised objectives. In supervised classification, both SupCon and Soft SupCon (a dense relaxation of it where pairs from distinct classes have small non-zero similarity) collapse samples within each class to a single prototype. However, while balanced SupCon recovers the classical regular simplex geometry, class imbalance breaks this symmetry: SupCon induces non-uniform inter-class similarities depending on class sizes, whereas Soft SupCon preserves a regular simplex geometry regardless of class imbalance. In continuous-label settings, our framework reveals a different failure mode: y-Aware CL generally cannot attain its entropic optimum unless the labels lie on a hypersphere, exposing a mismatch between Euclidean label weights and spherical latent similarity. By contrast, geometrically consistent choices such as Euclidean-Euclidean weighting or X-CLR admit unique optimal embeddings. Our results show that the choice of weighting scheme determines whether contrastive learning is geometrically realizable, degenerate, or inconsistent, providing a principled framework for designing contrastive objectives.

AI.tldr: 该论文将加权InfoNCE目标解释为距离几何问题，揭示了对比学习的几何本质：权重方案决定了嵌入空间是否能几何实现、是退化还是不一致。具体而言，监督分类中平衡SupCon产生正则单纯形但类不平衡破坏对称性，而Soft SupCon始终保持正则单纯形；连续标签中y-Aware CL存在几何不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 理解对比学习（CL）生成的嵌入空间的几何性质。
AI.method: 将加权InfoNCE目标解释为距离几何问题，权重方案指定了表示需要实现的目标几何结构。
AI.result: 1）监督分类中，SupCon和Soft SupCon都将同类样本坍缩为单一原型；2）平衡SupCon恢复经典正则单纯形几何，但类不平衡会破坏对称性，而Soft SupCon无论类别是否平衡都保持正则单纯形；3）在连续标签设置中，y-Aware CL通常无法达到熵最优，除非标签位于超球面上，暴露了欧氏标签权重与球面潜在相似性之间的不匹配；4）几何一致的选择如欧氏-欧氏加权或X-CLR允许唯一最优嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 对比学习中的权重方案决定了几何可实现性、退化或不一致性，为设计对比目标提供了原则性框架。

title: From Descriptive to Prescriptive: Uncover the Social Value Alignment of LLM-based Agents
summary: Wide applications of LLM-based agents require strong alignment with human social values. However, current works still exhibit deficiencies in self-cognition and dilemma decision, as well as self-emotions. To remedy this, we propose a novel value-based framework that employs GraphRAG to convert principles into value-based instructions and steer the agent to behave as expected by retrieving the suitable instruction upon a specific conversation context. To evaluate the ratio of expected behaviors, we define the expected behaviors from two famous theories, Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs and Plutchik's Wheel of Emotion. By experimenting with our method on the benchmark of DAILYDILEMMAS, our method exhibits significant performance gains compared to prompt-based baselines, including ECoT, Plan-and-Solve, and Metacognitive prompting. Our method provides a basis for the emergence of self-emotion in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SoVA（Social Value Alignment），一个基于 GraphRAG 的“价值导向”框架：把少量人工撰写的心理学/伦理学规范原则（种子原则）与 DAILYDILEMMAS 标注的社会价值结合，构建价值—实体—关系知识图谱并生成社区摘要，在推理时按查询检索 top-k 指令以引导 LLM（Llama-3-70B-Instruct）作出符合社会价值的两难选择。作者用 Maslow 需求层次、Plutchik 情绪轮、亚里士多德德性三类理论定义“期望行为比例”（r）与“德性偏好得分”（s_preference），并在 DAILYDILEMMAS 上取得优于 ECoT、Plan-and-Solve、Metacognitive Prompting 等提示基线的显著提升，且可迁移到开放式对话（DailyDialog、ESConv）；但作者也承认指令检索会抑制创造力并破坏多轮情感连贯性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体要在人机社交场景中被信任，必须与人类的社会价值（需求、情绪、道德德性）对齐，但现有工作存在三重缺陷：① 自我认知不足，难以理解自身在社会情境中的位置与动机；② 面临两难（dilemma）时无法给出符合社会规范的选择；③ 缺乏“自我情绪”，无法像人一样产生并表露情绪反应。已有对齐路线（微调如 CENTaUR、SteerLM；多模态社交机器人 Nadine；自我博弈式社会场景模拟）大多依赖与社会隔离的数据集或模拟器，泛化到陌生情境能力差；同时高质量社会标注稀缺、人机交互采样效率低，导致训练出的智能体难以展现类人情绪、道德与决策。此外，作者认为心理学中大量“描述性（descriptive）”理论（Maslow、Plutchik、道德基础理论）长期只被用于事后解释，而未被转化为可执行的“规范性（prescriptive/normative）”指导原则，存在未被利用的价值对齐空间。
AI.method: 框架名为 SoVA（Social Value Alignment），建立在 GraphRAG（Edge et al., 2024）之上，构建一个动态、自适应的“指令元缓冲区”。具体为：① 弱监督种子原则——人工撰写 18 条 Maslow 原则、32 条 Plutchik 原则、16 条 Aristotle 原则，并引入 MIC（Ziems et al., 2022）中 99k 条经核验的 RoT 原则作为补充；② 索引阶段（价值化 KG 抽取）——每次随机采样一条原则与一个价值，组合成“原则—价值”对作为图谱文本块，按 GraphRAG 的实体/关系抽取（E&R）提示构建 KG，做社区检测并生成社区摘要（CS）；③ 查询阶段——面向查询的摘要（QFS）生成社区答案（CA），由 LLM 给出 0–100 分打分，排序后召回 top-k 个 CA（设分数阈值 ε），再由 LLM 汇总生成全局答案（GA），取 top-k 指令注入提示以引导 LLM 行为。该 top-k 机制是对 GraphRAG “全局搜索”（开销大）与“局部搜索”（仅 top-1，有偏）之间的折中；另设外层检索器（可选 E5-large）对指令再排序。评测：测试台为 DAILYDILEMMAS 的二选一困境（BCQ，每选项带社会价值标注）；指标包括期望行为比例 r（Maslow：选低层级需求的选项占跨需求困境比；Plutchik：有效情绪—行为转化占可转化困境比，由 GPT4o 标注行为或“no behavior”）、德性偏好得分 s_preference（GPT4o 对 9 种德性打 0–100 分，取被选与被拒选项的平均差）、Rouge-L/BLEU-2、以及 4 名人工评审的盲测胜平负（价值对齐、自然流畅、情感认知、语义理解四个维度）；基线包括 Direct、ECoT、Plan-and-Solve、Metacognitive Prompting、Naïve RAG、SFT、SteerLM；还做跨模型规模扩展性实验、GraphRAG 指令与价值偏好的相关性分析，以及向开放式对话（DailyDialog、ESConv）的迁移。附录给出公式：Maslow 冲突矩阵 C_ij∈[-1,1]、Plutchik 情绪—行为占比 M_e,b、价值计数/权重/支持-反对分差 ΔE[n_i] 等。
AI.result: 在 DAILYDILEMMAS 上，SoVA 相对 ECoT、Plan-and-Solve、Metacognitive Prompting 等提示类基线在 Maslow、Plutchik、Aristotle 三类场景的期望行为比例与德性偏好得分上均取得显著提升，并优于 SFT、SteerLM 等微调类方法；作者报告 GraphRAG 指令与价值偏好之间存在可分析的对应关系（价值计数、加权偏好差 ΔE[n_i] 随选择而变化），且方法在不同模型底座与规模上具有可扩展性与稳健性。开放式对话实验中，方法可从二选一困境迁移到自由生成，Rouge-L/BLEU-2 与人工评测显示其在价值对齐、情感认知等维度优于基线，同时暴露副作用：指令检索压平了自由联想式创造（“失业诗人描述月亮”被改写为先满足生理需求），且逐轮检索使多轮情感轨迹割裂（第二轮将道歉降格为维护关系的工具，回应不一致）。需要指出：提供的文本中实验章节（第 4 节）缺失，具体数值与显著性检验未在文本中给出。
AI.conclusion: SoVA 证明了一条“从描述到规范”的技术路径：把心理学/伦理学描述性理论编码为规范性原则，用 GraphRAG 将原则与真实社会价值关联成图谱与社区摘要，再以检索方式在推理期动态注入指令，从而在不微调的情况下显著提升 LLM 智能体的社会价值对齐与两难决策质量，并可为 AI 系统的“自我情绪”涌现提供基础。其价值主要在三点：把稀疏人工标注自动扩展成大规模可检索指令；用成熟心理理论提供可操作的评测口径（期望行为比例、德性偏好得分）；证明了价值对齐行为可从封闭式二选一迁移到开放式情感支持对话。局限与展望：指令仓库偏向保守/常见模板会牺牲创造性与发散性，逐轮语义匹配损害跨轮连贯性与情感一致性，未来需引入跨轮上下文聚合、指令多样性与去保守化机制，并把评价从 GPT4o 自动打分扩展到更可靠的人工与真实交互验证。

title: Finite Sample Bounds for Learning with Score Matching
summary: Learning of continuous exponential family distributions with unbounded support remains an important area of research for both theory and applications in high-dimensional statistics. In recent years, score matching has become a widely used method for learning exponential families with continuous variables due to its computational ease when compared against maximum likelihood estimation. However, theoretical understanding of the statistical properties of score matching is still lacking.
