AI.result: (1) 段可分性：ICC_micro=0.3820，ICOR_micro=0.0791，差Δ≈0.30，p<0.001；State段ICC最高(≈0.675)，Latency–State间ICOR偏高(≈0.42)但中位数极低，属离群结构；小提琴图显示ICC分布右移长尾、ICOR集中于零。(2) 时间扰动：循环移位后ICC_shift=0.061、ICOR_shift=0.0343，出现反转，证明分离性依赖真实时序协调。(3) 冗余剪枝稳健性：ICC降至0.3108、ICOR微降至0.0745，Δ=0.2363，仍p<0.001；State段仍保持高内聚，说明部分内聚来自潜在结构而非冗余。(4) 功能分解：所有切分数与聚合窗口下Δ=R_R−R_C恒为正，窗口越长优势越明显。(5) 残差边际性：残余空间AUC持续接近0.5、风险接近或劣于无信息基线；高风险条件下corr(p_R,p_C|p_C>θ_C)围绕零波动、无稳定符号，故无可靠互补信息。(6) 对比：平均风险 canonical 0.155、residual 0.202、full 0.200、PCA 0.163；canonical与full/PCA的配对检验差异均不显著，表明语义分割在保留语义的同时无损于预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 语义特征分割可视为一种"信息保持的结构性过滤器"：它把监测特征空间重组为语义同质、时序协调的功能子系统（典型空间），并把弱信息、结构外围信号隔离到残余空间。典型空间在结构上内聚且在冗余削减后稳健，在预测上承载了故障先验的主要信息且性能与全特征空间和PCA线性压缩相当，但保留了变量与运行机制的语义对应关系——这正是预测性维护中与准确率同等重要的可解释性要求。因此建模与特征工程应主要聚焦典型空间。局限：仅在单一系统、有限故障事件上验证；分割规则依赖人工领域知识、跨系统可移植性受限；信息论结论目前仅为经验性操作化刻画，尚需显式信息量度量加以严格论证。未来方向包括跨基础设施/故障模式推广、与数据驱动优化融合以兼顾可移植性与可解释性、以及引入显式信息论理论刻画。

title: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have driven growing interest in graphical user interface (GUI) agents, yet their generalization remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale training data spanning diverse real-world applications. Existing datasets rely heavily on costly manual annotations and are typically confined to narrow domains. To address this challenge, we propose Video2GUI, a fully automated framework that extracts grounded GUI interaction trajectories directly from unlabeled Internet videos. Video2GUI employs a coarse-to-fine filtering strategy to identify high-quality GUI tutorial videos and convert them into structured agent trajectories. Applying this pipeline to 500 million video metadata entries, we construct WildGUI, a large-scale dataset containing 12 million interaction trajectories spanning over 1,500 applications and websites. Pre-training Qwen2.5-VL and Mimo-VL on WildGUI yields consistent improvements of 5-20% across multiple GUI grounding and action benchmarks, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance. We will release both the WildGUI dataset and the Video2GUI pipeline to support future research of GUI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Video2GUI框架，通过自动化从无标注互联网视频中提取GUI交互轨迹，构建了大规模WildGUI数据集（1200万轨迹、1500+应用），基于该数据集预训练的模型在多个基准上取得5-20%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI智能体的泛化能力受限于训练数据规模不足、覆盖领域狭窄，且依赖昂贵的人工标注，亟需大规模、多样化的自动化数据获取方案。
AI.method: 采用粗到细的两阶段过滤策略筛选高质量GUI教程视频，并将其转换为结构化的智能体轨迹；基于Qwen2.5-VL和Mimo-VL进行预训练验证数据集有效性。
AI.result: 成功构建WildGUI数据集（1200万轨迹、1500+应用），基于该数据集预训练的模型在多个GUI任务基准上实现5-20%的提升。
AI.conclusion: Video2GUI框架通过自动化方式从海量无标注互联网视频中提取GUI交互轨迹，成功构建了包含1200万条轨迹、覆盖1500+应用的大规模WildGUI数据集。基于该数据集预训练的模型在多个GUI任务基准上实现5-20%的提升，证明了大规模自动化数据构建的可行性。

title: AudioMosaic: Contrastive Masked Audio Representation Learning
summary: Audio self-supervised learning (SSL) aims to learn general-purpose representations from large-scale unlabeled audio data. While recent advances have been driven mainly by generative reconstruction objectives, contrastive approaches remain less explored, partly due to the difficulty of designing effective audio augmentations and the large batch sizes required for contrastive pre-training. We introduce \textbf{AudioMosaic}, a contrastive learning-based audio encoder for general audio understanding. During pre-training, AudioMosaic constructs positive pairs by applying structured time-frequency masking to spectrogram patches, which reduces memory usage and enables efficient large-batch training. Compared with generative approaches, the AudioMosaic encoder learns more discriminative utterance-level representations that demonstrate strong transferability across datasets, domains, and acoustic conditions. Extensive experiments show that AudioMosaic achieves state-of-the-art performance on several standard audio benchmarks under both linear probing and fine-tuning. We further show that integrating the pretrained AudioMosaic encoder into audio-language models improves performance on audio-language tasks. The code is publicly available in our \href{https://github.com/HanxunH/AudioMosaic}{GitHub repository}.

AI.tldr: AudioMosaic是一种基于对比学习的音频编码器，通过结构化时频掩码策略解决音频自监督学习中对比方法的内存和设计难题，在多个基准上取得最优性能，并可迁移至音频-语言多模态任务。
AI.motivation: 现有音频自监督学习主要依赖生成式重建目标，对比学习方法因音频增强设计困难和对比学习对大批量训练的依赖而较少被探索。
AI.method: AudioMosaic采用对比学习框架，通过对频谱图patch应用结构化时频掩码策略构建正样本对，降低了内存占用，支持大批量高效训练。
AI.result: AudioMosaic学习到更具判别性的 utterance 级表示，在数据集、领域和声学条件间展现出强迁移能力；在多种音频基准测试的线性探测和微调设置下均达到最优性能；且可有效集成到音频-语言模型中提升多模态任务表现。
AI.conclusion: AudioMosaic通过结构化掩码策略实现了高效的对比学习预训练，在多个音频基准测试上达到最优性能，且可有效迁移至音频-语言多模态任务，验证了对比学习方法在通用音频理解中的可行性。

title: Are Agents Ready to Teach? A Multi-Stage Benchmark for Real-World Teaching Workflows
summary: Language agents are increasingly deployed in complex professional workflows, with tutoring emerging as a particularly high-stakes capability that remains largely unmeasured in existing benchmarks. Effective tutor agents require more than producing correct answers or executing accurate tool calls: a robust tutor must diagnose learner state, adapt support over time, make pedagogically justified decisions grounded in educational evidence, and execute interventions within realistic learning-management systems. We introduce EduAgentBench, a source-grounded benchmark for holistically evaluating tutor agents across the full scope of teaching work. It contains 150 quality-controlled tasks across three capability surfaces: professional pedagogical judgment, situated multi-turn tutoring, and Canvas-style teaching workflow completion. Tasks are constructed through a pedagogical-insight-driven pipeline and evaluated with complementary verification signals and human review. Across a comprehensive evaluation of frontier models, our findings reveal that current models are generally capable of bounded pedagogical judgment, but still fall short of professional teaching standards in situated tutoring and autonomous teaching-workflow execution. To our knowledge, EduAgentBench is the first theory-grounded and realistic benchmark for evaluating the holistic teaching capability of tutor agents, providing a measurement foundation for developing future tutor agents that can support realistic teaching work.

AI.tldr: EduAgentBench 是一个用于全面评估 tutor agents 教学能力的新型基准测试，包含150个任务，覆盖专业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导和教学系统工作流三个维度。评估发现当前前沿模型在情境化辅导和教学流程执行方面仍存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试未能充分衡量 tutoring 这一高风险能力的全部范围。有效的 tutor agents 不仅需要给出正确答案或执行准确工具调用，还必须诊断学习者状态、随时间调整支持、做出有教学依据的决策，并在真实学习管理系统中执行干预措施。
AI.method: 通过教育洞察驱动的问题构建 pipeline 构建了150个质量控制任务，采用互补的验证信号和人工审查进行评估，覆盖三个能力维度：专业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导和 Canvas 风格教学工作流完成。
AI.result: 当前模型在有限的教学判断方面表现尚可，但在情境化 tutoring 和自主教学工作流执行方面仍远未达到专业教学标准。
AI.conclusion: EduAgentBench是首个基于理论且贴合实际场景的 tutor agents 全面评估基准，为开发能够支持真实教学工作的 tutor agents 提供了测量基础。

title: Non-linear Interventions on Large Language Models
summary: Intervention is one of the most representative and widely used methods for understanding the internal representations of large language models (LLMs). However, existing intervention methods are confined to linear interventions grounded in the Linear Representation Hypothesis, leaving features encoded along non-linear manifolds beyond their reach. In this work, we introduce a general formulation of intervention that extends naturally to non-linearly represented features, together with a learning procedure that further enables intervention on implicit features lacking a direct output signature. We validate our framework on refusal bypass steering, where it steers the model more precisely than linear baselines by intervening on a non-linear feature governing refusal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用的“非线性干预”（non-linear intervention）框架：把传统线性干预的“换基”操作推广为可逆非线性特征映射 f_θ，在特征空间坐标轴上做干预后再逆映射回隐藏状态空间；并用 interchange intervention 学习 f_θ，配合针对隐式特征（无直接输出信号）的自监督 hinge 损失。实验在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的“拒答绕过”引导任务上验证：单点干预即达到与线性基线相当的 StrongREJECT 分数（0.813 / 0.760），而编辑幅度比所有线性基线低两个数量级以上；消融表明增益并非来自损失位点与方向的选择，而是来自真正非线性的拒答特征。
AI.motivation: 干预（intervention）是理解 LLM 内部表征的核心因果工具，但现有方法几乎都是线性的：在激活空间沿固定方向做加性或消融，其前提是线性表征假设（LRH）。已有工作表明部分可解释概念并非沿线性方向编码，而是分布在非线性流形上（如星期几的环形结构、计数所需的几何结构），线性干预在构造上无法触及这类特征。此外，对于拒答、风格偏移等“不直接在输出中显现”的隐式特征，缺少直接的输出层训练目标，使得特征映射本身难以学习。本文旨在给出一个可推广的干预形式化表述，并给出可学习该形式、且能处理隐式特征的方法。
AI.method: （1）形式化：将线性干预 h ← h + Σα_i v_i 重写为换基形式 h ← W⁻¹(W h + Σα_i e_i)，其中 W 正交；随后把 W 替换为可逆非线性特征映射 f_θ，定义 h ← f_θ⁻¹(f_θ(h) + Σα_i e_i)。线性干预是 f_θ 为线性映射时的特例，故框架具有完备性/涵盖性。（2）学习 f_θ：构造正负提示集 D⁺（2000 条无害 Alpaca 提示）与 D⁻（2000 条有害 SALAD-Bench 提示）；对配对 (x⁻, x⁺) 做 interchange intervention，令 α_i = (f_θ(h⁺) − f_θ(h⁻))_i，把正样本在目标坐标上的取值“搬运”到负样本上，冻结模型 M，以 L(θ) = E[ℓ(M_int(x⁻, x⁺; θ))] 优化 θ。（3）隐式特征的损失设计：在干预位点下游的各（层, token 位）提取与 F 相关联的方向 v_s（D⁺/D⁻ 的类均值差），仅保留投影对 x⁺/x⁻ 的分离 AUC 超过阈值 τ 的位点构成 S（一次性计算并固定）；损失为 Σ_{s∈S} max(0, μ_s⁺ − v_sᵀ h_s^int) 的 hinge 形式，使干预后各相关位点的投影对齐正样本均值，饱和特性避免过拟合单一站点。（4）实现：f_θ 用 i-ResNet（2 个可逆残差块，分支为两层 MLP，隐宽 128，LeakyReLU(0.1)；通过谱范数运行时估计的重缩放 W̃ = W·min(1, 1/σ̂(W)) 与输出缩放 κ=0.6 保证 Lip(g)<1；逆用不动点迭代至多 30 步、相对残差容差 1e-5，梯度经隐式微分反传），k=1，仅在 block_output 残差流上每例干预一个位点（Llama 第 10 层 token −3；Qwen 第 14 层 token −4），推理时用无害集上 f_θ(h) 首坐标的缓存均值 Ȳ⁺ 并做 clamp 代替逐次正样本。（5）评测：StrongREJECT（313 条有害提示，LLM 评审）与总干预幅度（各编辑位点 ‖h′−h‖₂ 之和）双轴评估；基线为 DIM 与 RDO（各自 Ablation 与 ActAdd 两种方案）。
AI.result: 非线性方法每例仅编辑 1 个位点，StrongREJECT 达 Llama 0.813 / Qwen 0.760，与需要编辑成千上万个位点的线性基线相当；总编辑范数 Llama 仅 3.5（线性基线 1,812–2,899）、Qwen 仅 28.3（线性基线 15,474–41,376），低两个数量级以上。消融：在损失位点沿 v_s 做线性干预得 0.689/0.415，明显低于非线性方法，说明 f_θ 的作用不止于对齐这些投影，而是产生了下游涌现的对齐效应；将 f_θ 限制为线性映射后 StrongREJECT 骤降至 0.010/0.072，证实非线性本身是关键。层扫描显示早期层几乎无效、中层达峰、后期层回落，提示控制拒答/服从的非线性特征主要位于模型中层。Qwen 上复现的 RDO ActAdd 仅得 0.020，作者判定不可靠并从图表中剔除（原文报告其与 Ablation 相当）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的非线性干预形式化统一并推广了线性干预，可触及沿非线性流形编码的特征；配合基于 interchange intervention 的学习流程与面向隐式特征的自监督 hinge 损失，可在拒答绕过这一代表性隐式特征任务上实现与线性基线相当但更“精准”（编辑位点与幅度小两个数量级）的引导，并揭示出主要驻留在模型中层的非线性拒答特征。局限：f_θ 目前仅实现为 i-ResNet，框架同样允许其他可逆架构；干预位置的选取仍需启发式指定（线性干预共有的局限）；方向提取器、位点选择准则与代理损失均为可替换的设计选择。

title: CrystalReasoner: Reasoning and RL for Property-Conditioned Crystal Structure Generation
summary: Generative modeling has emerged as a promising approach for crystal structure discovery. However, existing LLM-based generative models struggle with low-level atomic precision, while diffusion-based methods fall short in integrating high-level scientific knowledge. As a result, generated structures are often invalid, unstable, or do not possess desirable properties. To address this gap, we propose CrystalReasoner (\method), an end-to-end LLM framework that generates crystal structures from natural language instructions through reasoning and alignment. \method introduces physical priors as thinking tokens, which include crystallographic symmetry, local coordination environments and predicted physical properties before generating atomic coordinates. This bridges the gap between natural language and 3D structures. \method then employs reinforcement learning (RL) with a multi-objective, dense reward function to align generation with physical validity, chemical consistency, and thermodynamic stability. For property-conditioned tasks, we design task-specific reward functions and train specialized models for discrete constraints (e.g., space group) and continuous properties (e.g., elasticity, thermal expansion). Empirical results demonstrate that compared to prior works and baselines without thinking traces or RL, \method obtains better performance on diverse metrics, triples S.U.N. ratio, and achieves better performance for property conditioned generation. \method also exhibits adaptive reasoning, increasing reasoning lengths as the number of atoms increases. Our work demonstrates the potential of leveraging thinking traces and RL for generating valid, stable, and property-conditioned crystal structures. Please see our work at https://crystalreasoner.github.io/ .

AI.tldr: CrystalReasoner是一个端到端LLM框架，通过物理先验作为思考令牌和强化学习多目标奖励，从自然语言指令生成晶体结构，实现了物理有效性、化学一致性和热力学稳定性的对齐，并在属性条件生成任务上取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的生成模型在原子级精度上存在不足，而基于扩散的方法难以整合高层科学知识，导致生成的晶体结构常无效、不稳定或不具有目标性质。
AI.method: 1) 引入物理先验作为"思考令牌"(thinking tokens)，在生成原子坐标前融入晶体学对称性、局部配位环境和预测物理性质；2) 采用强化学习(RL)结合多目标密集奖励函数，对齐物理有效性、化学一致性和热力学稳定性；3) 为属性条件任务设计专用奖励函数，训练针对离散约束(如空间群)和连续属性(如弹性、热膨胀)的专门模型。
AI.result: 相比先前工作和无思考痕迹/RL的基线模型，CrystalReasoner在多项指标上表现更优，S.U.N.比率提升3倍，属性条件生成任务性能更佳，并展现自适应推理能力(原子数增加时推理长度增长)。
AI.conclusion: Thinking traces和强化学习的结合为生成有效、稳定且满足性质约束的晶体结构提供了新范式，展示了将LLM推理能力与物理先验知识融合的巨大潜力。

title: Streaming Speech-to-Text Translation with a SpeechLLM
comment: 9 pages of main text; 24 pages in total
summary: Normally, a system that translates speech into text consists of separate modules for speech recognition and text-to-text translation. Combining those tasks into a SpeechLLM promises to exploit paralinguistic information in the speech and to reduce cascaded errors. But existing SpeechLLM systems are slow since they do not work in a real streaming fashion: they wait for a complete utterance of audio before outputting a translation, or output tokens at fixed intervals, which is not suitable for real applications. This work proposes an LLM-based architecture for real streaming speech-to-text translation. The LLM learns not just to emit output tokens, but also to decide whether it has seen enough audio to do so. The system is trained using automatic alignments of the input speech and the output text. In experiments on different language pairs, the system achieves a translation quality close to the non-streaming baseline, but with a latency of only 1-2 seconds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于LLM的实时流式语音到文本翻译架构。该系统创新性地让LLM同时学习生成翻译和判断音频是否充分，而非等待完整语句。实验表明该方法在多语言对上接近非流式基线质量的同时，实现了1-2秒的低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有 SpeechLLM 系统无法实时流式输出，必须等待完整音频或按固定间隔输出，导致延迟高、速度慢，无法满足实际应用需求。
AI.method: 采用LLM架构，使其能够同时学习输出标记以及判断是否已收集足够音频来生成翻译。通过自动对齐的语音输入和文本输出进行训练，实现了真正的流式处理而非等待完整 utterance 或固定间隔输出。
AI.result: 在不同语言对的实验中，系统实现了接近非流式基线的翻译质量，同时将延迟控制在1-2秒以内。
AI.conclusion: 该系统首次实现了基于LLM的流式语音到文本翻译，在保持接近非流式基线翻译质量的同时，将延迟降低至1-2秒，兼顾了质量与实时性。

authors: Francisco Nattero Santiago Mauricio Barron Bucolo
title: Active Learners as Efficient PRP Rerankers
summary: Pairwise Ranking Prompting (PRP) elicits pairwise preference judgments from an LLM, which are then aggregated into a ranking, usually via classical sorting algorithms. However, judgments are noisy, order-sensitive, and sometimes intransitive, so sorting assumptions do not match the setting. Because sorting aims to recover a full permutation, truncating it to meet a call budget does not produce a dependable top-K. We thus reframe PRP reranking as active learning from noisy pairwise comparisons and show that active rankers are drop-in replacements that improve NDCG@10 per call in the call-constrained regime. Our noise-robust framework also introduces a randomized-direction oracle that uses a single LLM call per pair. This approach converts systematic position bias into zero-mean noise, enabling unbiased aggregate ranking without the cost of bidirectional calls.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM排序重框架为噪声比较的主动学习问题，引入随机方向预言机将位置偏差转换为零均值噪声，在保持单次LLM调用效率的同时实现了噪声鲁棒的排序。
AI.motivation: 现有PRP方法存在三个核心问题：LLM判断存在噪声干扰、排序结果对输入顺序敏感、以及判断可能存在不可传递性。传统排序算法的全排列恢复假设与实际场景不匹配，且截断排序无法产生可靠top-K结果。
AI.method: 将PRP重框架化为噪声比较的主动学习问题，并引入随机方向预言机（randomized-direction oracle），每次比较仅需单次LLM调用，将系统性位置偏差转换为零均值噪声，从而实现无偏聚合排序。
AI.result: 在调用受限场景下，主动排序器可作为直接替代方案，显著提升NDCG@10指标；随机方向预言机实现无偏聚合排序，同时避免了双向调用的成本开销。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将系统性的位置偏差转换为零均值噪声，实现了无偏的聚合排序，同时避免了双向调用的成本。在调用受限场景下，主动排序器可作为直接替代方案，显著提升NDCG@10指标。

title: Herculean: An Agentic Benchmark for Financial Intelligence
summary: As AI agents improve, the central question is no longer whether they can solve isolated well-defined financial tasks, but whether they can reliably carry out financial professional work. Existing financial benchmarks offer only a partial view of this ability, as they primarily evaluate static competencies such as question answering, retrieval, summarization, and classification. We introduce Herculean, the first skilled benchmark for agentic financial intelligence spanning four representative workflows, including Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, and Auditing. Each workflow is instantiated as a standardized MCP-based skill environment with its own tools, interaction dynamics, constraints, and success criteria, enabling consistent end-to-end assessment of heterogeneous agent systems. Across frontier agents, we find agents perform relatively well on Trading and Market Insights, but struggle substantially on Hedging and Auditing, where long-horizon coordination, state consistency, and structured verification are critical. Overall, our results point to a key gap in current agents in turning financial reasoning into dependable workflow execution in high-stakes financial workflows.

AI.tldr: Herculean是首个面向金融智能体技能的综合基准测试，涵盖Trading、Hedging、Market Insights和Auditing四个工作流。研究发现当前智能体在简单任务上表现尚可，但在高风险金融工作流中，将金融推理转化为可靠执行的能力存在关键短板。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准仅评估静态能力（问答、检索、摘要、分类），无法全面衡量AI智能体可靠完成金融专业工作的能力。
AI.method: 构建基于MCP的标准化技能环境，涵盖四个代表性金融工作流，每个工作流具有独立的工具、交互动态、约束条件和成功标准，实现对异构智能体系统的端到端一致评估。
AI.result: 前沿智能体在Trading和Market Insights上表现较好，但在Hedging和Auditing上表现不佳，这些任务需要长时序协调、状态一致性和结构化验证。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI智能体在静态任务上表现良好，但在需要长时序协调、状态一致性和结构化验证的高风险金融工作流中仍存在显著差距，需提升金融推理到可靠工作流执行的转化能力。

title: Graphs of Research: Citation Evolution Graphs as Supervision for Research Idea Generation
summary: Research idea generation is the innovation-driving step of automated scientific research. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown potential for automating idea generation at scale. However, existing methods mainly condition LLMs on eliciting idea generation through static retrieval of relevant literature or complex prompt engineering, without discarding the structural relations among references. We propose Graphs of Research (GoR), a supervised fine-tuning method that extracts a 2-hop reference neighborhood for each seed paper, derives the relations among those references from citation position, frequency, predecessor links, and publication time, and organizes them into a paper-evolution directed acyclic graph (DAG). We construct an automated extraction pipeline that draws data from five major ML/NLP venues, comprising 498/50/50 train/validation/test seed papers and approximately 7,600 cited references. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M is fine-tuned on a structured-text prompt that includes the citation graph, edge signals, reference information, and task definition to predict the idea for the seed paper. Across head-to-head LLM-judge tournaments against gpt-4o-driven baselines, GoR-SFT achieves SOTA, demonstrating the effectiveness of citation-evolution graphs as supervision signal for LLM-based idea generation. We hope that this reduces the barrier for citation evolution graphs as a supervision, accelerating automated scientific innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GoR方法，通过构建包含引用位置、频率、前驱链接和发表时间等关系的论文演化DAG图，对LLM进行监督微调，以生成研究想法。实验证明该方法在自动化科研创意生成任务上优于现有最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要通过静态检索相关文献或复杂提示工程来激发LLM生成研究想法，忽视了参考文献之间的结构化关系，限制了创意生成的质量和创新性。
AI.method: 构建了自动化抽取流水线，从5个ML/NLP顶会抽取498/50/50的训练/验证/测试种子论文及其约7,600篇被引用文献。使用监督微调(SFT)方法，基于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M模型，通过包含引用图、边信号、参考文献信息和任务定义的结构化文本提示进行训练，预测种子论文的研究想法。
AI.result: GoR-SFT在LLM-judge评选的对抗赛中超越了gpt-4o驱动的基线模型，取得了SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: GoR-SFT 通过构建论文演化DAG图，将引用关系结构化地融入LLM微调过程，显著提升了AI生成研究想法的质量与创新性，为自动化科学研究降低了门槛。

title: Paraphrasing Attack Resilience of Various AI-Generated Text Detection Methods
summary: The recent large-scale emergence of LLMs has left an open space for dealing with their consequences, such as plagiarism or the spread of false information on the Internet. Coupling this with the rise of AI detector bypassing tools, reliable machine-generated text detection is in increasingly high demand. We investigate the paraphrasing attack resilience of various machine-generated text detection methods, evaluating three approaches: fine-tuned RoBERTa, Binoculars, and text feature analysis, along with their ensembles using Random Forest classifiers. We discovered that Binoculars-inclusive ensembles yield the strongest results, but they also suffer the most significant losses during attacks. In this paper, we present the dichotomy of performance versus resilience in the world of AI text detection, which complicates the current perception of reliability among state-of-the-art techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了AI文本检测领域"性能与韧性"的二元困境：当前最强检测方法反而最脆弱，表明现有SOTA技术的可靠性评估需要重新审视。
AI.motivation: LLMs大规模涌现导致plagiarism和虚假信息传播问题加剧，加之AI检测规避工具兴起，对可靠的机器生成文本检测技术需求日益迫切。
AI.method: 研究评估了三种机器生成文本检测方法（微调RoBERTa、Binoculars、文本特征分析）及其与随机森林分类器的集成方案在 paraphrase 攻击下的韧性表现。
AI.result: Binoculars集成方法取得最强检测性能，但在攻击中遭受最显著的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的AI文本检测技术存在"性能-韧性"权衡困境：表现最佳的检测方法（如Binoculars集成方法）在面对 paraphrase 攻击时反而最为脆弱，挑战了对现有技术的可靠性认知。

title: Uncovering the Representation Geometry of Minimal Cores in Overcomplete Reasoning Traces
summary: Language models often generate long chain-of-thought traces, but it remains unclear how much of this reasoning is necessary for preserving the final prediction. We study this through the lens of overcomplete reasoning traces: generated traces that contain more intermediate steps than are needed to support the model's answer. We define the minimal core as the smallest subset of steps that preserves either the final answer or predictive distribution, and introduce metrics for compression ratio, redundancy mass, step necessity, and necessity concentration. Across six deliberative reasoning benchmarks spanning arithmetic, competition mathematics, expert scientific reasoning, and commonsense multi-hop QA, we find substantial overcompleteness: on average, 46% of steps are removable under greedy minimal-core extraction while preserving the original answer in 86% of cases. We also find that predictive support is concentrated: the top three steps account for 65% of measured necessity mass on average. Beyond compression, minimal cores expose a cleaner geometry of reasoning: compared with full traces, they improve correct-incorrect trace separation by 11 points, reduce estimated intrinsic dimensionality by 34%, and transfer across model families with 85% off-diagonal answer retention. Theoretically, we establish existence of minimal sufficient subsets, local irreducibility guarantees for greedy elimination, and certificates of overcompleteness and sparse necessity. Together, these results suggest that full reasoning traces are often verbose and overcomplete, while minimal cores isolate the effective support underlying language-model predictions.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了语言模型推理过程中的冗余性，发现链式思维推理存在大量冗余（平均46%步骤可移除），但预测支撑集中在少数关键步骤（前3个步骤占65%）。最小核心能提升轨迹质量、降低维度34%，并可跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成长链式思维轨迹，但这些推理过程中有多少步骤对最终预测真正必要尚不清楚，需要理解推理过程中的冗余程度。
AI.method: 通过贪婪最小核心提取方法，在六个推理基准测试上评估步骤可移除比例；引入压缩率、冗余质量、步骤必要性和必要性集中度等指标；使用预测分布支撑度测量单个步骤的贡献。
AI.result: 平均46%的推理步骤可移除，同时在86%的情况下保持原始答案；前三个步骤占据平均65%的必要性质量；最小核心展现出更清晰的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 最小核心能改善正确/错误轨迹分离11个百分点，降低估计内在维度34%，跨模型家族转移时保持85%的答案保留率。理论层面存在最小充分子集，局部不可约保证适用于贪婪消除，并为冗余性和稀疏必要性提供证书。

title: Conversion of Lexicon-Grammar tables to LMF. Application to French
summary: We describe the first experiment of conversion of Lexicon-Grammar tables for French verbs into the Lexical Markup Framework (LMF) format. The Lexicon-Grammar of the French language is currently one of the major sources of lexical and syntactic information for French. Its conversion into an interoperable representation format according to the LMF standard makes it usable in different contexts, thus contributing to the standardization and interoperability of natural language processing dictionaries. We briefly introduce the Lexicon-Grammar and the derived dictionaries; we analyse the main difficulties faced during the conversion; and we describe the resulting resource.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了首次将法语动词的《词典-语法》（Lexicon-Grammar）表格转换到词汇标记框架（LMF）标准格式的实验，完成了从源表格到可互操作资源的转换，并分析了其中的技术难点。
AI.motivation: 《法语词典-语法》（Lexicon-Grammar）是目前法语最主要的词汇与句法信息来源之一，但其表格化、非标准化的组织方式限制了它在计算语言学中的复用。将其转换为符合LMF标准的可互操作表示后，可在统一框架下与其他词典、形态与句法分析工具（如Unitex、有限状态处理机）对接，推动NLP词典的标准化与互操作性。
AI.method: 作者首先简要介绍了Lexicon-Grammar本体及其派生词典（动词变位/句型表格等）；随后系统分析了转换过程中遇到的主要困难，例如：表格结构高度复杂且列数可变、多张子表之间存在嵌套与交叉引用、单元格中的信息既有线性文本又有受约束的候选集合、语法标注与形态标注体系与LMF数据模型不一致、以及源数据在XML/编码层面的不规整（需要清洗与统一）；在此基础上设计了转换方案（解析源表格结构、抽取并重排属性、重建LMF的词条/特征/关系层级），最后描述了由此生成的目标资源。
AI.result: 成功构建出第一个覆盖法语动词Lexicon-Grammar表格的LMF格式词汇资源，源表格中的形态、句法与框架信息被映射为LMF词条、特征结构与关系表示；转换流程可处理表格中的复杂变位与句型组织，使该资源能够被标准的NLP工具链读取与复用。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，将Lexicon-Grammar表格转换为LMF在技术上可行，产出的资源有助于法语词汇与句法信息的标准化和跨工具互操作；同时转换中暴露的结构不规整与标注不一致问题，也指明了后续完善Lexicon-Grammar电子化与扩展到其他词类的方向。

title: Latency-Quality Routing for Functionally Equivalent Tools in LLM Agents
summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents increasingly access the same tool type through multiple functionally equivalent providers, such as web-search APIs, retrievers, or LLM backends exposed behind a shared interface. This creates a provider-routing problem under runtime load: the router must choose among providers that differ in latency, reliability, and answer quality, often without gold labels at deployment time. We introduce LQM-ContextRoute, a contextual bandit router for same-function tool providers. Its key design is latency-quality matching: instead of letting low latency offset poor answers in an additive reward, the router ranks providers by expected answer quality per service cycle. It combines this capacity-aware score with query-specific quality estimation and LLM-as-judge feedback, allowing it to adapt online to both load changes and provider-quality differences. On the main web-search load benchmark, LQM-ContextRoute improves F1 by +2.18 pp over SW-UCB while staying on the latency-quality frontier. In a high-heterogeneity StrategyQA setting, LQM-ContextRoute avoids additive-reward collapse and improves accuracy by up to +18 pp over SW-UCB; on heterogeneous retriever pools, it improves NDCG by +2.91--+3.22 pp over SW-UCB. These results show that same-function tool routing benefits from treating latency as service capacity, especially when runtime pressure and provider-quality heterogeneity coexist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LQM-ContextRoute，一种用于同功能工具提供商路由的上下文赌博机路由器。核心创新是将延迟视为服务容量而非加性惩罚项，结合容量感知评分、查询特定质量估计和LLM-as-judge反馈实现运行时自适应。在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，尤其在高异质性场景下优势明显。
AI.motivation: 工具增强型LLM智能体经常需要访问功能等效但性能特征（延迟、可靠性、答案质量）差异显著的多个提供商。在部署时往往缺乏金标准标签，现有的加性奖励方法在提供商异质性高时会出现"奖励崩溃"问题，无法有效平衡延迟与质量。
AI.method: LQM-ContextRoute采用上下文赌博机框架进行在线适配。核心设计是"延迟-质量匹配"：按服务周期内的预期答案质量对提供商排序，而非将低延迟作为加性奖励的抵消项。方法融合了容量感知评分（将延迟建模为服务容量约束）、查询特定质量估计（基于上下文特征预测提供商表现）以及LLM-as-judge反馈（用于无标签环境下的在线学习）。
AI.result: 主网页搜索基准上，LQM-ContextRoute的F1比SW-UCB提升+2.18pp；在高异质性StrategyQA设置中，避免了加性奖励崩溃，准确率比SW-UCB提升达+18pp；在异质性检索器池中，NDCG比SW-UCB提升+2.91至+3.22pp。
AI.conclusion: LQM-ContextRoute通过将延迟视为服务容量而非简单惩罚项，在高负载、高异质性的工具路由场景中显著优于传统加性奖励方法。消融实验表明容量感知评分、查询特定质量估计和LLM-as-judge反馈三个组件缺一不可。

title: Nexus : An Agentic Framework for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting is not just numerical extrapolation, but often requires reasoning with unstructured contextual data such as news or events. While specialized Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) excel at forecasting based on numerical patterns, they remain unaware to real-world textual signals. Conversely, while LLMs are emerging as zero-shot forecasters, their performance remains uneven across domains and contextual grounding. To bridge this gap, we introduce Nexus, a multi-agent forecasting framework that decomposes prediction into specialized stages: isolating macro-level and micro-level temporal fluctuations, and integrating contextual information when available before synthesizing a final forecast. This decomposition enables Nexus to adapt from seasonal signals to volatile, event-driven information without relying on external statistical anchors or monolithic prompting. We show that current-generation LLMs possess substantially stronger intrinsic forecasting ability than previously recognized, depending critically on how numerical and contextual reasoning are organized. Evaluated on data strictly succeeding LLM knowledge cutoffs spanning Zillow real estate metrics and volatile stock market equities, Nexus consistently matches or outperforms state-of-the-art TSFMs and strong LLM baselines. Beyond numerical accuracy, Nexus produces high-quality reasoning traces that explicitly show the fundamental drivers behind each forecast. Our results establish that real-world forecasting is an agentic reasoning problem extending well beyond only sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: Nexus是一个多智能体时间序列预测框架，通过将预测分解为宏观/微观时间波动分离和上下文信息整合等专门阶段来弥合传统时间序列模型与大型语言模型之间的差距。实验表明当前LLM在正确组织数值和上下文推理的情况下具有更强的内在预测能力，预测任务本质上是一个智能体推理问题而非单纯的序列建模问题。
AI.motivation: 当前时间序列基础模型擅长基于数值模式的预测，但对现实世界的文本信号缺乏感知能力；而大型语言模型虽能进行零样本预测，但在不同领域和上下文理解上表现不一致。因此需要一种能够桥接数值预测和上下文推理的混合方案。
AI.method: 提出Nexus多智能体预测框架，该框架将预测分解为专门阶段：分离宏观级别和微观级别的时间波动，在有上下文信息时进行整合，最后综合得出预测。该框架不依赖外部统计锚点或单一提示，而是根据从季节性信号到波动性事件驱动信息的不同情况进行自适应调整。
AI.result: Nexus在严格遵循LLM知识截止日期的数据上进行了评估，覆盖Zillow房地产指标和波动性股票市场，在数值准确性和推理质量上均达到或超越了最先进的时间序列基础模型和强基线的LLM方法。同时，该框架还产生了高质量的推理痕迹，清晰展示了每个预测背后的基本驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: Nexus通过将预测任务分解为专门的阶段来处理时间序列预测中的数值和上下文信息，成功证明了当前大型语言模型具有比以往更强的内在预测能力。这一研究将现实世界的预测问题重新定义为一个智能体推理问题，而非仅仅的序列建模任务。

title: Tokenizer Fertility and Zero-Shot Performance of Foundation Models on Ukrainian Legal Text: A Comparative Study
summary: Foundation models tokenize Ukrainian legal text with vastly different efficiency, yet no systematic comparison exists for this domain. We benchmark seven models from five providers on 273 validated court decisions from Ukraine's state registry (EDRSR), measuring tokenizer fertility and zero-shot performance on three tasks. Three findings emerge. (1) Tokenizer fertility varies 1.6x: Qwen3 models consume 60% more tokens than Llama-family models on identical input, directly reducing API cost. (2) NVIDIA Nemotron Super 3 (120B) achieves the highest composite score (83.1), outperforming Mistral Large 3 (675B total, 41B active) -- a model with 5.6x more total parameters and 3.4x more active parameters per token -- at one-third the API cost. (3) Few-shot prompting degrades performance by up to 26 percentage points; stratified and prompt-sensitivity ablations confirm this is intrinsic to Ukrainian-language demonstrations, not an artifact of example selection. For practitioners: tokenizer analysis should precede model selection, and zero-shot is a more reliable default than few-shot for morphologically rich languages.

AI.tldr: This paper benchmarks seven LLMs on Ukrainian legal text, finding tokenizer efficiency varies 1.6x across models, Nemotron Super 3 (120B) outperforms much larger Mistral Large 3 despite lower API cost, and few-shot prompting actually degrades performance by up to 26 percentage points for morphologically rich languages.
AI.motivation: Foundation models tokenize Ukrainian legal text with vastly different efficiency, yet no systematic comparison exists for this domain.
AI.method: Benchmarked seven models from five providers on 273 validated Ukrainian court decisions (EDRSR), measuring tokenizer fertility and zero-shot performance on three tasks.
AI.result: (1) Tokenizer fertility varies 1.6x; Qwen3 models consume 60% more tokens than Llama-family. (2) NVIDIA Nemotron Super 3 (120B) outperforms Mistral Large 3 (675B/41B active) with 5.6x fewer parameters at one-third the API cost. (3) Few-shot prompting degrades performance by up to 26pp due to Ukrainian-language demonstrations' intrinsic properties.
AI.conclusion: Tokenizer analysis should precede model selection; zero-shot is a more reliable default than few-shot for morphologically rich languages.

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assistant Cardiotocography: Unified Model for Signal Reconstruction, Fetal Heart Rate Analysis, and Variability Assessment
summary: The monitoring of fetal heart rate (FHR) and the assessment of its variability are crucial for preventing fetal compromise and adverse outcomes. However, traditional methods encounter limitations arising from equipment performance, data transmission, and subjective assessments by doctors. We have developed a tailored AI-based FHrCTG model specifically for FHR monitoring, which effectively mitigates noise interference and precisely reconstructs signals. Our model was pre-trained on a massive dataset consisting of 558,412 unlabeled data points and further refined using 7,266 expert-reviewed entries. To validate FHR, we introduced the Intersection Overlapping Labels (IOL) approach, which transforms rate analysis into categorical judgments. Testing revealed that our model demonstrates high sensitivity and specificity in detecting critical FHR decelerations (89.13% and 87.78%, respectively) and accelerations (62.5% and 92.04%, respectively). Furthermore, based on Fischer's criteria for clinical application, our model achieved impressive AUC scores of 0.7214 and 0.9643 for verifying FHR periodicity and amplitude variation, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种AI驱动的胎心率监测模型，通过大规模预训练和专家标注微调实现了高精度的FHR信号重建与分类，在关键指标检测上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统胎心率监测方法受限于设备性能、数据传输及医生主观评估，亟需更客观、精准的监测手段以预防胎儿窘迫和不良结局。
AI.method: 开发了定制化AI-FHrCTG模型，使用558,412条未标注数据预训练，7,266条专家标注数据微调；引入IOL方法将胎心率分析转化为分类判断。
AI.result: 关键FHR减速检测灵敏度89.13%、特异度87.78%；加速检测灵敏度62.5%、特异度92.04%；FHR周期性验证AUC=0.7214，振幅变异验证AUC=0.9643。
AI.conclusion: 该AI-FHrCTG模型有效降低了噪声干扰，精确重建信号，在关键FHR减速和加速检测中展现出良好的敏感性和特异性，且根据Fischer标准验证达到临床应用要求。

title: Learning to Build the Environment: Self-Evolving Reasoning RL via Verifiable Environment Synthesis
summary: We pursue a vision for self-improving language models in which the model does not merely generate problems or traces to imitate, but constructs the environments that train it. In zero-data reasoning RL, this reframes self-improvement from a data-generation loop into an environment-construction loop, where each artifact is a reusable executable object that samples instances, computes references, and scores responses. Whether this vision sustains improvement hinges on a single property: the environments must exhibit stable solve--verify asymmetry, the model must be able to write an oracle once that it cannot reliably execute in natural language on fresh instances. This asymmetry takes two complementary forms. Some tasks are algorithmically hard to reason through but trivial as code: a dynamic program or graph traversal, compiled once, yields unboundedly many calibrated instances. Others are intrinsically hard to solve but easy to verify, like planted subset-sum or constraint satisfaction. Both create a durable gap between proposing and solving that the policy cannot close by gaming the verifier, and it is this gap that keeps reward informative as the learner improves. We instantiate this view in EvoEnv, a single-policy generator, solver method that synthesizes Python environments from ten seeds and admits them only after staged validation, semantic self-review, solver-relative difficulty calibration, and novelty checks. The strongest evidence comes from the already-strong regime: on Qwen3-4B-Thinking, fixed public-data RLVR and fixed hand-crafted environment RLVR reduce the average, while EvoEnv improves it from 72.4 to 74.8, a relative gain of 3.3%. Stable self-improvement, we suggest, depends not on producing more synthetic data, but on models learning to construct worlds whose difficulty stays structurally beyond their own reach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoEnv，一种自改进语言模型新范式：通过构建具有稳定"求解-验证不对称性"的Python环境实现自我提升，而非仅生成待模仿的数据。EvoEnv从10个种子合成环境，经多阶段验证确保难度超越模型当前能力。在Qwen3-4B-Thinking上实现72.4→74.8的稳定提升(+3.3%)，而传统RLVR方法反而降效。核心洞见：稳定的自我改进依赖于模型学会构建在结构上超出自身能力边界的训练世界。
AI.motivation: Current self-improving LMs merely generate problems/traces to imitate. This data-generation approach may not sustain improvement. The key question: how can environments that train the model itself maintain informative rewards as the learner improves? Answer requires stable solve-verify asymmetry—the model must be able to write an oracle once that it cannot reliably execute in natural language on fresh instances.
AI.method: EvoEnv: single-policy generator-solver method synthesizing Python environments from ten seeds with staged validation, semantic self-review, solver-relative difficulty calibration, and novelty checks. Core insight: zero-data reasoning RL reframes self-improvement as environment construction loop (not data generation), requiring stable solve-verify asymmetry where model can write oracle but cannot reliably execute it on fresh instances. Two asymmetry forms: (1) algorithmically hard to reason but trivial as code (dynamic programs, graph traversals); (2) intrinsically hard to solve but easy to verify (planted subset-sum, CSP).
AI.result: On Qwen3-4B-Thinking, fixed public-data RLVR and fixed hand-crafted environment RLVR both reduce average performance, while EvoEnv improves it from 72.4 to 74.8 (3.3% relative gain), demonstrating stable self-improvement capability.
AI.conclusion: EvoEnv achieves stable self-improvement (72.4→74.8, +3.3%) on Qwen3-4B-Thinking where conventional approaches degrade. Stable improvement requires constructing environments whose difficulty remains structurally beyond the model's own reach, rather than merely producing more synthetic data.

title: Chain-of-Procedure: Hierarchical Visual-Language Reasoning for Procedural QA
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive results on standard image-text tasks, yet their potential for visual procedure question answering (VP-QA) remains largely unexplored. VP-QA presents unique challenges where users query next-step actions by uploading images for intermediate states of complex procedures. To systematically evaluate VLMs on this practical task, we propose ProcedureVQA, a novel multimodal benchmark specifically designed for visual procedural reasoning. Through comprehensive analysis, we identify two critical limitations in current VLMs: inadequate cross-modal retrieval of structured procedures given visual states, and misalignment between image sequence granularity and textual step decomposition. To address these issues, we present Chain-of-Procedure (CoP), a hierarchical reasoning framework that first retrieves relevant instructions using visual cues, then performs step refinement through semantic decomposition, and finally generates the next step. Experiments across six VLMs demonstrate CoP's effectiveness, achieving up to 13% absolute improvement over standard baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉过程问答（VP-QA）任务系统评估VLM性能，发现当前模型存在跨模态检索能力不足和图像序列粒度与文本步骤分解不对齐两大关键问题，提出Chain-of-Procedure（CoP）分层推理框架，通过视觉线索检索、语义分解细化和步骤生成三阶段提升推理能力，实验验证该框架可带来最高13%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在标准图像-文本任务上表现优异，但其解决视觉过程问答（VP-QA）的潜力尚未被充分探索。VP-QA是一个实际应用场景，用户通过上传复杂过程的中间状态图像来查询下一步操作，现有模型在此任务上面临独特挑战。
AI.method: 提出ProcedureVQA基准测试用于系统评估视觉过程推理能力；设计Chain-of-Procedure（CoP）分层推理框架，包含三阶段：1）基于视觉线索检索相关指令；2）通过语义分解进行步骤细化；3）生成下一步动作。
AI.result: 跨六个VLM的实验表明，CoP框架相比标准基线实现了最高13%的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: Chain-of-Procedure框架能有效解决视觉过程推理问题，在6个VLM上实现最高13%的绝对提升，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Action-Conditioned Risk Gating for Safety-Critical Control under Partial Observability
summary: Many safety-critical control problems are modeled as risk-sensitive partially observable Markov decision processes, where the controller must make decisions from incomplete observations while balancing task performance against safety risk. Although belief-space planning provides a principled solution, maintaining and planning over beliefs can be computationally costly and sensitive to model specification in practical domains. We propose a lightweight risk-gated reinforcement learning approximation for risk-sensitive control under partial observability. The method constructs a compact finite-history proxy state and learns an action-conditioned predictor of near-term safety violation. This predicted candidate-action risk is used in two complementary ways: as a risk penalty during value learning, and as a decision-time gate that interpolates between optimistic and conservative ensemble value estimates. As a result, low-risk actions are evaluated closer to reward-seeking estimates, while high-risk actions are evaluated more conservatively. We evaluate the approach in two safety-critical partially observable domains: automated glucose regulation and safety-constrained navigation. Across adult and adolescent glucose-control cohorts, the method improves overall glycemic tradeoffs and substantially reduces runtime relative to a belief-space planning baseline. On Safety-Gym navigation benchmarks, it achieves a more favorable reward-cost balance than unconstrained RL and several standard safe-RL baselines. These results suggest that action-conditioned near-term risk can provide an effective local signal for approximate risk-sensitive POMDP control when full belief-space planning is impractical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"风险门控强化学习（Risk-Gated RL）"：在部分可观测的安全关键控制中，用长度为W的有限历史窗口构造代理状态，学习一个"动作条件化的近端风险预测器"ρ̂(o,a)，并用该风险同时做两件事——训练时作为奖励惩罚项（r̃ = r − λ_risk·ρ̂），决策时作为"门控"在集成评论家的乐观估计 Q⁺（max）与保守估计 Q⁻（min）之间插值得到 Q^gate，再叠加硬性风险阈值 R_max 的可行动作集过滤与"最小风险动作"兜底规则，从而无需显式信念更新即可实现风险敏感控制。作者在 FDA 认证的 UVa/Padova 血糖仿真器（成人/青少年队列）与 Safety-Gym 导航任务上验证：血糖控制 TIR 达 82.0%/71.6%（两个队列最优、平均排名最好），运行时间由 POMDP 基线的 1351s/1346s 降至 144s/136s，单步延迟由 61.914ms 降至 4.363ms；Safety-Gym 两个任务上取得最优 reward/cost 比（0.146 / 0.102）。附录给出理论误差分解（历史截断、对偶次优、统计估计三项）、集成包络保证与"安全时与 POMDP 策略一致、不安全时必然介入"的一致性命题。
AI.motivation: 安全关键控制常同时具有部分可观测性（噪声传感、隐藏餐食吸收、胰岛素延迟作用、潜在扰动）与风险敏感性要求。POMDP 信念空间规划虽是原则性解法，但需要精确的转移/观测模型、递归贝叶斯更新与在线信念空间规划，计算代价高、部署困难；而标准安全强化学习多假设完全状态可观测，或仅把安全作为期望代价/拉格朗日惩罚处理，未显式刻画"每个候选动作在近端引发违规的概率"。作者聚焦一个更窄但更实用的问题：当安全决策主要由短时域约束风险主导时，能否用近期历史的动作条件化近端风险估计替代完整信念推断，在保持安全-性能权衡的同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.method:
**代理状态与风险预测**：不做信念更新，仅将最近W步历史（观测、动作、奖励、成本）压缩为代理状态 o_t=φ(W_t^W)（血糖域含当前CGM、CGM趋势、上次大剂量、衰减的胰岛素在体量；导航域含近期观测/动作与短时域安全交互摘要）；训练一个动作条件化的近端风险预测器 ρ̂(o,a)≈P(E_t(a)=1|H_t)，预测执行候选动作 a 后短时域内进入不安全区域的概率/严重度。

**风险门控值估计**：维护 M 个评论家集成，Q⁺=max_m Q_m、Q⁻=min_m Q_m，门控值 Q^gate(o,a)=(1−ρ̂)Q⁺+ρ̂Q⁻。低风险动作接近乐观包络（趋于奖励导向），高风险动作向保守包络偏移（受悲观主义/保守 Q-Learning 启发），实现对每个候选动作自适应调整保守度。

**动作选择与学习**：硬性可行动作集 A_safe={a: ρ̂(o,a)≤R_max}，在其中取 Q^gate 最大者；若全不可行则退化为最小风险动作 argmin ρ̂（不在不安全动作上最大化价值）。风险模型与评论家联合从回放数据训练，评论家使用风险惩罚奖励 r̃=r−λ_risk·ρ̂，风险标签来自近端违规或脉冲式（pulse）风险标签。

**理论**：定义 Oracle Q*（全历史、真实风险）与代理 Q̃*（窗口代理状态、经验风险），Proposition 1 给出 ‖Q*−Q̃*‖∞ ≤ L_r L_ω C γ^W/(1−β)² + |λ−λ*|/(1−β) + λ*O(1/√n)/(1−β)（历史截断、对偶次优、统计估计三项，Hoeffding 给出 O(1/√n)）；Proposition 2 给出集成包络的指数覆盖界 P(Q̃*∉[Q⁻_M,Q⁺_M])≤p₊^M+p₋^M、极值一致性与 M→∞ 时 Q^gate 的安全感知偏移；Proposition 3 证明安全裕度充足时与 POMDP 策略一致、真正不安全时以概率 1−δ 强制介入且风险 ≤ τ+ε。

**实验设置**：UVa/Padova（simglucose）成人与青少年虚拟患者，每3分钟给离散化大剂量，训练2025-04-19至05-19，随后连续评估14天不重置；对 SafetyPointGoal1 与 SafetyPointCircle1 采用同一控制器。基线包括 POMDP、PID、Meal-Bolus、PPO、Safe-PPO、Safe-DQN，以及 PPO-Lag、TRPO-Lag、CPPO-PID、RCPO、CPO、PCPO、CUP、FOCOPS。
AI.result:
**血糖控制**：RiskGated 成人 TIR 82.0±12.0%、青少年 71.6±16.5%，均为最高；相比 PPO 与 POMDP 成人分别 +4.7/+7.6 个百分点，青少年 +5.9/+14.7 个百分点；低血糖（成人 4.2%）虽不及 Safe-PPO/Safe-DQN（1.9%），但高血糖更轻（13.8% vs 22.1/22.4%），平均排名最优（2.33 / 1.67）。POMDP 虽降低青少年低血糖但高血糖升至 33.1%。运行时间 144s/136s vs POMDP 1351s/1346s（约 9.4 倍加速），单步延迟 4.363ms vs 61.914ms。定性轨迹显示 RiskGated 在更少、更精准的决策点给药。

**Safety-Gym**：SafetyPointGoal1 平均代价 36.93（PPO 109.87）、奖励 5.39、reward/cost 0.146 为全场最优；SafetyPointCircle1 奖励 10.86、代价 106.47、reward/cost 0.102 为最优，代价显著低于 PPO（278.48）与 POMDP（237.23）。该方法未最大化原始奖励（低于 PPO），但相比 CPO/PCPO/CUP/FOCOPS 等避免了"低奖励且效率差"的坍缩。

**风险预测可靠性**：在线预测风险与匹配的事后实现脉冲风险高度一致——平均有符号误差 0.0001、MAE 0.0055、RMSE 0.0197、相关系数 0.9982、Hellinger 距离 0.0054；阈值 R_max=0.25 处的一致率 98.12%（预测超阈 47.60% vs 事后 49.27%）。

**消融/敏感性**：W 与 M 附近取值性能稳定（默认 W=8 即24分钟历史、M=5），说明不依赖精细调参；R_max 呈预期单调安全-性能效应（阈值过小更保守、过大显著增加低血糖时间）；λ_risk 在 0.05–0.20 区间给出最佳权衡，过大（0.85）过度偏向降代价，且该参数作用非单调（硬过滤仍由 ρ̂ 与 R_max 决定）。
AI.conclusion:
结论：动作条件化的近端风险是一种在部分可观测安全关键控制中有效的局部决策信号。用有限历史代理状态 + 风险门控的乐观-保守集成值插值 + 硬阈值过滤/最小风险兜底，可在不维护信念的前提下获得良好的任务性能-安全-计算效率平衡：血糖域同时改善整体血糖质量并把运行时间降一个数量级，Safety-Gym 上取得最优奖励-代价比。理论上，代理策略的误差可分解为历史截断、对偶次优与统计估计三项，并随 W→∞、n→∞ 收敛至 Oracle；安全裕度足够时与 POMDP 策略一致，裕度被突破时保证介入。

局限与展望：代理表示与风险特征仍部分依赖具体领域（血糖域需 CGM 趋势、胰岛素在体量等人工特征，导航域需领域化安全交互摘要）；λ_risk 与 R_max 需人工标定；理论分析假设窗口化信念近似与代理 Q 可精确表示（深度函数逼近误差未计入），且仅以血糖域为主要形式化对象；风险可靠性分析使用与控制器一致的脉冲风险函数作为事后参照，并非独立临床金标准。未来工作应探索统一的可学习表示与自适应风险敏感度（如在线调整阈值/λ），并关注分布偏移下的稳健性与验证充分性。

title: Coding Agent Is Good As World Simulator
summary: World models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for building interactive simulation environments, with recent video-based approaches demonstrating impressive progress in generating visually plausible dynamics. However, because these models typically infer dynamics from video and represent them in latent states, they do not explicitly enforce physical constraints. As a result, the generated video rollouts are not physically plausible, exhibiting unstable contacts, distorted shapes, or inconsistent motion. In this paper, we present an agentic framework constructing physics-based world models through executable simulation code. The framework coordinates planning, code generation, visual review, and physics analysis agents. The planning agent converts the natural language prompt into a structured scene plan, the code agent implements it as executable simulation code, and the visual review agent provide visual feedback while the physics analysis agent checks physical consistency. The code is iteratively revised based on the feedback until the simulation matches the prompt reqirements and physical constraints. Experimental results show that our framework outperforms advanced video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity and visual quality, which could be applied to various scenarios including driving simulation and embodied robot tasks.

AI.tldr: A multi-agent framework that builds physics-based world models by generating executable simulation code, incorporating iterative feedback from visual and physics analysis agents to ensure both prompt alignment and physical plausibility.
AI.motivation: Existing video-based world models infer dynamics from video and represent them in latent states without explicit physical constraints, resulting in physically implausible rollouts exhibiting unstable contacts, distorted shapes, or inconsistent motion.
AI.method: An agentic framework coordinating four specialized agents: (1) Planning agent converts natural language to structured scene plans, (2) Code agent generates executable simulation code, (3) Visual review agent provides visual feedback, (4) Physics analysis agent checks physical consistency. Code is iteratively revised based on agent feedback until requirements and physical constraints are satisfied.
AI.result: Physical accuracy, instruction fidelity, and visual quality exceed those of advanced video-based models.
AI.conclusion: The framework outperforms advanced video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity, and visual quality, with potential applications in driving simulation and embodied robot tasks.

title: Performance-Driven Policy Optimization for Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Windowing
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a lightweight draft model propose speculative windows of candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. In practice, speculative efficiency is often bottlenecked by hard-to-draft positions, where an early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the speculative window. Most learning-based drafters are still optimized with token-level supervised objectives, even though speculative utility is inherently window-level and prefix-sensitive. We propose PPOW (Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing), a reinforcement learning framework that shifts drafter optimization from token-level imitation to window-level optimization. PPOW combines a Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, a Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, and Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing, which prioritizes informative windows with high confidence-weighted draft-target divergence. PPOW achieves average acceptance lengths of 6.29-6.52 and speedups of 3.39-4.36$\times$ across multiple model families and benchmarks under a unified decoding protocol. These results show that performance-driven window-level optimization is a practical approach to improving speculative decoding efficiency.

AI.tldr: PPOW通过强化学习将投机解码的draft模型优化从token级提升到window级，通过成本感知加速奖励、分布邻近性奖励和自适应发散感知窗口化三个机制，在多个模型和基准上实现了3.39-4.36倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型draft模型仍使用token级监督目标进行优化，但投机解码的效用本质上是窗口级且对前缀敏感的，导致hard-to-draft位置成为瓶颈——早期不匹配会截断接受的前缀并使剩余投机窗口失效。
AI.method: 提出PPOW（Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing），结合三个核心组件：1）Cost-Aware Speedup Reward（成本感知加速奖励）；2）Distribution-Based Proximity Reward（基于分布的邻近性奖励）；3）Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing（自适应发散感知窗口化），优先选择高置信度加权draft-target发散的信息性窗口。
AI.result: PPOW在统一解码协议下，在多个模型家族和基准测试上达到平均接受长度6.29-6.52和3.39-4.36倍加速。
AI.conclusion: PPOW通过在多个模型家族和基准测试上实现平均接受长度6.29-6.52和3.39-4.36倍加速，证明了性能驱动的窗口级优化是提高投机解码效率的实用方法。

title: EnergyLens: Predictive Energy-Aware Exploration for Multi-GPU LLM Inference Optimization
summary: We present EnergyLens, an end-to-end framework for energy-aware large language model (LLM) inference optimization. As LLMs scale, predicting and reducing their energy footprint has become critical for sustainability and datacenter operations, yet existing approaches either require production-level code and expensive profiling or fail to accurately capture multi-GPU energy behavior. As a result, practitioners lack tools for deciding which optimizations to prioritize and for selecting among existing deployment configurations when exhaustive profiling is impractical. EnergyLens addresses this gap with an intuitive einsum-based interface that captures LLM specifications including fusion, parallelism, and compute-communication overlap, combined with load-imbalance-aware MoE modeling and an empirically driven communication energy model for multi-GPU settings. We validate EnergyLens on Llama3 and Qwen3-MoE across tensor-parallel and expert-parallel configurations, achieving mean absolute percentage errors (MAPEs) between 9.25% and 13.19% for multi-GPU prefill and decode energy, and 12.97% across SM allocations for Megatron-style overlap. Our energy-driven exploration reveals up to 1.47x and 52.9x energy variation across configurations in prefill and decode efficiency and motivates distributed serving. We further show that compute-communication overlap is difficult to optimize with intuition alone, but EnergyLens correctly identifies Pareto-optimal overlap configurations.

AI.tldr: EnergyLens 是一个仅需高层 einsum 规格（无需 GPU、实现代码或执行 trace）即可预测多 GPU LLM 推理能量与延迟的端到端框架。它支持算子融合、张量并行/专家并行/上下文并行、MoE 负载不均衡建模、基于实测的通信能量模型以及 Megatron 式计算-通信重叠，在 Llama3 与 Qwen3-MoE 上多 GPU 能量 MAPE 为 9.25%–13.19%、重叠场景 12.97%。据此可无测量地识别 Pareto 最优配置（恢复 69% 真实 Pareto 前沿，优于最大重叠启发式的 20%），并揭示 prefill 宜低 TP/小 batch、decode 宜大 batch 的能耗差异，从而支撑分离式（disaggregated）服务部署。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理的算力与能耗开销随规模急剧增长，可持续性与数据中心运营都要求在部署前就能估计并优化推理能耗。实践者在两个阶段需要能量模型：(1) 实现之前，决定优先做哪些优化（融合、并行、计算-通信重叠）；(2) 部署期间，在无法穷举 profiling 时于已有部署配置中做选择。现有方法的不足：直接测量准确但需要 GPU 与大量工程实现，枚举成本极高（例：Llama3-70B 两种融合策略 × 7 batch × 32 输入长度需在 8-GPU 服务器上 profiling 12 小时，而 EnergyLens 仅需 15 分钟）；TDP 类粗放估计易用但忽略 prefill/decode 阶段间高达 60% 的功率差异（A100 上 Llama3-70B decode 能量最多被高估 60%）；LLMCO2 只预测功率、不支持融合实现与 MoE、缺少能量归因；EnergAIzer 等 kernel 级预测器无法刻画多 GPU 效应（TP/EP、通信与重叠），而多 GPU 场景中通信占比已很可观（Llama3-70B 在 8-GPU TP 下 AllReduce 占总能量 23%）。此外，现有并行/重叠延迟模型（如 Hong et al. 2025）假设固定 SM 分配、GEMM 线性切分，在小批量与变 SM 分配下失准。
AI.method: 框架由四部分组成。(1) EnergyLens 接口：用 PyTorch 风格的 einsum 记法在几行代码内描述稠密与 MoE 模型，如 op("bsm,miKh->bsiKh", parallel="K") 表示融合 QKV 投影并按 K 维切分；通过 parallel、CP_dim、overlap_stage、overlap_SM、overlap 等轻量注解表达并行与重叠；模型维度运行时注入，故同一规格可覆盖不同规模与 prefill/decode（s=1）。(2) 轻量解释器：把 einsum 映射为 GEMM 维度 A[M,K]×B[K,N]=C[M,N] 与算术强度，判定计算/访存受限；由切分维与输出张量形状推导所需通信 kernel（AllReduce 判据为被切分维是否在求和下标中，All2All 由相邻算子 CP_dim 变化触发）。对 MoE 引入有效量 E（每 GPU 激活专家数）与 T（每专家有效 token 数，计入负载不均衡与 grouped-GEMM tile 量化，decode 下 tile 最小粒度为 16），延迟按瓶颈 GPU 的 (T_max, E_max) 计算，能量按各 GPU 均值 (T_avg, E_avg) 并加上因不均衡空转产生的 P_idle 等待能量。(3) 通信能量模型：对多种通信 kernel 与传输尺寸实测延迟与能量并插值，刻画小消息下固定开销主导导致每比特延迟/能量上升的行为，并显式建模 SM 数量对通信 kernel 速度的影响。(4) 计算-通信重叠聚合：把 GEMM+AllReduce 层分解为（非重叠计算阶段）→（stage-1 个重叠阶段，耗时取受限 SM 的 GEMM 与 NCCL kernel 的最大值）→（尾部暴露通信阶段），t_total = t_GEMM + t_RS + max(t_GEMM_ovl, t_RS_ovl)×(stage-1)；重叠阶段按 GEMM 估计功率（多数 SM 与显存带宽服务计算），尾部暴露通信阶段沿用重叠阶段功率而非稳态 NCCL 功率（短 kernel 期间 DVFS 难以调压，稳态值会低估能量）。计算侧以 EnergAIzer 为主后端（同时给出延迟与功率），可插拔 NeuSight、Li 等模型。系统还引入能量版指标 ETFT（类比 TTFT）与 EPOT（类比 TPOT，按 OSL 归一化），并输出端到端能量拆解与能量-延迟 Pareto 前沿。
AI.result: 精度：单 GPU Llama3-8B 上 prefill 能量 MAPE 11.31%、decode 能量 12.87%；Llama3-70B TP 上 prefill 能量 12.18%（延迟 12.39%）、decode 能量 12.86%（延迟 25.45%）；TP 重叠 prefill 能量 12.97%、延迟 11.18%；Qwen3-30B-A3B（TP+EP）prefill 能量 9.25%、decode 能量 13.19%；CP2 上 Llama3-8B 能量/延迟 MAPE 14.69%/12.58%。decode 延迟误差偏大源于低算术强度与偏斜矩阵形状（EnergAIzer 25.45%、NeuSight 25.69%、Li 210.59%，说明非后端特有）。能量拆解结论：prefill 计算能量在 TP2→TP8 几乎不变而 AllReduce 成本随 TP 增长（TP8 占总能量 23%）；decode 能量对 batch size 敏感（GEMM 算术强度提升），M=b 小的 kernel 严重欠利用；融合 QKV+Gate/Up 在 prefill 平均省 4.37%、decode ISL=512 平均省 8.18%。探索性发现：(1) 相同 TTFT 下小 batch + 低 TP 更省能——ISL=4096 时 B4/TP2 比 B16/TP8 快且省 24% 能量（实测 30%），全 ISL 平均省 20.87%；(2) decode 增大 batch 大幅降 EPOT——OSL≤7680、TP8 下 B16 相对 B1 降 92.63%，因此 prefill 与 decode 目标相反，强烈支持分离式部署；(3) overlap 难以凭直觉调优——最大重叠启发式只恢复 20% 的实测 Pareto 前沿，而 EnergyLens 预测的 Pareto 子集恢复 69%（32 场景/55 配置），且被选中的配置确实落在实测前沿上。实验共耗费约 1054 GPU-hours，重跑实验 MAPE 与原值接近，可复现性良好。
AI.conclusion: EnergyLens 证明：仅凭高层 einsum 规格即可在无实现、无 trace、无 GPU 的条件下预测多 GPU LLM 推理的能量与延迟，从而把能耗-延迟优化从"部署后测量分析"前移到"设计期空间探索"。其多 GPU 能量误差（9.25%–13.19%）远小于实际配置间的能耗差异（prefill 最高 1.47×、decode 效率最高 52.9×），因此足以支撑排序与 Pareto 识别级别的决策，尤其能捕捉直觉难判的 overlap 权衡。主要局限是 decode 阶段小批量、低算术强度 kernel 的延迟预测不准（MAPE 约 25%），源于计算 kernel 模型本身而非框架实现；此外通信模型在大传输尺寸下与实测一致性高、小尺寸存在偏差。后续可扩展方向包括更精确的通信小消息建模、更多后端/更广架构覆盖，以及将预测直接用于调度与自动配置选择。

title: Metis AI: The Overlooked Middle Zone Between AI-Native and World-Movers
summary: The dominant discourse on AI limitations frames the boundary of AI capability as a divide between digital tasks (where AI excels) and physical tasks (where embodiment is required). We argue this framing misses the most consequential boundary: the one within digital tasks. We identify a class of tasks we call Metis AI, named for the Greek concept of metis (practical, contextual knowledge), that are performed entirely on computers yet resist reliable AI automation. These tasks are not computationally intractable; they are institutionally, socially, and normatively entangled in ways that defeat algorithmic approaches. We distinguish constitutive metis (knowledge destroyed by the act of formalization) from operational metis (system-specific familiarity that automation can progressively absorb), and propose five structural characteristics that define the Metis AI zone: consequential irreversibility, relational irreducibility, normative open texture, adversarial co-evolution, and accountability anchoring. We ground each in established theory from across the social sciences, philosophy, and humanitarian practice, argue that these characteristics are properties of the tasks themselves rather than limitations of current models, and show that the appropriate design response is not better automation but centaur architectures in which humans lead and AI supports.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统AI局限性的认知框架，提出"Metis AI"概念——指那些完全在数字环境中完成、却因社会制度、规范和人际关系的深度纠缠而无法被可靠自动化的任务。通过区分构成性Metis（形式化即被破坏的知识）和操作性Metis（可逐步被吸收的系统特定熟悉度），提出五项结构特征，并主张对此类任务应采用"人马架构"(centaur architectures)——人类主导、AI辅助的设计模式。
AI.motivation: The dominant discourse frames AI limitations as a digital vs. physical task divide. However, this framing misses the most consequential boundary within digital tasks themselves—a class of tasks performed entirely on computers that resist reliable AI automation due to institutional, social, and normative entanglement rather than computational intractability.
AI.method: The paper introduces the concept of "Metis AI" (named after the Greek concept of practical, contextual knowledge), distinguishes between constitutive metis (knowledge destroyed by formalization) and operational metis (system-specific familiarity that automation can progressively absorb), and proposes five structural characteristics defining the Metis AI zone, grounded in social sciences, philosophy, and humanitarian practice theory.
AI.result: Five structural characteristics defining the Metis AI zone: (1) Consequential irreversibility, (2) Relational irreducibility, (3) Normative open texture, (4) Adversarial co-evolution, and (5) Accountability anchoring.
AI.conclusion: The appropriate design response for Metis AI tasks is not better automation, but "centaur architectures" where humans lead and AI supports. These characteristics are inherent properties of the tasks themselves rather than limitations of current AI models.

title: Quantifying and Mitigating Premature Closure in Frontier LLMs
summary: Premature closure, or committing to a conclusion before sufficient information is available, is a recognized contributor to diagnostic error but remains underexamined in large language models (LLMs). We define LLM premature closure as inappropriate commitment under uncertainty: providing an answer, recommendation, or clinical guidance when the safer response would be clarification, abstention, escalation, or refusal. We evaluated five frontier LLMs across structured and open-ended medical tasks. In MedQA (n = 500) and AfriMed-QA (n = 490) questions where the correct choice had been removed, models still selected an answer at high rates, with baseline false-action rates of 55-81% and 53-82%, respectively. In open-ended evaluation, models gave inappropriate answers on an average of 30% of 861 HealthBench questions and 78% of 191 physician-authored adversarial queries. Safety-oriented prompting reduced premature closure across models, but residual failure persisted, highlighting the need to evaluate whether medical LLMs know when not to answer.

AI.tldr: 该研究定义并系统评估了医疗LLM中的"过早终止"现象——即在信息不足时的不当回答倾向。五个前沿模型在此问题上均表现出高风险：错误选择率达55-82%，开放式不当作答率30-78%。Safety-oriented prompting虽有帮助但不足以根本解决，提示当前LLM缺乏对"不确定性边界"的认知能力。
AI.motivation: 过早终止（premature closure）是人类诊断错误的重要因素，但在LLM领域缺乏充分研究。医疗场景中，模型在信息不足时的不当承诺（如给出错误建议）可能造成严重后果，亟需系统性地量化和理解这一问题。
AI.method: 实验设计采用结构化问答（MedQA、AfriMed-QA删除正确答案后测试）与开放式评估（HealthBench、医师设计的对抗性查询）相结合，对五个前沿LLM进行多维度测评。Safety-oriented prompting作为干预手段被纳入以验证缓解效果。
AI.result: 在信息缺失条件下，模型错误选择率高达55-81%（MedQA）和53-82%（AfriMed-QA）。开放式评估中，30%的HealthBench问题与78%的对抗性查询出现不当作答。Safety-oriented prompting虽能降低发生率，但无法彻底消除问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了医疗LLM安全性评估中一个关键缺口：不仅需要评估模型"知道什么"，更需评估"何时应拒绝回答"。Safety-oriented prompting虽可降低风险，但残余失败率表明当前模型在不确定性管理上仍有根本性局限，建议在医疗部署前将"适当时机拒绝能力"纳入核心评估指标。

title: Not All Timesteps Matter Equally: Selective Alignment Knowledge Distillation for Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs), which are brain-inspired and spike-driven, achieve high energy efficiency. However, a performance gap between SNNs and artificial neural networks (ANNs) still remains. Knowledge distillation (KD) is commonly adopted to improve SNN performance, but existing methods typically enforce uniform alignment across all timesteps, either from a teacher network or through inter-temporal self-distillation, implicitly assuming that per-timestep predictions should be treated equally. In practice, SNN predictions vary and evolve over time, and intermediate timesteps need not all be individually correct even when the final aggregated output is correct. Under such conditions, effective distillation should not force every timestep toward the same supervision target, but instead provide corrective guidance to erroneous timesteps while preserving useful temporal dynamics. To address this issue, we propose Selective Alignment Knowledge Distillation (SeAl-KD), which selectively aligns class-level and temporal knowledge by equalizing competing logits at erroneous timesteps and reweighting temporal alignment based on confidence and inter-timestep similarity. Extensive experiments on static image and neuromorphic event-based datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing distillation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/KaiSUN1/SeAl

AI.tldr: 针对SNN中知识蒸馏忽略时间步差异的问题，提出SeAl-KD方法，通过选择性对齐类别知识和时序知识（等化错误时间步的竞争logits+基于置信度和相似性的时序重加权）提升蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 现有SNN知识蒸馏方法对所有时间步施加均匀对齐约束，隐含假设每个时间步的预测应被同等对待。但实践中SNN预测随时间演变，且最终聚合输出正确时中间时间步未必各自正确，有效的蒸馏应为错误时间步提供纠正指导同时保留有用的时序动态。
AI.method: 提出选择性对齐知识蒸馏(SeAl-KD)，通过等化错误时间步的竞争logits实现类别级知识对齐，以及基于置信度和时间步相似性的重加权策略实现时序对齐。
AI.result: 在静态图像和神经形态事件驱动数据集上验证，SeAl-KD相比现有蒸馏方法获得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: SeAl-KD consistently improves SNN performance across both static image and neuromorphic event-based datasets compared to existing distillation methods.

title: A Unified Knowledge Embedded Reinforcement Learning-based Framework for Generalized Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems
summary: The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) is a fundamental NP-hard problem with broad applications in logistics and transportation. Real-world CVRPs often involve diverse objectives and complex constraints, such as time windows or backhaul requirements, motivating the development of a unified solution framework. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches have shown promise in combinatorial optimization, yet they rely on end-to-end learning and lack explicit problem-solving knowledge, limiting solution quality. In this paper, we propose a knowledge-embedded framework inspired by the Route-First Cluster-Second heuristics. It incorporates knowledge at two levels: (1) decomposing CVRPs into the route-first and cluster-second subproblems, and (2) leveraging dynamic programming to solve the second subproblem, whose results guide the RL-based constructive solver to solve the first problem. To mitigate partial observability caused by problem decomposition, we introduce a unified history-enhanced context processing module. Extensive experiments show that this framework achieves superior solution quality compared with state-of-the-art learning-based methods, with a smaller gap to classical heuristics, demonstrating strong generalization across diverse CVRP variants.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CVRP问题，提出将经典Route-First Cluster-Second启发式知识嵌入到强化学习框架中，通过双层知识融合（问题分解+动态规划求解聚类子问题）引导RL求解路线规划问题，并引入历史增强上下文模块解决局部可观测性问题。实验验证了其在解质量和跨变体泛化能力上的优势。
AI.motivation: CVRP作为NP难问题在物流运输中有广泛应用，实际场景涉及多目标优化和复杂约束（时间窗、回程需求等），现有端到端强化学习方法缺乏显式的问题结构知识，限制了求解质量。因此需要开发统一的解决方案框架。
AI.method: 本文提出知识嵌入框架，采用双层知识融合策略：(1) 将CVRP问题分解为路线优先和聚类其次两个子问题；(2) 利用动态规划求解聚类子问题，其结果指导基于RL的构造式求解器完成路线规划。针对问题分解导致的局部可观测性挑战，引入统一的历史增强上下文处理模块。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架在解决方案质量上优于现有基于学习的方法，与经典启发式方法的差距更小，并展现出对多种CVRP变体的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一种知识嵌入的RL框架，将经典启发式算法的结构化知识与深度强化学习相结合，为CVRP及相关组合优化问题提供了有效的求解范式。该框架展示的跨变体泛化能力表明知识嵌入策略可有效提升学习方法的鲁棒性和适应性，为后续研究奠定了基础。

title: The Scientific Contribution Graph: Automated Literature-based Technological Roadmapping at Scale
summary: Scientific contributions rarely develop in isolation, but instead build upon prior discoveries. We formulate the task of automated technological roadmapping as extracting scientific contributions from scholarly articles and linking them to their prerequisites. We present the Scientific Contribution Graph, a large-scale AI/NLP-domain resource containing 2 million detailed scientific contributions extracted from 230k open-access papers and connected by 12.5 million prerequisite edges. We further introduce scientific prerequisite prediction, a scientific discovery task in which models predict which existing technologies can enable future discoveries, and show that contemporary models are rapidly improving on this task, reaching 0.48 MAP when evaluated using temporally filtered backtesting. We anticipate technological roadmapping resources such as this will support scientific impact assessment and automated scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: This paper presents the Scientific Contribution Graph (SCG), a large-scale resource containing 2 million scientific contributions extracted from 230k papers with 12.5 million prerequisite edges, and introduces the scientific prerequisite prediction task. Models achieve 0.48 MAP on this task, demonstrating potential for scientific impact assessment and automated discovery.
AI.motivation: Scientific contributions rarely develop in isolation but build upon prior discoveries. There is a need for automated technological roadmapping to understand and predict how existing technologies enable future discoveries.
AI.method: Extract scientific contributions from scholarly articles and link them to their prerequisites using NLP techniques, constructing a large-scale knowledge graph (SCG) with 2 million contributions and 12.5 million prerequisite edges.
AI.result: Contemporary AI/NLP models are rapidly improving on scientific prerequisite prediction, reaching 0.48 MAP when evaluated using temporally filtered backtesting.
AI.conclusion: The Scientific Contribution Graph (SCG) resource, containing 2 million scientific contributions from 230k papers with 12.5 million prerequisite edges, enables technological roadmapping for scientific impact assessment and automated discovery. Contemporary models achieve 0.48 MAP on this task.

title: Architecture-Aware Explanation Auditing for Industrial Visual Inspection
summary: Industrial visual inspection systems increasingly rely on deep classifiers whose heatmap explanations may appear visually plausible while failing to identify the image regions that actually drive model decisions. This paper operationalizes an architecture-aware explanation audit protocol grounded in the native-readout hypothesis: the perturbation-based faithfulness of an explanation method is bounded by its structural distance from the model's native decision mechanism. On WM-811K wafer maps (9 classes, 172k images) under a three-seed zero-fill perturbation protocol, ViT-Tiny + Attention Rollout attains Deletion AUC 0.211 against 0.432-0.525 for Swin-Tiny / ResNet18+CBAM / DenseNet121 + Grad-CAM (abs(Cohen's d) > 1.1), despite lower classification accuracy. Swin-Tiny disentangles architecture family from readout structure: despite being a Transformer, its spatial feature-map hierarchy makes it Grad-CAM compatible, showing that the operative factor is readout structure rather than architecture family. A model-agnostic control (RISE) compresses all families to Deletion AUC about 0.1, indicating the gap arises from the explainer pathway; notably, RISE outperforms all native methods, so native readout is a compatibility principle rather than an optimality guarantee. A blur-fill sensitivity analysis shows that the family ordering reverses under a different perturbation baseline, reinforcing that faithfulness rankings are joint properties of (model, explainer, perturbation operator) triples. An exploratory boundary-condition study on MVTec AD (pretrained models) indicates that audit results are dataset/task dependent and identifies conditions requiring qualification. The protocol yields actionable guidance: explanation pathways should be co-designed with model architectures based on readout structure, and deployed heatmaps should be accompanied by quantitative faithfulness metrics.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出基于"原生读取假说"的架构感知解释审计协议，证明了ViT+Attention Rollout在扰动保真度上优于CNN+Grad-CAM，且读取结构兼容性比架构家族更具决定性作用。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉检测系统中，深度分类器的热图解释可能视觉上合理但无法真实反映模型决策依据，存在"看似可信但失效"的风险，亟需系统性地审计解释方法的保真度。
AI.method: 采用零填充扰动协议（3个随机种子）在WM-811K晶圆地图数据集上对比ViT-Tiny+Attention Rollout、Swin-Tiny、ResNet18+CBAM、DenseNet121等模型结合Grad-CAM的扰动基删除AUC；同时设置RISE作为模型无关控制组，并进行模糊填充敏感性分析；另在MVTec AD上做探索性边界条件研究。
AI.result: ViT-Tiny+Attention Rollout的Deletion AUC为0.211，显著优于其他模型的0.432-0.525（|Cohen's d|>1.1）；Swin-Tiny虽为Transformer架构但因空间特征图层级结构与Grad-CAM兼容；模型无关方法RISE将所有架构压缩至~0.1的Deletion AUC；模糊填充扰动下家族排序发生逆转，证实保真度排名是(model, explainer, perturbation operator)三元组的联合属性。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明解释方法的保真度取决于其与模型原生决策机制的读取结构兼容性，而非架构家族本身；建议将解释通路与模型架构协同设计，并要求热图部署时附带定量保真度指标。该审计协议在跨数据集场景下存在依赖性，需进一步验证。

title: DVMap: Fine-Grained Pluralistic Value Alignment via High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of ACL 2026
summary: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) typically rely on coarse-grained national labels for pluralistic value alignment. However, such macro-level supervision often obscures intra-country value heterogeneity, yielding a loose alignment. We argue that resolving this limitation requires shifting from national labels to multi-dimensional demographic constraints, which can identify groups with predictable, high-consensus value preference. To this end, we propose DVMap (High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping), a framework for fine-grained pluralistic value alignment. In this framework, we first present a demographic archetype extraction strategy to construct a high-quality value alignment corpus of 56,152 samples from the World Values Survey (WVS) by strictly retaining respondents with consistent value preferences under identical demographics. Over this corpus, we introduce a Structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism that explicitly guides LLMs to reason about demographic-value correlations. Subsequently, we employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to achieve adaptive anchoring of value distributions. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we further establish a triple-generalization benchmark (spanning cross-demographic, cross-country, and cross-value) comprising 21,553 samples. Experimental results demonstrate that DVMap effectively learns the manifold mapping from demographics to values, exhibiting strong generalization and robustness. On cross-demographic tests, Qwen3-8B-DVMap achieves 48.6% accuracy, surpassing the advanced open-source LLM DeepSeek-v3.2 (45.1%). The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/EnlightenedAI/DVMap.

AI.tldr: DVMap是一个用于细粒度多元价值对齐的框架，通过人口统计算型提取、结构化CoT推理和GRPO优化，将价值对齐从国家级别精细化到个人人口统计特征层面，显著提升了模型在跨人口统计、跨国家和跨价值维度上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM的价值对齐主要依赖粗粒度的国家标签进行监督，忽略了国家内部的价值异质性，导致对齐效果松散。解决这一局限需要从国家标签转向多维度人口统计约束，以识别具有可预测、高共识价值偏好的群体。
AI.method: (1) 人口统计算型提取策略：从WVS构建56,152样本高质量价值对齐语料库，仅保留相同人口统计特征下价值偏好一致的受访者；(2) 结构化CoT机制：显式引导LLM推理人口统计-价值相关性；(3) GRPO：实现价值分布的自适应锚定；(4) 三重泛化基准测试（跨人口统计、跨国家、跨价值观）。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B-DVMap在跨人口统计测试中达到48.6%准确率，显著超越高级开源LLM DeepSeek-v3.2（45.1%），证明了该方法能有效学习从人口统计到价值偏好的人形映射，具有强泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DVMap通过高共识人口统计-价值观映射实现了强大的泛化能力，Qwen3-8B-DVMap在跨人口统计测试中准确率达48.6%，优于DeepSeek-v3.2的45.1%，证明了细粒度人口统计约束在价值对齐中的有效性。

title: COTCAgent: Preventive Consultation via Probabilistic Chain-of-Thought Completion
summary: As large language models empower healthcare, intelligent clinical decision support has developed rapidly. Longitudinal electronic health records (EHR) provide essential temporal evidence for accurate clinical diagnosis and analysis. However, current large language models have critical flaws in longitudinal EHR reasoning. First, lacking fine-grained statistical reasoning, they often hallucinate clinical trends and metrics when quantitative evidence is textually implied, biasing diagnostic inference. Second, non-uniform time series and scarce labels in longitudinal EHR hinder models from capturing long-range temporal dependencies, limiting reliable clinical reasoning. To address the above limitations, this work presents the Probabilistic Chain-of-Thought Completion Agent (COTCAgent), a hierarchical reasoning framework for longitudinal electronic health records. It consists of three core modules. The Temporal-Statistics Adapter (TSA) converts analytical plans into executable code for standardized trend output. The Chain-of-Thought Completion (COTC) layer leverages a symptom-trend-disease knowledge base with weighted scoring to evaluate disease risk, while the bounded completion module acquires structured evidence through standardized inquiries and iterative scoring constraints to ensure rigorous reasoning. By decoupling statistical computation, feature matching, and language generation, the framework eliminates reliance on complex multi-modal inputs and enables efficient longitudinal record analysis with lower computational overhead. Experimental results show that COTCAgent powered by Baichuan-M2 achieves 90.47% Top-1 accuracy on the self-built dataset and 70.41% on HealthBench, outperforming existing medical agents and mainstream large language models. The code is available at https://github.com/FrankDengAI/COTCAgent/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COTCAgent，一种面向纵向电子病历的分层推理框架，通过时序统计适配器、思维链补全层和有界补全模块三部分设计，解决了大语言模型在临床统计推理和时间依赖建模方面的缺陷，在医疗诊断任务上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在纵向电子病历推理中存在两大关键缺陷：(1) 缺乏细粒度统计推理能力，在文本暗示定量证据时产生临床趋势幻觉，导致诊断偏差；(2) 纵向病历的非均匀时序特性和标注稀缺性阻碍模型捕捉长程时间依赖关系，限制了可靠临床推理的实现。
AI.method: COTCAgent框架包含三个核心模块：(1) 时序统计适配器(TSA)将分析计划转化为可执行代码，输出标准化趋势；(2) 思维链补全(COTC)层利用症状-趋势-疾病知识库进行加权评分评估疾病风险；(3) 有界补全模块通过标准化查询和迭代评分约束获取结构化证据。三模块协同实现纵向病历的严谨推理。
AI.result: COTCAgent在自建数据集上达到90.47%的Top-1准确率，在HealthBench上达到70.41%，优于现有医疗智能体和主流大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: COTCAgent通过解耦统计计算、特征匹配和语言生成，实现了高效纵向病历分析，显著降低计算开销，同时保持较高的诊断准确率，为临床决策支持系统提供了新的技术方案。

title: Dynamics of the Transformer Residual Stream: Coupling Spectral Geometry to Network Topology
summary: Large language models are remarkably capable, yet how computation propagates through their layers remains poorly understood. A growing line of work treats depth as discrete time and the residual stream as a dynamical system, where each layer's nonlinear update has a local linear description. However, previous analyses have relied on scalar summaries or approximate linearizations, leaving the full spectral geometry of trained LLMs unknown. We perform full Jacobian eigendecomposition across three production--scale LLMs and show that training installs a monotonic spectral gradient through depth -- from non-normal, rotation-dominated early layers to near--symmetric late layers -- together with a cumulative low-rank bottleneck that funnels perturbations into a small fraction of the residual stream's effective dimensions. Our experiments reveal that this gradient and the dimensional collapse are learned rather than architectural, and is largely dissolved when structured non-normality is removed. We further show that the topological positioning of graph communities predicts whether the Jacobian amplifies or suppresses them, with the sign of the coupling determined by the local operator type, a relationship absent at initialization. These results map a learned spectral geometry in LLMs that links perturbation propagation and compression to the network's functional topology.

AI.tldr: 本文对 Llama 3.1 8B、OLMo 3 7B、Gemma 4 E4B 三个生产级 LLM 逐层计算精确 Jacobian 并做完整特征分解/奇异值分析，揭示训练后残差流存在一条单调的“非正规性梯度”：浅层为旋转主导（强非正规、自对齐≈0.04），深层趋于近对称（≈0.55–0.70）；跨深度累积 Jacobian 形成低秩瓶颈，把扰动压缩到约 4–40 个有效维度。同时，激活相关图的中尺度社区结构与 Jacobian 动力学存在逐单元耦合：跨越社区的“边界单元”在近对称层被放大、在强非正规层被去放大，耦合符号由算子类型决定，且该耦合在随机初始化时不存在，属训练习得。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多把Transformer深度视作离散时间、残差流视作动力系统，并用SVD/标量摘要（如条件数、稳定秩）或近似线性化（detach Jacobian、回归拟合、DMD）刻画各层Jacobian，导致训练后模型真实的谱几何（特征值分布、非正规性结构、旋转动力学、扩张/收缩模态平衡）仍不清楚；同时，“网络的拓扑结构（激活图社区）”是否与动力学耦合、属于架构先验还是训练习得，也未在生产规模上检验。作者希望通过精确（full）Jacobian 特征分解，配合激活图社区检测，并借助 OLMo 的 step-0 随机初始化对照，把“架构贡献”与“训练贡献”分离。
AI.method: 模型与数据：Llama 3.1 8B（32层，d=4096）、OLMo 3 7B（32层，含 step 0/471k/1.41M 三个预训练检查点）、Gemma 4 E4B（42层，d=2560）；在 1,000 条 WikiText-2 样本上提取每个子层边界（attention前/MLP前）的 last-token 激活。Jacobian：用 torch.autograd.functional.jacobian 对每个 block 的孤立副本（float32）计算 d×d 精确输入空间 Jacobian J_ℓ=∂h_{ℓ+1}/∂h_ℓ=I+∂f_ℓ/∂h_ℓ，得 1,000 个逐样本 Jacobian 并取均值（J̄ 以 float64 累加），特征值由 numpy.linalg.eigvals 求得，逐样本做 SVD 供分布统计。谱量：条件数 κ、participation ratio PR、扩张模态占比（|λ|>1）、自对齐 self-alignment=‖V_k^T U_k‖_F²/k（k=64，对称=1，纯旋转≈k/d≈0.016）、Henrici 偏离 δ(J)=√(‖J‖_F²−Σ|λ_i|²)/‖J‖_F、层间前向对齐、去掉跳连的残差算子 R=J−I。累积 Jacobian P_ℓ=J_{31}⋯J_ℓ 用迭代截断SVD（k=512）计算并取有效秩 erank=exp(−Σp log p)。Schur 手术：J_ℓ=Q(Λ+N)Q*，固定谱 Λ 与基 Q，仅对严格上三角 N 按剂量 c∈{0,…,2} 缩放，并设两个对照（A：Frobenius 匹配的随机上三角替换；B：Haar 随机 Schur 基），另在 R 模式复现以排除跳连影响。拓扑：对每个子层快照做 z-score + 4096×4096 Pearson 相关，保留每节点 top-20 边（保留符号），用 signed Leiden CPM（γ=0.001）做社区检测，每层得 6–87 个社区；用参与系数 p_i=1−Σ_c(k_ic/k_i)² 刻画“边界单元”；统计检验包括置换检验、100 次同规模随机划分的方差解释 z 检验、逐层 Cohen's d（top10% vs bottom10% 参与度尾部）+ Benjamini–Hochberg FDR（α=0.05）。
AI.result:
1) 谱几何：均值 Jacobian 约 98% 特征值为共轭复对（螺旋状旋转模式），此结构被 SVD 完全掩盖。Llama 3.1 8B 呈现三段式深度分区：浅层(0–4)强各向异性（κ≈10⁶）且近纯旋转（self-alignment≈0.04）；中层(5–19) κ降至10²–10³、扩张模态17–30%；深层(20–31) κ回升至10⁵–10⁶并趋向对称（≈0.55）。self-alignment 从≈0.04 单调升至≈0.70，Henrici 偏离 0.91→0.47；剥离跳连后 R 的自对齐全程<0.20，说明块计算在每层都非正规，J 的“表观对称”源于恒等项主导（残差范数比 0.963→0.518）。层间前向对齐基本处于随机基线（k/d≈0.016），仅 OLMo 训练后 R 在中层出现 3.8× 基线峰，支持“共享工作区”而非串行流水线。
2) 维度坍缩：累积乘积有效秩从单层 436 降至 6.7（Llama，4096 维输入仅约 7 维存活），Gemma 42 层降至 5.9；OLMo step 0 保持 ≈326–4006，训练后降至 ≈42（比初始化低两个数量级），坍缩最陡在浅层（有效秩与谱半径 Spearman ρ=−0.33）。
3) Schur 手术：置 c=0（保留谱、去除非正规性）使累积有效秩从 7.1 回升至 45.4（6.4×；OLMo 5.6×、Gemma 6.7×），c=2 进一步降至 2.5；随机对照 A 使剂量响应反转（升至 215.9/349.4），对照 B 在 OLMo 无法复现漏斗，说明漏斗源于训练所得上三角非正规结构（及部分架构中的 Schur 基），而非谱、Frobenius 质量或跳连本身。
4) 拓扑耦合：社区结构在所有深度存在且随深度平缓重组（1−NMI 随层距平滑衰减）。社区投影算子 K=C_out^T J C_in 解释的方差显著高于同规模随机划分，且 step 0 时即成立（32/32 层超零假设，中位 z=19.2），故中尺度拓扑—动力学一致性是部分架构先验；层间“速率级”耦合则不稳健（跨架构不一致，不作主张）。逐单元边界耦合：OLMo step 0 为 0/32 层 FDR 显著，step 471k 14/32（中位 d=+0.124），step 1.41M 24/32（中位 d=+0.248）；Llama 16/32（中位 d=+0.131）；Gemma 出现符号反转——4/42 层正、13/42 层负，负效应集中于强非正规浅/中层。跨五个配置，自对齐与 Cohen's d 呈单一单调关系：自对齐 <0.1 时 d<0（边界去放大），>0.5 时 d>0（边界放大），交叉点位于非正规→近对称的算子类型转变处。
AI.conclusion: 训练后的生产级 LLM 获得了一条此前未被刻画的学习型谱几何：浅层旋转主导、深层近对称的单调非正规性梯度，以及把扰动漏斗化到极少数有效通道的累积低秩瓶颈；该瓶颈由训练习得的非正规上三角结构（而非特征谱或跳连）驱动，并可通过 Schur 手术可逆地调节。残差流激活图的中尺度社区结构部分源于架构布线（初始化时即存在），但“边界单元被放大/抑制”的逐单元耦合及其符号由算子类型决定，是训练后才涌现的性质。作者据此主张：近似线性化与纯 SVD 分析无法揭示旋转动力学；依赖激活图社区结构的研究应报告随机初始化基线以免把布线误当作学习到的组织；初始化期的信号传播理论仅覆盖晚期近对称算子、层间子空间解耦与中尺度方差信号，无法解释非正规梯度、维度坍缩与边界单元耦合。局限包括：依赖单一社区检测算法（CPM 量级最大，形状算法无关）、逐单元效应量偏中等（0→14→24 更应解读为耦合在深度上的可检测范围扩大而非强度提升）、Jacobian 仅在 WikiText-2 的 last-token 上评估，跨分布泛化性未验证，以及 OLMo 中层 R 前向对齐峰是否为普遍现象仍待验证。

title: BEAM: Binary Expert Activation Masking for Dynamic Routing in MoE
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enhance the efficiency of large language models by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, standard MoE employs a fixed Top-K routing strategy, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal inference latency. Existing acceleration methods either require costly retraining with architectural changes or suffer from severe performance drop at high sparsity due to train-inference mismatch. To address these limitations, we propose BEAM (Binary Expert Activation Masking), a novel method that learns token-adaptive expert selection via trainable binary masks. With a straight-through estimator and an auxiliary regularization loss, BEAM induces dynamic expert sparsity through end-to-end training while maintaining model capability. We further implement an efficient custom CUDA kernel for BEAM, ensuring seamless integration with the vLLM inference framework. Experiments show that BEAM retains over 98\% of the original model's performance while reducing MoE layer FLOPs by up to 85\%, achieving up to 2.5$\times$ faster decoding and 1.4$\times$ higher throughput, demonstrating its effectiveness as a practical, plug-and-play solution for efficient MoE inference.

AI.tldr: BEAM proposes token-adaptive binary mask learning to achieve dynamic expert sparsity in MoE models, enabling efficient inference with minimal performance loss.
AI.motivation: Standard MoE uses fixed Top-K routing, causing redundant computation and suboptimal inference latency. Existing methods either require costly retraining or suffer performance degradation at high sparsity.
AI.method: Trainable binary masks with straight-through estimator and auxiliary regularization loss, plus custom CUDA kernel integration with vLLM.
AI.result: 98%+ performance retention, 85% FLOPs reduction, 2.5× decoding speedup, 1.4× throughput improvement.
AI.conclusion: BEAM achieves 98%+ performance retention while reducing 85% MoE FLOPs, delivering 2.5× faster decoding and 1.4× throughput gains. It serves as a plug-and-play solution compatible with vLLM.

title: From Scenes to Elements: Multi-Granularity Evidence Retrieval for Verifiable Multimodal RAG
summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems retrieve evidence at coarse granularities (entire images or scenes), creating a mismatch with fine-grained user queries and making failures unverifiable.
