We introduce GranuVistaVQA, a multimodal benchmark featuring real-world landmarks with element-level annotations across multiple viewpoints, capturing the partial observation challenge where individual images contain only subsets of entities. We further propose GranuRAG, a multi-granularity framework that treats visual elements as first-class retrieval units through three stages: element-level detection and classification, multi-granularity cross-modal alignment for evidence retrieval, and attribution-constrained generation. By grounding retrieval at the element level rather than relying on implicit attention, our approach enables transparent error diagnosis. Experiments demonstrate that GranuRAG achieves up to 29.2% improvement over six strong baselines for this task.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态RAG系统中粗粒度检索与细粒度查询不匹配的问题，提出GranuVistaVQA基准（含元素级标注的地标多视角数据集）和GranuRAG框架（元素级检测→多粒度对齐→归因约束生成的三阶段方法），实现透明化错误诊断并在基准上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 Multimodal RAG 系统在粗粒度（整个图像或场景）进行证据检索，与用户细粒度查询存在粒度不匹配问题，且失败结果难以验证和诊断。
AI.method: 本文提出GranuRAG框架，采用三阶段方法：(1) 元素级检测与分类；(2) 多粒度跨模态对齐用于证据检索；(3) 归属约束生成。核心创新在于将视觉元素作为一等检索单元，通过显式对齐而非隐式注意力机制实现检索。
AI.result: GranuRAG在GranuVistaVQA基准上相比6个强基线模型实现最高29.2%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: GranuRAG通过元素级检索策略，在GranuVistaVQA基准上相比6个强基线模型实现了最高29.2%的性能提升，同时支持透明化的错误诊断。

title: TILT: Target-induced loss tilting under covariate shift
summary: We introduce and analyze Target-Induced Loss Tilting (TILT) for unsupervised domain adaptation under covariate shift. It is based on a novel objective function that decomposes the source predictor as $f+b$, fits $f+b$ on labeled source data while simultaneously penalizing the auxiliary component $b$ on unlabeled target inputs. The resulting fit $f$ is deployed as the final target predictor. At the population level, we show that this target-side penalty implicitly induces relative importance weighting at the population level, but in terms of an estimand $b^*_f$ that is self-localized to the current error, and remains uniformly bounded for any source-target pair (even those with disjoint supports). We prove a general finite-sample oracle inequality on the excess risk, and use it to give an end-to-end guarantee for training with sparse ReLU networks. Experiments on controlled regression problems and shifted CIFAR-100 distillation show that TILT improves target-domain performance over source-only training, exact importance weighting, and relative density-ratio baselines, with a stable dependence on the regularization parameter.

AI.tldr: TILT is a novel unsupervised domain adaptation method under covariate shift that decomposes the predictor and penalizes an auxiliary component on target data, implicitly inducing self-adaptive importance weighting with theoretical guarantees and empirical improvements over existing methods.
AI.motivation: Unsupervised domain adaptation under covariate shift requires weighting source samples to match target distribution. Existing methods like importance weighting can be unstable, especially when source and target supports are disjoint. The paper seeks a more robust approach with guaranteed boundedness across all source-target pairs.
AI.method: TILT decomposes the source predictor as f+b, where f is the final target predictor. It fits f+b on labeled source data while simultaneously penalizing the auxiliary component b on unlabeled target inputs. This target-side penalty implicitly induces relative importance weighting using an estimand b*_f that self-localizes to the current error.
AI.result: Theoretically, TILT maintains uniform boundedness for any source-target pair (even with disjoint supports) and achieves a finite-sample oracle inequality on excess risk with end-to-end guarantees for sparse ReLU networks. Empirically, TILT improves target-domain performance over baselines with stable dependence on regularization parameters.
AI.conclusion: TILT provides a theoretically grounded approach for domain adaptation with stable regularization behavior, achieving empirical improvements over source-only training, importance weighting, and density-ratio baselines on both synthetic and real-world tasks.

title: Synthesizing POMDP Policies: Sampling Meets Model-checking via Learning
comment: Paper accepted at 38th International Conference on Computer Aided Verification (CAV 2026), Lisbon, Portugal, July 2026
summary: Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) are the standard framework for decision-making under uncertainty. While sampling-based methods scale well, they lack formal correctness guarantees, making them unsuitable for safety-critical applications. Conversely, formal synthesis techniques provide correctness-by-construction but often struggle with scalability, as general POMDP synthesis is undecidable. To bridge this gap, we propose a synthesis framework that integrates sampling, automata learning, and model-checking. Inspired by Angluin's $L^*$ algorithm, our approach utilizes sampling as a membership oracle and model-checking as an equivalence oracle. This enables the synthesis of finite-state controllers with formal guarantees, provided the sampling-induced policy is regular. We establish a relative completeness result for this framework. Experimental results from our prototypical implementation demonstrate that this method successfully solves threshold-safety problems that remain challenging for existing formal synthesis tools. We believe our algorithm serves as a valuable component in a portfolio approach to tackling the inherent difficulty of POMDP synthesis problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合采样、自动机学习和模型检验的POMDP综合框架，灵感来源于Angluin的L*算法。当采样诱导的策略具有正则性时，该方法可综合具有形式化保证的有限状态控制器。建立了相对完备性结果，实验验证了在阈值安全问题上优于现有形式化综合工具。
AI.motivation: There exists a gap between scalable sampling-based methods (lacking formal guarantees) and correct-by-construction formal synthesis techniques (suffering from scalability). General POMDP synthesis is undecidable, necessitating new approaches for safety-critical applications.
AI.method: A synthesis framework integrating sampling, automata learning, and model-checking, inspired by Angluin's L* algorithm. Uses sampling as a membership oracle and model-checking as an equivalence oracle to synthesize finite-state controllers with formal guarantees, applicable when the sampling-induced policy is regular.
AI.result: Relative completeness result is established; experimental results demonstrate successful solving of threshold-safety problems challenging for existing formal synthesis tools.
AI.conclusion: The algorithm serves as a valuable component in a portfolio approach to tackling the inherent difficulty of POMDP synthesis problems. Experimental results demonstrate success on threshold-safety problems that challenge existing formal synthesis tools.

title: Smooth Multi-Policy Causal Effect Estimation in Longitudinal Settings
summary: Comparative evaluation of multiple dynamic treatment policies is essential for healthcare and policy decisions, yet conventional longitudinal causal inference methods estimate each in isolation, preventing information sharing across counterfactuals. We demonstrate that this separate estimation paradigm induces a structurally uncontrolled second-order bias, inflating finite-sample variance even after standard debiasing with longitudinal targeted maximum likelihood estimation(LTMLE). To address this, we propose a policy-aware reparameterization of Iterative Conditional Expectation (ICE) Q-functions that enables joint estimation through shared representations. We implement this approach in the Policy-Encoded Q Network (PEQ-Net), an architecture centered on a shared policy encoder. The encoder is trained using kernel mean embeddings, ensuring that the learned representation space reflects population-level policy dissimilarities. After applying an LTMLE correction step, we prove this design imposes a structural constraint on the second-order remainder, thereby stabilizing finite-sample variance. Experiments on semi-synthetic datasets demonstrate that PEQ-Net consistently outperforms existing ICE-based methods, achieving substantial reductions in root-mean-square error, particularly when evaluating closely related policies.

AI.tldr: 针对动态治疗策略评估中孤立估计导致方差膨胀的问题，提出PEQ-Net通过策略编码器与核均值嵌入实现联合估计，结合LTMLE校正证明可稳定有限样本方差，实验验证RMSE大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 传统纵向因果推断方法孤立估计各动态治疗策略，无法跨反事实共享信息，导致即使使用标准去偏的LTMLE仍存在结构未受控的二阶偏差，使有限样本方差膨胀。
AI.method: 提出PEQ-Net架构，采用策略感知重参数化的ICE Q函数，通过共享策略编码器实现联合估计；使用核均值嵌入训练编码器确保表示空间反映群体层面策略差异；结合LTMLE校正步骤证明对二阶余项施加结构约束。
AI.result: 在半合成数据集上，PEQ-Net一致优于现有ICE方法，RMSE显著降低，在评估相近策略时优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: PEQ-Net通过策略编码器和核均值嵌入实现联合估计，经LTMLE校正后对二阶余项施加结构约束，有效稳定有限样本方差。在半合成数据集上显著优于现有ICE方法，RMSE大幅降低，尤其在评估相近策略时表现突出。

title: Concurrency without Model Changes: Future-based Asynchronous Function Calling for LLMs
summary: Function calling, also known as tool use, is a core capability of modern LLM agents but is typically constrained by synchronous execution semantics. Under these semantics, LLM decoding is blocked until each function call completes, resulting in increasing end-to-end latency. In this work, we introduce AsyncFC, a pure execution-layer framework that decouples LLM decoding from function execution, enabling overlap between model decoding and function execution as well as inter-function parallelism when dependencies permit. AsyncFC layers over existing models and unmodified function implementations, requiring no fine-tuning or changes to the standard synchronous function-calling protocol. Across standard function-calling benchmarks and adapted software engineering benchmarks, AsyncFC significantly reduces end-to-end task completion time while preserving task accuracy. Furthermore, these results reveal that LLMs possess a native capability to reason over symbolic futures that represent unresolved execution results, enabling an asynchronous paradigm for model-tool interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AsyncFC框架，通过异步解耦LLM解码与函数执行，实现解码-执行重叠和函数间并行，无需微调或修改现有接口，在保持准确率的同时大幅降低延迟。核心发现是LLM具备对符号未来（未解析执行结果）进行推理的原生能力。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体的函数调用（工具使用）采用同步执行语义，导致模型解码被阻塞直到函数调用完成，造成端到端延迟随调用数量线性增长。
AI.method: AsyncFC是一个纯执行层框架，通过将LLM解码与函数执行解耦实现异步并行。具体包括：(1)允许模型解码与函数执行重叠；(2)在依赖允许时实现函数间并行执行；(3)兼容现有模型和未修改的函数实现，无需微调，也不改变标准同步函数调用协议。
AI.result: 在标准函数调用基准测试和改编的软件工程基准测试中，AsyncFC显著降低端到端任务完成时间，同时保持任务准确性。
AI.conclusion: LLMs具备原生能力，可对代表未解决执行结果的符号未来进行推理，从而实现模型-工具交互的异步范式。

title: MetaMoE: Diversity-Aware Proxy Selection for Privacy-Preserving Mixture-of-Experts Unification
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity by combining specialized experts, but most existing approaches assume centralized access to training data. In practice, data are distributed across clients and cannot be shared due to privacy constraints, making unified MoE training challenging. We propose MetaMoE, a privacy-preserving framework that unifies independently trained, domain-specialized experts into a single MoE using public proxy data as surrogates for inaccessible private data. Central to MetaMoE is diversity-aware proxy selection, which selects client-domain-relevant and diverse samples from public data to effectively approximate private data distributions and supervise router learning. These proxies are further used to align expert training, improving expert coordination at unification time, while a context-aware router enhances expert selection across heterogeneous inputs. Experiments on computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks demonstrate that MetaMoE consistently outperforms recent privacy-preserving MoE unification methods. Code is available at https://github.com/ws-jiang/MetaMoE.

AI.tldr: MetaMoE 是一个隐私保护的 MoE 统一框架：把各客户端独立微调得到的领域专家合并为单一可部署的 MoE 模型，全程不共享私有数据。其核心是「多样性感知代理选择」——用相关性加权 DPP（relevance-weighted DPP）从公共数据中挑选既与客户端领域相关、又彼此多样化的样本作为私有数据的代理；再配合「代理对齐专家训练」和「上下文感知路由器」，缓解专家域隔离与路由冲突。在 CV（CLIP ViT-B/32、ViT-B/16 + Pets/Flowers/EuroSAT）与 NLP（LLaMA-3.2-3B、LLaMA-3.1-8B + CSQA/CosmosQA/SocialIQA）基准上，MetaMoE 平均准确率 94.52%/96.24%/74.42%/81.59%，一致优于 FlexOlmo、BTX、ModelSoup、BTM 及联邦方法 CoMiGS、MoA，并给出路由向量的隐私敏感性/不可恢复性形式化论证。
AI.motivation: 核心问题（隐私保护的 MoE 统一）：如何在不共享客户端私有数据的前提下，将多个独立微调得到的领域专家合并为一个可统一部署的 MoE 模型。现有路线的缺陷：(1) 联邦学习需多轮同步、异构数据下性能退化且梯度存在模型反演泄漏风险；(2) BTM 只做推理期集成，无单一模型；(3) Model Soup 类参数平均在专家分歧大时脆弱；(4) BTX 训练路由器需要客户端私有数据，违反隐私；(5) FlexOlmo 虽用公共代理数据，但其代理选择纯基于相似度，导致代理冗余、覆盖狭窄、路由监督不足，且专家仅在私有数据上训练、未见过代理，形成「域隔离」与代理路由监督之间的分布错配。因此需要更原则化的代理选择与对齐策略。
AI.method: 整体三阶段流程：(1) 代理数据选择——训练二分类器区分 D0 与 Dp 得到相关性分数 g(x,Dp)（附录A），先取 top-n 候选池，再用相关性加权 DPP 构造 L~=Diag(r)LDiag(r)，最大化 log det(L~_S)=2Σlog r_i + log det(L_S) 以同时兼顾相关性与多样性；MAP 推理为 NP-hard，采用贪心 + Cholesky 增量更新，把复杂度从 O(nm^3) 降到 O(nm)。(2) 代理对齐专家训练——每个客户端从种子模型分支，仅用 LoRA 微调 FFN 子层，训练数据为私有数据 Dp 与其代理集 D̂p 的并集，其余参数冻结，从而让专家表征与后续路由监督分布对齐、缓解域隔离；并计算各层路由向量 e_p^(l)（私有+代理嵌入均值）。(3) 上下文感知路由器与最终 MoE 训练——将各专家 FFN 子层合并为 MoE 层，路由输入为混合表示 z̃=(1-λ)z_t+λz_x（token 级 + 序列级均值上下文，λ 可学习），top-k 门控，以 e_p^(l) 做域感知初始化；最后在所有代理数据并集上联合微调路由器与 FFN 专家。隐私方面仅上传代理索引、专家 FFN 权重与路由向量三类工件。
AI.result: CV：MetaMoE 平均准确率 94.52%（ViT-B/32）与 96.24%（ViT-B/16），超过最强基线 FlexOlmo（92.92%、93.53%）约 1.6/2.7 个点，接近但未超过不受隐私约束的 UnrestrictedMoE（95.68%、96.75%）。NLP：74.42%（LLaMA-3.2-3B）与 81.59%（LLaMA-3.1-8B），优于 BTM/ModelSoup/BTX/FlexOlmo（8B 上 81.59% 甚至略高于 UnrestrictedMoE 的 81.34%）。消融：RW-DPP 在 FlexOlmo 上 +0.85/+2.32/+0.28/+0.85，在 MetaMoE 上进一步提升（73.60→74.42、80.32→81.59、94.12→94.52、95.39→96.24）；上下文感知路由器贡献 1.2–2.2 点；代理对齐训练贡献 0.6–1.7 点。仅用代理数据训练专家性能骤降（ViT-B/16 平均 52.17% vs 96.24%），证明私有数据不可替代、代理主要提供协调信号。稳健性：更换公共集为 OpenOrca 仍领先（74.79%）；去除与客户端域语义重叠的 ImageNet 类别后 MetaMoE 仅降 0.74 点而 FlexOlmo 降 3.53 点。开销：代理选择仅增加 0.2–0.3 分钟/客户端（3–5%），统一时间与 FlexOlmo 相当（CV 12.15s/19.88s，NLP 114.46s/205.42s），推理速度与 BTX/FlexOlmo 相当，BTM 推理约慢 3×。与 CoMiGS、MoA 相比亦全面领先。
AI.conclusion: MetaMoE 证明了在严格不共享私有数据（data residency）的前提下，利用公共代理数据即可有效统一异构领域专家为单一可部署 MoE：多样性感知代理选择缓解了相似度代理的冗余问题，代理对齐专家训练消除域隔离，上下文感知路由器降低路由冲突；配套的形式化隐私分析表明所共享路由向量的单样本敏感性被 O(1/m) 界定且私有嵌入均值在不知 N 时不可恢复，隐私严格强于 FlexOlmo。局限与后续：仅保证数据驻留级别的形式化性质，未引入差分隐私噪声机制，高风险领域部署需额外审计；依赖公共数据集与代理集规模 m 的设定；评测限于分类/常识推理类基准。

title: Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ): A Framework for Measuring Organizational AI Impact
summary: The Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ) is a composite metric intended to quantify the depth to which AI systems are integrated into organizational work and their impact. Rather than treating access counts or aggregate token volume as sufficient evidence of impact, IIQ combines a novelty-weighted, time-decayed token stock with usage frequency, a grace-period recency gate, organizational leverage, task complexity, and autonomy. The formulation produces a raw Intelligence Adoption Index (IAI) and a normalized 0-1000 IIQ index for comparison between heterogeneous users and units. We also derive sub-daily update rules and a bounded interpretation layer for estimated efficiency and financial impact. The paper positions IIQ as a deployment-oriented measurement framework: a formal proposal for tracking AI embedding in workflows, not a direct measure of model capability or a substitute for causal productivity evaluation. Synthetic scenarios illustrate how the revised metric distinguishes between frequent low-leverage use, semantically repetitive prompting, and more autonomous, higher-consequence AI-assisted work.

AI.tldr: The paper proposes the Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ), a composite metric combining novelty-weighted time-decayed token stock, usage frequency, recency gating, organizational leverage, task complexity, and autonomy to measure organizational AI integration depth and impact, yielding normalized 0-1000 scores for cross-unit comparison.
AI.motivation: Existing AI impact metrics based on access counts or aggregate token volume are insufficient for capturing true organizational integration depth. There is a need for a composite metric that distinguishes between superficial adoption and meaningful AI embedding in workflows.
AI.method: The IIQ combines novelty-weighted time-decayed token stock with usage frequency, grace-period recency gate, organizational leverage, task complexity, and autonomy to produce a raw Intelligence Adoption Index (IAI) and normalized 0-1000 IIQ index, with sub-daily update rules.
AI.result: A formal IIQ metric that accounts for temporal dynamics, novelty weighting, recency gating, leverage, complexity, and autonomy, with bounded interpretation for estimated efficiency and financial impact.
AI.conclusion: IIQ offers a formal deployment measurement framework that distinguishes between frequent low-leverage use, semantically repetitive prompting, and autonomous high-consequence AI-assisted work, enabling comparison across heterogeneous users and units.

title: ML-Embed: Inclusive and Efficient Embeddings for a Multilingual World
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026. The data has been released earlier in the preprint arXiv:2603.19223
summary: The development of high-quality text embeddings is increasingly drifting toward an exclusionary future, defined by three critical barriers: prohibitive computational costs, a narrow linguistic focus that neglects most of the world's languages, and a lack of transparency from closed-source or open-weight models that stifles research. To dismantle these barriers, we introduce ML-Embed, a suite of inclusive and efficient models built upon a new framework: 3-Dimensional Matryoshka Learning (3D-ML). Our framework addresses the computational challenge with comprehensive efficiency across the entire model lifecycle. Beyond the storage benefits of Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) and flexible inference-time depth provided by Matryoshka Layer Learning (MLL), we introduce Matryoshka Embedding Learning (MEL) for enhanced parameter efficiency. To address the linguistic challenge, we curate a massively multilingual dataset and train a suite of models ranging from 140M to 8B parameters. In a direct commitment to transparency, we release all models, data, and code. Extensive evaluation on 430 tasks demonstrates that our models set new records on 9 of 17 evaluated MTEB benchmarks, with particularly strong results in low-resource languages, providing a reproducible blueprint for building globally equitable and computationally efficient AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ML-Embed模型套件，基于3D-ML框架解决高质量文本嵌入的三大壁垒（计算成本、语言覆盖、透明度）。通过整合MRL、MLL、MEL三种学习策略，在保持参数效率的同时支持多语言，在430个任务上于17个MTEB基准中的9个创下新纪录。
AI.motivation: 当前高质量文本嵌入模型面临三大壁垒：(1)计算成本过高；(2)语言覆盖狭窄，忽视大多数世界语言；(3)闭源或开源模型缺乏透明度，阻碍研究进展。
AI.method: 提出3-Dimensional Matryoshka Learning (3D-ML)框架，集成三种学习策略：Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL)解决存储效率、Matryoshka Layer Learning (MLL)提供灵活推理深度、Matryoshka Embedding Learning (MEL)增强参数效率；构建大规模多语言数据集，训练140M至8B参数规模的模型。
AI.result: 在430个任务上进行了广泛评估，在17个MTEB基准中的9个上创下新纪录，在低资源语言上表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了3D-ML框架和ML-Embed模型套件，在17个MTEB基准中的9个上创下新纪录，尤其在低资源语言上表现突出，并承诺全面开源（模型、数据、代码），为构建全球公平且计算高效的AI系统提供了可复现的蓝图。

title: Minimal-Intervention KV Retention: A Design-Space Study and a Diversity-Penalty Survivor
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/libophd/minimal-kv-retention
summary: KV-cache compression at small budgets is a crowded design space spanning cache representation, head-wise routing, compression cadence, decoding behavior, and within-budget scoring. We study seven mechanisms across these five families under matched mean cache on long-form mathematical reasoning (MATH-500~\cite{hendrycks2021math}) with two distilled-reasoning models (Qwen-7B and Llama-8B variants of DeepSeek-R1-Distill~\cite{deepseek2025r1}) at budgets $b \in \{64, 128\}$. All seven were rejected. We then propose $α$, a one-function modification to the TriAttention~\cite{mao2026triattention} retention scorer that replaces argmax-top-$k$ with greedy facility-location-inspired selection under a V-space redundancy penalty controlled by a single weight $λ$. A pre-registered protocol tunes $λ$ on a frozen development split and confirms on a disjoint held-out split; with $λ= 0.5$, $α$ clears Bonferroni on two of the four (model, budget) cells (Qwen $b{=}128$ and Llama $b{=}64$), no cell is significantly negative, and the pre-registered Branch~A triggers. The finding is asymmetric: a minimal scoring modification beat heavier structural redesigns in this regime, and the combined matched-memory, sympy-graded, held-out confirmation protocol is the evidence standard that made the asymmetry visible.

AI.tldr: 本文在KV-cache压缩的小预算场景下，系统评估了七种机制后均被否定，继而提出α机制——对TriAttention评分器的单函数修改，用贪心设施选址启发式替代argmax-top-k。在匹配内存条件下，通过预注册协议和Bonferroni校正验证了其在特定模型和预算配置下的有效性，揭示了轻量级评分调整优于复杂结构重新设计的不对称现象。
AI.motivation: 当前KV-cache压缩研究在小预算场景下存在多种设计选择（缓存表示、逐头路由、压缩节奏、解码行为、预算内评分），但缺乏系统的对比评估和标准化实验协议。
AI.method: 将TriAttention的argmax-top-k保留评分机制替换为贪心设施选址启发式选择，引入V空间冗余惩罚项，通过单一权重λ控制。在固定开发集上调整λ，在分离的held-out测试集上确认效果。
AI.result: α在四个(model, budget)实验单元中通过Bonferroni校正的有两个（Qwen b=128和Llama b=64），且无一显著负向结果。发现具有非对称性：最小评分修改优于更复杂的结构性重新设计。
AI.conclusion: α通过单个参数λ(设为0.5)实现简单修改，在KV-cache压缩领域取得显著进展，在Qwen b=128和Llama b=64两个实验条件下通过Bonferroni校正，表明轻量级评分修改优于结构性重新设计。实验采用匹配内存、sympy评分、held-out确认的标准化协议。

title: Stateful Reasoning via Insight Replay
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has become a foundation for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, but recent studies show that its benefits do not scale monotonically with chain length: while longer CoT generally enables a model to tackle harder problems, on a given problem, accuracy typically increases with CoT length up to a point, after which it declines. We identify a major cause of this phenomenon: as the CoT grows, the model's attention to critical insights produced earlier in the trace gradually weakens, making those insights progressively less accessible when they are most needed. Therefore, we propose \textbf{InsightReplay}, a stateful reasoning approach in which the model periodically extracts critical insights from its reasoning trace and replays them near the active generation frontier, keeping them accessible as the reasoning scales. Extensive experiments on a $\mathbf{2}\!\times\!\mathbf{3}\!\times\!\mathbf{4}$ benchmark grid, covering model scales $\{\text{8B}, \text{30B}\}$, model families $\{\text{Qwen3.5}, \text{DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen}, \text{Gemma-4}\}$, and reasoning benchmarks $\{\text{AIME}, \text{HMMT}, \text{GPQA Diamond}, \text{LiveCodeBench v5}\}$, show that 3-round InsightReplay yields accuracy gains across \textbf{all 24 settings}, with an averaged improvement of $\mathbf{+1.65}$ points over standard CoT, and a largest single-setting gain of $\mathbf{+9.2}$ points on R1-Distill-32B's LiveCodeBench v5 subset. Our results suggest that the effectiveness of test-time scaling depends not only on how much a model reasons, but also on whether critical intermediate insights remain accessible throughout long reasoning trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了长链思维推理中准确率下降的根因——关键洞察随推理链增长而变得难以访问，并提出InsightReplay解决方案，通过定期提取并重放关键洞察保持其可及性，在24个实验设置中均取得提升。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-Thought (CoT)推理的效益不会随链长单调增长：在给定问题上，准确率随CoT长度增加至某点后会下降。主要原因是随着CoT增长，模型对推理早期产生的关键洞察的注意力逐渐减弱，使其在最需要时变得难以访问。
AI.method: 提出InsightReplay方法：模型定期从推理轨迹中提取关键洞察，并在活跃生成前沿附近重放这些洞察，使它们在整个推理过程中保持可及性。实验采用2×3×4基准网格设计，测试3轮重放效果。
AI.result: 在全部24个实验设置中均实现准确率提升，平均提升+1.65个百分点，R1-Distill-32B在LiveCodeBench v5子集上单次提升达+9.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: InsightReplay通过在推理过程中定期提取并重放关键洞察，有效解决了长链思维中洞察可及性衰减的问题。实验在24个设置中全部取得提升，平均提升+1.65分，最高达+9.2分，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Improving Multi-turn Dialogue Consistency with Self-Recall Thinking
summary: Large language model (LLM) based multi-turn dialogue systems often struggle to track dependencies across non-adjacent turns, undermining both consistency and scalability. As conversations lengthen, essential information becomes sparse and is buried in irrelevant context, while processing the entire dialogue history incurs severe efficiency bottlenecks. Existing solutions either rely on high latency external memory or lose fine-grained details through iterative summarization. In this paper, we propose Self-Recall Thinking (SRT), a framework designed to address long-range contextual dependency and sparse informative signals in multi-turn dialogue. SRT identifies helpful historical turns and uses them to generate contextually appropriate responses, enabling the model to selectively recall and reason over context during inference. This process yields an endogenous reasoning process that integrates interpretable recall steps without external modules. SRT incorporates: (1) Dependency Construction: Generating and converting it into self-recall chains; (2)Capability Initialization: Training to enable reasoning chains with recall tokens capability; (3)Reasoning Improvement: Refining accuracy via verifiable rewards to optimize recall and reasoning for correct answers. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that SRT improves F1 score by 4.7% and reduces end-to-end latency by 14.7% over prior methods, achieving a balance between reasoning latency and accuracy, and outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: SRT是一种无需外部模块的多轮对话系统框架，通过自召回链机制使模型能够选择性回忆和推理历史上下文，在提升准确率的同时显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多轮对话系统在处理非相邻轮次间的依赖关系时存在困难，导致一致性和可扩展性下降。随对话长度增加，有效信息变得稀疏且被无关上下文淹没，而完整处理对话历史会带来严重的效率瓶颈。现有方案依赖高延迟的外部记忆或通过迭代摘要丢失细粒度细节。
AI.method: SRT框架包含三个核心模块：依赖构建（生成并转换为自召回链）、能力初始化（通过召回标记训练推理链）、推理改进（利用可验证奖励优化召回和推理）。该方法无需外部模块即可实现端到端的上下文选择性和推理能力。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，SRT相比先前方法将F1分数提升4.7%，端到端延迟降低14.7%，实现了推理延迟与准确率之间的良好平衡，并超越了最优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SRT通过内部推理机制实现了可解释的上下文回忆，在提升准确率的同时降低了延迟。实验证明该方法在多个数据集上优于现有基线方法。

title: Policy Optimization in Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Action Spaces via Mixed Gradients
summary: We study reinforcement learning in hybrid discrete-continuous action spaces, such as settings where the discrete component selects a regime (or index) and the continuous component optimizes within it -- a structure common in robotics, control, and operations problems. Standard model-free policy gradient methods rely on score-function (SF) estimators and suffer from severe credit-assignment issues in high-dimensional settings, leading to poor gradient quality. On the other hand, differentiable simulation largely sidesteps these issues by backpropagating through a simulator, but the presence of discrete actions or non-smooth dynamics yields biased or uninformative gradients. To address this, we propose Hybrid Policy Optimization (HPO), which backpropagates through the simulator wherever smoothness permits, using a mixed gradient estimator that combines pathwise and SF gradients while maintaining unbiasedness. We also show how problems with action discontinuities can be reformulated in hybrid form, further broadening its applicability. Empirically, HPO substantially outperforms PPO on inventory control and switched linear-quadratic regulator problems, with performance gaps increasing as the continuous action dimension grows. Finally, we characterize the structure of the mixed gradient, showing that its cross term -- which captures how continuous actions influence future discrete decisions -- becomes negligible near a discrete best response, thereby enabling approximate decentralized updates of the continuous and discrete components and reducing variance near optimality. All resources are available at github.com/MatiasAlvo/hybrid-rl.

AI.tldr: 针对混合离散-连续动作空间的强化学习问题，提出HPO算法利用可微模拟与SF估计器的混合梯度策略，在保持无偏性的同时提升梯度质量，并在库存控制和切换LQR任务上验证了优于PPO的性能，同时理论揭示了接近最优时梯度结构的可分离特性。
AI.motivation: 标准无模型策略梯度方法依赖score-function(SF)估计器，在高维设置中存在严重的信用分配问题导致梯度质量差；而可微模拟虽然避免此问题，但离散动作或不光滑动力学导致梯度有偏或信息不足。
AI.method: 提出混合策略优化(HPO)，通过simulator在可光滑处反向传播，使用结合pathwise梯度和SF梯度的混合梯度估计器，同时保持无偏性；针对动作不连续问题提供重构方法以扩展适用性。
AI.result: 在库存控制和切换线性二次调节器问题上显著优于PPO，性能差距随连续动作维度增加而增大；理论分析表明在离散最优响应附近，交叉项可忽略，实现连续和离散分量的近似去中心化更新并降低方差。
AI.conclusion: HPO框架成功结合了 differentiable simulation 的精度和SF估计器的灵活性，交叉项理论揭示了可分离近似的有效性，为大规模混合动作空间问题提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: OmniDrop: Layer-wise Token Pruning for Omni-modal LLMs via Query-Guidance
summary: Omni-modal large language models have demonstrated remarkable potential in holistic multimodal understanding; however, the token explosion caused by high-resolution audio and video inputs remains a critical bottleneck for real-time applications and long-form reasoning. Existing omni-modal token compression methods typically prune tokens at the input embedding level, relying on audio-video similarity or temporal co-occurrence as proxies for semantic relevance. In practice, such assumptions are often unreliable. To address this limitation, we propose OmniDrop, a training-free, layer-wise token pruning framework that progressively prunes audiovisual tokens within the LLM decoder layers rather than at the input-level, allowing early layers to preserve sufficient omni-modal information fusion before aggressively removing tokens in deeper layers. We further utilize text queries as guidance for modality-agnostic and task-adaptive token pruning. We also introduce a temporal diversity score that encourages balanced token survival to preserve global temporal context. Experimental results across various audiovisual benchmarks demonstrate that OmniDrop outperforms all baselines by up to 3.58 points while reducing prefill latency by up to 40% and memory usage by up to 14.7%.

AI.tldr: OmniDrop 是一个免训练的、逐层（layer-wise）的音视频 token 剪枝框架，用于 Omni-modal LLM（基于 Qwen2.5-Omni 7B/3B）。它放弃在输入嵌入层做跨模态相似度压缩的思路，改为在 LLM 解码层内部渐进式剪枝，并以文本 query 的注意力作为语义引导，另引入时间多样性分数（TDS）保持全局时序上下文。在 VideoMME、WorldSense、AVUT 基准上以 30%/20% token 保留率超越 OmniZip 与 DASH（最高 +3.58 分），同时降低 prefill 延迟约 40%、GPU 显存约 14.7%。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM（Qwen2.5-Omni 等）处理高分辨率音视频时存在"token 爆炸"：1 分钟视频即产生 >10k 音视频 token，导致计算与显存二次方增长，阻碍实时交互与长视频推理。现有训练免压缩方法（OmniZip、DASH 等）均在输入嵌入层剪枝，依赖两个不可靠假设：(1) 音视频嵌入在共享空间中已语义对齐——但 PCA 与余弦相似度分析显示二者占据不同子空间，跨模态相似度几乎落在 0.0–0.2 的无信息区间；(2) 时间共现等价于语义对应——背景音乐、画外音、环境声、场景切换往往与画面不同源。作者对 OmniZip 的消融（WorldSense 35% 保留率）显示，去掉音频锚点合并（AC）或改用随机 k 采样，结果反而更好或持平，说明输入层相似度相比随机选择毫无优势。同时对 Qwen2.5-Omni 的注意力分析发现：token 重要性是 query 依赖的，且注意力稀疏度随层变化——浅层 top-20% 注意力召回率低于 0.6（文本广泛关注所有 token），中层开始出现首个峰值并在后层维持高位，即从中层起模型才开始区分信息性 token。这促使作者把剪枝时机从"输入前"移到"解码层内"，并需要与 query 相关的可靠重要性信号。
AI.method: 整体框架由三部分组成：(1) 进入 LLM 前的模态内剪枝——音频沿用 OmniZip，保留音频编码器最后一层中注意力最高的 token（音频保留 70%）；视频采用 Dycoke 的 TTM 策略，对每 4 连续帧按余弦相似度合并冗余 token（视频保留 40%），合计 45%。(2) 渐进式逐层剪枝（PLP）——第 l 层的动态剪枝率 p_l = p_init + (p_final − p_init)·σ(l, t_mid, β)，其中 σ 为以 t_mid 为中点、β 为斜率的 sigmoid（β=20，t_mid=0.5/0.55）；剪枝只执行到倒数第二层（L−2）以保留语言建模头前的隐状态；由几何衰减 r_{l+1}=r_l(1−p_l) 标定 p_final（理论 ≈0.146，实取 0.2）以保证全局平均保留率符合 30%/20% 目标。(3) query 引导的 token 重要性——以文本 token 到音视频 token 的注意力均值 S = (1/n_T)·Σ_q Attn_{q→{V,A}} 作为重要性分数，按 p_l 剪去得分最低的 k_l = ⌊(n_A^l + n_V^l)·p_l⌋ 个 token；该机制使保留比例自适应于任务（视频中心任务保留更多视频 token，音频中心任务保留更多音频 token），无需显式任务标签。(4) 时间多样性分数（TDS）——对分数最低的 2k_l 候选集计算其相对最高分 token 所在关键 chunk 的归一化时距 D=|c_max−c_i|/max(C)，以 S_TDS = S + λ_div·D（λ_div=0.2）重排序，再剪去最低 k_l 个，从而抑制"少数高响应 token 垄断保留"的偏置；TDS 仅从中段层起启用（7B 第 14 层、3B 第 19 层）。全流程免训练、无需改动架构。
AI.result: 主实验（Qwen2.5-Omni 7B/3B；对比 OmniZip、DASH）：30% 保留率下 OmniDrop 在 VideoMME/WorldSense/AVUT 全面领先，并超过 100% 全 token 基线（VideoMME 66.52 vs 64.67，3B 63.07 vs 62.51）；20% 保留率下仍领先，AVUT 7B 上取得最大 3.58 分增益（63.67 vs DASH 60.09）。从 30% 降到 20% 时，OmniDrop 平均仅下降 0.18（7B）/0.47（3B）分，而 OmniZip、DASH 降幅均超 1.0 分。效率方面，WorldSense 上 prefill 时间减少 39.9%（7B）/28.1%（3B），GPU 显存下降 11.3%/14.7%；虽早期层保留约 45% token，但深层激进剪枝使整体延迟与显存与输入级剪枝基线相当。消融：PLP 相对"仅模态内剪枝"在 30% 下把 WorldSense/AVUT 从 44.33/59.34 提升至 46.53/63.90；20% 下 sigmoid 调度优于指数调度（45.93→46.25、63.03→63.32），证实"浅层保信息、中层起激进剪枝"的设计；TDS 在所有预算下进一步提升（20% 下 46.25→46.50、63.32→63.67），压缩越激进收益越大；将文本引导替换为音频引导在 3B 上显著退化（20% 时 WS 43.25 vs 46.19、AVUT 56.57 vs 60.55），且音频→视频注意力图计算开销大、7B 上 OOM。任务自适应分析：AR 任务音频保留率最高、SR 视频保留率最高、ASL 两者均衡。附录给出 WorldSense 8 个领域与 AVUT 6 个子任务的细分结果，OmniDrop 在多数领域/子任务取得最佳或持平；3B 的注意力分析趋势与 7B 一致。
AI.conclusion: OmniDrop 证明在 Omni-LLM 中"输入级跨模态相似度是弱信号"，并提出以文本 query 为语义中介、随解码层推进的渐进式剪枝范式：文本引导打分不仅更可靠，而且是实现层内剪枝的必要前提（因为自注意力融合后跨模态余弦相似度与音频语义边界假设均失效）。该方法在激进压缩（20% 保留率）下仍稳健优于现有训练免 SOTA，并带来接近 40% 的 prefill 延迟下降与约 15% 显存节省，为实时、多模态长视频推理提供了实用方案。局限与未来工作：依赖文本 prompt，纯音视频输入（无 query）场景不适用，需要研究无需文本引导的跨模态语义对齐；作为免训练框架，其剪枝调度与超参数仍靠经验设定，未来可用校准数据学习或联合优化以提升鲁棒性与泛化性。

title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents
summary: Voice agents increasingly require reliable tool use from speech, whereas prominent tool-calling benchmarks remain text-based. We study whether verified text benchmarks can be converted into controlled audio-based tool calling evaluations without re-annotating the tool schema and gold labels. Our dataset-agnostic framework uses text-to-speech, speaker variation, and environmental noise to create paired text-audio instances while preserving the original dataset annotations. Based on extensive evaluation of 7 omni-modal models on audio-converted versions of Confetti and When2Call, our framework demonstrates that the performance is strongly model- and task-dependent: Gemini-3.1-Flash-Live obtains the highest Confetti score (70.4), whereas GPT-Realtime-1.5 performs best on When2Call (71.9). On Confetti, the text-to-voice gap ranges from 1.8 points for Qwen3-Omni to 4.8 points for GPT-Realtime-1.5. A targeted analysis of failure cases demonstrates that degradations most often reflect misunderstandings of argument values in the speech. Considering real-world deployment scenarios, we further report text-only results, an ambiguity-based reformulation stress test, and a reference-free LLM-as-judge protocol validated against human preferences. Notably, we find that open-source Qwen3 judges with at least 8B parameters exceed 80% agreement with proprietary judges, supporting privacy-preserving evaluation. Overall, our framework provides a verifiable and reproducible first-stage diagnostic that complements purpose-built audio corpora.

AI.tldr: 研究提出将文本工具调用基准转换为音频评估的数据集无关框架，评估7个多模态模型发现性能存在模型和任务依赖性，文本到语音的性能差距1.8-4.8分，主要源于语音参数理解错误，开源评判器可替代专有方案。
AI.motivation: 当前主流工具调用基准仍基于文本，无法评估语音输入场景下的工具调用能力。研究者希望验证是否能在不重新标注的情况下，将文本基准转换为受控的音频评估。
AI.method: 提出数据集无关的框架，通过文本转语音、说话人变化和环境噪声创建配对的文本-音频实例，同时保留原始数据集标注。包含无参考的LLM评判协议和基于歧义的压力测试。
AI.result: 7个多模态模型在转换后的Confetti和When2Call数据集上表现差异显著：Gemini-3.1-Flash-Live在Confetti上最高(70.4)，GPT-Realtime-1.5在When2Call上最优(71.9)。文本到语音的性能差距因模型而异，Qwen3-Omni仅差1.8分，GPT-Realtime-1.5差距达4.8分。失败案例多因语音中参数值理解错误。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个可验证且可复现的音频工具调用评估框架，作为专用音频语料库的补充。该框架发现开源模型（如Qwen3-8B及以上）可作为隐私保护的评估器，与专有评判器一致性超过80%。

title: Language-Induced Priors for Domain Adaptation
summary: Domain adaptation faces a fundamental paradox in the cold-start regime. When target data is scarce, statistical methods fail to distinguish relevant source domains from irrelevant ones, which often leads to negative transfer. In this paper, we address this challenge by leveraging expert textual descriptions of the target domain, a resource that is often available but overlooked. We propose a probabilistic framework that translates these semantic descriptions into a choice model, namely a Language-Induced Prior (LIP), that learns the preferences from a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM). The LIP is then integrated into an Expectation-Maximization algorithm to identify source relevance. Methodologically, this framework is compatible with any parametric model where a likelihood is available. It allows the LIP to guide the selection of sources when target signals are weak, while gradually refining these choices as samples accumulate. Theoretically, we prove that the estimator roughly matches an oracle cold-start MSE under a correct prior, while remaining asymptotically consistent regardless of the quality of the LIP. Empirically, we validated the framework on a descriptive (Gaussian estimation), a predictive (C-MAPSS dataset), and a prescriptive task (MuJoCo hopper).

AI.tldr: 本文利用LLM从专家文本描述中学习先验知识（LIP），结合EM算法实现冷启动场景下的源域自适应选择，在理论上保证鲁棒性和一致性，实验覆盖描述性、预测性和处方性任务。
AI.motivation: 冷启动场景下目标数据稀缺，统计方法难以区分相关与无关源域，导致负迁移问题。现有方法忽视了专家文本描述这一易获取资源。
AI.method: 提出Language-Induced Prior (LIP)框架：通过预训练LLM将专家文本描述转化为概率选择模型，并将其融入EM算法迭代识别源域相关性。该框架兼容任意有似然函数的参数模型，初期依赖LIP引导源选择，随样本积累逐步精炼。
AI.result: 理论证明：在正确先验下估计量逼近oracle冷启动MSE下界；无论LIP质量如何，估计量保持渐近一致。实验验证：高斯估计、CMAPSS预测任务、MuJoCo跳跃处方任务均验证了框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: LIP框架在目标数据稀缺时显著优于传统方法，且理论保证其鲁棒性（即使先验质量不佳也能保持渐近一致性）。该工作为冷启动领域的域适应提供了一种利用LLM先验知识的新范式，兼具方法灵活性和理论保证。

title: From Table to Cell: Attention for Better Reasoning with TABALIGN
summary: Multi-step LLM reasoning over structured tables fails because planning and execution share no explicit cell-grounding contract. Existing methods constrain the planner to a left-to-right factorization at odds with table permutation invariance, and score intermediate states by generated content alone, overlooking cell grounding. We conduct a pilot study showing that diffusion language models (DLMs) produce more human-aligned and permutation-stable cell attention on tables than autoregressive models, with a 40.2% median reduction in attention-AUROC variability under row reordering. Motivated by this, we propose TABALIGN, a planned table reasoning framework that operationalizes the contract. TABALIGN pairs a masked DLM planner, whose bidirectional denoising emits plan steps as binary cell masks, with TABATTN, a lightweight verifier trained on 1,600 human-verified attention standards to score each step by its attention overlap with the plan-designated mask. Across eight benchmarks covering table question answering and fact verification, TABALIGN improves average accuracy by 15.76 percentage points over the strongest open-source baseline at comparable 8B-class scale, with a matched-backbone ablation attributing 2.87 percentage points of this gain to the DLM planner over an AR planner on a fixed reasoner. Cleaner DLM plans also accelerate downstream reasoning execution by 44.64%.

AI.tldr: TABALIGN提出计划-执行解耦的表格推理框架，通过扩散语言模型(DLM)规划器和注意力验证器的协同，在8个基准上提升准确率15.76pp，同时加速推理执行44.64%。
AI.motivation: Existing multi-step LLM table reasoning methods suffer from: (1) no explicit cell-grounding contract between planning and execution, (2) left-to-right factorization incompatible with table permutation invariance, (3) intermediate state scoring based solely on generated content, ignoring cell grounding
AI.method: Pair a masked DLM planner (bidirectional denoising → binary cell masks) with TABATTN verifier (1,600 human-verified attention standards → attention overlap scoring)
AI.result: TABALIGN improves average accuracy by 15.76pp over strongest open-source baseline at 8B-class scale; DLM planner alone contributes 2.87pp over AR planner (fixed reasoner); downstream reasoning execution accelerated by 44.64%
AI.conclusion: TABALIGN achieves SOTA on 8 benchmarks with 15.76pp improvement; DLM planner contributes 2.87pp (matched-backbone ablation); cleaner plans also accelerate downstream execution by 44.64%

title: MeMo: Memory as a Model
comment: This paper introduces MeMo, a framework that augments any LLM with up-to-date or domain-specific knowledge via a trained memory model, avoiding costly retraining, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and remaining robust to retrieval noise
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a wide range of tasks, but remain frozen after pretraining until subsequent updates. Many real-world applications require timely, domain-specific information, motivating the need for efficient mechanisms to incorporate new knowledge. In this paper, we introduce MeMo (Memory as a Model), a modular framework that encodes new knowledge into a dedicated memory model while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged. Compared to existing methods, MeMo offers several advantages: (a) it captures complex cross-document relationships, (b) it is robust to retrieval noise, (c) it avoids catastrophic forgetting in the LLM, (d) it does not require access to the LLM's weights or output logits, enabling plug-and-play integration with both open and proprietary closed-source LLMs, and (e) its retrieval cost is independent of corpus size at inference time. Our experimental results on three benchmarks, BrowseComp-Plus, NarrativeQA, and MuSiQue, show that MeMo achieves strong performance compared to existing methods across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: MeMo is a modular knowledge augmentation framework that encodes new information into a dedicated memory model, enabling LLMs to access up-to-date knowledge without fine-tuning or modifying core model parameters.
AI.motivation: Large language models remain frozen after pretraining, creating a gap when real-world applications require timely, domain-specific knowledge updates. Existing methods for incorporating new knowledge face limitations including catastrophic forgetting, dependency on model weights, and retrieval costs scaling with corpus size.
AI.method: MeMo encodes new knowledge into a dedicated memory model while keeping LLM parameters frozen; it captures cross-document relationships, handles retrieval noise robustly, and supports plug-and-play integration with both open and proprietary LLMs.
AI.result: MeMo achieves strong performance on three benchmarks (BrowseComp-Plus, NarrativeQA, and MuSiQue) across diverse settings.
AI.conclusion: MeMo framework enables efficient knowledge incorporation for LLMs through a dedicated memory model without modifying core parameters.

title: Matrix-Space Reinforcement Learning for Reusing Local Transition Geometry
summary: Compositional generalization in sequential decision-making requires identifying which parts of prior rollouts remain useful for new tasks. Existing methods reuse skills or predictive models, but often overlook rich local transition geometry and dynamics. We propose Matrix-Space Reinforcement Learning (MSRL), a geometric abstraction that represents trajectory segments through positive semidefinite matrix descriptors aggregating first- and second-order statistics of lifted one-step transitions. These descriptors expose shared hidden structure, support algebraic composition in an abstract matrix space, and reveal opportunities for transfer. We prove that the descriptor is well defined up to coordinate gauge, complete for the induced low-order additive signal class, additive under valid segment composition, and minimally sufficient among admissible additive descriptors. We further show that conditioning value functions on the trajectory-segment matrix yields a first-order smooth approximation of action values, enabling source-learned matrix-to-value mappings to bootstrap learning in new tasks. MSRL is plug-in compatible with standard model-free and model-based methods, while obstruction filtering rejects implausible compositions. Empirically, MSRL achieves the best average finite-budget target AUC of 0.73, outperforming MSRL from scratch (0.65), TD-MPC-PT+FT (0.63), and TD-MPC (0.57).

AI.tldr: 提出矩阵空间强化学习(MSRL)，通过正半定矩阵描述符表示轨迹片段，捕获一阶和二阶转移统计量，揭示隐结构并支持代数组合，实现跨任务迁移学习，在有限预算目标任务上达到0.73平均AUC，优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: Existing methods for compositional generalization in sequential decision-making reuse skills or predictive models but overlook rich local transition geometry and dynamics. There's a need to identify which parts of prior rollouts remain useful for new tasks.
AI.method: Proposes Matrix-Space RL (MSRL), using positive semidefinite matrix descriptors to represent trajectory segments by aggregating first- and second-order statistics of lifted one-step transitions. These descriptors capture hidden structure, support algebraic composition in matrix space, and enable source-learned matrix-to-value mappings to bootstrap new tasks. Includes obstruction filtering to reject implausible compositions.
AI.result: MSRL achieves best average finite-budget target AUC of 0.73, outperforming baselines: MSRL from scratch (0.65), TD-MPC-PT+FT (0.63), and TD-MPC (0.57).
AI.conclusion: MSRL provides a principled geometric framework for transfer learning in RL, with theoretical guarantees on completeness, additivity, and minimal sufficiency of trajectory-segment descriptors, and achieves state-of-the-art performance with 0.73 average AUC on finite-budget tasks.

title: LEMON: Learning Executable Multi-Agent Orchestration via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become a strong foundation for multi-agent systems, but their effectiveness depends heavily on orchestration design. Across different tasks, role design, capacity assignment, and dependency construction jointly affect both solution quality and execution efficiency. Existing approaches automate parts of this design process, yet they often optimize these decisions partially or sequentially, and rely on execution-level feedback that provides limited credit assignment for local orchestration decisions. We propose LEMON (\textbf{L}earning \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{M}ulti-agent \textbf{O}rchestratio\textbf{N} via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning), an LLM-based orchestrator that generates an executable orchestration specification. The specification integrates task-specific roles, customized duties, capacity levels, and dependency structure into a single deployable system. To train the orchestrator, we augment the orchestration-level GRPO objective with a localized counterfactual signal that edits role, capacity, or dependency fields and applies the resulting reward contrast only to the edited spans. Experiments on six reasoning and coding benchmarks, including MMLU, GSM8K, AQuA, MultiArith, SVAMP, and HumanEval, show that LEMON achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated multi-agent orchestration methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LEMON-B23C.

AI.tldr: LEMON（全文版名 Collator）提出“组合式多智能体编排”：由一个 LLM 编排器为每个任务生成统一的 YAML 编排规范（角色/职责 + 容量等级 + 依赖引用），并用“编排级 GRPO + 局部反事实信用分配”训练。具体做法是对规范中单个 role/capacity/dependency 字段做删除/回滚/降级等编辑，再执行对比，把奖励差只回传到被编辑的 token span，从而把稀疏的全局奖励变为字段级监督。在 MMLU、GSM8K、AQuA、MultiArith、SVAMP、HumanEval 六个基准上取得最佳平均分 90.72%，并位于精度–token 消耗的 Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的效果高度依赖编排设计：角色专精、容量分配（worker 模型规模）与依赖结构（信息流）共同决定解质量与执行开销，且三者相互耦合。现有自动化方法多只优化其中一个组件（拓扑搜索、工作流构造、路由/组队），或以分阶段、级联方式串联决策，无法形成统一可执行的编排规范；且训练信号多来自端到端执行的稀疏全局奖励，无法判断结果应归因于哪一次局部编排决策（角色、容量还是依赖），造成信用分配困难。此外，编排越精细并不总是越好，会同时抬高 worker token 成本与结构复杂度开销，因此需要任务自适应的、按需分配计算量的编排设计。
AI.method:
问题形式化：编排器 πθ 给定任务 x 生成统一编排规范 y∈Y（YAML），规范编译为有向无环图 G_y=(V_y,E_y)，每个 agent v=(b_v,d_v,c_v)，分别为继承的基础角色、任务定制职责、容量等级（small/medium/large → 7B/14B/32B），依赖边表示上游输出作为下游上下文；同一步骤内可并发。规则校验器检查 schema、必填属性、容量取值合法、agent 唯一性、引用仅指向先前步骤的 agent，Valid(y)∈{0,1}，故图为分层 DAG。

奖励与优化：全局编排奖励 R_orch = R_task + λ_tok·B_tok − λ_str·Ω_str（无效规范给负奖励 r_invalid）。其中容量加权 token 成本 C(x,y)=Σ_v ω_cap(c_v)(n_v^in+n_v^out)，ω_cap = 0.5/1/2；token 效率奖励 B_tok 在任务特定的 [τ_x^−, τ_x^+] 区间内线性衰减（正确 g=1，有效但未解出 g=ρ）；结构成本 Ω_str = ω_V|V|+ω_E|E|+ω_H·h(G)（节点数、边数、图深度）。在此基础上用标准 clipped GRPO 优化完整规范。

局部反事实信用分配：从反事实族 F_cf={φ_dep（删除一条依赖）、φ_role（把定制职责回滚为通用职责）、φ_cap（容量降一档）}中采样族与字段位置，构造只差一个字段的反事实规范 ỹ，用同一奖励函数评估得 ΔR = R_orch(x,y) − R_orch(x,ỹ)；定义 span 平均对数概率 s_θ^fact 与 s_θ^cf，对比权重 w_cf = min(|ΔR|,δ_max)/δ_max，局部损失 J_cf = −E[1{|ΔR|≥δ_min}·w_cf·log σ(β_cf·sign(ΔR)[s_fact−s_cf])]，即只对被编辑 span 的 token 施加监督，span 外 token 仅作上下文。总损失 J_total = J_GRPO + λ_cf·J_cf。先在可执行规范上做 SFT 冷启动；反事实执行仅用于训练，并通过节点级缓存复用未变更的 worker 调用以控制开销。附录还给出局部反事实目标的理论分析、YAML schema、提示模板、评测协议与算力细节。
AI.result: 六个基准上 Collator/LEMON 平均 90.72%，为对比方法最佳：较 SC-CoT、Tree-MAS、AgentPrune、AFlow 分别高 3.96/2.19/2.59/5.39 个百分点；在 5 个基准上排名第一，MMLU 上第二（84.32，仅比 ARG-Designer 低 0.98）。精度–token 权衡方面在四个基准的 Pareto 前沿上：MMLU 用约 0.2×10^4 worker token（ARG-Designer 0.3×10^4，多个拓扑基线 >0.6×10^4）；GSM8K/AQuA/SVAMP 上在低于若干拓扑基线的 token 消耗下取得最高精度。消融：SFT 显著提升规范可执行性但准确率不及最强单智能体；在此基础上编排级 GRPO 分别在 MMLU/GSM8K/AQuA 提升 10.19/11.75/5.90 点；再叠加局部反事实信用额外 +1.24/+0.92/+0.79 点，且 worker token 下降 15.5%/10.2%/31.7%。移除任一设计组件均降准（依赖构建对 MMLU 影响最大 −3.46 点，角色设计对 AQuA 最大 −3.15 点）；去掉容量分配会使 AQuA token 用量从 2056 翻倍至 4154；移除任一反事实族（依赖/角色/容量）均降准，说明三类信用互补。训练动态上完整方法最终奖励由约 2.0 提升至 2.25，每次执行 worker token 从 1.30K 降至 1.15K（约 −11.1%）；反事实采样概率随近期 |ΔR| 自适应在 1/3 附近调整。案例分析显示其生成的角色职责与依赖更贴合任务推理步骤，而基线多用泛化/重复角色。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 多智能体编排统一形式化为“组合式编排设计”，在单一可执行 YAML 规范中联合指定角色职责、容量等级与依赖引用，可直接校验、编译、执行；提出局部反事实强化学习，把执行级奖励差转化为被编辑字段的 span 级监督，缓解稀疏信用分配并抑制无效计算开销。实验表明该方法在推理与代码基准上同时提升任务性能与 token 效率，优于单智能体、固定拓扑、拓扑设计与自适应工作流等基线；消融验证了组合式设计与局部反事实监督的互补性。后续方向包括更强的局部信用理论分析、更丰富/更自动的反事实编辑族以及更大规模的编排搜索空间。

title: Text Knows What, Tables Know When: Clinical Timeline Reconstruction via Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Alignment
comment: Sayantan Kumar, Shahriar Noroozizadeh, Juyong Kim (authors contributed equally)
summary: Reconstructing precise clinical timelines is essential for modeling patient trajectories and forecasting risk in complex, heterogeneous conditions like sepsis. While unstructured clinical narratives offer semantically rich and contextually complete descriptions of a patient's course, they often lack temporal precision and contain ambiguous event timing. Conversely, structured electronic health record (EHR) data provides precise temporal anchors but misses a substantial portion of clinically meaningful events. We introduce a retrieval-augmented multimodal alignment framework that bridges this gap to improve the temporal precision of absolute clinical timelines extracted from text. Our approach formulates timeline reconstruction as a graph-based multistep process: it first extracts central anchor events from narratives to build an initial temporal scaffold, places non-central events relative to this backbone, and then calibrates the timeline using retrieved structured EHR rows as external temporal evidence. Evaluated using instruction-tuned large language models on the i2m4 benchmark spanning MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, our multimodal pipeline consistently improves absolute timestamp accuracy (AULTC) and improves temporal concordance across nearly all evaluated models over unimodal text-only reconstruction, without compromising event match rates. Furthermore, our empirical gap analysis reveals that 34.8% of text-derived events are entirely absent from tabular records, demonstrating that aligning these modalities can produce a more temporally faithful and clinically informative reconstruction of patient trajectories than either source alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种检索增强多模态对齐框架，通过整合非结构化临床叙述与结构化EHR数据重建精确临床时间线。该方法采用图式多步骤流程：构建时间骨架、相对放置事件、EHR证据校准。在MIMIC-III/IV数据集上验证显著提升时间戳精度，并发现34.8%文本事件在结构化数据中缺失，证明多模态对齐优于单一数据源。
AI.motivation: 现有的临床时间线重建面临两难：非结构化临床叙述语义丰富但时间精度不足且事件时间模糊；结构化EHR数据时间精确但遗漏大量临床重要事件。需要一种方法桥接两种模态以提升时间线精度。
AI.method: 提出检索增强多模态对齐框架，采用图式多步骤流程重建时间线：(1)从叙述文本提取中心锚点事件构建初始时间骨架；(2)将非中心事件相对于该骨架进行放置；(3)使用检索到的结构化EHR行作为外部时间证据进行校准。在i2m4基准（MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV）上使用指令微调大语言模型进行评估。
AI.result: 多模态管道一致提升绝对时间戳精度（AULTC）和近所有模型的时序一致性，且不损害事件匹配率。实证分析揭示34.8%的文本衍生事件在表格记录中完全不存在。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持事件匹配率的同时显著提升了时间戳精度（34.8%的文本事件在结构化数据中缺失），证明了多模态对齐能产生比单一数据源更忠实、临床信息更丰富的患者轨迹重建。

title: Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment
comment: 28 pages including appendix. Code and BBBench benchmark to be released
summary: Test-Time Scaling (TTS), which samples multiple candidate actions and ranks them via a Critic Model, has emerged as a promising paradigm for generalist GUI agents. Its efficacy thus hinges on the critic's fine-grained ranking ability. However, existing GUI critic models uniformly adopt binary classification. Our motivational analysis of these models exposes a severe entanglement: scores for valid actions and plausible-but-invalid distractors become indistinguishable. We attribute this failure to two structural defects: Affordance Collapse--the hierarchical affordance space is compressed into 0/1 labels; and Noise Sensitivity--binary objectives overfit to noisy decision boundaries. To resolve this, we introduce BBCritic (Beyond-Binary Critic), a paradigm shift grounded in the Functional Equivalence Hypothesis. Through two-stage contrastive learning, BBCritic aligns instructions and actions in a shared Affordance Space, recovering the hierarchical structure that binary supervision flattens. We also present BBBench (Beyond-Binary Bench), the first GUI critic benchmark that pairs a dense action space with a hierarchical four-level taxonomy, enabling fine-grained ranking evaluation. Experimental results show that BBCritic-3B, trained without any extra annotation, outperforms 7B-parameter SOTA binary models. It demonstrates strong zero-shot transferability across platforms and tasks, supporting our methodological view: GUI critique is fundamentally a metric-learning problem, not a classification one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BBCritic，一种超越二分类的GUI Critic新范式，通过两阶段对比学习在Affordance Space中对齐指令和动作，解决现有二分类模型中有效动作和干扰项得分不可区分的问题。BBCritic-3B在无需额外标注的情况下超越7B参数的最优二分类模型，并展现强跨平台零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI Critic模型采用二分类（好/坏）范式，导致两个根本性问题：(1) Affordance Collapse - 将层级化的affordance空间压缩为0/1标签，丢失决策粒度；(2) Noise Sensitivity - 二分类目标对噪声决策边界过拟合。这使得有效动作和"看似合理但错误的"干扰项得分难以区分。
AI.method: (1) 提出Functional Equivalence Hypothesis作为理论基础；(2) 设计两阶段对比学习框架，在Affordance Space中同时对齐指令-动作对；(3) 构建BBench基准测试——首个具备密集动作空间和四级层级分类体系的GUI Critic评估基准。
AI.result: BBCritic-3B在无需任何额外标注的情况下，性能超越7B参数的SOTA二分类模型，并展现出跨平台、跨任务的强零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: GUI Critic本质上是度量学习问题而非分类问题。层级化affordance空间的恢复对于细粒度排序能力至关重要，验证了所提方法论观点的正确性。

title: Deepchecks: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques are revolutionizing applications across multiple domains, such as healthcare, finance, and customer service. Despite their potential, evaluating RAG systems remains a complex challenge due to the stochastic nature of generated outputs and the intricate interplay between retrieval and generation components. This paper introduces Deepchecks, a comprehensive framework tailored for evaluating RAG applications. Deepchecks' evaluation framework addresses RAG applications evaluation through a multi-faceted approach, root cause analysis and production monitoring. By ensuring alignment with application-specific requirements, Deepchecks framework provides a robust foundation for assessing reliability, relevance, and user satisfaction in RAG systems.

AI.tldr: Deepchecks是一个针对RAG应用设计的综合评估框架，通过多维度评估、根因分析和生产监控来解决RAG系统评估的复杂性问题。
AI.motivation: RAG系统的评估面临复杂挑战，主要源于生成输出的随机性以及检索与生成组件之间的复杂交互
AI.method: 多维度方法，包括应用评估、根因分析和生产监控三个层面
AI.result: 提出了一个全面的评估框架，能够确保RAG应用符合特定领域要求
AI.conclusion: Deepchecks为RAG系统评估提供了可靠的基础，支持可靠性、相关性和用户满意度的评估。

title: Is Grep All You Need? How Agent Harnesses Reshape Agentic Search
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled complex agentic workflows where models autonomously retrieve information, call tools, and reason over large corpora to complete tasks on behalf of users. Despite the growing adoption of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in agentic search systems, existing literature lacks a systematic comparison of how retrieval strategy choice interacts with agent architecture and tool-calling paradigm. Important practical dimensions, including how tool outputs are presented to the model and how performance changes when searches must cope with more irrelevant surrounding text, remain under-explored in agent loops. This paper reports an empirical study organized into two experiments. Experiment 1 compares grep and vector retrieval on a 116-question sample from LongMemEval, using a custom agent harness (Chronos) and provider-native CLI harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI), for both inline tool results and file-based tool results that the model reads separately. Experiment 2 compares grep-only and vector-only retrieval while progressively mixing in additional unrelated conversation history, so that each query is embedded in more distracting material alongside the passages that matter. Across Chronos and the provider CLIs, grep generally yields higher accuracy than vector retrieval in our comparisons in experiment 1; at the same time, overall scores still depend strongly on which harness and tool-calling style is used, even when the underlying conversation data are the same.

AI.tldr: Empirical study comparing grep vs vector retrieval in LLM agentic workflows across multiple harnesses (Chronos, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) and tool-calling paradigms. Findings show grep generally outperforms vector retrieval, while agent harness choice significantly impacts performance.
AI.motivation: Existing literature lacks systematic comparison of how retrieval strategy interacts with agent architecture and tool-calling paradigm in RAG-based agentic systems. Critical practical dimensions—tool output presentation and performance under increasing irrelevant text—are under-explored in agent loops.
AI.method: Two-factorial experimental design: Experiment 1 compared grep vs vector retrieval on 116-question LongMemEval sample across Chronos, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, testing inline vs file-based tool result presentations. Experiment 2 evaluated grep-only vs vector-only retrieval under progressively increasing unrelated conversation history (distracting material).
AI.result: Grep yielded higher accuracy than vector retrieval across experiments; overall scores strongly depended on harness and tool-calling style selection, even when underlying conversation data remained constant.
AI.conclusion: Grep generally outperforms vector retrieval in agentic RAG systems; however, overall performance is heavily dependent on harness choice and tool-calling paradigm, even with identical underlying data. These findings highlight the importance of considering agent architecture alongside retrieval strategy.

title: Guided Diffusion Sampling for Precipitation Forecast Interventions
summary: Extreme precipitation causes severe societal and economic damage, and weather control has long been discussed as a potential mitigation strategy. However, to the best of our knowledge, perturbation-based interventions for weather control using data-driven weather forecasting models have not yet been explored. While adversarial attacks also generate perturbations that alter forecasts, they aim to exploit model artifacts and do not account for physical plausibility. In this paper, we propose a gradient-based guidance framework for precipitation-reduction interventions through diffusion sampling in diffusion-based weather forecasting models. Instead of directly perturbing atmospheric states, our method steers the diffusion sampling trajectory, enabling precipitation reduction while maintaining consistency with the atmospheric distribution. To assess physical plausibility, we evaluate from three perspectives: (i) vertical and variable-wise perturbation profiles, (ii) latent-space trajectory deviation, and (iii) cross-model transferability. Experiments on extreme precipitation events from WeatherBench2 demonstrate that our method achieves effective precipitation reduction while yielding more physically plausible interventions than adversarial perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了基于扩散模型的天气预报模型进行降水减少干预的新方法。通过引导扩散采样轨迹而非直接扰动大气状态，实现降水减少的同时保持物理合理性。实验表明该方法在WeatherBench2数据集上有效且具有跨模型迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 极端降水会造成严重的社会和经济损失，天气控制作为一种潜在的缓解策略长期被讨论。然而，据作者所知，基于扰动的天气控制干预在使用数据驱动天气预报模型方面尚未被探索。对抗攻击虽能产生改变预报的扰动，但旨在利用模型 artifacts，未考虑物理合理性。
AI.method: 提出基于梯度的引导框架，通过在扩散模型的采样轨迹中进行引导来实现降水减少干预，而非直接扰动大气状态，从而保持与大气分布的一致性。
AI.result: 该方法在WeatherBench2极端降水事件上实现了有效降水减少，且比对抗性扰动产生更符合物理规律的干预效果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在WeatherBench2极端降水事件上验证了有效性，在有效减少降水的同时，比对抗性扰动产生更符合物理规律的干预效果，且具有一定的跨模型迁移能力。

title: Learning Scenario Reduction for Two-Stage Robust Optimization with Discrete Uncertainty
summary: Two-Stage Robust Optimization (2RO) with discrete uncertainty is challenging, often rendering exact solutions prohibitive. Scenario reduction alleviates this issue by selecting a small, representative subset of scenarios to enable tractable computation. However, existing methods are largely problem-agnostic, operating solely on the uncertainty set without consulting the feasible region or recourse structure. In this paper, we introduce PRISE, a problem-driven sequential lookahead heuristic that constructs reduced scenario sets by evaluating the marginal impact of each scenario. While PRISE yields high-quality scenario subsets, each selection step requires solving multiple subproblems, making it computationally expensive at scale. To address this, we propose NeurPRISE, a neural surrogate model built on a GNN-Transformer backbone that encodes the per-scenario structure via graph convolution and captures cross-scenario interactions through attention. NeurPRISE is trained via imitation learning with a gain-aware ranking objective, which distills marginal gain information from PRISE into a learned scoring function for scenario ranking and selection. Extensive results on three 2RO problems show that NeurPRISE consistently achieves competitive regret relative to comprehensive methods, maintains strong calability with varying numbers of scenarios, and delivers 7-200x speedup over PRISE. NeurPRISE also exhibits strong zero-shot generalization, effectively handling instances with larger problem scales (up to 5x), more scenarios (up to 4x), and distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文针对离散不确定性下的两阶段鲁棒优化（2RO）场景削减问题，提出 PRISE（问题驱动的序贯前瞻启发式）与 NeurPRISE（基于 GNN-Transformer 的神经代理模型）：PRISE 按每个候选场景对缩减场景集目标值的边际增益逐一求解缩减 MILP 来选择场景，质量高但代价为 O(k̂·S) 次 MILP 求解；NeurPRISE 用模仿学习蒸馏 PRISE 的边际增益排序信号，单次前向传播完成全场景打分并支持任意 top-k 选取，在三类 2RO 问题（Selection、Vertex Cover、CFLP）上取得与 PRISE 接近的 regret，同时较 PRISE 加速 17–200 倍（摘要中写作 7–200×），并支持零样本泛化到更大问题规模（5×）、更多场景（4×）与分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 离散不确定性下的两阶段鲁棒优化（2RO）因 min-max-min 结构与场景规模耦合，使得精确方法（如列与约束生成 CCG）的确定性等价 MILP 规模随 |Ξ| 线性膨胀而不可行。场景削减是常用的输入端降维手段，但现有方法（SOR、K-means、MaxSum 等）多为"问题无关"的，仅依赖不确定集的几何/概率距离，未利用可行域、目标与追索（recourse）结构，导致所选场景在最坏情形下覆盖不足（实验中需 2–4 倍于 PRISE 的场景数才能达到同等覆盖）。已有单阶段鲁棒优化的 MILP 场景削减模型无法直接推广到 2RO（会形成更难的嵌套/三层优化）。因此需要一种能直接度量"场景对鲁棒目标的实际边际影响"的问题驱动方法，但精确实现代价高昂，故需要学习加速。
AI.method: （1）问题形式化：线性两阶段鲁棒优化 min_x c^T x + max_{ξ∈Ξ} min_{y∈F(x,ξ)} b_ξ^T y，定义追索成本 Q(x,ξ)、缩减场景目标值 V(R)=min_x[c^Tx+max_{ξ∈R}Q(x,ξ)]、全场景最优值 V(Ξ) 与 regret 指标 Regret(R)=(Z(x*)-V(Ξ))/V(Ξ)×100。（2）PRISE：从 R_0=∅ 出发，在每步对每个未选场景 ξ_j 求解缩减问题 R_t∪{ξ_j}，选使 V 最大的场景（等价于最大化边际增益 Δ=V(R_t∪{ξ_j})-V(R_t)），并以边际增益容差 ε 提前停止，同时记录 (R, ξ*, Δ) 监督标签；证明 V(R) 关于集合包含单调非减（Proposition 1），并给出非次模性反例（Remark 1）与后验 regret 上界（Proposition 2）及与 CCG 的区别（CCG 针对固定解的最坏场景分离，PRISE 针对重优化后的目标提升）。（3）NeurPRISE：GNN-Transformer 神经代理。编码器把每个场景的 MILP 子问题表示为约束-变量二部图，用 2 层 GINE（含边特征、节点类型指示、目标系数、场景成本、RHS、系数行与目标向量的余弦相似度、VC 的度数等特征）编码并全局均值池化得到 h_j；Transformer 编码器建模跨场景交互得到集合感知嵌入 Z_sce。解码器以平均池化的实例上下文 z_inst 作为 Query、Z_sce 作为 Key/Value，做多头缩放点积打分并经 MLP 混合得到每个场景 logit z_j，单次前向输出全部 |Ξ| 个场景分数，推理时按 top-k 提取任意预算的缩减集，无需重训。损失采用 gain-aware 排序目标 SWKL：对 PRISE 的边际增益做 log(1+g) 压缩、温度 τ=5 的 softmax 得到目标分布 P，预测分布 P̂ 由 logits softmax 得到，损失为 KL(P‖P̂)（与 BCE、R2R 的消融对比）；输入按语义特征组做逐实例尺度归一化（CFLP 中一/二阶段成本共享同一分母）。
AI.result: 在 SEL、VC（以及附录 CFLP）上与 Exact（Gurobi 全场景）、PRISE、Random、K-means、MaxSum、SOR、GK-RF、Neur2RO 对比（regret 与 wall-clock）：NeurPRISE 在 24 个（问题×规模×k）列中的 14 列取得非 oracle 方法最低 regret，SEL 上几乎全面最优，VC 在 k≥4 时最优或接近最优，且运行时间与轻量场景方法相当，比 GK-RF 快 2–69 倍，比 PRISE 快 17–200 倍；PRISE 在 k≥2 时 regret 最低但耗时极高（VC large k=6 达 18,713 s，NeurPRISE 仅 87.1 s）。压缩预算上 PRISE 平均仅需 2–8% 场景即达 1% 内误差（SEL-20-50 均值 4.2%），而 MaxSum/Random 需 2–4 倍场景。泛化方面：5× 问题规模下 SEL 全部预算最优、VC 在 k≥4 最优；S=50 训练模型可零样本迁移到 S=100/200 并保持优势；在 Normal 与多模态分布偏移下，uniform 训练的模型与目标分布训练的模型相当。消融显示：SWKL 在中大规模优于 BCE，Ours 融合方式不劣于 LF/EF；CFLP 上问题专属（设施-客户）图编码相比标准约束-变量编码 regret 更低（0.10 vs 0.16）、显存少 3.6×、训练快 4.3×；等时间预算下优于限时精确求解（VC large k=6: 4.89% vs 41.48%）；放宽 MIP gap 至 25% 可提速 7× 而 regret 仅增 3.4%；5 个随机种子标准差 ≤0.31 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PRISE 与 NeurPRISE 共同构成"问题驱动场景削减"的完整方案：PRISE 用边际增益把场景削减转化为序贯决策并提供高质量子集（单调性有理论保证、经验上强边际递减），NeurPRISE 通过 GNN-Transformer 模仿学习把 O(k̂·S) 次 MILP 求解摊销为单次前向，逼近 oracle 质量且大幅提速，同时具备跨规模、跨场景数、跨分布族与跨问题的零样本/少样本迁移能力。局限包括：离线 PRISE 标注成本高昂（VC 小规模约 14.2 小时，可通过近似标注/跨尺度泛化缓解）；下游缩减 MILP 成本随 k 增长（可用容差放松或 2RO 特定编码缓解）；V 一般非次模，故无经典贪心近似比，仅能给后验证书；方法限于线性 2RO 与有限离散不确定集，且 CFLP 中缩减集仍可能导致追索不可行（k=6 时降为 0%）。

title: Dynamic Latent Routing
summary: We investigate the temporal concatenation of sub-policies in Markov Decision Processes (MDP) with time-varying reward functions. We introduce General Dijkstra Search (GDS), and prove that globally optimal goal-reaching policies can be recovered through temporal composition of intermediate optimal sub-policies. Motivated by the "search, select, update" principle underlying GDS, we propose Dynamic Latent Routing (DLR), a language-model post-training method that jointly learns discrete latent codes, routing policies, and model parameters through dynamic search in a single training stage. In low-data fine-tuning settings, DLR matches or outperforms supervised fine-tuning across four datasets and six models, achieving a mean gain of +6.6 percentage points, while prior discrete-latent baselines consistently underperform SFT. Mechanistic analyses and targeted code ablations show that DLR learns structured routing behaviors with distinct causal roles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「动态潜在路由」（Dynamic Latent Routing, DLR）——一种单阶段的大模型后训练方法：以离散潜在码作为「子策略」在时间轴上拼接，通过学到的路由头在每步执行"搜索-选择-更新"（search-select-update），将码本、路由头与基座模型参数联合优化，码以 steering vector 形式注入残差流而不破坏预训练序列结构。作者首先在理论上提出并证明了「广义 Dijkstra 搜索」（GDS）：在时变奖励的动态 MDP（DMDP）中，全局最优的目标达成策略可由中间最优子策略的时间拼接得到（DLR 是 GDS 的一种"神经松弛"）。在 4 个 QA 基准 × 6 个开源模型（24 个配置）上，DLR 在低数据微调下全面超过 SFT（平均 +6.6pp），而 PauseToken、TokenAssorted 等离散隐变量基线一致弱于 SFT；机制分析表明学到的码具备结构化的、上下文相关的路由行为并具有因果承载作用。
AI.motivation: 1）层次化/组合式 RL 长期使用子策略（options、feudal、MAXQ）却缺少"沿时间轴拼接子策略为何有效"的理论依据；本文通过把 MDP 奖励显式化为时变形式构造动态 MDP，证明该拼接范式可达全局最优，从而填补理论空白。2）在 LLM 侧：离散隐变量是否有益？既有工作（PauseToken、Meta-Tokens、TokenAssorted、Abstract-CoT）均把离散码作为额外 token 插入自然语言序列，破坏预训练分布结构，需要大规模 warm-up/多阶段训练，在低数据场景下持续落后于 SFT；且这些方法无法在单阶段内同时完成"码搜索 + 路由学习 + 模型更新"。3）已有表示工程/steering 方法多为固定单一向量，无法动态、输入依赖地调控模型。作者希望离散码既能作为可控、可干预的计算接口（直接可观测的中间计算），又能在低数据微调下带来真实增益。
AI.method: 理论部分：定义有限时域动态 MDP（时变奖励 r_t ≤ 0、紧致状态空间、有限动作、奖励有界，A1–A3），给出拼接策略的价值分解定理（Thm 12），证明最优策略一般必须时变（Thm 11 反例），并给出动态 Bellman 迭代收敛到最优时变策略（Thm 7–10）。在此基础上提出 GDS：以优先队列搜索子策略拼接，按价值出队、基于支配/被支配目标集与容差 ε_t 的剪枝保证，首个可行出队策略即为最优目标达成策略（Thm 13，App. B 完整引理 1–18），并给出对偶的目标覆盖版本（Thm 14, App. C）。方法部分（DLR）：把自然语言序列按抽象比 K 切成 chunk（m(t)=⌊(t−1)/K⌋，M=⌈T/K⌉），每个 chunk 由线性路由头 W_rt 在首 token 隐状态上（带 stop-gradient）产出 C 维 logits 并 hard-argmax 选出码 a_m；码本向量 e_k ∈ R^H（零初始化）在注入层 l* 处以 h ← h + α·e_{a_m(t)} 的形式写入残差流，不改动输入 token 序列。损失 L_DLR 由四项组成：通用 LM 损失 −log p(x)、信息增益项 −log[p(x|a)/sg(p(x))]、策略优化项 −α_policy log p(a|x)、以及与 bigram-Zipfian 先验的 KL 边缘熵正则。训练循环即"搜索（N 次温度采样 rollout）→ 选择（取 p(x|a) 最大者）→ 更新（单一目标联合更新码本、路由头、LM）"，为 GDS 的神经松弛；默认 C=32、K=4、AdamW、lr 1e−5、单 epoch、2×H100。
AI.result: 主结果：24 个（模型×数据集）单元格 DLR 全部第一，相对 SFT 平均 +6.6pp（三个推理基准 +7.8pp）；最大增益 ScienceQA +18.8pp（Qwen3-8B）、+12.9pp（Qwen3-4B）、GSM8K +10.2pp（Llama-1B）。PauseToken 大致追平 SFT 但在 StrategyQA 崩塌（如 Qwen3-0.6B 24.6 vs 47.0），TokenAssorted 在数学/推理上崩溃（GSM8K 15.7 vs 46.0；SciQA 17.3 vs 56.4）。C=1 的 DLR（单 steering 向量）明显弱于 C=32。消融：去掉策略项最严重（GSM8K 平均 −9.8pp，最差 −23.7pp）、去掉 bigram-Zipfian 正则导致码本坍缩至 1/C 且掉 0–8pp、改用纯条件似然损失最轻（平均 −1.8~−4.8pp）；超参上 N=1 无搜索 −5.0pp、N=8 无额外收益、τ=0 −6.9pp、τ=2 −4.1pp、K=1 −3.7pp、K=8 −1.3pp、注入层选择可差 5–10pp。机制分析：码本两两余弦相似度 ≤0.28、利用率 31–100%；ScienceQA 上码 n-gram 主题纯度显著高于随机基线 0.17 且随 n 增大而升高；全局干预（steering scale→0 掉 3.4–17.4pp，随机替换码掉 2.6–11.7pp）与单码消融（平均 −0.71~−2.74pp）证明码具有因果承载作用，且出现主题条件化的符号翻转（如消融 code 0：生物学 +3.6pp、物理 −4.0pp）。六位数算术案例：2 层 1 头 128 维 Transformer 上带码准确率 95.5%、全部 knockout 后降至 0.1%；30 码中 23 个激活，多数码的 Quirke 子任务纯度 ≥70% 且位置锁定，自发复现了 Quirke 等人用激活级方法发现的进位状态三分类器 ST_n∈{0,U,1}；单点换码可在 27–31% 的错例中"修正"答案（跨运算移植 93.5% vs 随机 75.5%）；在 13 个（架构×数据量）配置中 12 个优于 SFT，最难 6 级进位全部优于 SFT，最大 +50pp。
AI.conclusion: GDS 首次为"沿时间轴拼接子策略可获得动态 MDP 中的最优目标达成策略"提供了形式化证明（附对偶的目标覆盖结果），从而为层次化/组合式 RL 提供了缺失的理论依据；DLR 把 GDS 的"搜索-选择-更新"原理落地为可用的 LLM 后训练方法，单阶段联合学习离散码、路由策略与模型参数，在低数据微调下稳定超过 SFT 并显著优于既有离散隐变量基线，同时把"隐式中间计算"外化为可直接观测、可因果干预的离散路由符号（六位数算术上复现了已知的进位分类电路）。局限：GDS 定理假设外部给定的时变奖励，而 DLR 的奖励 log p_θ(x|a) 依赖模型参数本身，故理论只是"启发"而非对方法的认证；实验限于低数据后训练与 0.6B–8B 两个开源家族，搜索收益在大规模持续预训练场景下可能更大，留待后续工作。

title: When Robots Do the Chores: A Benchmark and Agent for Long-Horizon Household Task Execution
summary: Long-horizon household tasks demand robust high-level planning and sustained reasoning capabilities, which are largely overlooked by existing embodied AI benchmarks that emphasize short-horizon navigation or manipulation and rely on fixed task categories. We introduce LongAct, a benchmark designed to evaluate planning-level autonomy in long-horizon household tasks specified through free-form instructions. By abstracting away embodiment-specific low-level control, LongAct isolates high-level cognitive capabilities such as instruction understanding, dependency management, memory maintenance, and adaptive planning. We further propose HoloMind, a VLM-driven agent with a DAG-based long-horizon hierarchical planner, a Multimodal Spatial Memory for persistent world modeling, an Episodic Memory for experience reuse, and a global Critic for reflective supervision. Experiments with GPT-5 and Qwen3-VL models show that HoloMind substantially improves long-horizon performance while reducing reliance on model scale. Even top models achieve only 59% goal completion and 16% full-task success, underscoring the difficulty of LongAct and the need for stronger long-horizon planning in embodied agents.

AI.tldr: LongAct是一个评估长时域家庭任务规划级自主性的基准测试，通过自由形式指令指定任务，剥离具体控制层面的低层控制，聚焦指令理解、依赖管理、记忆维护和自适应规划等高层认知能力。配套的HoloMind智能体集成了DAG层次化规划器、多模态空间记忆、情景记忆和全局Critic等组件。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入式AI基准测试主要关注短时域导航或操控任务，依赖固定任务类别，缺乏对长时域家庭任务所需的高层规划能力和持续推理能力的评估。
AI.method: HoloMind采用四大核心组件：(1) 基于有向无环图（DAG）的长时域层次化规划器；(2) 多模态空间记忆模块用于持久化世界建模；(3)情景记忆模块用于经验复用；(4) 全局 Critic 用于反思式监督。
AI.result: 实验表明HoloMind大幅提升长时域任务性能，同时减少对模型规模的依赖。然而顶级模型仅达到59%的目标完成率和16%的完整任务成功率，凸显LongAct的挑战性。
AI.conclusion: HoloMind通过大型视觉语言模型（GPT-5和Qwen3-VL）驱动，在LongAct基准上显著提升长时域任务性能，同时降低对模型规模的依赖。但即便最先进模型也仅达到59%的目标完成率和16%的完整任务成功率，表明现有模型在长时域规划方面仍有较大提升空间。

title: AIM-DDI: A Model-Agnostic Multimodal Integration Module for Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is a critical task in computational biomedicine, as adverse interactions between co-administered drugs can cause severe side effects and clinical risks. A key challenge is unseen-drug generalization, where interactions must be predicted for drugs not observed during training. Although multimodal DDI models exploit diverse drug-related information, their fusion mechanisms are often tied to specific prediction architectures, limiting their reuse across models. To address this, we propose AIM-DDI, an architecture-independent multimodal integration module that represents heterogeneous modality information as tokens in a shared latent space. By modeling dependencies across modality tokens through a unified fusion module, AIM-DDI enables model-agnostic integration of structural, chemical, and semantic drug signals across different DDI prediction architectures. Extensive evaluations across diverse DDI models and DrugBank-based settings show that AIM-DDI consistently improves prediction performance, with the strongest gains under the most challenging both-unseen setting where neither drug in a test pair is observed during training. These results suggest that treating multimodal integration as a reusable module, rather than a model-specific fusion component, is an effective strategy for robust unseen-drug DDI prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIM-DDI，一种架构无关的多模态药物相互作用预测整合模块，通过将异构模态信息统一表示为token并建模跨模态依赖，实现跨架构的高效整合，有效提升未见药物场景下的DDI预测性能。
AI.motivation: 药物相互作用预测面临未见药物泛化挑战，且现有融合机制与特定预测架构绑定，限制了其可复用性。
AI.method: 提出AIM-DDI，一种架构无关的多模态整合模块：将异构模态信息表示为共享潜在空间中的token，通过统一融合模块建模跨模态token的依赖关系，实现结构、化学和语义信息的跨架构整合。
AI.result: AIM-DDI在多种DDI模型和DrugBank数据集上持续提升预测性能，在最具挑战性的"双边未见"设置下效果最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态整合作为一个可复用模块而非模型特定组件，是实现鲁棒的未见药物DDI预测的有效策略。

title: Cattle Trade: A Multi-Agent Benchmark for LLM Bluffing, Bidding, and Bargaining
summary: We introduce \textsc{Cattle Trade, a multi-agent benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) as agents in strategic reasoning under imperfect information, adversarial interaction, and resource constraints. The benchmark combines auctions, hidden-offer trade challenges (TCs), bargaining, bluffing, opponent modeling, and resource allocation within a single long-horizon game lasting 50--60 turns. Unlike prior agent benchmarks that test these abilities in isolation, \textsc{Cattle Trade} evaluates whether agents integrate them across a competitive, multi-agent economic game with conflicting incentives. The benchmark logs every bid, TC offer, counteroffer, and card selection, enabling behavioural analysis beyond final scores or win rates. We evaluate seven cost-efficient language models and three deterministic code agents across 242 games. Strategic coherence, in particular spending efficiency, resource discipline, and phase-adaptive bidding, is associated with rank more strongly than spending volume or any single subskill. Two heuristic code agents outperform most tested LLMs, and behavioural traces surface recurring LLM failure modes including overbidding, self-bidding, bankrupt TC initiation, and weak opponent-state adaptation. Evaluating agentic competence requires benchmarks that test the joint deployment of multiple capabilities in multi-agent environments with conflicting incentives, uncertainty, and economic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 《Cattle Trade》是一个多智能体基准测试，将拍卖、隐藏报价交易挑战（Kuhhandel/TC）、虚张声势、讨价还价、对手建模与离散资源约束整合进同一款 50–60 回合、3–5 人（实验用 4 人）的经济类桌游中，考察 LLM 代理在不完全信息、对手对抗与流动性约束下的多能力协同（战略连贯性），而非单项技能。论文基于 242 局对战 7 个低成本 LLM 与 3 个确定性启发式代码代理，用 TrueSkill 排名并做行为日志分析。结论：成功与"支出效率、资源纪律、阶段自适应出价"等整体连贯性关联更强；3 个代码基线中 2 个（TrackerAgent、SetRaceAgent）胜过大多数 LLM；LLM 反复出现过度出价、自我竞价、破产式 TC 发起、对手状态适应弱等失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准（MMLU、HumanEval、BIG-bench）只测知识与代码生成；AgentBench 缺乏对抗性战略推理；GTBench、AvalonBench、Werewolf、MACHIAVELLI、Suspicion-Agent、ALYMPICS 等游戏类基准各自孤立考察欺骗、博弈论、社会推理或经济约束中的一种，且多为短视野、单一智能体或二元/简单计分。作者的核心论点是：单点能力通过并不等于联合胜任力，真正决定下游经济型代理（如谈判、采购、组合管理）表现的是能否在对抗性、多智能体、激励冲突且有资源约束的环境中协调运用多种能力。此外，缺乏可诊断的日志使得评测只能告诉你"谁输了"而无法告诉你"为何输"。因此需要一个把拍卖、隐藏报价议价、欺骗、离散无找零支付、组合敏感计分集中在同一环境中的基准，并配套行为诊断指标。
AI.method: 游戏改编自 Rüdiger Koltze 1985 年 Ravensburger 桌游 Kuhhandel：10 种动物 × 4 张 = 40 张动物牌，quartet 分值（鸡10→马1000），终局计分 Score = (已完四张套牌分值之和) × 完套数（乘法结构奖励广度）；55 张固定面额货币牌（0/10/50/100/200/500），不找零（付60用100牌即花100），起始 90 币。回合内主动玩家可选拍卖或发起 TC：拍卖采用 canonical 同时意向多轮叫价，可出价超过自身财富（触发暴露财富+重拍，同场第二次超拍淘汰），拍主可选择接受最高价或行使 buy-right 付价留牌；TC 中挑战者暗牌出价（含0牌虚张声势），对手可接受或暗牌反报价，摊牌后多者胜，双方都持对子时输家让两张、否则让一张，三次平局挑战者默认胜；抽到驴牌向所有人发钱（50/100/200/500），造成前紧后松的流动性阶段转换。引擎用 Python 实现（canonical/fast/legacy 三种叫价模式），日志记录每次出价、TC 出价、反报价、选牌与完整状态转移；无找零支付用子集和 DP 求最小超额组合。代理接口：自然语言观测（私有手牌与精确金钱、公开他人牌数与金钱张数但不显面值、牌堆剩余、最近约10条事件、300 token 内个人 scratchpad），输出结构化 JSON 动作（竞价金额、buy-right 决策、TC 目标/动物/具体出价卡组合、接受或反报价），模型自行构造 0 牌虚张声势而非引擎启发式；全部模型共享中性规则 system prompt + "play optimally" 两行角色提示，不含策略提示；温度 0.1、low reasoning effort、4096 token 上限、每回合额外一次模型调用更新 scratchpad；错误处理含多级 JSON 解析回退、截断重试、指数退避，并按动作类型区分"静默纠正/重试/机制性保留"（超拍不纠正）。评测体系：TrueSkill 贝叶斯评级（μ、σ、μ−3σ）、胜率、分数、四元套数等排名指标；行为指标含资本效率 η=分数/总流出、TC 议价紧度 τ=Σ(败方出价+10)/Σ(胜方出价)、出价激进度（出价/quartet 值）、buy-right 率、TC 接受率、纯0牌虚张声势率、自我竞价率、超拍率、每 quartet 成本。实验：7 个低成本 LLM（Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5/3/3.1 Flash Lite 或 Flash、GPT-5.4 Nano、DeepSeek v3.2）；3 个确定性代码代理基线（TrackerAgent 完美信息+算牌+贪心，SetRaceAgent 集齐导向，EconomyAgent 资源预算导向）；242 局 = 60 局纯 LLM 四人锦标赛（15 种平衡组合）+ 168 局混合格式（LLM 对 3 个代码代理，7 种对手构成 C1–C7）+ 14 局 Sonnet 探索局；主分析切片为 98 局 canonical（70 纯 LLM + 28 mixed comp1），另有 172 局 exp2 切片用于 LLM-vs-代码校准。
AI.result: 排名（98 局 canonical 切片，按 TrueSkill μ）：Gemini 3 Flash 30.1±3.3（72.9% 胜、中位分 5,250、每局 3.96 套）> TrackerAgent 28.7±3.6 > Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 28.0±2.9 > SetRaceAgent 27.3±3.3 > Claude Sonnet 4.5 26.4±1.6（n=14）> DeepSeek v3.2 23.9 > GPT-5.4 Nano 22.6 > EconomyAgent 22.1 > Claude Haiku 4.5 21.8 > Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite 20.5。TrackerAgent 胜过 7 个 LLM 中的 6 个，SetRaceAgent 胜过 5 个；仅 Gemini 3 Flash 明显超过全部代码基线。172 局校准切片中 G3-F 胜率 67.9%、G3.1-FL 50.0%，DS-v3.2 10.7%、GPT5.4-N 14.3%、Haiku 7.1%、G2.5-FL 0%；含两个 TrackerAgent 的构成（C2/C7）最难，含两个 EconomyAgent（C3/C6）最易，说明信息利用与果断获取比保守预算更重要。行为层面：支出效率上 G3-F η=1.77、G3.1-FL 1.46、Tracker 1.55，而激进出价（激进度 2.52）的 G2.5-FL 仅 0.23、每 quartet 成本 1,193（头部 600–750）；超拍率 G2.5-FL 1.20%、Haiku 0.87%、DS 0.49%、GPT5.4-N 0.47%，三个代码代理为 0；自我竞价率与表现呈负相关（G3.1-FL 6.8%、Sonnet 4.8% vs DS 75.4%、G2.5-FL 78.5%），但作者提醒 canonical 模式需全体同时 pass 才终止拍卖，故该指标应读作"拍卖内抬价倾向"；阶段适应上 G3-F 从 0.26 升至 2.49（约10倍），G3.1-FL 0.22→0.65，代码代理亦显著爬升（Tracker 0.06→1.92），而 G2.5-FL 2.07→2.08 无适应；TC 紧度上 G3-F τ≈0.34 最优，Haiku/GPT5.4-N 虽最紧（≈0.4）但效率低，Tracker/SetRace 效率高而松（0.2–0.25）。轨迹级：G2.5-FL 出现零资金发起 TC（被10币反报价轻易击败）；G3-F 对破产对手用0牌虚张声势、对富裕对手出500+币，并能对组合完成支付远高于面值的加价以利用乘法计分（净赚约1,800分）。成本方面 token 用量跨模型约20倍（G3-F 每局约275k completion token vs G3.1-FL 约14.8k），两者同列前二，说明冗长推理链非必需；Haiku token 最多却排倒数第二；结构化输出失败率各模型均<1%，不能解释性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 在多智能体、激励冲突、不完全信息与资源约束并存的长期经济博弈中，决定成绩的核心是"战略连贯性"——支出效率、资源纪律与阶段自适应出价的组合——而非任何单项子技能，也非出价总量或 token 消耗量。三个廉价确定性启发式基线中有两个胜过多数受测 LLM，说明当前低成本模型缺乏的不是个别能力而是其在竞争压力下的可靠整合；系统的行为日志（超拍率、自我竞价、破产发起、报价校准）把静态基准和 Elo 聚合分数都无法看见的失效模式量化出来，指向状态追踪、资源约束推理与对手建模三处具体缺口。论文同时给出未来方向：以完整推理预算评测前沿模型以区分能力上限与成本效率取舍、引入代理间自由聊天以模拟人类联盟与说服层、开源模型自博弈微调以检验自我竞价等失效是否可训练消除、以及与人类玩家对标以校准 LLM 失败是否属于新手同样会犯的错误。局限包括：仅测低成本模型且推理强度低、Sonnet 仅 14 局、未做记忆规模与温度消融、行为指标为点估计无置信区间、组内分数方差远大于座位差异且缺少牌序受控消融，部分失败也可能源于提示设计、自然语言数值解析或工作记忆而非纯粹推理缺陷。

title: Nearest-Neighbor Radii under Dependent Sampling
summary: Nearest-neighbor methods are fundamental to classical and modern machine learning, yet their geometric properties are typically analyzed under independent sampling. In this paper, we study the nearest-neighbor radii under dependent sampling. We consider strong mixing dependent observations and ask whether dependence changes the scale of nearest-neighbor neighborhoods. We establish distribution-free almost sure convergence under polynomial mixing and sharp non-asymptotic moment bounds under geometric mixing. The moment bounds depend on the local intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension, making the results applicable to high-dimensional data concentrated near lower-dimensional manifolds. Synthetic experiments and real-world time-series benchmarks support the theory, showing that nearest-neighbor geometry remains informative under dependence sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究强混合依赖采样下 k 近邻半径（k-NN radius）的几何尺度。结论：在多项式 α-混合下 k-NN 半径分布无关地几乎处处收敛到查询点到边缘分布支撑集的距离；在几何 α-混合配合局部质量条件 μ(B(x,r)) ≍ r^s 时，矩满足 E[R_{n,k}(x)^p] ≍ (k/n)^{p/s}，即依赖性只影响常数与集中机制（引入 log n 惩罚），不改变由局部内在维数 s 决定的规范尺度 (k/n)^{1/s}。
AI.motivation: 近邻方法（k-NN 分类/回归、密度估计与自适应带宽、流形学习、图方法、检索与语言模型等）都建立在一个基本几何量上：查询点 x 到其第 k 近邻的距离 R_{n,k}(x)。该随机半径决定了局部邻域尺度，从而控制局部方法的偏差—方差权衡、邻域连通性与局部几何的可分辨尺度。但在 i.i.d. 情形下这一尺度已知为 (k/n)^{1/d}（更一般为 (k/n)^{1/s}，s 为内在维数）；而现实中大量数据是时序、空间或与环境交互产生的（时间序列预测、强化学习轨迹、事件流、时空感知），其边缘分布稳定但样本之间高度相关。一旦存在依赖，二项式尾部界与经典集中论证失效，经典 i.i.d. 近邻几何结论能否平移就成了关键问题：若依赖改变了半径尺度，许多局部学习算法的几何基础也会改变；若尺度不变，则可为把局部方法推广到依赖数据提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用三角阵列（triangular array）框架：第 n 行 n 个 R^d 值观测 X_{n,i} 共享同一边缘分布 μ（允许依赖结构随 n 变化，覆盖平稳序列作为特例），以强混合系数 α_m 刻画依赖。核心对象为 R_{n,k}(x)=||X_{(k)}^n(x)-x||，并利用等价关系 R_{n,k}(x)>r ⟺ N_n(x,r)<k（局部计数过程）把半径问题转化为依赖计数过程的集中问题。技术路线：(1) 定理1 在多项式混合 α_m ≲ m^{-γ}（γ>1）下，对指示变量中心化序列应用 Rio (1995)/Liebscher (1996) 的 α-混合 Bernstein 型不等式，配合 Davydov 协方差不等式控制条件方差 σ² ≤ Mm（M = 1+24Σα_ℓ），并用 Borel–Cantelli 得到几乎必然收敛；(2) 在几何混合 α_m ≤ e^{-γm} 下采用 blocking（保块-弃块交替，块长 b_n = ⌈8log n/γ⌉）使块序列混合系数 ≤ α_{ℓb_n} ≤ n^{-8}，再对块和用 Bernstein 不等式得到非渐近尾界；(3) 上界依赖局部下质量条件 μ(B(x,r)) ≥ c_- r^s，下界仅用局部上质量 μ(B(x,r)) ≤ c_+ r^s 加 Markov 不等式；(4) 矩界通过对数分档尾界积分并用紧支撑假设（直径 ≤ D）控制远尾。核心工具是混合序列的 Bernstein 型集中不等式与分块解耦技术。
AI.result: 定理1（分布无关 a.s. 收敛）：多项式 α-混合、k/n→0 时 ||X_{(k)}^n(x)-x|| → r_x（x 到 supp(μ) 的距离）几乎必然成立；若 x∈supp(μ) 则半径→0，无需密度或光滑性假设。定理2（非渐近尾界）：在几何混合、局部下质量与紧支撑下，P(R>2^j r_*) ≤ 4exp(-c_0 2^{js} k/log n)+Cn^{-7}，r_*=(8k/(c_- n))^{1/s}，即高概率上界 R ≲ ((k+t log n)/n)^{1/s}。定理3（锐矩上界）：对任意 p>0，在 K_0 log n ≤ k ≤ κn 下 E[R^p] ≤ C_{p,s}(k/n)^{p/s}。定理4（匹配下界，无需依赖条件）：E[R^p] ≥ ½(k/(2c_+ n))^{p/s}。定理5（精确阶）：c_{p,s}(k/n)^{p/s} ≤ E[R^p] ≤ C_{p,s}(k/n)^{p/s}。理论要点：依赖只带来 k ≳ log n 的对数级集中惩罚（分块解耦代价），基本指数 1/s 不变；理论以局部内在维数 s 而非环境维数 d 表述，故适用于集中于低维流形的高维数据。实验：(1) 矩收敛率——i.i.d. 基线 vs 线性高斯状态空间模型、2 状态 HMM、FFT-RBF 高斯过程三依赖 DGP（弱/中/强三档），d∈{1,3,5}，对 log M = a + b log(k/n) 拟合斜率，弱依赖接近理论值 p/d，中强依赖偏离；(2) 熵估计——s 维高斯 AR(1) 隐过程经 20×5 线性增广到 20 维，用 Kozachenko–Leonenko 熵估计，oracle 隐空间估计与 5 主成分 PCA 表示的估计均随 n 增大趋近真熵 H_s=(s/2)log(2πe)，说明弱依赖主要改变常数；(3) 真实数据——Time Series PILE（Informer 长程预测 9 数据集、Monash 短程预测 6 组、UCR 分类 91 数据集）上 Raw-kNN 与 PCA-kNN 对比预训练基础模型 MOMENT：长程预测 MSE 0.628/0.627 vs MOMENT 0.617；分类准确率 0.748/0.748 vs MOMENT 0.794；短程 within-group sMAPE 16.199/16.488，迁移设定 27.210/27.369（MOMENT 14.525），表明近邻结构在真实依赖数据上仍具信息量，且降维后性能基本保持。
