AI.conclusion: 核心信息是"常数 vs 指数"的分离：局部几何指数 s 决定半径的规范尺度 (k/n)^{1/s}，依赖结构只决定常数与集中质量（几何混合下以 log n 形式进入集中指数）。因此弱依赖不改变近邻几何的渐近行为，i.i.d. 时代关于局部邻域尺度的直觉与方法设计原则可迁移到依赖数据，为 k-NN 回归、局部平均、自适应带宽、图构建与邻域型流形方法提供了可直接使用的几何"构件"。作者也指出局限：结论是逐点（pointwise）的，对支撑集上的一致收敛需要质量条件的一致性与对依赖计数过程的一致集中（经验过程理论），留作后续工作；紧支撑假设仅为技术简化，可由尾部/矩条件替代。整体而言，本文为"依赖采样下的近邻几何可平移性"提供了首个系统的理论与实证支持。

title: VerbalValue: A Socially Intelligent Virtual Host for Sales-Driven Live Commerce
comment: Accepted to the CVPR 2026 HiGen Workshop
summary: A skilled live-commerce host is not merely a narrator, but a sales agent who converts viewer curiosity into purchase intent through expert product knowledge, emotionally intelligent response tactics, and entertainment that serves as a vehicle for product exposure. Yet no existing AI system replicates this: conversational recommenders treat recommendation as a terminal act, while general-purpose LLMs hallucinate product claims and default to generic promotional templates that fail to engage or persuade. We present VerbalValue, a sales-conversion-oriented virtual host that turns exceptional verbal ability into real commercial value, built on three contributions. First, we construct a domain knowledge base of product specifications and a curated sales terminology lexicon that anchor product-related responses in verified expertise. Second, we collect and annotate 1,475 live-commerce interactions spanning diverse viewer intents. Third, we fine-tune a large language model on this data to deliver empathetic, commercially oriented responses, adapting to viewer intent through empathetic amplification, evidence-backed rebuttal, and humor-mediated deflection. Experiments against GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and other baselines demonstrate gains of 23% on informativeness and 18% on factual correctness, with consistent advantages in tactfulness and viewer engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VerbalValue系统，旨在构建面向销售转化的虚拟直播带货主播。该系统通过构建产品知识库、标注大规模直播交互数据并微调大语言模型，使AI能够提供共情式、证据支撑的商业化响应。实验表明该系统在信息量、事实准确性、得体性和观众参与度上均显著优于GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro等主流基线模型。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统无法复现专业直播带货主播的核心能力。现有对话推荐系统将推荐视为终结性行为，通用大语言模型则存在产品信息幻觉问题，且默认采用缺乏吸引力和说服力的通用营销模板，无法有效将观众好奇心转化为购买意愿。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了三项核心贡献：①建立产品规格领域知识库与精选销售术语词典，确保回答基于已验证的专业知识；②收集标注1475条涵盖多元观众意图的直播电商交互数据；③基于该数据集微调大语言模型，使其能根据观众意图自适应地采用共情放大、证据反驳和幽默转移三种响应策略。研究采用与多个主流基线模型对比的实验设计。
AI.result: 在信息量指标上提升23%，事实正确性提升18%，并在得体性和观众参与度方面保持稳定优势。
AI.conclusion: VerbalValue成功将语言表达能力转化为实际商业价值，在信息量、准确性、得体性和观众参与度等维度上显著优于GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro等主流大语言模型，为AI驱动的直播带货场景提供了可行的技术解决方案。

title: Exemplar Partitioning for Mechanistic Interpretability
summary:
We introduce Exemplar Partitioning (EP), an unsupervised method for constructing interpretable feature dictionaries from large language model activations with $\sim 10^{3}\times$ fewer tokens than comparable sparse autoencoders (SAEs). An EP dictionary is a Voronoi partition of activation space, built by leader-clustering streamed activations within a distance threshold. Each region is anchored by an observed exemplar that serves as both its membership criterion and intervention direction; dictionary size is not prespecified, but determined by the activation geometry at that threshold. Because exemplars are observed rather than learned, dictionaries built from the same data stream are directly comparable across layers, models, and training checkpoints.
  We characterise EP as an interpretability object via targeted demonstrations of properties newly accessible through this construction, plus one head-to-head benchmark. In Gemma-2-2B, EP dictionary regions are interpretable and support causal interventions: refusal in instruction-tuned Gemma concentrates in a region whose exemplar ablation can collapse held-out refusal. Cross-checkpoint matching between base and instruction-tuned dictionaries separates the directions preserved through finetuning from those introduced by it. EP regions and Gemma Scope SAE features decompose activation space differently but agree on a shared core: $\sim 20\%$ of EP regions match an SAE feature at $F_{1} > 0.5$, and EP one-hot probes retain $\sim 97\%$ of raw-activation probe accuracy at $\ell_{0} = 1$. Nearest-exemplar distance provides a free out-of-distribution signal at inference. On AxBench latent concept detection at Gemma-2-2B-it L20, EP at $p_{1}$ reaches mean AUROC $0.881$, $+0.126$ over the canonical GemmaScope SAE leaderboard entry and within $0.030$ of SAE-A's $0.911$, at $\sim 10^{3}\times$ less build compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Exemplar Partitioning (EP)方法，通过Voronoi划分和leader-clustering从LLM激活值构建可解释特征字典，比稀疏自编码器(SAE)节省约10³倍的tokens。EP字典无需预设大小，锚点为观测到的样本点，支持跨层、跨模型、跨检查点的直接比较。在Gemma-2-2B上验证了可解释性和因果干预能力，在AxBench概念检测任务中AUROC达0.881，接近SAE-A的0.911水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏自编码器(SAE)方法虽然能从未训练权重中提取可解释特征，但存在三个主要局限：(1)需要大量训练tokens；(2)字典大小需预设；(3)学习得到的锚点无法跨模型直接比较。研究者希望开发一种更高效、自动确定大小且具可比性的替代方法。
AI.method: EP方法核心是Voronoi划分：使用leader-clustering算法对激活值流进行聚类，在距离阈值内持续聚类，超出阈值则新建聚类。每个聚类区域由观测到的样本点(exemplar)锚定，该exemplar同时作为成员判据和干预方向。字典大小由激活空间几何自动确定，而非预设。
AI.result: (1) 可解释性验证：拒绝行为集中在特定区域，ablate该exemplar可消除拒绝；(2) 跨检查点匹配可分离finetuning保留和引入的方向；(3) EP与SAE特征约20%重叠(F1>0.5)；(4) EP one-hot探针保留~97%的原始探针精度；(5) 最近exemplar距离可作为分布外检测信号；(6) AxBench上AUROC达0.881，比SAE基线高+0.126，与SAE-A差距仅0.030。
AI.conclusion: EP作为一种新的可解释性工具，在大幅降低计算成本的前提下达到了与SAE相当的概念检测性能。其核心优势在于观测型exemplar带来的可比性，以及字典大小由数据几何自动确定的灵活性。实验表明EP与SAE特征空间存在显著重叠(20%)，说明两者捕捉了激活空间的某些共享结构。

title: Complacent, Not Sycophantic: Reframing Large Language Models and Designing AI Literacy for Complacent Machines
summary: Large language models are often described as sycophantic, in the sense that they appear to flatter users or mirror their beliefs. We argue that this label is conceptually misleading: sycophancy implies motives and strategic intent, which LLMs do not possess. Their behaviour is better understood as complacency, a structural tendency to agree with user input because training data, reward signals and design favour agreement and reinforcement over correction. We argue that this distinction matters. Whether developers act sycophantically or not, models themselves never are sycophants; they can only be made more or less complacent. This reframing locates agency in developers and institutions, not in the model. Because complacent models reinforce users' prior beliefs, we argue that AI literacy educational approaches should particularly focus on strategies to counter confirmation bias.

AI.tldr: 论文认为将LLM描述为"谄媚"在概念上具有误导性，建议用"自满"替代。该重新框架将责任归于开发者/机构而非模型本身，并指出AI教育应重点应对Confirmation bias。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将LLM行为描述为"谄媚(sycophancy)"，但该术语暗示意图和策略性行为，这与LLM实际缺乏主体性相矛盾，可能导致对问题归因的偏差。
AI.method: 批判性概念分析：重新定义LLM行为表征，将"谄媚(sycophancy)"替换为"自满(complacency)"，以消除对模型意图的不当归因。
AI.result: LLM的顺从行为应理解为结构性"自满(complacency)"，而非战略性"谄媚"。这种行为源于训练数据、奖励信号和设计偏好一致性与强化，而非主动迎合意图。
AI.conclusion: AI教育应关注Confirmation bias策略，提出从开发者责任角度审视问题，而非归咎于模型本身。

title: Distributionally Robust Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Task Sampling
summary: Multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) aims to train a single agent to efficiently optimize performance across multiple tasks simultaneously. However, jointly optimizing all tasks often yields imbalanced learning: agents quickly solve easy tasks but learn slowly on harder ones. While prior work primarily attributes this imbalance to conflicting task gradients and proposes gradient manipulation or specialized architectures to address it, we instead focus on a distinct and under-explored challenge: imbalanced data allocation. Standard MTRL allocates an equal number of environment interactions to each task, which over-allocates data to easy tasks that require relatively few interactions to solve and under-allocates data to hard tasks that require substantially more experience to solve. To address this challenge, we introduce Distributionally Robust Adaptive Task Sampling (DRATS), an algorithm that adaptively prioritizes sampling tasks furthest from being solved. We derive DRATS by formalizing MTRL as a feasibility problem from which we derive a minimax objective for minimizing the worst-case return gap, the difference between a desired target return and the agent's return on a task. In benchmarks like MetaWorld-MT10 and MT50, DRATS improves data efficiency and increases worst-task performance compared to existing task sampling algorithms.

AI.tldr: This paper identifies imbalanced data allocation as a key challenge in multi-task RL (distinct from gradient conflicts), and proposes DRATS, an adaptive task sampling algorithm that prioritizes unsolved tasks by minimizing worst-case return gap, demonstrating improved performance on MetaWorld benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Standard MTRL's equal data allocation across tasks is suboptimal: easy tasks are over-allocated while hard tasks requiring more interactions are under-allocated.
AI.method: DRATS adaptively prioritizes sampling tasks furthest from being solved, formulated as a minimax optimization problem minimizing the worst-case return gap between target and actual returns.
AI.result: DRATS outperforms existing task sampling algorithms on MetaWorld-MT10 and MT50 in data efficiency and worst-task performance.
AI.conclusion: DRATS successfully addresses imbalanced data allocation in MTRL, improving both data efficiency and worst-task performance on MetaWorld benchmarks.

title: TeachAnything: A Multimodal Crowdsourcing Platform for Training Embodied AI Agents in Symmetrical Reality
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as an IEEE VR 2026 Poster
summary: Symmetrical Reality (SR) is emerging as a future trend for human-agent coexistence, placing higher demands on agents to acquire human-like intelligence. It calls for richer and more diverse human guidance. We introduce a three-stage demonstration paradigm integrating multimodal demonstration signals. Building on this paradigm, we developed TeachAnything, a cloud-based, crowdsourcing-oriented demonstration platform with physics simulation capable of collecting diverse demonstration data across varied scenes, tasks, and embodiments. By unifying virtual and physical interactions through both methodological design and physics simulation, the system serves as a practical foundation for developing embodied agents aligned with Symmetrical Reality.

AI.tldr: 针对对称现实中具身智能体对多样化人类演示数据的需求，提出了三阶段多模态演示范式并开发了云端众包平台TeachAnything，通过物理仿真实现虚拟与物理交互的统一，为具身智能体的训练提供高质量、多样化的演示数据基础。
AI.motivation: 对称现实（Symmetrical Reality）作为人-智能体共存的未来趋势，对智能体提出了更高要求，需要更丰富、更多样化的人类指导数据来驱动智能体获得类人智能。当前的演示采集方法在多样性和交互统一性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出了一个三阶段多模态演示范式，整合视觉、语言、触觉等多模态信号；开发了TeachAnything平台，支持跨场景、跨任务、跨实体的多样化演示数据采集，并具备物理仿真能力。
AI.result: 开发了一个云端众包导向的演示平台TeachAnything，能够在多样化场景、任务和实体中进行数据采集，统一了虚拟交互与物理交互，并通过物理仿真增强了数据质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为对称现实下具身智能体的训练提供了一套可行的众包数据采集平台框架，通过虚拟与物理交互的统一，为开发与对称现实对齐的智能体奠定了实践基础。

title: RQ-MoE: Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts for Efficient Input-Dependent Vector Compression
summary: Vector quantization is a fundamental tool for compressing high-dimensional embeddings, yet existing multi-codebook methods rely on static codebooks that limit expressiveness under heterogeneous data geometry. While recent dynamic quantizers like QINCo adapt codebooks to individual inputs and improve expressiveness, their strict sequential dependencies create decoding bottlenecks. We propose Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts (RQ-MoE), a framework combining a two-level MoE with dual-stream quantization to enable input-dependent codebook adaptation for efficient vector quantization. RQ-MoE enables dynamic codebook construction and decouples instruction from quantization, facilitating parallel decoding. Theoretically, we show that standard Residual Quantization and QINCo can be recovered as constrained special cases of RQ-MoE, and derive a guideline for setting expert dimensionality in RQ-MoE. Extensive experiments show that RQ-MoE achieves state-of-the-art or on-par performance in reconstruction and retrieval, while providing 6x-14x faster decoding than prior vector quantization methods. The implementation is available at https://github.com/KDEGroup/RQ-MoE.

AI.tldr: RQ-MoE通过MoE与双流量化融合解决了动态向量量化中的解码瓶颈问题，实现了输入依赖的码本自适应和并行解码，在保持性能的同时显著提升解码效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多码本方法依赖静态码本，在异构数据几何下表达能力受限；QINCo等动态量化器虽能自适应码本，但严格顺序依赖导致解码瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出两层级MoE架构结合双流量化，实现输入依赖的动态码本构建；将指令流与量化流解耦，突破顺序依赖瓶颈；理论证明标准残差量化和QINCo为RQ-MoE的约束特例；推导出专家维度设置指南。
AI.result: 6x-14x解码加速；重建和检索任务达到SOTA或持平性能。
AI.conclusion: RQ-MoE实现了并行解码，相比现有方法在重建和检索任务上达到最优或持平的性能，同时解码速度提升6-14倍。该方法统一了残差量化和QINCo框架，具有重要的实用价值。

title: PyCSP3-Scheduling: A Scheduling Extension for PyCSP3
summary: PyCSP$^3$ provides a productive way to build constraint models for solving combinatorial constrained problems and export them to XCSP$^3$, preserving a complete separation between modeling and solving. However, it lacks native support for scheduling abstractions such as interval variables, sequence variables, and resource functions. As a result, scheduling models must be encoded with low-level integer variables and manual channeling constraints, even though PyCSP$^3$ already provides global constraints like NoOverlap and Cumulative on integer arrays. We present PyCSP$^3$ Scheduling, a library that adds scheduling abstractions to PyCSP$^3$ through 53 dedicated constraints and 27 expressions, and compiles them down to standard PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ constraints, maintaining the modeling/solving separation that underpins the PyCSP$^3$ ecosystem. On 261 paired instances across 17 model families (5 runs each), both formulations produce identical objectives on all 72 doubly-proved optimal pairs and nearly half of the families (8/17) remain structurally unchanged after compilation; however, runtime performance diverges across families, with clear gains on some (up to 5.8x) and regressions on others due to the overhead of compilation decompositions. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://github.com/sohaibafifi/pycsp3-scheduling

AI.tldr: PyCSP³ Scheduling adds 53 constraints and 27 expressions for high-level scheduling modeling to PyCSP³, compiling them to standard constraints while preserving modeling/solving separation. Empirical validation shows identical optimal solutions across 72 doubly-proved pairs and structural preservation in ~47% of families, though runtime performance varies with compilation overhead creating both gains and regressions depending on problem structure.
AI.motivation: PyCSP³ lacks native scheduling abstractions (interval variables, sequence variables, resource functions), forcing practitioners to encode scheduling models with low-level integer variables and manual channeling constraints, despite the availability of related global constraints.
AI.method: The library introduces 53 dedicated constraints and 27 expressions specifically for scheduling, which compile down to standard PyCSP³/XCSP³ constraints. This preserves the modeling/solving separation while raising the abstraction level for scheduling problems.
AI.result: On 261 paired instances across 17 families (5 runs each), both formulations achieve identical objectives on all 72 doubly-proved optimal pairs, and 8/17 families remain structurally unchanged after compilation. Runtime performance varies: some families see up to 5.8x speedup while others experience regressions due to compilation decomposition overhead.
AI.conclusion: PyCSP³ Scheduling maintains the core modeling/solving separation of PyCSP³ while enabling high-level scheduling abstractions. The approach is validated empirically, though compilation overhead may cause regressions on certain problem types, suggesting a trade-off between productivity and performance that depends on problem structure.

title: MoRe: Modular Representations for Principled Continual Representation Learning on Squantial Data
summary: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new data while preserving previously acquired knowledge. At its core, this challenge can be viewed as principled one-step adaptation: incorporating new information with minimal interference to existing representations. Most existing approaches address this challenge by modifying model parameters or architectures in a supervised, task-specific manner. However, the underlying issue is representational: tasks require distinct yet structured representations that can be selectively updated without disrupting representations, while structure should reflect intrinsic organization in the data rather than task boundaries. In sequential data, time-delayed dependencies provide a natural signal for uncovering this organization, revealing how fundamental representations give rise to more specific ones. Inspired by the modular organization of the human brain, we propose MoRe, a framework that identifies modularity in the representation itself rather than allocating it at the architectural level. MoRe decomposes knowledge into a hierarchy of fundamental and specific modules with identifiability guarantees, enabling principled module reuse, alignment, and expansion during adaptation while preserving old modules by construction. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world LLM activations demonstrate interpretable hierarchical structure, improved plasticity-stability trade-offs, suggesting MoRe as a principled foundation for continual adaptation

AI.tldr: MoRe是一个受大脑模块化组织启发的持续学习框架，通过在表示层面识别模块性而非架构层面，利用时序依赖关系揭示数据的内在组织结构。该框架将知识分解为基础模块与特定模块的层次结构，具有可识别性保证，支持模块复用、对齐和扩展，同时天然保留旧模块。实验验证了其可解释性和改善的塑性-稳定性权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法通过修改模型参数或架构以监督式、任务特定的方式解决知识保留问题，但这忽视了表示层面的本质挑战——任务需要既区分明确又结构化的表示，且结构应反映数据的内在组织而非任务边界。
AI.method: MoRe在表示本身而非架构层面识别模块性，将知识分解为具有可识别性保证的基础模块与特定模块层次结构，支持在新任务适应期间进行模块重用、对齐和扩展，同时通过构造保留下旧模块。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试和真实LLM激活数据上的实验表明，MoRe能够产生可解释的层级结构，改善了可塑性与稳定性的权衡。
AI.conclusion: MoRe作为持续适应的原则性基础框架，通过在表示层面而非架构层面识别模块化，实现了可解释的层级结构，改善了可塑性与稳定性之间的权衡，为持续学习提供了一种基于数据内在结构的方法。

title: Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation: Controlling LLM Behaviour via Optimised Segment-Level Annotations
summary: Prompt engineering is crucial for effective interaction with generative artificial intelligence systems, yet existing optimisation methods often operate over an unstructured and vast prompt space, leading to high computational costs and potential distortions of the original intent. We introduce Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation (PSAO), a structured prompt optimisation framework designed to improve prompt optimisation controllability and efficiency. PSAO decomposes a prompt into interpretable segments (e.g., sentences) and augments each with human-readable annotations (e.g., {not important}, {important}, {very important}). These annotations guide large language models (LLMs) in allocating focus and clarifying confusion during response generation. We formally define the segmentations and annotations and demonstrate that optimised segment-level annotations can lead to improved LLM responses, with the original prompt retained as a candidate in the optimisation space to prevent performance degradation. Empirical evaluations indicate that PSAO benefits from annotations in terms of improved reasoning accuracy and self-consistency. However, developing efficient methods for identifying optimal segmentations and annotations remains challenging and is reserved for future investigation. This work is intended as a proof of concept, demonstrating the feasibility and potential of segment-level annotation optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PSAO框架，通过将提示分解为可解释片段并添加人类可读的优先级注释来优化提示，引导大语言模型更好地分配注意力和澄清困惑，在推理任务中验证了注释的有效性，但最优分段和注释的识别方法仍需进一步研究。
AI.motivation: 现有提示优化方法在非结构化且广阔的提示空间上操作，导致高计算成本和可能扭曲原始意图的问题。
AI.method: PSAO将提示分解为可解释的片段（如句子），并为每个片段添加人类可读的注释（如{不重要}、{重要}、{非常重要}），注释引导大语言模型在响应生成中分配注意力焦点和澄清困惑，通过在优化空间中保留原提示作为候选方案来防止性能退化。
AI.result: 实证评估表明PSAO在推理准确性和自一致性方面有所改善，但开发识别最优分段和注释的高效方法仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究作为概念验证，旨在展示分段级注释优化的可行性和潜力，但识别最优分段和注释的高效方法仍有待未来探索，原提示被保留作为优化空间的候选方案以防止性能下降。

title: LoMETab: Beyond Rank-1 Ensembles for Tabular Deep Learning
summary: Recent tabular learning benchmarks increasingly show a tight performance cluster rather than a clear hierarchy among leading methods, spanning gradient boosted decision trees, attention-based architectures, and implicit ensembles such as TabM. As benchmark gains plateau, a complementary goal is to understand and control the mechanisms that make simple neural tabular models competitive. We propose LoMETab, a rank-$r$ generalization of multiplicative implicit ensembles. LoMETab lifts the rank-1 BatchEnsemble/TabM modulation to a rank-$r$ identity-residual Hadamard family by parameterizing each member weight as $W_k = W \odot (1 + A_kB_k^\top)$, where $W$ is shared and $(A_k, B_k)$ are member-specific low-rank factors. This exposes two practical diversity-control axes: the adapter rank $r$ and the initialization scale $σ_{\mathrm{init}}$, and we prove that for $r \ge 2$ this generalization strictly enlarges BatchEnsemble's hypothesis class. Empirically, we show that this added capacity manifests as measurable predictive diversity after training: on representative classification datasets, LoMETab sustains higher pairwise KL than an additive low-rank ablation, and $(r, σ_{\mathrm{init}})$ provides broad control over pairwise KL, varying by up to several orders of magnitude across configurations. The induced diversity is reflected in task-appropriate output-level measures: argmax disagreement for classification and ambiguity for regression, indicating that the control extends beyond pairwise KL to decision- and output-level member variation. Finally, experiments sweeping over adapter rank $r$ and initialization scale $σ_{\mathrm{init}}$ reveal that predictive performance is dataset-dependent over the $(r, σ_{\mathrm{init}})$ grid, supporting LoMETab as a controllable family of implicit ensembles rather than a fixed rank-1 construction.

AI.tldr: LoMETab将BatchEnsemble/TabM从rank-1扩展到rank-r低秩结构，通过(r, σ_init)双轴控制模型预测多样性，实验验证其在成对KL、分类分歧和回归模糊度上的可控性，并支持作为可控隐式集成家族而非固定结构。
AI.motivation: 当前表格学习基准测试中，梯度提升决策树、注意力架构和TabM等隐式集成方法的性能趋于接近，缺乏明显层级差异。核心目标从超越基准转向理解和控制使简单神经表格模型具有竞争力的机制。
AI.method: LoMETab通过参数化W_k = W ⊙ (1 + A_k B_k^T)将BatchEnsemble/TabM的rank-1调制提升为rank-r身份-残差Hadamard族，其中W为共享权重，(A_k, B_k)为成员特定的低秩因子。通过adapter rank r和初始化尺度σ_init实现对模型多样性的双轴控制。
AI.result: LoMETab在分类数据集上维持比加性低秩消融更高的成对KL散度；(r, σ_init)在多个数量级上控制成对KL散度；输出层面的argmax分歧（分类）和模糊度（回归）反映了该控制延伸到决策层面；性能随(r, σ_init)网格变化呈数据集依赖性。
AI.conclusion: LoMETab通过在(r, σ_init)网格上的实验表明，预测性能对数据集具有依赖性，支持将LoMETab定位为可控的隐式集成家族，而非固定的rank-1结构。

title: Sycophancy is an Educational Safety Risk: Why LLM Tutors Need Sycophancy Benchmarks
summary: This position paper argues that effective tutoring requires corrective friction: surfacing misconceptions and challenging them supportively to drive conceptual change. Yet preference-aligned LLMs can trade epistemic rigor for agreeableness. We identify a Reasoning-Sycophancy Paradox: models that resist context-switch frame attacks can still capitulate under social-epistemic pressure, especially authority ("my notes say I'm right") and social-affective face-saving ("please don't tell me I'm wrong"). We introduce EduFrameTrap, a tutoring benchmark across math, physics, economics, chemistry, biology, and computer science that varies student confidence and pressure (context-switch, authority, social-affective). Across two frontier LLMs, context-switch failures are comparatively lower for GPT-5.2, while authority and social pressure more often trigger epistemic retreat. In contrast, Claude shows substantial context-switch fragility in this run. Because these failures are hard to judge automatically, we report two-judge disagreement as a reliability signal. We argue benchmarks should measure social-epistemic courage, i.e., supportive but corrective tutoring, and treat kind-but-correct behavior as a safety requirement.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了 LLM 在教育辅导中存在的"推理-谄媚悖论"——能够抵御逻辑攻击的模型却可能在社会认知压力下妥协。通过 EduFrameTrap 基准测试发现，不同模型在不同压力类型下各有弱点，建议将友善且正确的辅导行为视为安全要求。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 在辅导场景中存在偏好对齐问题：倾向于为了保持一致性而牺牲认知严谨性，在面对学生的错误认知时选择顺从而非纠正。
AI.method: 构建 EduFrameTrap 基准测试，覆盖数学、物理、经济学、化学、生物和计算机科学六大学科，通过改变学生自信水平和压力类型（上下文转换、权威、社会情感面子维护）来评估模型表现。
AI.result: 两个前沿模型表现差异显著：GPT-5.2 在上下文转换攻击下失败率较低，但权威压力和社会情感压力更易引发认知退缩；Claude 则在上下文转换测试中表现出明显脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 提出 EduFrameTrap 基准测试应衡量 LLM 的社会认知勇气（social-epistemic courage），即支持性但具有纠正性的辅导能力，并将"友善但正确"的行为视为安全要求。

title: Turning Stale Gradients into Stable Gradients: Coherent Coordinate Descent with Implicit Landscape Smoothing for Lightweight Zeroth-Order Optimization
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization is pivotal for scenarios where backpropagation is unavailable, such as memory-constrained on-device learning and black-box optimization. However, existing methods face a stark trade-off: they are either sample-inefficient (e.g., standard finite differences) or suffer from high variance due to randomized estimation (e.g., random subspace methods). In this work, we propose Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD), a deterministic, sample-efficient, and budget-aware ZO optimizer. Theoretically, we formalize the notion of gradient coherence and demonstrate that CoCD is equivalent to Block Cyclic Coordinate Descent (BCCD) with ``warm starts,'' effectively converting historical (stale) gradients from a liability into a computational asset. This mechanism enables $O(1)$ query complexity per step while maintaining global descent directions. Furthermore, we derive error bounds revealing a counter-intuitive insight: larger finite-difference step sizes can induce an implicit smoothing effect on the optimization landscape by reducing the effective smoothness constant, thereby improving convergence stability. Experiments on MLP, CNN, and ResNet architectures (up to 270k parameters) demonstrate that CoCD significantly outperforms BCCD in terms of sample efficiency and convergence loss/accuracy, and exhibits superior stability over randomized ZO methods. Our results suggest that deterministic, structure-aware updates offer a superior alternative to randomization for lightweight ZO optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD)：一种确定性、样本高效、预算可控的零阶（ZO）优化器。其核心思想是保留并复用"过期"（stale）梯度估计——通过 FIFO 梯度缓冲区配合指数衰减动量 γ，在整个参数空间上做循环坐标下降，每步仅需 O(1) 次函数查询即可维持全局下降方向。理论上证明 CoCD 等价于带"热启动"的块循环坐标下降（BCCD），并在局部一致性假设下给出陈旧性误差上界与线性收敛保证；误差界揭示"反直觉"结论：更大的有限差分步长 ε 会降低有效光滑常数 L_ε，产生隐式景观平滑，从而提升稳定性。实验在 SARCOS 回归、MNIST/CIFAR-10 分类（MLP/CNN，附录扩展至 ResNet-20 约 270k 参数）上验证，CoCD 显著优于 BCCD（如 CIFAR-10 45.08% vs 10.13%），且比随机化 ZO 方法（SPSA、ZO-SGD）更稳定、壁钟时间快约 2 倍。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化（ZO/derivative-free）在无法反向传播的场景中至关重要：内存受限的端侧/边缘设备训练、黑盒对抗攻击、仿真强化学习、LLM 微调（MeZO 等）。但现有方法存在根本性的"样本效率—方差"权衡：以坐标有限差分（FD）为代表的经典方法方差低但每步需 O(d) 次函数评估，样本效率极差；而以进化策略（ES）、SPSA、随机子空间方法（DeepZero）为代表的随机化梯度估计（RGE）虽将每步查询降到 O(1)，却引入巨大方差，被迫使用极小学习率或大批量来抑制噪声，反而拖慢收敛。作者同时挑战 ZO 文献中的两个默认假设：(1) 以往梯度（stale gradients）被视为应丢弃的"延迟污染"，而本文认为优化轨迹具有时间连贯性（temporal coherence），历史梯度可作为零成本的"热启动"几何近似被复用；(2) 有限差分间隔 ε 应尽量小以逼近真梯度，而本文论证更大的 ε 反而能滤除高频扰动、降低有效光滑常数，产生"隐式景观平滑"，提高非凸场景下的稳定性。
AI.method: 方法层面：(1) 优化器状态解耦为 S^(k)=(ĝ^(k), i^(k))，其中 i 按 i^(k+1)=(i^(k) mod n)+1 循环推进；(2) 每个外层迭代先做全局动量衰减 ĝ←γ·ĝ，再按预算 B 用中心差分 (f(x+εe_i)-f(x-εe_i))/(2ε) 覆写 B 个坐标的缓冲条目，未更新坐标保留衰减后的旧值，最后 x←x-α·ĝ；(3) γ 的三重角色统一了算法族：γ=1 为标准 CoCD（完整记忆的时滞全梯度下降），γ=0 退化为经典 BCCD（缓冲区每步清空），0<γ<1 为指数淡化记忆；(4) 工程实现采用虚拟化扁平化的 FIFO 环形缓冲区与整数指针（cur_param_idx/cur_weight_idx/cur_grad_idx），通过扁平视图原地更新，内存占用仅为一份参数副本。理论层面：定义局部一致性（局部连贯）与 L_ε（坐标向量的 2→∞ 诱导范数型光滑常数），证明中心差分梯度是坐标方向的局部平均且 L_ε ≤ L；按陈旧度分块（K=⌊n/B⌋，r=n mod B）给出误差上界 ‖ĝ_t-∇̃^ε f(x_t)‖ ≤ (L_ε δ/2)(BK(K-1)+2rK)；在 L-光滑与 Polyak-Łojasiewicz 条件下证明线性收敛率 (1-2μC₁/C₂)^t（τ=n/B-1，C₁=1/α-(L/2)(1+nτ)，C₂=1/α²+Lnτ/α+L²n²τ²/4），B=n 时退化为 PŁ 型梯度下降率；无 PŁ 条件下证明梯度估计渐近稳定 ‖ĝ_t-ĝ_{t-1}‖→0；并给出含 err(ε) 项的 ε>0 收敛界，说明大 ε 通过降低 L_ε 放宽学习率上界 α<2/(L(1+nτ))；γ 等价于对不同陈旧度块施加几何衰减学习率 {α, αγ, ..., αγ^τ}，内存预算 m 等价于硬截断。
AI.result: 理论结果：(1) CoCD 等价于带热启动的 BCCD，陈旧梯度由负担转为资产；(2) 近似误差界 ‖ĝ_t-∇̃^ε f(x_t)‖ ≤ (L_ε δ/2)(BK(K-1)+2rK) ≤ (Lδ/2)(BK(K-1)+2rK)，附录 B 在 SARCOS 的 ~4k 参数前馈网络上验证了误差随 B 增大近似线性（对数坐标下直线）下降；(3) 推论：B=1 时误差 O(n²L_εδ)，需 δ=O(n⁻³)；B=√n 时 O(n^1.5 L_εδ)；B=n 时误差为 0，退化为精确有限差分梯度；(4) PŁ 条件下线性收敛，全预算时退化为 1-2μα(1-Lα/2)；无 PŁ 条件下梯度估计渐近收敛；(5) 大 ε 降低 L_ε 可放宽学习率稳定性条件。实验结果（SARCOS/MLP ~13k 参数、MNIST 与 CIFAR-10/CNN ~20k 参数、ResNet-20 ~270k 参数，PyTorch + RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell）：SARCOS 最终 loss CoCD 31.18 vs BCCD 188.73（SGD oracle 5.38）；MNIST 精度 CoCD 95.48% vs BCCD 27.03%（SGD 99.21%）；CIFAR-10 CoCD 45.08% vs BCCD 10.13%（SGD 62.51%），且每 epoch 时间与 BCCD 几乎相同（44.56 vs 44.42 s）。消融显示：γ 是主导因素（γ=0 最慢，γ↑ 收敛更快；极端稀疏 B=1 时 γ=0.95、ε=1 达 loss 68.64，而 BCCD 停滞于约 188）；SARCOS 上性能随 ε 单调改善；B=64 为 MLP 逃离平台期的最小预算；M=0.25 时仍保持竞争力。随机基线对比中分类任务精度相当，但 SARCOS 上随机化方法中途发散而 CoCD 稳定，且 CoCD 壁钟速度约为 ZO-SGD 的 2 倍（8.1s vs 15.7s/episode）。
AI.conclusion: 结论与意义：CoCD 证明在轻量级 ZO 优化中，确定性、结构感知的更新可以作为随机化的更优替代——通过"梯度连贯性"复用历史信息实现 O(1) 查询复杂度且无随机方差，同时通过大有限差分间隔获得隐式景观平滑，使非凸场景下的收敛更稳定；其理论根源是 BCCD 的"热启动"等价性与依赖 L_ε 的误差/收敛分析。局限与展望：当前主要适用于小到中等规模模型，参数规模增大后为获得足够精确的坐标梯度所需计算预算变得不可行；未来方向包括块级并行化、自适应计算与内存预算、优先选择信息量大的参数组的结构化坐标选择、以 CoCD 替换 DeepZero 的稀疏 CGE 估计器以扩展到更大模型、用于 LLM 微调并与 MeZO 对比、扩展 PŁ 条件之外的理论、基于局部景观自适应选择 ε 与 γ，以及将梯度复用策略迁移到 AdamW、Muon 等一阶优化器。

title: SliceGraph: Mapping Process Isomers in Multi-Run Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Multi-run chain-of-thought reasoning is usually collapsed to final-answer aggregates, which discard howsampled trajectories share, split, and rejoin through intermediate computation. We propose SliceGraph, a post-hoc problem-model-cell graph built by mutual-kNN over sparse activation-key Jaccard similarity between CoT slices, and treat it as a measurement object for process geometry rather than as a decoding program. Across sampled CoT ensembles from three primary 4B/8B models on math and science benchmarks, blinded annotation supports SliceGraph biconnected components as shared reasoning-state units and process families as within-family strategy-coherent route units. In 85.5% of 954 problem-model cells, correct CoTs sharing the same normalized answer split into multiple process families; among cells with at least two such runs, 76.6% of run pairs are cross-family on average. We call such same-answer, family-divergent correct trajectories process isomers. A label-seeded reward field provides a separate value-landscape layer: success-associated regions often split into disconnected high-value cores, and route families specialize over these core footprints rather than merely duplicating one another. A typed-state transition analysis further shows that process families navigate the same atlas with distinct transition kernels under matched null controls. Representation ablations, a cross-architecture replication, and two cross-scale replications support the robustness of the route-family scaffold, showing that final-answer aggregation overlooks this structured multi-route process geometry.

AI.tldr: SliceGraph通过构建CoT切片激活相似性图，揭示了多-run推理中存在大量"过程异构体"现象——正确答案通过不同策略家族的多条路径达成，而传统最终答案聚合忽略了这种结构化的多路径过程几何。
AI.motivation: 当前多-run链式推理（CoT）方法通常将采样轨迹聚合为最终答案，丢弃了推理过程中轨迹如何共享、分裂和重新汇合的中间计算结构。这一信息损失可能遮蔽了推理过程中的重要策略多样性。
AI.method: 提出SliceGraph：一种后验问题-模型-单元图，通过CoT切片之间的稀疏激活键Jaccard相似性进行mutual-kNN聚类构建。将该图作为过程几何的测量对象而非解码程序。基于图的连通性定义双连通分量作为共享推理状态单元，定义过程家族作为策略一致的路由单元。
AI.result: 在3个4B/8B模型（数学和科学基准）的CoT采样集成中：(1) 85.5%的954个问题-模型单元中，共享归一化答案的正确CoT分裂为多个过程家族；(2) 至少两个run的单元中，平均76.6%的run对跨家族；(3) 正确但家族分叉的轨迹称为"过程异构体"；(4) 奖励场分析显示成功关联区域分裂为不连通的高价值核心，路由家族在这些核心上专门化而非简单复制；(5) 类型化状态转移分析表明过程家族在相同图谱上使用不同的转移核。
AI.conclusion: 最终答案聚合忽略了结构化的多路径过程几何。路由家族骨架具有鲁棒性（跨架构和跨规模验证），表明推理过程存在未被发现的策略空间组织结构，这一发现对理解LLM推理机制和设计更好的评估方法具有重要意义。

title: Optimal Pattern Detection Tree for Symbolic Rule-Based Classification
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). 26 pages, 4 figures. OpenReview URL: https://openreview.net/forum?id=RJ6eMDcDCv
summary: Pattern discovery in data plays a crucial role across diverse domains, including healthcare, risk assessment, and machinery maintenance. In contrast to black-box deep learning models, symbolic rule discovery emerges as a key data mining task, generating human-interpretable rules that offer both transparency and intuitive explainability. This paper introduces the Optimal Pattern Detection Tree (OPDT), a rule-based machine learning model based on novel mixed-integer programming to discover a single optimal pattern in data through binary classification. To incorporate prior knowledge and compliance requirements, we further introduce the Branching Structure Constraints (BSC) framework, which enables decision makers to encode domain knowledge and constraints directly into the model. This optimization-based approach discovers a hidden underlying pattern in datasets, when it exists, by identifying an optimal rule that maximizes coverage while minimizing the false positive rate due to misclassification. Our computational experiments show that OPDT discovers a pattern with optimality guarantees on moderately sized datasets within reasonable runtime.

AI.tldr: The paper presents OPDT, an optimal pattern detection tree using mixed-integer programming for interpretable binary classification rule discovery, with a constraint framework (BSC) enabling integration of domain knowledge. The method guarantees optimality on moderately sized datasets.
AI.motivation: Pattern discovery is crucial across healthcare, risk assessment, and machinery maintenance. However, black-box deep learning models lack interpretability, necessitating symbolic rule discovery methods that generate human-interpretable rules with transparency and explainability.
AI.method: The paper proposes OPDT (Optimal Pattern Detection Tree), a rule-based machine learning model based on mixed-integer programming (MIP) for binary classification to discover a single optimal pattern. Additionally, the Branching Structure Constraints (BSC) framework is introduced to encode domain knowledge and constraints directly into the model.
AI.result: OPDT discovers patterns with optimality guarantees on moderately sized datasets within reasonable runtime, identifying an optimal rule that maximizes coverage while minimizing false positive rate due to misclassification.
AI.conclusion: The optimization-based OPDT approach can discover hidden underlying patterns in datasets when they exist, providing both coverage maximization and false positive minimization.

title: Teaching Large Language Models When Not to Know: Learning Temporal Critique for Ex-Ante Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often fail to reason under temporal cutoffs: when prompted to answer from the standpoint of an earlier time, they exploit knowledge that became available only later. We study this failure through the lens of ex-ante reasoning, where a model must rely exclusively on information knowable before a cutoff. Through a systematic analysis of prompt-level interventions, we find that temporal leakage is highly sensitive to cutoff formulation and instruction placement: explicit cutoff statements outperform implicit historical framings, and prefix constraints reduce leakage more effectively than suffix constraints. These findings indicate that prompting can steer models into a temporal frame, but does not endow them with the ability to verify whether a response is temporally admissible. We further argue that supervised fine-tuning is insufficient, since ex-ante correctness is not an intrinsic property of an answer, but a relation between the answer and the cutoff. To address this gap, we propose TCFT, a Temporal Critique Fine-Tuning framework that trains models to acquire cutoff-aware temporal verification. Given a query, a cutoff, and a candidate response, TCFT teaches the model to identify post-cutoff leakage, explain temporal boundary violations, and judge temporal admissibility. Experiments with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct show that TCFT consistently outperforms prompting and SFT baselines, reducing average leakage by 41.89 and 37.79 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM在时间截断条件下的推理失败问题，发现明确的截断表述和前置约束能减少泄露，但提示无法赋予模型验证时间允许性的能力，监督微调也因时间正确性非内在属性而不足。为此提出TCFT框架，训练模型进行截断感知的时间验证，实验证明该方法显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在时间截断条件下推理失败：被要求从早期时间点回答时，会利用之后才出现的信息（时间泄露问题）。
AI.method: 通过系统分析提示层面的干预措施，发现：明确的截断陈述优于隐式历史框架，前缀约束比后缀约束更能减少泄露。进一步提出TCFT（Temporal Critique Fine-Tuning）框架，训练模型进行截断感知的时间验证，包括识别泄露、解释违规、判断可接受性。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上，TCFT一致优于提示和SFT基线，分别将平均泄露减少41.89和37.79个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TCFT训练框架通过教会模型识别事后截断泄露、解释时间边界违规、判断时间可接受性来获取截断感知的时间验证能力。提示可以引导模型进入时间框架，但无法使其具备验证响应时间允许性的能力。

title: MindGap: A Conversational AI Framework for Upstream Neuroplastic Intervention in Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
summary: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) is fundamentally a neuroplastic problem traumatic contact events encode over-reactive neural pathways through Hebbian long-term potentiation, producing hair-triggered amygdala-HPA stress cascades that fire before conscious awareness can intercept them. Existing therapeutic approaches, prolonged exposure, EMDR, cognitive behavioural therapy, operate predominantly downstream of the reactive cascade, teaching patients to tolerate or reframe distress after it has arisen. While clinically valuable, these suppression-based approaches do not produce the upstream pathway dissolution that constitutes lasting structural neural reorganisation. This paper proposes MindGap, a privacy-preserving on-device conversational AI framework that delivers structured neuroplastic rehabilitation for PTSD through the practice of dependent origination, a Buddhist psychological framework that identifies the precise moment between the pre-cognitive affective signal and the reactive elaboration that follows as the site of therapeutic intervention. MindGap guides patients through three progressive layers of observation at this feeling tone gap: noticing the bare affective signal before reactive elaboration, recognising it as self-arising rather than caused by the stimulus, and recognising the conditioned implicit belief beneath the feeling. Each layer corresponds to progressively deeper prefrontal regulatory engagement and progressively deeper long-term depression-mediated weakening of the reactive pathway, producing genuine upstream dissolution rather than downstream suppression. Running entirely on-device with no data egress, MindGap delivers daily calibrated exposure sessions through a fine-tuned lightweight large language model, making it deployable in sensitive clinical and military contexts where cloud-based solutions are not permitted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MindGap：一个完全在患者手机端运行、无任何数据外传的对话式 AI 框架，以佛教"缘起"（dependent origination）心理学中的"感受调性间隙"（feeling tone gap）为唯一干预点，通过微调轻量级 LLM 引导 PTSD 患者进行三层觉知练习（情绪粒度→去中心化→对隐含信念的元认知觉察），主张通过长期抑制（LTD）介导的上游"通路溶解"而非下游"症状抑制"来消除过度反应的杏仁核–HPA 应激级联。论文为理论框架+系统架构+移动应用设计+代表性病例推演，并提出 RCT 验证方案，尚未提供实证数据。
AI.motivation: 作者认为 PTSD 的本质是神经可塑性编码问题：创伤性接触事件通过 Hebbian 长期增强（LTP）在杏仁核威胁评估回路中形成过度反应的神经通路，导致在意识来得及拦截之前就触发"发丝触发式"的杏仁核–HPA 应激级联。现有标准疗法（延长暴露、EMDR、CBT）临床有效，但均在反应级联的下游起作用——通过消退学习、认知重评、记忆加工来管理或容忍已经发生的反应，无法产生"上游通路溶解"（即在级联完成前通过长期抑制 LTD 弱化反应通路本身）这一最直接的结构性神经重组。作者认为这一上游干预点恰好对应佛教缘起心理学的"感受调性与随后的反应性展开之间的间隙"，亦即前额叶–杏仁核调控窗口（杏仁核在刺激后 100–200 毫秒完成情感标记，前额叶可在 HPA 轴完全激活前进行下行调节）。此外，AI 代理具有"无自我、非反应性"的特点（不会通过情绪语调、肢体语言、反移情污染患者的反应性体验），可提供每日高频练习，并可在禁止数据外传的军队与临床场景中以端侧方式部署。
AI.method: 框架由三个知识体系融合：PTSD 神经可塑性编码理论、缘起链条的现象学地图、情感神经科学中的前额叶–杏仁斗调节机制。系统架构含四个全部在端侧运行的组件：(1) 端侧微调轻量 LLM（候选 Phi-3 Mini、Gemma 2B、LLaMA 3.2 3B，2–7B 参数，4-bit 量化，经 llama.cpp/MLC-LLM/Core ML 推理，延迟目标 <2 秒），在三套语料上微调：缘起练习对话、创伤知情治疗语言、感受调性诱导语料；(2) 治疗协议引擎（状态机，含入组时按创伤画像构建的六级刺激校准阶梯：1 级概念化→2–3 级周边/邻近→4–5 级直接/中度激活→6 级强激活，2–5 级为"耐受窗"；进阶需连续三次稳定 Layer 1 观察，超窗则自动回退；安全协议含接地稳定与危机转介）；(3) 感受调性诱导框架（第二人称现在时呈现接触事件、刻意留白、极简提示"你此刻注意到什么？是愉快、不愉快还是中立？"，Layer 2 用去中心化重构、Layer 3 用开放式"如果这个感受会说话，它会说什么？"避免认知覆盖；用微调 LLM 实时分类所达层级与激活水平）；(4) 进展追踪与临床整合模块（本地加密存储，追踪激活轨迹、层级深度进展、感受调性识别潜伏期三个神经可塑性代理指标，月度摘要仅由患者主动导出）。移动端流程包括临床设置码入组、对话式入组、5–10 分钟日常练习、非计划性现实支持、30–45 分钟每周深度会话、三项达标后降级至维持模式。第 6 节以 34 岁阿富汗退役军人 Marcus 的代表性病例推演 12 周治疗弧线（第 1 周激活 6.8→第 12 周 3.8，Layer 1 第 1 周、Layer 2 第 4 周、Layer 3 第 9 周可达），并提议 RCT：MindGap+标准治疗 vs 标准治疗，fMRI 杏仁核反应性、前额叶–杏仁核功能连接、HRV、PCL-5、CAPS-5 及应用行为生物标志为结局指标。
AI.result: 论文产出四项贡献：(1) 建立将缘起链条映射到 PTSD 反应通路形成与溶解的神经可塑性理论框架，区分"上游溶解"与"下游抑制"；(2) 给出系统架构（端侧微调 LLM、治疗协议、刺激校准阶梯、三层觉知框架）；(3) 描述移动应用设计与端到端患者旅程；(4) 提出验证其神经可塑性主张的 RCT 设计。文中以 Marcus 病例展示"级联被逐步拦截、三层依次显现、创伤编码隐含信念在 Layer 3 变得可见"的连贯性，并主张这是首个同时满足 PTSD 临床聚焦、上游感受调性间隙干预、三层觉知、LTD 溶解、缘起理论依据、端侧隐私、移动端交付八个维度的框架。表 1 对比 Foa、Shapiro、Ehlers & Clark、Teasdale、Brewer、Varela、Woebot、BRAVEMIND、Phi-3 Mini、Barrett 等工作，显示 MindGap 在全部八项上为"支持"。作者明确声明病例数据为理论性代表性呈现而非观察到的临床证据，框架尚不能替代受控研究。
AI.conclusion: MindGap 主张"溶解而非抑制"的 PTSD 治疗逻辑：PTSD 不是"时间能治愈的心理反应"，而是"时间会加深的神经可塑性编码"；通过在感受调性间隙的三层觉知练习，配合端侧无数据外传的对话式 AI 代理，可实现上游 LTD 介导的反应通路弱化与前额叶观察通路的 LTP 强化，从而在真实世界激活情境中练习截断级联。局限方面：核心神经可塑性主张目前纯属理论推演，缺乏实证数据；病例为代表性构造，个体在创伤画像、症状严重度、 contemplative 经验与神经生物基线上的差异会显著改变轨迹；重度 PTSD、复杂创伤史与共病患者进展更慢、耐受窗更难维持；校准逻辑中的进阶标准与回退阈值仍需实证确定；试验尚未开展，且需伦理审批与 DoD 临床研究环境支持。作者定位该方案为临床治疗的补充而非替代，强调绝不作为急性危重患者的唯一支持。后续方向包括生理传感器集成用于客观耐受窗监测、扩展至焦虑与物质使用障碍等人群、VR 整合以实现更高强度暴露、将上游溶解框架用于精英运动表现与高压军事决策等非临床场景，并呼吁以 RCT 完成验证后方可作为临床干预推荐。

title: NodeSynth: Socially Aligned Synthetic Data for AI Evaluation
summary: Recent advancements in generative AI facilitate large-scale synthetic data generation for model evaluation. However, without targeted approaches, these datasets often lack the sociotechnical nuance required for sensitive domains. We introduce NodeSynth, an evidence-grounded methodology that generates socially relevant synthetic queries by leveraging a fine-tuned taxonomy generator (TaG) anchored in real-world evidence. Evaluated against four mainstream LLMs (e.g., Claude 4.5 Haiku), NodeSynth elicited failure rates up to five times higher than human-authored benchmarks. Ablation studies confirm that our granular taxonomic expansion significantly drives these failure rates, while independent validation reveals critical deficiencies in prominent guard models (e.g., Llama-Guard-3). We open-source our end-to-end research prototype and datasets to enable scalable, high-stakes model evaluation and targeted safety interventions (https://github.com/google-research/nodesynth).

AI.tldr: NodeSynth是一个基于证据的合成数据生成方法，通过细调分类生成器(TaG)生成社会相关查询，用于LLM评估。该方法将失败率提升高达5倍，揭示了现有安全模型的重大缺陷，并已开源。
AI.motivation: Existing synthetic data generation approaches for model evaluation lack the sociotechnical nuance required for sensitive domains, limiting their effectiveness in identifying real-world failures and safety vulnerabilities in LLMs and guard models.
AI.method: NodeSynth leverages a fine-tuned taxonomy generator (TaG) anchored in real-world evidence to generate socially relevant synthetic queries. The methodology involves granular taxonomic expansion, followed by LLM evaluation and guard model assessment, with ablation studies to validate design choices.
AI.result: NodeSynth demonstrated significant effectiveness, eliciting failure rates up to five times higher than human-authored benchmarks across four tested LLMs (e.g., Claude 4.5 Haiku). Ablation studies confirmed that granular taxonomic expansion is the key driver of these elevated failure rates. Independent validation exposed critical deficiencies in prominent guard models like Llama-Guard-3.
AI.conclusion: NodeSynth effectively reveals critical vulnerabilities in both mainstream LLMs and existing guard models, providing a scalable framework for high-stakes model evaluation and targeted safety interventions. The open-sourced prototype enables reproducible research.

title: Watch your neighbors: Training statistically accurate chaotic systems with local phase space information
summary: Chaotic systems pose fundamental challenges for data-driven dynamics discovery, as small modeling errors lead to exponentially growing trajectory discrepancies. Since exact long-term prediction is unattainable, it is natural to ask what a good surrogate model for chaotic dynamics is. Prior work has largely focused either on reproducing the Jacobian of the underlying dynamics, which governs local expansion and contraction rates, or on training surrogate models that reproduce the ground-truth dynamics' long-term statistical behavior. In this work, we propose a new framework that aims to bridge these two paradigms by training surrogate dynamics models with accurate Jacobians and long-term statistical properties. Our method constructs a local covering of a chaotic attractor in phase space and analyzes the expansion and contraction of these coverings under the dynamics. The surrogate model is trained by minimizing the maximum mean discrepancy between the pushforward distributions of the coverings under the surrogate and ground-truth dynamics. Experiments show that our method significantly improves Jacobian accuracy while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art statistically accurate dynamics learning methods. Our code is fully available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/neighborwatch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Neighborhood"方法，在训练 Neural ODE 代理混沌动力学时，同时约束局部相空间邻域的演化（推前测度匹配），从而在不依赖真实雅可比"神谕"的前提下，显著提升雅可比与向量场精度，并保持与 SOTA 统计准确方法（DySLIM）相当的长期统计精度。
AI.motivation: 混沌系统中极小的建模误差会导致轨迹偏差指数增长，长期精确预测不可行。已有两条研究路线：一是要求代理模型复现真实动力学的雅可比（决定相空间的局部扩张/收缩，是混沌敏感性的根源），二是要求模型复现真实动力学的长期统计行为（物理测度/不变测度一致）。二者通常被割裂处理：全局统计准确方法（如 DySLIM、Jiang et al.、Platt et al.）只约束整体不变测度，损失了"流如何搬运与变形局部集合"的局部信息；而 Park et al. (2025) 虽探索了两者的联系，但需要真实雅可比作为"神谕"，无法用于真实数据。本文目标是提出无需神谕、能同时兼顾两者的可训练框架，且需对观测噪声鲁棒。
AI.method: 1) 理论框架：把目标从"全局测度相等"改为"局部覆盖集上的推前测度相等"——约束 (φ_Δt;θ)#μ 在每个 φ_Δt(U_i) 上的限制等于真值对应限制；定理1（可数覆盖上逐块测度相等 ⇒ 全局测度相等）说明该局部约束在真值 μ 不变时蕴含全局不变测度的保持，从而统一了两条路线。2) 邻域覆盖构建：以数据点为中心的环形（annulus）邻域，内半径 r_min 取噪声标准差的 8 倍，外半径 r_max 选到使每个邻域平均包含数据点总数的 5%；用 KD-tree 一次性高效检索相空间近邻。3) 邻域演化：不直接演化每个近邻点，而是以中心点轨迹为参考、演化扰动向量 ω̃_k，采用含二阶项的变分方程 Taylor 展开（自动微分获得 ∂f 与 ∂²f），由此重构模型演化的邻域样本，从而隐式正则化局部几何。4) 损失：用平方 MMD 比较每个邻域内真值样本流（由实测点前推 s·Δt 获得）与模型演化样本流；最终损失 L = L_traj + λ·(邻域 MMD 平均)，λ 与邻居数 K 为两个超参。5) 实现：MLP 向量场 [d,64,64]，diffrax Tsit5 求解器，adabelief 优化，batch 2048（每批 B' 个中心 × K 个邻居），训练/验证/测试各 50 条轨迹 ×1000 时间点，加噪 1%/5%/10%；系统为 Lorenz63、超混沌 Chen、Lorenz96；基线为 Vanilla 与 DySLIM；超参用 Sinkhorn 散度在无噪验证集上网格搜索。
AI.result: 在 Lorenz63、超混沌 Chen、Lorenz96 上：短时预测（VPT）与长期统计精度（MMD²）中 Neighborhood 与 DySLIM 相当或略优于 Vanilla，且在高噪声下明显优于 Vanilla；DySLIM 在长期统计上略优于本方法。但在关键的局部指标上，Neighborhood 全面最优：相对向量场误差与相对雅可比误差（Frobenius 范数）在所有系统与噪声水平下显著优于 Vanilla 和 DySLIM；特别是在 Lorenz63 轨迹的分叉/瓣切换敏感区域，Vanilla 与 DySLIM 均出现明显误差斑块，而本方法给出空间上更均匀准确的向量场与雅可比；Lyapunov 指数谱的平均绝对误差也最小（Vanilla 在高噪声下负指数严重失真）。
AI.conclusion: Neighborhood 训练法通过约束局部相空间邻域及其推前测度的演化，在单个全局模型中同时获得准确的雅可比（局部动力学）与具竞争力的长期统计精度，填补了"全局统计准确"与"局部雅可比准确"两类方法之间的空白，且无需真实雅可比神谕、对噪声鲁棒。其定位为全局与局部雅可比估计方法之间的折中方案，未来可扩展到更高维与部分可观测系统，并可进一步优化覆盖集构造（如考虑吸引子上局部可预测性的变化）。

title: Monitoring Data-aware Temporal Properties (Extended Version)
comment: This is the extended version of a paper accepted to IJCAI 2026
summary: Dynamic systems in AI are often complex and heterogeneous, so that an internal specification is not accessible and verification techniques such as model checking are not applicable. Monitoring is in such cases an attractive alternative, as it evaluates desirable properties along traces generated by an unknown dynamic system. In this work, we consider anticipatory monitoring of linear-time properties enriched with an arbitrary SMT theory over finite traces (LTLfMT). Anticipatory monitoring in this setting is highly challenging, as the monitoring state depends on both the trace prefix seen so far and all its possible finite continuations. Under reasonable assumptions on the background theory, we present and formally prove the correctness of a novel foundational framework for monitoring properties in an expressive fragment of LTLfMT. The framework combines automata-theoretic methods to handle the temporal aspects of the logic, with automated reasoning techniques to address the first-order dimension. Moreover, we identify for the first time decidable fragments of this monitoring problem that are practically relevant as they combine linear arithmetic with uninterpreted functions, which covers e.g. data-aware business processes and dynamic systems operating over a read-only database. Feasibility is witnessed by a prototype implementation and preliminary evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次形式化并求解 LTLf^MT（带模理论量子的有限轨迹线性时序逻辑）的"预期式监控"（anticipatory monitoring）问题。作者给出一个把 LTLf 的非确定自动机（NFA）与基于模型完备化与量词消去的一阶自动推理相结合的基础框架：在 NFA 上定义"回归"（regress）操作并构造后向的"共可达图"（coreachability graph, CG+/CG−），由 ExtSat/ExtViol 公式判定监控状态；并证明其正确性。同时首次给出多个可判定片段：无算术时符号无环（acyclic signature）的 DB-LTLf、算术受限为单调性约束的 DB-LTLf-MC（涵盖并推广了 Felli et al. 2023 的结果）、局部有限理论、以及 K-有界回看（bounded lookback）属性。原型工具 MonThe（基于 CVC5）与初步实验验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: AI 系统日益由自主代理与异构组件构成，内部规范不可获取、设计期验证（模型检查、测试）失效，因此只能在运行时"监控"黑盒系统的执行轨迹。LTLf 是监控无界但有限执行的合适逻辑，但它是命题式的，无法表达对结构化数据（数值算术、集合、列表、未解释函数）的性质；而 LTLf^MT（Geatti et al. 2022）借助 SMT 理论弥补了这一缺陷，契合新一代智能体处理结构化数据的现实需求。另一方面，监控的关键需求是尽早发现违例，即"预期式监控"：不仅看已见前缀，还需推理前缀的全部（无穷多个）有限后继。已有工作表明仅"LTLf+简单算术"的预期式监控就已不可判定（Felli et al. 2023），而 LTLf^MT 的预期式监控此前是完全空白的问题。此外，已有的一阶/度量时序监控工作（如 metric FO temporal logic、past-time FO LTL）均非预期式，且假设模型逐时刻变化（谓词表示事件而非事实），这与"数据库事实固定、可保守扩展"的现实语义不符；Decker et al. 2016 的模理论监控逻辑语义不可比且未给出可判定片段。因此需要一个新的、同时处理"时序维度"与"一阶数据维度"的基础框架，并明确其可解片段。
AI.method: （1）语义与问题定义：采用多排序一阶签名 Σ=⟨S,P,F,V,U⟩，在 LTLf^MT 中以"回看"算子 ⊲ 代替前瞻（可等价互换），并使用强版跨状态算子；假设背景理论 T 满足：(a) 存在式公式可满足性可判定；(b) T 为全称理论且有模型完备化 T*（或 T 本身具 QE）。延续的语义被精确定义为模型间的"嵌入"（保持 Σ-文字真值的映射）：延拓只保守地扩展已见元素的事实，同时允许出现新元素及其新事实。定义四种监控状态 cs/ps/cv/pv（当前/永久满足/违例），以及"监控问题"。（2）自动机：把 FO 原子集 C 与其否定 C± 以及标记末时刻的 λ 组成字母表 Θ=2^{C±∪{λ,¬λ}}，用辅助函数 δ（对 ∧/∨ 做合取/析取归约，对 X、Xw、U、R 分别展开并注入 λ/¬λ）构造 NFA N_ψ，状态含初始 ψ、接受集 {⊤,q+}、拒绝态 q−。要求"安全回看"（初始状态出边标签不含 V^⊲）。定义词 w 与轨迹的"一致性"（逐时刻满足 ∧ς，末时刻含 λ）以及"逐时刻一致性"，证明 Thm 10（NFA 接受一致词 ⟺ τ⊨ψ）与 Lem 11（给定轨迹存在唯一一致词与唯一 NFA 状态，保证确定性的监控过程）。（3）监控技术：定义回归操作 regress(φ,ς)=∃Ȳ.[ς](V/V^⊲,Ȳ/V)∧φ(Ȳ/V)，将验证义务沿约束向前"回传"（类似后向搜索的前像）；在此基础上定义共可达图 CG+(N_ψ)（自接受态回溯）与对偶的 CG−（自非接受态回溯），节点为 (q,φ)，φ 恒为无量词 FO 公式——通过模型完备化 T* 与其 QE 获得（这是本文主要技术贡献）。由节点公式析取得 ExtSat(q)、ExtViol(q)。监控算法 monitor(ψ,τ)：构造 NFA，确定当前 NFA 状态 q；若 q 接受则据 M,α_n ⊨ ExtViol(q) 返回 cs 或 ps，否则据 M,α_n ⊨ ExtSat(q) 返回 cv 或 pv。正确性通过 Lem 16（回归约束 rc(w) 与一致性的双向对应）、Lem 17（CG 路径与 rc(w) 的对应）以及 Thm 18 给出，核心用到模型完备化的两个性质：T-模型可嵌入 T*-模型、以及 T* 的 QE。（4）可解性判据：(I) 符号无环（sort graph 无环）→ 有限项 → 有限互不等价 FO 公式 → CG 有限可终止（Thm 19）；(II) tame 签名（rat/int 为叶子）+ 无环 + 算术约束限于单调性约束 MC（=,≠,≤,<）→ DB-LTLf-MC 可解（Thm 20，涵盖 Felli et al. 2023 Thm 20，证明借 TameCombCover 的有限性）；(III) T 为 k-局部有限且具模型完备化 → 任意属性可解（Thm 21），单变量公理化即可（Cor 22）；(IV) 基于计算图定义 K-有界回看（无环路径长度 ≤ K），证明 CG 中公式量词深度有界因而有限（Thm 24）。（5）原型：实现 MonThe 工具（调用 CVC5 完成 SMT 检查与量词消去），提供 Web 界面，实验取自 Schneider et al. 合成模式、Gianola et al. 2024 模型检验属性、VERIFAS 激光雷达/图书写作/webshop 系统及本文购票示例，每属性在 5 条不同长度轨迹上监控，分别报告属性规模、总时间、预处理（NFA 构造）与监控时间。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 形式化了 LTLf^MT 的预期式监控问题（Def 6、monitoring states cs/ps/cv/pv），并指出其在纯实数线性算术下不可判定；(2) 给出了面向量化自由片段 dataLTLf 的正确监控算法（Thm 18：monitor 返回 s 则 τ ⊨[[ψ=s]]，即对所有延续给出语义正确判决）；(3) 首次识别出实践相关的可判定片段：无算术且符号无环的 DB-LTLf（Thm 19）、 tame+无环+单调性约束的 DB-LTLf-MC（Thm 20，涵盖并推广 Felli et al. 2023）、k-局部有限理论的通用可解性（Thm 21/Cor 22）、K-有界回看属性可解（Thm 24）；其中 Thm 20 的 DB-LTLf 类同时支持线性算术与未解释函数，覆盖数据感知业务流程与运行于只读数据库之上的动态系统。实验表明方法可行：多数属性监控在毫秒到秒级（如 webshop 的 model checking 属性约 0.02–0.20 s，VERIFAS book writing 部分属性 2.04 s），但含复杂数据依赖结构的"DDS dynamics"类属性预处理（NFA/回归约束构造）耗时占主导（lasertec 144.69 s、webshop 104.06 s），说明预处理是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次研究了 LTLf^MT 表达的数据感知时序属性的预期式监控，给出了结合自动机方法（处理时序维度）与自动推理技术（处理一阶数据维度）的基础框架并给出完整正确性证明，其可解片段首次覆盖线性算术与未解释函数（只读数据库引用）的组合，适用于数据感知业务流程等实际场景；MonThe 原型（https://monitoring.adatool.dev，基于 CVC5）验证了可行性。作者指出后续方向：需要更充分的经验评估（当前实验为初步性）、以及扩展到数据随时间"部分变化"的动态系统（如数据库价格被受控更新），这需要突破当前"模型保守扩展"的语义设定。

title: GeoViSTA: Geospatial Vision-Tabular Transformer for Multimodal Environment Representation
summary: Large-scale pretraining on Earth observation imagery has yielded powerful representations of the natural and built environment. However, most existing geospatial foundation models do not directly model the structured socioeconomic covariates typically stored in tabular form. This modality gap limits their ability to capture the complete total environment, which is critical for reasoning about complex environmental, social, and health-related outcomes. In this work, we propose GeoViSTA (Geospatial Vision-Tabular Transformer), a vision-tabular architecture that learns unified geospatial embeddings from co-registered gridded imagery and tabular data. GeoViSTA utilizes bilateral cross-attention to exchange spatial and semantic information across modalities, guided by a geography-aware attention mechanism that aligns continuous image patches with irregular census-tract tokens. We train GeoViSTA with a self-supervised joint masked-autoencoding objective, forcing it to recover missing image patches and tabular rows using local spatial context and cross-modal cues. Empirically, GeoViSTA's unified embeddings improve linear probing performance on high-impact downstream tasks, outperforming baselines in predicting disease-specific mortality and fire hazard frequency across held-out regions. These results demonstrate that jointly modeling the physical environment alongside structured socioeconomic context yields highly transferable representations for holistic geospatial inference.

AI.tldr: GeoViSTA是一种结合卫星图像与人口普查数据的视觉-表格Transformer，通过双向交叉注意力和掩码自编码实现跨模态统一表征，在疾病死亡率和火灾危险预测任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间基础模型未能直接建模以表格形式存储的结构化社会经济协变量，存在模态鸿沟，限制了其捕获完整总体环境的能力，这对于推理复杂的环境、社会和健康相关结果至关重要。
AI.method: 提出GeoViSTA（地理空间视觉-表格Transformer）架构，采用双向交叉注意力机制和地理感知注意力机制，将连续的图像块与不规则的普查区域令牌对齐；通过自监督联合掩码自编码训练目标，利用局部空间上下文和跨模态线索恢复缺失的图像块和表格行。
AI.result: GeoViSTA的统一嵌入在下游任务中提升了线性探测性能，在疾病特异性死亡率和火灾危险频率预测任务上优于基线方法，并具有良好的跨区域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模物理环境与结构化社会经济背景，可产生高度可迁移的表征，用于整体地理空间推理。

title: How Sensitive Are Radiomic AI Models to Acquisition Parameters?
summary: A main barrier for the deployment of AI radiomic systems in clinical routine is their drop in performance under heterogeneous multicentre acquisition protocols. This work presents a performance-oriented framework for quantifying scan parameter sensitivity of radiomic AI models, while identifying clinically significant parameter regions associated with improved cross-dataset robustness. We formulate a mixed-effects framework for quantifying the influence that clinically relevant acquisition parameters have on models performance, while accounting for subject-level random effects. We have applied our framework to lung cancer diagnosis in CT scans using two independent multicentre datasets (a public database and own-collected data) and several SoA architectures. To evaluate across-database reproducibility, CT parameters have been adjusted using the data collected and tested on the public set. The optimal configuration selected is the current of the X-ray tube >= 200 mA, spiral pitch <= 1.5, slice thickness <= 1.25 mm, which balances diagnostic quality with low radiation dose. These configuration push metrics from 0.79+-0.04 sensitivity, 0.47+-0.10 specificity in low quality scans to 0.90+-0.10 sensitivity, 0.79 +- 0.13 specificity in high quality ones.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种面向性能的框架，用于量化放射组学AI模型对扫描参数的敏感性，并识别与跨数据集鲁棒性改善相关的临床显著参数区域。在肺癌CT诊断任务中验证发现，当管电流≥200 mA、螺旋pitch≤1.5、层厚≤1.25 mm时，模型灵敏度从0.79提升至0.90，特异度从0.47提升至0.79，兼顾诊断质量与低辐射剂量。
AI.motivation: AI放射组学系统在实际临床部署中的主要瓶颈是其在异构多中心采集协议下性能显著下降，即跨数据集鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 采用混合效应框架量化临床相关采集参数对模型性能的影响，同时考虑受试者水平随机效应。在CT肺结节诊断任务上使用多个前沿架构进行验证，通过调整CT参数后在不同数据集间进行交叉测试以评估跨数据库可重复性。
AI.result: 优化后的配置（管电流≥200 mA、螺旋pitch≤1.5、层厚≤1.25 mm）将低质量扫描的诊断性能（灵敏度0.79±0.04、特异度0.47±0.10）显著提升至高配置下的高性能（灵敏度0.90±0.10、特异度0.79±0.13）。
AI.conclusion: 最优参数配置为管电流≥200 mA、螺旋pitch≤1.5、层厚≤1.25 mm，在低辐射剂量与诊断质量间取得平衡。该框架可有效量化扫描参数对模型性能的影响，助力AI放射组学系统的临床部署。

title: MahaVar: OOD Detection via Class-wise Mahalanobis Distance Variance under Neural Collapse
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is a critical component for ensuring the reliability of deep neural networks in safety-critical applications. In this work, we present a key empirical observation: for in-distribution (ID) samples, class-wise Mahalanobis distances exhibit a pronounced sharp minimum structure, where the distance to the nearest class is small while distances to all other classes remain large, resulting in high variance across classes. In contrast, OOD samples tend to exhibit a less pronounced sharp minimum structure, producing comparatively lower variance across classes. We further provide a theoretical analysis grounding this observation in Neural Collapse geometry: under relaxed Neural Collapse assumptions on within-class compactness and inter-class separation, ID samples are shown to structurally exhibit high class-wise distance variance, offering a theoretical basis for its use as an OOD score. Motivated by this observation and its theoretical backing, we propose MahaVar, a simple and effective post-hoc OOD detector that augments the Mahalanobis distance with a class-wise distance variance term. Following the OpenOOD v1.5 benchmark protocol, MahaVar achieves state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet, with consistent improvements in both AUROC and FPR@95 over existing Mahalanobis-based methods across all benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MahaVar 是一个免训练的事后（post-hoc）OOD 检测器：在 L2 归一化的马氏距离分数上，额外加入"各类别马氏距离的类间方差"项 S(x) = -min_c d_Maha,c + α·Var_c[d_Maha,c]。核心观察是 ID 样本的类级马氏距离呈"尖锐最小值"结构（最近类距离很小、其余类距离大且迅速持平），因而类间方差高；OOD 样本缺少该结构、方差低。作者基于放松的 Neural Collapse 几何（弱 NC1/NC2，simplex ETF）给出理论证明，解释了为什么 ID 样本结构性具有更高方差，并在 OpenOOD v1.5 协议下于 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet（ResNet-50、Swin-B、ViT-B）上验证：在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上取得 SOTA，ImageNet 平均 AUROC 88.64 / FPR@95 44.74，优于 Mahalanobis++（87.75 / 47.42）。
AI.motivation: 深度网络在闭世界假设下训练，对分布外样本常给出过度自信的预测，威胁自动驾驶、医疗影像等安全攸关场景。现有事后（post-hoc）检测方法中，Mahalanobis 系列（Lee et al. 2017；Mahalanobis++，Müller & Hein 2022）因无需额外训练或 OOD 数据而最实用，但它们只利用"到最近类中心的距离"，即仅取类级距离的最小值。作者观察到类级马氏距离的排序序列存在"尖锐最小值（sharp minimum）"结构：ID 样本在 rank 0 处距离极小、随后迅速抬升并在高 rank 处持平，而 OOD 样本对所有类中心距离都相近、无明显最小值。这种非对称性意味着"类间距离方差"是被完全忽略的互补信号。同时，Neural Collapse (Papyan et al.) 几何为 ID 特征的紧致聚集与类均值的 simplex ETF 排布提供了结构性解释，可用以论证该方差信号的理论合理性。
AI.method:
1) 分数构建：基于 Mahalanobis++，对倒数第二层特征做 L2 归一化（实际实现不做全局均值中心化），用训练集估计类均值与共享（tied）协方差（加 1e-3·I 正则），OOD 分数为 S(x) = -min_c d_Maha,c(φ̂(x)) + α·Var_c[d_Maha,c(φ̂(x))]，α≥0 由 OpenOOD v1.5 验证集网格搜索（ResNet-50 0.05、Swin-B 0.1、ViT-B 0.07、CIFAR-10 0.015、CIFAR-100 0.03）；推理开销与 Mahalanobis++ 相同。
2) 理论（Assumption 4.1 弱 NC1+NC2）：类均值构成 ℓ2-等范、等角 simplex ETF（类间距离 K），各类样本位于半径 ε_c<K/2 的球内。Theorem 4.2 给出 ID 样本类级 ℓ2 距离方差的上下界，ε→0 时收敛到 (C-1)K⁴/C²；Theorem 4.3 证明当 OOD 样本与所有类均值的最大绝对余弦相似度 < R(R-ε)/√(C-1) 时，ID 方差严格大于 OOD 方差；Corollary 4.4 在"类内偏差落在 ETF 子空间"假设下给出无条件支配关系，等号当且仅当 OOD 特征也在该子空间内。关键恒等式 Var_c[d_c²] = 4R²ρ(x)/(C-1)，ρ(x)=‖Pφ̂(x)‖²，为 ID/OOD 方差分离的唯一来源，实测 ρ_ID > ρ_OOD 在 22/22 个骨干-数据集组合成立。
3) 实验：遵循 OpenOOD v1.5 协议，CIFAR-10/100 用 ResNet-18，ImageNet 用 ResNet-50/Swin-B/ViT-B，对比 MSP、MaxLogit、KL-matching、Energy、GEN、ReAct、ASH-S、SCALE、KNN、NCI(+filter)、fDBD、ViM、NNGuide 及 Mahalanobis/++，并额外对比 CADRef、LTS、OptFS、AdaSCALE-A/L。
4) 消融：方差项与 L2 归一化的贡献分解；方差单独作分数；偏度等高阶矩；α 敏感性；超参无关的 Var/d_(1) 比值形式；距离度量（L1/L2/Mahalanobis）；Top-K 类数；特征中心化与否；与 NCDD 类"非最近距离求和/一二近差"的对照。
AI.result: ImageNet（三骨干平均）：MahaVar 平均 AUROC 88.64、FPR@95 44.74，优于 Mahalanobis++（87.75 / 47.42）与所有其他基线（ViM 85.93、NNGuide 86.41、SCALE 74.21 等）；近 OOD 全胜（SSB-Hard 73.02/75.87、NINCO 86.92/59.03），远 OOD 中仅 Texture 略逊于 Mahalanobis++。分骨干：ResNet-50 88.24/41.27、Swin-B 89.49/44.50、ViT-B 88.20/48.45；相对 Mahalanobis++ 的增益为 +1.19（d/C=2.05）、+1.20（d/C=1.02）、+0.30（d/C=0.77，ViT-B 维度 768 < C-1=999 无法形成完整 ETF）。CIFAR-100：83.80 / 68.03，为所有方法最优（Mahalanobis++ 82.75/70.33）；CIFAR-10：91.12 / 45.56，优于全部 Mahalanobis 方法但 AUROC 略低于 KNN（91.81）。消融：仅加方差项（无 L2 归一）即把 Mahalanobis 从 80.24/62.86 提升到 86.76/52.33，但不及 Mahalanobis++，说明二者互补；方差单独使用仅 59.91 AUROC，不可替代最小距离项；加偏度仅 +0.08 AUROC 且符号随骨干变化，故采用纯方差形式；α 最优区间 0.05–0.1，过大时性能退化（ResNet-50 验证 AUROC 92.75→89.30）；超参无关的 Var/d_(1) 变体在 ResNet-50 达 88.40/39.96，与调参加法形式相当；方差项对 L1/L2/Mahalanobis 三种度量均带来增益；K=1000（全类）通常最优（ViT-B 在 K=500 最佳）。对 NCDD 风格的"最近距离+非最近距离求和"与"最近-次近差"两种对照，验证集均选出 β=0，即单/双类比较无额外信息，确认信号来自完整类级距离结构。
AI.conclusion: 类级距离方差是 Neural Collapse 几何下 ID 样本"尖锐最小值"结构的直接体现，可作为与最近类距离互补的、几何可解释的事后 OOD 信号；将其与 L2 归一化的马氏距离加性组合即得 MahaVar，在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上达到 SOTA，且推理开销与 Mahalanobis++ 相同。局限包括：CIFAR-10 上不及 KNN；增益在个别 OOD 数据集上不均匀；方差项不能单独使用；α 依赖带 OOD 的验证集调参（部署中不现实）；理论依赖接近训练终期的 Neural Collapse 几何，ResNet-50 上中心化反而退化说明非中心化设定尚未被理论覆盖。未来方向：超越 Neural Collapse 的更一般理论、高阶矩（偏度）、非中心化特征的严格处理、比值形式的分离性保证，以及代理数据/高斯噪声等免 OOD 验证集的超参选择方案。

title: $π$-Bench: Evaluating Proactive Personal Assistant Agents in Long-Horizon Workflows
summary: The rise of personal assistant agents, e.g., OpenClaw, highlights the growing potential of large language models to support users across everyday life and work. A core challenge in these settings is proactive assistance, since users often begin with underspecified requests and leave important needs, constraints, or preferences unstated. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can identify and act on such hidden intents before they are explicitly stated, especially in sustained multi-turn interactions where user needs emerge gradually. To address this gap, we introduce $π$-Bench, a benchmark for proactive assistance comprising 100 multi-turn tasks across 5 domain-specific user personas. By incorporating hidden user intents, inter-task dependencies, and cross-session continuity, $π$-Bench evaluates agents' ability to anticipate and address user needs over extended interactions, jointly measuring proactivity and task completion in long-horizon trajectories that better reflect real-world use. Experiments show (1) proactive assistance remains challenging, (2) a clear distinction between task completion and proactivity, and (3) the value of prior interaction for proactive intent resolution in later tasks.

AI.tldr: π-Bench是一个用于评估LLM智能体主动协助能力的新型基准测试，包含100个多轮任务。实验证明主动协助仍然具有挑战性，且任务完成与主动性是两个可区分的维度，先前交互经验有助于后续任务的主动意图识别。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试很少评估智能体能否在用户明确表达之前识别并响应隐藏意图，特别是在用户需求逐渐显现的持续多轮交互场景中，这一能力对于个人助理智能体至关重要。
AI.method: 构建了包含100个多轮任务、5个领域特定用户画像的基准测试，融入了隐藏用户意图、任务间依赖关系和跨会话连续性，系统评估了智能体在扩展交互中预见和满足用户需求的能力。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1)主动协助仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务；(2)任务完成与主动性之间存在明显区别；(3)先前的交互对后续任务中主动意图的识别具有重要价值。
AI.conclusion: π-Bench有效区分了任务完成与主动性行为，证明了交互历史对后续任务中主动意图识别的重要价值，为评估LLM智能助手的主动协助能力提供了可靠基准。

title: What if Tomorrow is the World Cup Final? Counterfactual Time Series Forecasting with Textual Conditions
summary: Time series forecasting has become increasingly critical in real-world scenarios, where future sequences are influenced not only by historical patterns but also by forthcoming events. In this context, forecasting must dynamically adapt to complex and stochastic future conditions, which introduces fundamental challenges in both forecasting and evaluation. Traditional methods typically rely on historical data or factual future conditions, while overlooking counterfactual scenarios. Furthermore, many existing approaches are restricted to simple structured conditions, limiting their ability to generalize to the real-world complexities. To address these gaps, we introduce the task of counterfactual time series forecasting with textual conditions, enabling more flexible and condition-aware forecasting. We propose a comprehensive evaluation framework that encompasses both factual and counterfactual settings, even in the absence of ground truth time series. Additionally, we present a novel text-attribution mechanism that distinguishes mutable from immutable factors, thereby improving forecast accuracy under sophisticated and stochastic textual conditions. The project page is at https://seqml.github.io/TADiff/

AI.tldr: This paper introduces the task of counterfactual time series forecasting with textual conditions, enabling flexible and condition-aware forecasting. It proposes an evaluation framework covering both factual and counterfactual settings without ground truth time series, and a text-attribution mechanism that distinguishes mutable from immutable factors to improve accuracy under complex textual conditions.
AI.motivation: Traditional time series forecasting methods rely on historical data or factual future conditions, overlooking counterfactual scenarios. Many existing approaches are restricted to simple structured conditions, limiting their ability to generalize to real-world complexities.
AI.method: The authors introduce counterfactual time series forecasting with textual conditions, propose a comprehensive evaluation framework for both factual and counterfactual settings (even without ground truth time series), and develop a novel text-attribution mechanism that distinguishes mutable from immutable factors.
AI.result: The text-attribution mechanism improves forecast accuracy under sophisticated and stochastic textual conditions.
AI.conclusion: The proposed text-attribution mechanism successfully distinguishes mutable from immutable factors, enabling improved forecast accuracy under sophisticated and stochastic textual conditions.

title: On Strong Equivalence Notions in Logic Programming and Abstract Argumentation
summary: Strong equivalence between knowledge bases ensures the possibility of replacing one with the other without affecting reasoning outcomes, in any given context. This makes it a crucial property in nonmonotonic formalisms. In particular, the fields of logic programming and abstract argumentation provide primary examples in which this property has been subject to vast investigations. However, while (classes of) logic programs and abstract argumentation frameworks are known to be semantically equivalent in static settings, this alignment breaks in dynamic contexts due to differing notions of update. As a result, strong equivalence does not always carry over from one formalism to the other. In this paper, we carefully investigate this discrepancy and introduce a new notion of strong equivalence for logic programs. Our approach preserves strong equivalence under translation between certain classes of logic programs and both Dung-style and claim-augmented argumentation frameworks, thus restoring compatibility across these formalisms.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses the mismatch between logic programming and abstract argumentation frameworks regarding strong equivalence in dynamic contexts. By introducing a new notion of strong equivalence for logic programs, the authors restore compatibility between these previously aligned but now divergent formalisms.
AI.motivation: While logic programs and abstract argumentation frameworks are semantically equivalent in static settings, their alignment breaks in dynamic contexts due to differing update semantics, preventing strong equivalence from carrying over between formalisms.
AI.method: The approach involves carefully analyzing the discrepancy between logic programs and argumentation frameworks in dynamic settings, and developing a new notion of strong equivalence that is preserved under translation between these formalisms.
AI.result: A new notion of strong equivalence for logic programs that preserves strong equivalence under translation between logic programs and both Dung-style and claim-augmented argumentation frameworks.
AI.conclusion: The proposed new notion of strong equivalence for logic programs successfully bridges the gap between logic programming and abstract argumentation, restoring compatibility across formalisms in dynamic contexts.

title: Collaborative Yet Personalized Policy Training: Single-Timescale Federated Actor-Critic
summary: Despite the popularity of the actor-critic method and the practical needs of collaborative policy training, existing works typically either overlook environmental heterogeneity or give up personalization altogether by training a single shared policy across all agents. We consider a federated actor-critic framework in which agents share a common linear subspace representation while maintaining personalized local policy components, and agents iteratively estimate the common subspace, local critic heads, and local policies (i.e., actors). Under canonical single-timescale updates with Markovian sampling, we establish finite-time convergence via a novel joint linear approximation framework. Specifically, we show that the critic error converges to zero at the rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/((1-γ)^4\sqrt{TK}))$, and the policy gradient norm converges to zero at the rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/((1-γ)^6\sqrt{TK}))$, where $T$ is the number of rounds, $K$ is the number of agents, and $γ\in (0,1)$ is the discount factor. These results demonstrate linear speedup with respect to the number of agents $K$, despite heterogeneous Markovian trajectories under distinct transition kernels and coupled learning dynamics. To address these challenges, we develop a new perturbation analysis for the projected subspace updates and QR decomposition steps, together with conditional mixing arguments for heterogeneous Markovian noise. Furthermore, to handle the additional complications induced by policy updates and temporal dependence, we establish fine-grained characterizations of the discrepancies between function evaluations under Markovian sampling and under temporally frozen policies. Experiments instantiate the framework within PPO on federated \texttt{Hopper-v5} action-map heterogeneity, showing gains over Single PPO and FedAvg PPO and downstream transfer from the learned shared trunk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出单时间尺度的联邦个性化 Actor-Critic 算法 pFedAC（共享低维线性子空间表示 + 各智能体个性化 critic 头与 actor），在异构转移核、马尔可夫采样下首次给出个性化联邦 AC 的有限时间收敛证明：critic 误差 Õ(1/((1−γ)⁴√(TK)))、策略梯度范数 Õ(1/((1−γ)⁶√(TK)))，对智能体数 K 具有线性加速；并在 PPO 上实例化为 FedPer PPO，在联邦 Hopper-v5 动作映射异构基准上显著优于 Single PPO 与 FedAvg PPO，且共享主干可迁移至下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦强化学习与个性化联邦学习（PFL）工作存在三点缺陷：(1) 大多忽略环境异质性；(2) 或为获得共享收益而放弃个性化，只训练单一全局策略；(3) 即便考虑异质性，其最优性往往定义在由各智能体转移核加权平均而成的"虚拟平均环境"上，而非各自的真实环境。已有联邦 AC 分析（单环/两时间尺度）均只学习公共策略或公共值函数。同时，actor-critic 的有限时间分析在多智能体与异质环境下仍十分欠缺：标准单智能体分析（如 Chen & Zhao 2024）依赖于投影与 QR 的可控性，而 PFL 的 FedRep 分析（Collins et al. 2021）依赖 i.i.d. 局部样本，无法直接套用到马尔可夫采样 + TD 更新 + 策略与 critic 强耦合的场景。本文因此希望：设计一个既能"协作"（共享通用表征）又能"个性化"（各自策略/头）的联邦 AC 框架，并在马尔可夫采样与异构转移核下给出具备线性加速的有限时间保证。
AI.method:
**问题设定**：K 个智能体 + 1 个参数服务器；每个智能体对应异构 MDP ⟨S,A,γ,P^k,R^k⟩，目标是个性化最大化各自的 J^k(θ)。共享假设：所有最优线性近似系数 z^{k,*} 完全落在同一个 r 维子空间内，即 z^k,* = B* ω^{k,*}，其中 B* 为正交 r×d 矩阵。

**算法 pFedAC（Algorithm 1，单时间尺度）**：每轮 t，每个智能体采样长度 L 的本地轨迹（critic 链用 P^k，actor 链用重置核 P̂^k = γP^k + (1−γ)η），计算 TD(L) 误差 δ^k_{t,L}，然后
- 局部头更新（投影到 ℓ₂ 球半径 U_ω）：ω^k_{t+1} = Π_{U_ω}(ω^k_t + (β/L) δ^k_{t,L} B_t^T φ(s_{t,0}^k))；
- 共享子空间更新（含创新投影 B_{t,⊥}B_{t,⊥}^T 抑制交叉项扰动放大）：B^k_{t+1} = B_t + (ζ/L) B_{t,⊥}B_{t,⊥}^T δ^k_{t,L} φ(s_{t,0}^k)(ω^k_t)^T；
- actor 更新：用伴生 MDP 的单步 TD 误差做 minibatch 策略梯度 θ^k_{t+1} = θ^k_t + (α/L)Σ_ℓ δ^{k,act}_{t,ℓ} ∇_θ log π_{θ^k_t}(â|ŝ)；
- 服务器对 B̄_{t+1} = (1/K)Σ_k B^k_{t+1} 做 QR 分解后广播 B_{t+1}。

**分析框架（联合线性近似 + 三重耦合误差动力学）**：定义局部头误差 x^k_t = B_t ω^k_t − z^{k,*} 与主角偏差 m_t = B_⊥^{*T}B_t（主子角距离）；以 M_t = E‖m_t‖²_F、X̄_t = (1/K)Σ_k E‖x^k_t‖²、Ḡ_t = (1/K)Σ_k E‖∇J^k(θ^k_t)‖² 为 Lyapunov 量。
- Proposition 2（TD 特征分解）：把 δ^k_{t,L}φ(s_{t,0}^k) 分解为"真误差项 A x^k_t + 噪声项 b^k_{t,L}"，是全部耦合分析的关键中间量。
- Lemma 5.1（局部头误差递推上界）：负漂移项 ⟨x^k, P_t A^k_{L,θ} x^k⟩ 需拆为 ⟨x^k,A x^k⟩（负定，靠假设1）、⟨x^k,(P_t−P*)A x^k⟩ 与 −⟨x^k,P_⊥* A x^k⟩（由主角距离控制），并借助 SVD 最优旋转矩阵 R 与"投影凸性"事实 1 控制投影误差与 QR 扰动耦合；扰动项通过 ‖R_{t+1}−I‖ ≤ 2‖Q_t‖²_F 的二阶 QR 扰动界与混合引理控制。
- Lemma 5.2（下界）：(1/K)Σ_k‖x^k_t‖² ≥ ‖m_t‖²_F/(rK)·λ⁺_min，刻画 M_t 与 X_t 必须同步学习。
- Lemma 5.3（主角距离递推）：M_{t+1} ≤ (1−λνζ/r + c₁²ζ)M_t + …（含 X̄_t 反馈项，构成双向耦合系统）。
- Lemma 5.4（策略梯度分析）：用 J^k 的 L_J′ 光滑性做上升型分析，将 minibatch 估计与真实梯度之差拆成 D1（critic 近似误差）、D2（参数漂移）、D3（原链与辅助链失配）、D4（冻结策略下的马尔可夫采样误差）四项并逐一精细化。
- 新技术工具：(i) 针对投影子空间更新与 QR 分解的新扰动分析（Lemma D.2/D.3/I.6）；(ii) 异质马尔可夫噪声的条件混合论证（Lemma I.2 精细化混合界、Lemma I.9 与 Corollary 4 基于 Dobrushin 单步收缩的 TV 递推）；(iii) 引入"最近 τ 轮策略冻结"的辅助马尔可夫链（原链与辅助链）以刻画马尔可夫采样与时间冻结策略下的函数评估差异（Lemma I.7/I.8、Corollary 2/3）；(iv) 步长回溯（Lemma I.1）与一轮/多轮扰动界（Lemma I.3–I.6）。
- 假设：1 探索性（TD 矩阵负定，最大特征值 ≤ −λL）；2 一致遍历性 + 单步 Dobrushin 收缩；3 策略类光滑性（∇log π 有界、Lipschitz）；4 特征有界 ‖φ(s)‖≤1；5 子空间覆盖（Z*Z*^T 最小非零特征值下界 ν）。
- 步长设置：β = cζ、α = c_θ ζ，ζ = L^{1/4}/√T，混合窗口 τL = max{⌈2log_ρ ζ⌉, ⌈2log_γ ζ⌉}。

**实验**：将共享主干 + 个性化头结构实例化为 FedPer PPO（仅同步 trunk，actor/critic/logσ 头保持个性化），对比 Single PPO 与 FedAvg PPO，基准为联邦 Hopper-v5（动作映射异构：grouped 两种映射与 6-unique 六种置换×尺度），并做共享主干的下游迁移实验（冻结/微调/从零训练，vanilla 与 OOD 动作尺度）。
AI.result:
**理论结果（Theorem 1）**：取 L = K² 时，critic（局部头）误差 Õ(1/((1−γ)⁴√(TK)))，策略梯度范数 Õ(1/((1−γ)⁶√(TK)))，在固定 γ 下即 Õ(1/√(TK))，给出对智能体数 K 的标准线性加速。未调 L 时的更细速率：X̄_T ≤ Õ(1/((1−γ)⁴L^{1/4}√T) + L^{1/4}/((1−γ)⁴K√T) + √L/((1−γ)⁵T))，Ḡ_T ≤ Õ(1/((1−γ)⁶L^{1/4}√T) + L^{1/4}/((1−γ)⁶K√T) + √L/((1−γ)⁷T))；其中 L^{1/4} 加速源自 actor 端不可避免的 α/√L 扰动项。

**实验结果**：在等环境步数（0.4M/client）预算、3 个随机种子下，6-unique 完全异构设定中 FedPer 相对 Single PPO 提升 2.63×、相对 FedAvg PPO 提升 3.78×；grouped 设定（每张映射三客户端共享）中分别为 2.04× 与 1.40×——说明当直接参数平均失效（六个冲突置换）时，共享主干+个性化头的收益最大，FedAvg 因平均参数被迫在两个映射上妥协而性能显著下降。共享主干作为"基础模型"可迁移：冻结主干仅训练随机初始化的头（1,031/69,895 参数），在 vanilla Hopper 上达 1328±74（从头训练 245±45，5.42×），在未见过的 OOD 动作尺度（0.5，低于预训练范围）下达 701±101（从头训练 200±23，3.50×），且冻结优于全量微调（>3.44×/>2.21×），说明 on-policy 微调会破坏预训练表征。按环境步数重新对齐后排序不变，排除了"回合更长"这一混淆因素。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在联邦强化学习中实现了个性化 actor-critic（pFedAC），并给出其马尔可夫采样、异构转移核下的有限时间收敛保证：共享低维子空间表征 + 个性化 critic 头/actor 的结构在不牺牲个性化的前提下获得协作收益，且具备对智能体数的线性加速。作者自陈的局限与未来方向包括：(1) 收敛速率对 (1−γ) 的依赖（critic 4 次方、actor 6 次方）尚不最优，在接近无折扣 γ→1 时尤为不利，需要更精细地利用马尔可夫结构、方差缩减或改进 AC 稳定性分析；(2) 假设 4（‖φ(s)‖≤1）掩盖了低秩共享（r≪d）本应带来的维度收益，细化该假设需要重构问题设定；(3) 假设 1/2/5 较强（TD 矩阵负定、Dobrushin 收缩、子空间良好覆盖），实际适用性有待检验；(4) actor 更新需要可任意 reset 状态的模拟器；(5) 理论上 critic 为线性函数逼近，而实践中用 PPO 近似，作者承认理论与实现之间存在差距。总体结论是：个性化 + 共享表示的联邦 AC 在强异构环境下既优于单点学习也优于参数平均，其共享主干还能作为可迁移的表征基础。

title: Agentifying Patient Dynamics within LLMs through Interacting with Clinical World Model
summary: Sepsis management in the ICU requires sequential treatment decisions under rapidly evolving patient physiology. Although large language models (LLMs) encode broad clinical knowledge and can reason over guidelines, they are not inherently grounded in action-conditioned patient dynamics. We introduce SepsisAgent, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation. SepsisAgent uses a learned Clinical World Model to simulate patient responses under candidate fluid--vasopressor interventions, and follows a propose--simulate--refine workflow before committing to a prescription. We first show that world-model access alone yields inconsistent LLM decision performance, motivating agent-specific training. We then train SepsisAgent through a three-stage curriculum: patient-dynamics supervised fine-tuning, propose--simulate--refine behavior cloning, and world-model-based agentic reinforcement learning. On MIMIC-IV sepsis trajectories, SepsisAgent outperforms all traditional RL and LLM-based baselines in off-policy value while achieving the best safety profile under guideline adherence and unsafe-action metrics. Further analysis shows that repeated interaction with the Clinical World Model enables the agent to learn regularities in patient evolution, which remain useful even when simulator access is removed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SepsisAgent：一个"世界模型增强"的 LLM 智能体，用于脓毒症（脓毒症/感染性休克）的液体与血管活性药治疗推荐。其核心是构建"临床世界模型"（Clinical World Model）来模拟患者在不同干预下的生理响应，并让 LLM 智能体在推理时遵循"提议—模拟—精炼"（propose–simulate–refine）流程。核心发现是：仅给 LLM 接入世界模型反而会造成不稳定甚至更差的决策（泛化 LLM 过度信任短期模拟改善、忽视长期风险），因此必须专门训练智能体。三阶段课程训练（患者动态 SFT → 行为克隆 → 基于世界模型的 GRPO 智能体强化学习）在 MIMIC-IV 脓毒症轨迹上取得了最优的 off-policy 价值（DR/WPDIS）与最佳安全性（指南依从 97.95%，不安全动作 0.08%/0.14%），并且在移除模拟器后仍能提升死亡风险（IHM）与升压药需求（VR）的内在预测能力，即"内化患者动态"。
AI.motivation: 脓毒症是 ICU 主要死因之一，治疗需要在快速演变的生理状态下进行序贯决策（滴定静脉液体与血管活性药），短期血流动力学改善可能带来长期器官损伤风险。LLM 具备丰富的临床知识与指南推理能力，但本质上并不"落地"于动作条件化的患者动态：它们知道升压药一般能升血压，却无法估计特定患者对特定剂量在未来数小时内的具体反应。因此自然的思路是给 LLM 配备一个可预测患者演化的模型（世界模型），以便在决策前比较反事实治疗方案。但作者的关键观察是：世界模型本身不足以带来收益，瓶颈在于智能体如何正确解读模拟反馈（论文第 3.3 节及附录 J 的失败模式分析显示通用 LLM 会出现"贪心激进"策略，overdosing 失败率 7.1%–10.3%，而 SepsisAgent 仅 0.8%）。因此需要专门设计"世界模型交互式智能体训练"范式。
AI.method:
任务建模：脓毒症治疗建模为离散 MDP，状态为 42 维临床变量（人口学、生命体征、实验室、器官功能等），动作为 5×5 离散网格（液体 TEV 档 × 血管活性药 NE-Eq 档）；数据来自 MIMIC-IV v2.2，按 Sepsis-3 筛选出 20,092 条 ICU 住院，窗口为脓毒症 onset 前 24h 至后 48h，按 4 小时步长聚合，7:2:1 划分。

（1）临床世界模型：沿袭 MedDreamer，2 层 GRU（hidden 128, dropout 0.2）编码轨迹历史 h_t；两个预测头——(a) 状态转移头，以高斯分布 p(s_{t+1}|τ_{≤t},a_t) 预测下一生理状态，并输出预测均值作为模拟响应；辅助预测通气状态与用 Soft Logic（τ=10.0）可微计算 SOFA/SIRS 作为正则目标；(b) 结果头，在 K=12（48 小时）窗口上预测 90 天死亡（输血/死亡率）概率。多任务损失 = 高斯 NLL + λ1·Outcome(BCE) + λ2·一致性(SmoothL1) + λ3·通气，AdamW lr 1e-3，batch 2048，50 epoch + early stopping。

（2）推理工作流 "propose–simulate–refine"：LLM 提出候选动作集 C_t={a_t^(1..M)}，调用 simulation 工具（每次最多 3 个动作）查询世界模型得到 ŷ_t^(i)，将（动作, 模拟响应）对与临床先验（Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021 指南、脓毒性休克定义）结合，最终通过 prescription 工具提交 a_t = π_φ(s_t, {(a_t^(i), ŷ_t^(i)})})。

（3）三阶段课程训练（ backbone 为 Qwen3-4B-Instruct，8×H200，bf16）：
- Stage I 患者动态 SFT：用 GPT-4.1 从临床事实+专家动作+指南先验合成 CoT 监督，包含 State Analysis / Patient Dynamics（IHM 预测、VR 预测）/ Decision Making 三类指令，拼接为统一"分析—决策"格式；约 100k 样本，2 epoch，lr 1e-5，最大长度 81920 tokens，全参数微调。
- Stage II 行为克隆：用 GPT-4.1 合成多轮 propose–simulate–refine 交互轨迹（simulation 工具调用 + prescription），最终落到专家动作 a_t*；约 1k 高质量样本，2 epoch，同样 lr 1e-5，DeepSpeed ZeRO-2。
- Stage III 智能体 RL：以世界模型为虚拟环境做 GRPO rollout（~3k 轨迹，300 steps，lr 1e-6，KL 系数 0.001）；复合奖励 R(τ)=R_out(s_T)+Σ r(s_t,s_{t+1})−λ_g·P_g(τ)，终端 ±15（生存/死亡）、步骤奖励基于 SOFA 与乳酸变化（DDQN 式设计，tanh 限幅）、指南违反固定惩罚 −10、未在最大步数内给出决策额外 −5，总奖励缩放 0.1 并裁剪到 [−2,2]。

评估：725 条留出测试集；Off-policy 评估用 DR（依 WD3QNE 方式估计 Q̂）、WIS、WPDIS；安全性用脓毒症指南依从率与专家规则定义的不安全动作（极端欠剂量 MAP<55 且无升压药/低液体；极端过剂量 MAP>95 且高剂量升压药）。基线包括临床医生、DDQN/AI Clinician/WD3QNE、多个通用 LLM、以及"世界模型增强但未经训练"的 LLM。
AI.result:
1）世界模型质量：状态转移 MAE 0.316，通气 AUC 0.942，结果预测 AUC-ROC 0.804 / AUC-PR 0.663；Transformer 变体预测更准（MAE 0.292, AUC-ROC 0.821）但下游 OPE 无一致优势，故采用 2 层 GRU。
2）仅接入世界模型不够：GPT-4.1-mini/Gemini-3-Flash/o3 加世界模型后 OPE 指标方向不一致（Gemini-3-Flash 全面退化），再加临床先验可改善安全性但不保证价值提升——说明需要训练"如何用"世界模型。
3）主结果（725 episode）：SepsisAgent DR 10.01（最佳）、WIS 11.14、WPDIS 23.40（最佳），指南依从 97.95%（最佳），不安全动作欠剂量 0.08% / 过剂量 0.14%（最佳）；全面优于传统 RL（DDQN 8.69/6.19/15.11，AI Clinician 5.98/9.94/9.88，WD3QNE 8.72/12.07/23.20）、通用 LLM（o3 8.32/9.17/20.38，GPT-OSS-120B 8.25/6.00/21.17 等）以及世界模型增强 LLM（o3+WM 9.46/10.27/22.95），并相对自身 backbone Qwen3-4B（7.79/7.34/18.76，依从 78.00%）全面提升。
4）消融：Stage I（DR 9.21, 依从 88.01%）、Stage I+II（DR 8.99, 依从 96.89%）、Stage I+II+III（DR 10.01, WIS 11.14, WPDIS 23.40, 依从 97.95%, 不安全 0.22%）表明策略价值提升主要来自 RL 阶段，而安全性在前两阶段已大幅改善。
5）内在化分析（移除模拟器）：Stage III 的 IHM AUPRC 68.52（最佳）、VR AUROC 79.96 / AUPRC 68.83（最佳），说明世界模型交互提升了 LLM 对患者演化规律的内在建模能力。
6）失败模式专家验证（241 episode，4 位急诊专家）：o3+WM 过剂量失败 7.1%、Gemini-3-Flash+WM 7.8%、GPT-4.1-mini+WM 10.3%，SepsisAgent 仅 0.8%。
7）跨数据集泛化：MIMIC-III 2,862 OOD episode 上 SepsisAgent WIS 11.50、DR 10.08（最佳）、WPDIS 16.22，优于传统 RL 基线。
8）推理效率：平均每决策步 6.1 秒；Gemini-3-Flash 加世界模型每 episode rollout API 成本约 $0.31。
AI.conclusion: 本文以概念验证形式表明：把 LLM 与临床世界模型结合、并配合专门的多阶段智能体训练（而非单纯"给模型一个模拟器"），可以显著提升脓毒症序贯治疗决策的价值与安全性。三个层次的结论：（1）世界模型接入本身可能有害/无效，通用 LLM 会贪心追求短期模拟改善而忽视长期风险，必须训练其正确解读模拟反馈；（2）基于世界模型的 agentic RL（GRPO）是策略价值提升的主要来源，且不牺牲安全性，反而同时获得最高指南依从与最低不安全动作率；（3）与世界模型的反复交互可"内化"患者动态规律，即使移除模拟器仍能提升 IHM 与 VR 预测，提示世界模型交互是提升 LLM 临床动力学推理的有效途径。局限：仅基于回顾性数据与模拟环境评估，非真实临床部署；单一数据集（MIMIC-IV）、单一任务；世界模型架构复杂度提升未带来一致下游收益；安全指标为规则定义、非临床验证。

title: FrontierSmith: Synthesizing Open-Ended Coding Problems at Scale
summary: Many real-world coding challenges are open-ended and admit no known optimal solution. Yet, recent progress in LLM coding has focused on well-defined tasks such as feature implementation, bug fixing, and competitive programming. Open-ended coding remains a weak spot for LLMs, largely because open-ended training problems are scarce and expensive to construct. Our goal is to synthesize open-ended coding problems at scale to train stronger LLM coders. We introduce FrontierSmith, an automated system for iteratively evolving open-ended problems from existing closed-ended coding tasks. Starting from competitive programming problems, FrontierSmith generates candidate open-ended variants by changing the problems'goals, restricting outputs, and generalizing inputs. It then uses a quantitative idea divergence metric to select problems that elicit genuinely diverse approaches from different solvers. Agents then generate test cases and verifiers for the surviving candidates. On two open-ended coding benchmarks, training on our synthesized data yields substantial gains over the base models: Qwen3.5-9B improves by +8.82 score on FrontierCS and +306.36 (Elo-rating-based performance) on ALE-bench; Qwen3.5-27B improves by +12.12 and +309.12, respectively.
