AI.tldr: A concept-based compositional framework using VQ-VAE learns interpretable crystal concepts from local and global patterns, enabling controlled generation of novel crystals beyond training distribution through concept recombination. Achieves up to 53.2% improvement on V.S.U.N metric.
AI.motivation: Existing crystal generation methods rely on black-box stochastic sampling, providing limited control over generating structures beyond the observed distribution. There is a need for controllable exploration of novel crystals.
AI.method: A vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) learns reusable crystal concepts from atomic environments and symmetry patterns, which are then used as building blocks for guided generation. A composition generator is introduced and iteratively refined using high-quality generated samples.
AI.result: Separately compositing concepts improves the base model by 53.2% and 51.7% on V.S.U.N metric, with significant gains in novelty while maintaining validity, stability, and uniqueness.
AI.conclusion: The framework significantly outperforms baseline models, achieving up to 53.2% and 51.7% improvements on V.S.U.N metric on MP-20 and Alex-MP-20 datasets, with particularly notable gains in novelty.

title: Beyond What to Select: A Plug-and-play Oscillatory Data-Volume Scheduling for Efficient Model Training
summary: Data selection accelerates training by identifying representative training data while preserving model performance. However, existing methods mainly focus on designing sample-importance criteria, i.e., deciding what to select, while typically fixing the selected data volume as the target ratio throughout training. Thus, they are often dynamic in sample identity but static in data volume. In this work, we revisit data selection from an optimization perspective and show that selected-data training induces an implicit regularization effect modulated by the instantaneous selection ratio. This reveals a key trade-off: lower ratios amplify selection-induced regularization, whereas higher ratios preserve data coverage and optimization fidelity. Motivated by this insight, we propose PODS, a Plug-and-play Oscillatory Data-volume Scheduling framework. Rather than introducing another sample-scoring metric, PODS serves as a lightweight module that dynamically schedules how much data to select over training. Under the target selection ratio, PODS alternates between low-ratio regularization phases and high-ratio recovery phases to exploit selection-induced regularization without sacrificing optimization stability. With its lightweight, ratio-level, and task-agnostic design, PODS is compatible with existing static and dynamic selection methods and broadly applicable across training paradigms. Experiments across various datasets, architectures, and tasks show that PODS consistently improves the efficiency-generalization trade-off, e.g., reducing ImageNet-1k training cost by 50% with improved accuracy and accelerating LLM instruction tuning by over 2x without performance degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文从优化视角重新审视数据选择问题，揭示选择比例对训练正则化效应的影响，提出PODS框架通过振荡调度选择比例（低比例正则化+高比例恢复）提升训练效率与泛化性能的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有数据选择方法主要关注设计样本重要性准则（即"选择什么"），但在训练全程保持固定的选择比例（即"选择多少"），这种方法在样本身份上是动态的，但在数据量上是静态的。
AI.method: 提出PODS（Plug-and-play Oscillatory Data-volume Scheduling）框架，在训练过程中动态调度选择比例，在低比例的正则化阶段和高比例的恢复阶段之间交替进行，从而利用选择诱导的正则化效应同时保证优化稳定性。该框架设计轻量、以比例为驱动、任务无关，可与现有静态和动态选择方法兼容。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、架构和任务上均取得一致改进：ImageNet-1k训练成本降低50%且精度提升；LLM指令微调加速超过2倍且无性能下降。
AI.conclusion: PODS作为一个轻量级、即插即用的框架，在保持与现有选择方法兼容的同时，通过振荡式调度数据量，在效率与泛化能力之间取得更好平衡。

title: Peng's Q($λ$) for Conservative Value Estimation in Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: We propose a model-free offline multi-step reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm, Conservative Peng's Q($λ$) (CPQL). Our algorithm adapts the Peng's Q($λ$) (PQL) operator for conservative value estimation as an alternative to the Bellman operator. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work in offline RL to theoretically and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of conservative value estimation with a \textit{multi-step} operator by fully leveraging offline trajectories. The fixed point of the PQL operator in offline RL lies closer to the value function of the behavior policy, thereby naturally inducing implicit behavior regularization. CPQL simultaneously mitigates over-pessimistic value estimation, achieves performance greater than (or equal to) that of the behavior policy, and provides near-optimal performance guarantees -- a milestone that previous conservative approaches could not achieve. Extensive numerical experiments on the D4RL benchmark demonstrate that CPQL consistently and significantly outperforms existing offline single-step baselines. In addition to the contributions of CPQL in offline RL, our proposed method also contributes to the offline-to-online learning framework. Using the Q-function pre-trained by CPQL in offline settings enables the online PQL agent to avoid the performance drop typically observed at the start of fine-tuning and to attain robust performance improvements. Our code is available at https://github.com/oh-lab/CPQL.

AI.tldr: CPQL是首个在理论上和实验上证明保守值估计与多步算子结合有效性的离线强化学习方法，通过PQL算子实现隐式行为正则化，同时克服过度悲观估计问题，在离线RL和离线到在线迁移学习中均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有离线强化学习中的保守方法存在过度悲观估计问题，无法实现优于行为策略的性能，也无法达到近乎最优的性能保证。核心挑战在于如何在缺乏在线交互的情况下有效利用离线轨迹进行值函数估计。
AI.method: 提出CPQL算法，将Peng's Q(λ)算子(PQL)适配为保守值估计，以替代传统的Bellman算子。PQL算子的不动点更接近行为策略的值函数，从而自然地引入隐式行为正则化。
AI.result: CPQL在D4RL基准测试中一致且显著地优于现有离线单步基线方法。在离线到在线学习框架中，使用CPQL预训练的Q函数能够避免微调初期的性能下降，实现稳健的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CPQL通过将保守值估计与多步算子相结合，为离线强化学习提供了一种有效的解决方案。该方法不仅在离线设置下显著优于现有基线，还能实现从离线到在线的平滑迁移，避免微调初期的性能下降。

title: Understanding Imbalanced Forgetting in Rehearsal-Based Class-Incremental Learning
comment: 37 pages; 24 tables; 7 figures; submitted to a journal
summary: Neural networks suffer from catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning (CIL) settings. Rehearsal$\unicode{x2013}$replaying a subset of past samples$\unicode{x2013}$is a well-established mitigation strategy. However, recent results suggest that, despite balanced rehearsal allocation, some classes are forgotten substantially more than others. Despite its relevance, this imbalanced forgetting phenomenon remains underexplored. This work shows that imbalanced forgetting arises systematically and severely in rehearsal-based CIL and investigates it extensively. Specifically, we construct, from a principled analysis, three last-layer coefficients that capture different gradient-level sources of interference affecting each past class during an incremental step. We then demonstrate that, together, they reliably predict how past classes will rank in terms of forgetting at the end of that step. While predictive performance alone does not establish causality, these results support the interpretation of the coefficients as a plausible mechanistic account linking last-layer gradient-level interactions during training to class-level forgetting outcomes. Notably, one coefficient$\unicode{x2013}$capturing self-induced interference$\unicode{x2013}$emerges as the strongest predictor, with controlled experiments providing evidence consistent with this coefficient being influenced by the new-class interference coefficient. Overall, our findings provide valuable insights and suggest promising directions for mitigating imbalanced forgetting by reducing class-wise disparities in the identified sources of interference.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了类别增量学习中不同类别遗忘程度不均衡的现象。通过构建三个最后一层系数来捕获训练过程中影响旧类别保持的梯度级干扰源，发现这些系数能可靠预测各类别的遗忘程度排序，其中自诱导干扰系数是最强预测因子，为缓解不平衡遗忘提供了新思路。
AI.motivation: 类别增量学习中存在严重的类别间不平衡遗忘现象，尽管已知使用均衡的复习样本分配策略，但仍无法有效缓解该问题，且该现象尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 从原理分析出发，构建了三个捕获不同梯度级干扰源的最后一层系数；通过受控实验验证这些系数与类别遗忘之间的关联性。
AI.result: 三个最后一层系数能够可靠地预测过去类别在增量步骤结束后的遗忘程度排序；其中捕捉自诱导干扰的系数是最强预测因子，且受新类别干扰系数的影响。
AI.conclusion: 提出了三个可用于预测类别遗忘程度的最后一层系数，其中自诱导干扰系数是最强预测因子；研究为通过减少类别间干扰差异来缓解不平衡遗忘提供了有价值的方向。

title: GFMate: Empowering Graph Foundation Models with Test-time Prompt Tuning
summary: Graph prompt tuning has shown great potential in graph learning by introducing trainable prompts to enhance the model performance in conventional single-domain scenarios. Recent research has extended graph prompts to improve Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) by few-shot tuning auxiliary prompts. Despite their progress, most existing methods embed source-domain information into prompts, which serve either as input to GFMs or encoded during model pre-training. Such prompt entanglement with specific source domains and GFM pre-training strategy restricts their generalisability to other domains and different GFMs. Furthermore, existing GFM prompts merely rely on few-shot tuning for adaptation, neglecting the rich information in unlabelled target domain test data. Motivated by these insights, this paper aims to empower GFMs with pre-training-agnostic test-time graph prompt tuning, named GFMate. GFMate introduces centroid and layer prompts applied after pre-training on target domains, avoiding entanglement with specific source domains and model pre-training. In addition, a test-time complementary learning objective is devised to exploit both labelled and unlabelled target domain data for effective test-time prompt tuning. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance and efficiency of GFMate, achieving improvements of up to 30.63%. Code is available at https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/GFMate.

AI.tldr: GFMate是一种预训练无关的测试时图提示调优框架，通过质心提示和层提示以及测试时互补学习目标，使图基础模型能够有效适应下游任务，同时避免与源域和预训练策略的纠缠。
AI.motivation: 现有图提示方法存在两个主要局限：(1) 提示与特定源域信息和GFM预训练策略绑定，限制了其跨领域和跨模型的泛化能力；(2) 现有GFM提示仅依赖少样本微调进行适配，忽视了大量未标记目标域测试数据的丰富信息。
AI.method: 提出GFMate方法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 质心提示(Centroid prompts)和层提示(Layer prompts)，应用于预训练后阶段，避免与特定源域和模型预训练策略的纠缠；(2) 测试时互补学习目标，利用目标域的标记和未标记数据进行有效的提示调整。
AI.result: GFMate在12个基准数据集上展现了优异的性能和效率，实现了最高30.63%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: GFMate通过预训练无关的测试时图提示调整，显著提升了GFM的适应性和性能，在12个数据集上实现了最高30.63%的性能提升，同时保持了较高的计算效率。

title: ToMAToMP: Robust and Multi-Parameter Topological Clustering
summary: Topological clustering, and its main algorithm ToMATo, is a clustering method from Topological Data Analysis (TDA) which has been applied successfully in several applications during the last few years. This is due to its high versatility, as clusters are detected from the persistent components in the sublevel sets of any user-defined function (gene expression, pixel values, etc), and efficiency, as topological clustering enjoys robustness guarantees. However, ToMATo is also limited in several ways. First, a graph on the data points needs to be provided as a hyper-parameter of the method (whose fine-tuning is left to the user). Second, ToMATo is known to be very sensitive to outlier values in the function range. Finally, and most importantly, ToMATo can only handle one function at a time, whereas it is critical to use several functions in various applications. In this article, we introduce ToMAToMP: the first topological clustering method able to handle several functions at the same time with theoretical guarantees. More specifically, we leverage a recent tool from multi-parameter persistent homology, called MMA decomposition, to design our clustering algorithm, and prove that it enjoys robustness properties. As corollaries, we show that it can be used to make ToMATo independent of graph tuning, and robust to outliers. Finally, we provide a set of numerical experiments showcasing the efficiency and quality of the clusterings produced by ToMAToMP, by showing strong improvement over non-topological and topological baselines for various datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToMAToMP，一种基于多参数持续同调MMA分解的新型拓扑聚类方法，解决原ToMATo方法的图定义依赖、异常值敏感和单函数限制三大问题。
AI.motivation: ToMATo方法存在三个主要局限：需要用户定义图作为超参数、对函数值中的异常值敏感、只能处理单一函数。而在许多实际应用中，同时使用多个函数至关重要。
AI.method: 利用多参数持续同调中的MMA分解来设计聚类算法，证明该方法具有鲁棒性理论保证，并可扩展ToMATo的功能。
AI.result: ToMAToMP成为首个能够同时处理多个函数的拓扑聚类方法，具有理论鲁棒性保证，可独立于图调优并对异常值具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过数值实验验证了ToMAToMP的有效性，在多个数据集上相比非拓扑和拓扑基线方法表现出显著改进。

title: GenAI for Energy-Efficient and Interference-Aware Compressed Sensing of GNSS Signals on a Google Edge TPU
summary: Traditional methods for classifying global navigation satellite system (GNSS) jamming signals typically involve post-processing raw or spectral data streams, requiring complex and costly data transmission to cloud-based interference classification systems. In contrast, our proposed approach efficiently compresses GNSS data streams directly at the hardware receiver while simultaneously classifying jamming and spoofing attacks in real time. Given the growing prevalence of GNSS jamming, there is a critical need for real-time solutions suitable for power-constrained environments. This paper introduces a novel method for compressing and classifying GNSS jamming threats using generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), specifically variational autoencoders (VAEs), deployed on Google Edge tensor processing units (TPUs). The study evaluates various autoencoder (AE) architectures to compress and reconstruct GNSS signals, focusing on preserving interference characteristics while minimizing data size near the receiver hardware. The pipeline adapts large-scale AE models for Google Edge TPUs through 8-bit quantization to ensure energy-efficient deployment. Tests on raw in-phase and quadrature-phase (IQ) data, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) data, and handcrafted features show the system achieves significant compression (>42x) and accurate classification of approximately 72 interference types on reconstructed signals (F2-score 0.915), closely matching the original signals (F2-score 0.923). The hardware-centric GenAI approach also substantially reduces jammer signal transmission costs, offering a practical solution for interference mitigation. Ablation studies on conditional and factorized VAEs (i.e., FactorVAE) explore latent feature disentanglement for data generation, enhancing model interpretability and fostering trust in machine learning (ML) solutions for sensitive interference applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于生成式人工智能（GenAI）的GNSS干扰压缩与分类方法，使用变分自编码器（VAE）在Google Edge TPU上进行8位量化部署，实现超过42倍的压缩率和72种干扰类型的准确分类（F2=0.915），同时通过因子化VAE探索潜在特征解耦以增强模型可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统GNSS干扰信号分类方法依赖原始或频谱数据的后处理，需要复杂的数传系统将数据传输至云端进行干扰分类，成本高且时效性差。随着GNSS干扰事件的日益增多，亟需适合功耗受限环境的实时干扰检测与分类解决方案。
AI.method: 该研究采用变分自编码器（VAE）实现GNSS数据流的压缩与分类，在Google Edge TPU上通过8位量化技术实现适配。针对不同自编码器架构进行了评估，包括条件VAE和因子化VAE（FactorVAE），以研究潜在特征解耦对数据生成的影响。测试基于原始IQ数据、FFT数据及手工特征三种输入形式。
AI.result: 系统在重构信号上实现了约72种干扰类型的准确分类（F2分数0.915），压缩率超过42倍，重构信号与原始信号高度匹配（F2分数0.923）。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的硬件中心GenAI方法显著降低了干扰信号传输成本，为干扰缓解提供了实用解决方案。因子化变分自编码器（FactorVAE）的消融研究探索了潜在特征解耦，增强了模型可解释性，有助于在敏感干扰应用中建立对机器学习方案的信任。

title: In-Context Learning for Data-Driven Censored Inventory Control
summary: We study inventory control with decision-dependent censoring, focusing on the censored or repeated newsvendor (R-NV), where each order quantity determines whether demand is fully observed or censored by sales. Existing approaches based on parametric Thompson sampling (TS) can be brittle under prior mismatch, while offline imputation methods need not transfer to online learning. Motivated by the predictive view of decision making, we combine these ideas by taking oracle actions on learned completions of latent demand. We propose in-context generative posterior sampling (ICGPS), which uses modern generative models that are meta-trained offline and deployed online by in-context autoregressive generation. Theoretically, we show that the Bayesian regret of ICGPS with a learned completion kernel is bounded by the Bayesian regret of a TS benchmark with the ideal completion kernel plus a deployment penalty scaling as $\sqrt{T}$ times the square root of the completion mismatch. This yields a plug-in template for operational problems with known TS regret bounds. For R-NV, we derive sublinear Bayesian regret by reducing censored feedback to bandit convex optimization feedback. We also show that, under reasonable coverage and stability assumptions, the online completion mismatch is controlled by the offline censored predictive mismatch, so offline predictive quality transfers to online performance. Practically, we instantiate ICGPS with ChronosFlow, which combines a frozen time-series transformer backbone with a trainable conditional normalizing-flow head for fast censoring-consistent sampling. In benchmark experiments, ChronosFlow-ICGPS matches correctly specified TS, outperforms myopic and UCB-style baselines, and is robust to prior mismatch and distribution shift. ChronosFlow-ICGPS also performs well for the real-world SuperStore dataset, especially under heavy censoring.

AI.tldr: 针对决策依赖右删失的重复报童模型（R-NV），本文提出「上下文生成式后验采样」（ICGPS）：离线元训练一个可按删失约束自回归采样隐含需求补全轨迹的生成模型，在线冻结参数、仅靠上下文条件化对潜在需求轨迹做补全，再在补全轨迹上取关键分位数（oracle）作为订货量。理论上给出「部署惩罚」型遗憾分解：ICGPS 的贝叶斯遗憾 ≤ 理想 TS 基准遗憾 + O(√T)·√(完成核失配)；并证明 R-NV 上 TS 本身有 Õ(√T) 贝叶斯遗憾（在覆盖性与自收缩假设下，离线删失感知预测失配可控制在线完成失配）。实证上以 ChronosFlow（冻结 Chronos-2 主干 + Kaplan–Meier 模块 + 条件归一化流头）实例化，在正确设定下与共轭 TS 打平，优于 Myopic/UCB，对先验失配与分布漂移更稳健，并在 SuperStore 真实数据重删失下表现最优。
AI.motivation: 重复/删失报童（R-NV）中，订货量决定观测：缺货时只能观测到销量，需求被右删失，形成探索—利用张力。现有两条路线各有硬伤：参数化 Thompson 采样（TS）在先验失配下脆弱（ Xu & Zeevi 2025）；离线去删失/插补方法（Clausen & Larsen 2025）缺乏在线保证、难迁移到在线交互。作者受「预测视角的决策」（missing-data / 缺失数据视角）启发：若能从真后验采样一条与反馈机制一致的完整轨迹补全（completion），再在补全数据上取 oracle 动作，即等价于后验采样。Cai et al. (2024)、Zhang et al. (2025a) 的 in-context GPS 已实现这一范式，但仅限有限离散动作与无删失反馈；本文将其推广到连续标量动作空间与决策依赖删失的连续动作、连续状态类运营问题（容量控制、预算节奏、定价等），并需要理论上给出「用学习到的补全模型替代真核」的代价量化。
AI.method:
方法论（三层）：(1) 框架 ICGPS（Alg.1）：离线元训练条件生成模型 p_θ(·|h)，在线每期从 p_θ(·|H_{t-1}) 自回归采样完整需求轨迹补全 D̃_{1:T}，再用 oracle x̂(·)（R-NV 中为经验 γ-分位数，γ=b/(b+h)）决策；全程无在线梯度更新，适配仅靠上下文条件化。(2) 删失感知学习与采样：离线用删失似然 NLL（未删失取密度项 −log f_θ(S|h)，删失取生存项 −log(1−F_θ(X|h))，Lemma 2/3.2.1）；在线用尾部条件化（Lemma 3：Π(D≤z|D>x)=(F(z)−F(x))/(1−F(x))）保证补全满足硬约束（C_s=1⇒D̃_s=S_s；C_s=0⇒D̃_s>X_s，Alg.2）。(3) 连续动作理论化：证明「结果采样」与「函数采样」等价（Lemma 4 pushforward），使后验采样可对接 bandit convex optimization 文献。(4) 实例化 ChronosFlow：冻结（i.i.d. 实验可微调）Chronos-2 主干输出分位网格 + Kaplan–Meier 生存估计分位 + 汇总统计 → 44 维上下文向量；轻量超网络驱动单调分段线性条件归一化流头（提供 F_θ 与逆 CDF），用删失 NLL 训练；ICGPS 采样器每期采 M 条补全、取 oracle 中位数决策，T0=3 轮预热（订 B）。

理论：(1) 定理1（部署惩罚）：在有界增量、历史无关可预测漂移、似然比有界 V_comp 假设下，BayesReg_T(π_θ) ≤ BayesReg_T(π_*) + B'√(T(2+log V_comp)/2 · Δ^comp_T(θ;π_θ))，其中两项均在同一真实环境 P* 下评估（不同于 Zhang et al. 2025a 的反事实基准），因此可直接「插拔」任何已知 TS 遗憾结果。(2) 定理2：理想 GPS（=TS）在 R-NV 上 BayesReg = Õ(√T)，通过把删失反馈归约为一维 BCO 反馈——风险等价目标 g_P(x)=(h+b)E[(x−D)^+]−bx，辅助随机化 U_t~Unif([0,X_t])、Z_t=1{D_t≤U_t}（可由 (S,C,U) 计算），得无偏可观测反馈 Y_t=(h+b)X_tZ_t−bX_t，g_P 凸、L=max{h,b}-Lipschitz、有界，归一化后套用 Bakhtiari et al. (2025) TS 的 Õ(√T) 界。(3) 定理3：在最大序覆盖 P(X_t=B|h)≥η 与 AR 自收缩 δ_s(h)≤(c_sc/s)d(h) 假设下，Δ^comp_T ≤ ((1+c_sc log T)/η)·Δ^obs_T，且 Δ^obs_T 等于超额删失感知对数损失（Lemma 21），从而离线预测质量可转为在线性能。(4) 推论1：BayesReg_T(π_θ) ≤ Õ(√T) + Ψ√(T log T·Δ^obs_T)。
AI.result: 理论：(1) 定理1给出遗憾分解 BayesReg(π_θ) ≤ BayesReg(π_*) + B'√(T(2+log V_comp)/2·Δ^comp_T)，证明技术包括 Donsker–Varadhan 换测度、有界适应鞅差 MGF 界、Hellinger 对称性把反向 KL 化为正向 KL；该式是可直接移植任意 TS 遗憾结果的通用模板。(2) 定理2首次用信息比框架给出 R-NV 上 TS 的 Õ(√T) 贝叶斯遗憾（经 BCO 归约，Lemma 16–20）。(3) 定理3表明在覆盖性与自收缩假设下，完成失配被删失感知预测失配控制（系数 (1+c_sc log T)/η，η 为可辨识性代价），给出离线→在线迁移的充分条件。(4) 推论1得 ICGPS 总遗憾 Õ(√T)+Ψ√(T log T·Δ^obs)。实证：(Q1) Weibull 正确设定下 ChronosFlow-ICGPS 与共轭 TS–Weibull 打平或略优，显著优于 Myopic 与 UCB（γ=0.5 重删失下差距最大，γ 增大后缩小）；(Q2) 固定在线包装、仅变离线数据规模与 CNF 容量，删失感知验证 NLL（Δ̂_obs）与在线终局遗憾呈单调对应，数据规模扫描最清晰，容量扫描更弱且偶有非单调；(Q3) 分布族漂移（在 4 族混合上预训练、测试 Weibull）与严重先验失配（训练 λ∈[0.2,0.4],k∈[0.8,1.2]，测试 λ*=0.8,k=2.0）下，参数化 TS 明显脆弱，ChronosFlow-ICGPS 稳定且大幅降低遗憾，γ=0.5 时有较大冷启动偏移但无持续增长；(Q4) SuperStore 真实数据（Technology/Office Supplies/Furniture 三类，λ 越小删失越重）上，Meta 变体在重删失区最优（Furniture λ=1：4.1 对 RCN 19.8、SAA 16.0；Technology λ=3：4.2），Meta 跨 λ 更稳定（Office Supplies λ=15：12.8 对 Native 18.2），轻删失时与基线差距缩小。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，在决策依赖右删失下，隐含需求可视为「缺失结果」，用生成模型在上下文中补全并据此取 oracle 动作，可把连续动作、删失反馈的运营问题纳入后验采样框架，并获得可解释的遗憾保证：理想 TS 基准（对 R-NV 为 Õ(√T)，经 BCO 归约）+ 与完成失配相关的部署惩罚；该惩罚在覆盖性与自收缩条件下可由离线可观测的删失感知预测损失控制，因此离线建模质量确实转化为在线决策质量。核心局限与代价：需要 max-order 覆盖（持续以概率 η 选满订量 B）以打破删失带来的尾部不可辨识性，需要 AR 自收缩以防误差沿自回归补全累积，且部署惩罚仍随 √T 增长；实验显示容量并非越大越好，离线拟合与在线遗憾的关系在重删失下更弱。作者提出的后续方向：扩展到含天气、价格、文本等特征的上下文化 R-NV，以及利用非平稳 BCO 处理需求漂移。

title: GPart: End-to-End Isometric Fine-Tuning via Global Parameter Partitioning
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of large language models (LLMs). However, its bilinear structure introduces a critical limitation: the mapping from trainable parameters to weight updates is not distance-preserving, distorting the optimization landscape. Methods that project a low-dimensional vector into LoRA's parameter space, such as Uni-LoRA, improve parameter efficiency, but the subsequent bilinear LoRA map breaks end-to-end isometry, leaving the core distance-preservation problem unresolved. We propose GPart (Global Partition fine-tuning), a highly parameter-efficient fine-tuning method which removes the low-rank bottleneck entirely. Our method uses a single isometric partition matrix to map a $d$-dimensional trainable vector directly into the full weight space of the model. The result is an extremely minimal fine-tuning pipeline: one random projection, end-to-end isometric, with a single clean hyperparameter ($d$) and storage cost of $d+1$ values (the trainable vector plus a random seed). GPart builds on the theoretical premise that effective fine-tuning can emerge from random low-dimensional subspaces of the full weight space, without imposing low-rank matrix structure. We empirically demonstrate the superior or comparable performance of GPart to existing PEFT methods on natural language understanding, computer vision tasks, and mathematical reasoning. Overall, GPart achieves state-of-the-art efficiency and performance by removing structural constraints, offering a straightforward and elegant path to PEFT.

AI.tldr: GPart是一种新型参数高效微调方法，通过移除低秩瓶颈（而非改进低秩结构）来解决LoRA的距离保持问题。它使用单个等距分区矩阵实现端到端等距映射，仅需一个随机投影，存储成本极低(d+1个值)，在多个任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: LoRA的双线性结构引入关键限制：可训练参数到权重更新的映射不保持距离，扭曲了优化景观。虽然Uni-LoRA等方法通过投影低维向量改进参数效率，但后续的双线性LoRA映射仍破坏端到端等距性，核心的距离保持问题未解决。
AI.method: GPart使用单个等距分区矩阵将d维可训练向量直接映射到模型的完整权重空间，包含一个随机投影层，全程保持端到端等距性，仅有一个超参数d，存储成本仅为d+1个值。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解、计算机视觉和数学推理任务上，GPart表现出优越或可比于现有PEFT方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: GPart通过移除结构约束，实现了最先进的参数效率和性能，提供了一条通往PEFT的直接而优雅的路径。

title: XFP: Quality-Targeted Adaptive Codebook Quantization with Sparse Outlier Separation for LLM Inference
summary: We introduce XFP, a dynamic weight quantizer for LLM inference that inverts the conventional workflow: the operator specifies reconstruction quality floors on per-channel cosine similarity (one strict floor for attention and shared experts, one lazy floor for routed-expert MoE); XFP determines codebook size, outlier budget, and packing per layer automatically -- no Hessian, no calibration data, no manual bit-width selection. Each weight matrix is decomposed into a sparse fp16 outlier residual and a dense sub-byte index tensor into a per-group learned codebook. Two storage modes share one auto-select frontend and one fused decode kernel: V2 (per-channel Lloyd) and V2a (shared library of L=32 codebooks per layer). On Qwen3.5-122B-A10B under V2, XFP reaches 138 tok/s single-stream decode on workstation hardware (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, TP=2) at 94.49% GSM8K strict-match (3 seeds, n=3957), and is 49% faster than Marlin INT4 at TP=1. For models that do not fit in the target memory envelope, we present the H-Process: a quality-driven iteration over the two cosine thresholds that finds the operating point at which the model just fits while still producing sensible output. Three constraints define its search space: the operator-set thresholds, an OOM boundary at quantize-on-load, and a garbage boundary in generation (cosine similarity steers; benches verify). On Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (512 routed experts/layer), the H-Process fits the full expert population into 2x96 GB at ~3.4 effective bits and delivers 100.9 tok/s long-output decode at 66.72% GSM8K strict-match on the full 1319-problem set (single seed at submission; multi-seed evaluation in progress), exceeding INT4 with routed-expert pruning on memory, throughput, and accuracy simultaneously.

AI.tldr: XFP 是一种面向工作站级 GPU 上大模型推理的动态权重量化格式：运营者只需给出每通道余弦相似度的质量下限（注意力/共享专家用严格阈值 τ_strict，路由专家 MoE 用宽松阈值 τ_lazy），XFP 自行逐层决定码本大小、离群点预算与亚字节打包方式，全程无需 Hessian、无需校准数据、无需手选位宽。权重被分解为稀疏 fp16 离群残差 + 指向按组学习码本的稠密亚字节索引张量；提供 V2（逐通道 Lloyd 码本）与 V2a（每层 L=32 共享码本库）两种存储模式，共享同一自动选择前端与同一融合解码内核。在 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B（RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, TP=2）下 V2 达到 138 tok/s 单流解码、GSM8K strict-match 94.49%（3 seeds, n=3957），TP=1 时比 Marlin INT4 快 49%；针对放不下的 397B MoE，提出 H-Process——以两个余弦阈值迭代搜索"刚好装下且输出可读"的运行点，在 2×96GB 上以约 3.4 有效比特容纳全部 512 路由专家/层，100.9 tok/s 长输出解码、GSM8K strict 66.72%（1319 题单 seed）。
AI.motivation:
动机来自一次具体的部署失败：作者在 2×96GB 的 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上尝试服务 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（MoE，512 路由专家/层），未压缩权重超 700GB，INT4 虽能装下但 KV cache 被挤占、上下文受限，且统一 4bit 的质量损失显著；进一步尝试激进化量化与专家剪枝后发现，低于某压缩阈值输出质量直接崩塌。作者的关键问题不是"如何量化"（GPTQ/AWQ 已解决），而是"为什么 4bit 的质量损失如此之大"。

作者给出的答案是：现有格式把一切塞进同一套表示模板——线性 INT-N 用单尺度因子适配幅度变化，对数型 NVFP4 用全模型通用的固定 16 项码本，attention 与 routed expert 无论分布形态（GLM-4.7-Flash 的 kv_a_proj 有 49σ 的灾难性离群点，而 routed expert 近乎紧致高斯）都获得同一码本，导致离群层浪费表示预算、良性层被过度配置。SM120/SM121 工作站级 Blackwell 又拿不到 NVFP4 的 Tensor Core 加速（需社区打补丁 vLLM/FlashInfer/CUTLASS，且 grouped-GEMM MoE 路径仍不完整，甚至慢于 Marlin INT4 回退），因此"有硬件加速的通用码本"与"用不上硬件加速的通用码本"在工作站层级都不可取。

由此形成三个结构性问题：P1 离群点问题（重尾分布使线性量化在 N=2 时主体几乎只剩一个可用非零电平）；P2 MoE 异质性问题（路由专家对粗量化的容忍度显著高于 attention/共享专家，单一全局阈值无法利用这一不对称）；P3 码本存储问题（逐通道码本占用随输出维度线性增长的 SMEM，在 99KB SMEM/CTA 的工作站 GPU 上迫使过早 split-K，限制了单流解码可承载的模型规模）。设计原则因此被反转为"质量作为约束"：位宽成为逐层导出量，而非人工指定；离群残差成为保证质量下限的结构性互补件而非启发式附加。
AI.method:
方法层面，XFP 建立在 vLLM 的组件级量化引擎 MultiQuant 之上，按组件类别（attention、routed experts、shared experts、LM head）注册独立精度策略，这一分组件架构是 2~3bit 可行的前提。

格式定义：W ≈ W_outlier + Codebook[Q_bulk]。离群提取按 |w-μ|>kσ（k=4.0，上限 2%）抽取高幅值权重为稀疏 fp16 残差（row/col int64 + fp16 值 = 18 B/离群点），抽取位置以 μ 填充主体。码本由 20 轮 Lloyd 迭代（分配 + 条件均值更新）在去离群后的主体分布上学习，初始化用 CDF 分位点，存为 fp16。存储布局：V2 为逐通道独立 fp16 码本（2^N 项/输出通道，N∈{2,3,4,5,6}）；V2a 为每层 L=32 个码本的共享库 + 5bit 的 128 权重组→库索引分配，开销约 0.31 bit/weight，N∈{2,4}，有效位宽约 2.31 / 4.31。

亚字节打包在 uint32/uint16 字内完成（V2：N=2→16值/字、N=3→10、N=4→8、N=5→uint16 3值、N=6→5值），并有 warp 级约束 LANES_PER_GROUP=group_size/values_per_word 须为整数且 32 可整除，因此在 g=128 下 V2a 只支持 N∈{2,4}（N=3 需 g=80 路径，留待后续）。V2a 的动机是 SMEM：L=32、N=4 的库恒占 32×16×2B=1KB，与维度无关，从而把单 CTA 激活行缓存从 K≤8192 扩到 K≤32768，免去 split-K 代价；库学习用 LibFit——先收集逐通道 Lloyd 码本，再对码本本身做第二遍 Lloyd 凝聚成 32 个代表码本，每组按 per-group scale 与 mid-point 重新索引到最近库项。

自动选择（Algorithm 1）先提离群得 W_bulk，按组件类别取阈值（MoE routed 用 τ_lazy，否则 τ_strict），按升序遍历候选 N（V2={2,3,4}，V2a={2,4}），对每个 N 学习码本、重建、计算逐通道余弦相似度并取 median，命中阈值即返回该 N，全部失败则回退到 max(N)。选择用余弦而非 MSE 的理由是 MSE 幅值敏感而余弦方向敏感，GEMM 中激活可通过归一化吸收幅值缩放；实证上 XFP2 在 routed expert 上 MSE 比 XFP4 高 12 倍但数学准确率相同。MoE 层用 4 个拼接专家做采样（离线验证：GLM 64 专家 0% 不一致、Qwen-35B 256 专家 0%、Qwen-122B 11.5% 且无数学影响）；V2a 的 MoE-LibFit 需更高 Lloyd 迭代预算（XFP_MOE_LLOYD_ITERS=20 vs V2 默认 5），否则欠收敛质心会系统性低估 xfp2 质量并偏向 xfp4。

双阈值机制是核心创新：早期单阈值 τ=0.98 在 35B/122B 上可行，因为候选集含中间档 N=3 使 routed 落 xfp3、attention 升 xfp4；V2a 去掉 N=3 后坍缩为 2.31 vs 4.31 bit 的二元选择，单阈值将迫使 100% xfp4（2×96GB 装不下）或近乎 100% xfp2（数学崩溃）。因此 τ_strict（attention/线性 attention/共享专家，默认 0.96）与 τ_lazy（路由专家，默认 0.93）解耦两种区间，阈值差成为运营者在固定部署目标上调内存/质量的唯一旋钮（环境变量 XFP_MIN_COS_STRICT / XFP_MIN_COS_LAZY）。

融合解码内核在每层前向融合四步：N-bit 解包到 int8、从 SMEM 做码本 gather、稀疏离群 scatter-add（fp16→bf16）、bf16 Tensor Core GEMM；码本每 CTA 载入一次 SMEM 一次，使内核位宽无关（N=2~6 同一 gather 路径）。原生 bf16 输入输出消除早期原型中 bf16→fp16→bf16 转换带来的 124% 单次调用开销；以 torch.library.custom_op 包装以兼容 torch.compile 与 CUDA Graph。M=1 解码时把整行 K 维激活缓存在 SMEM，迭代输出组时对缓存行做码本查表，消除重复全局访存（M=1 下的主导流量）。K>8192 时 V2 走 split-K（跨 CTA 分 partitioning，代价约 10~20% 单流延迟，397B 的线性 attention 投影走此路径）；V2a 提供免 split-K 的替代方案。离群点与码本的存储权衡给出盈亏平衡式 0.375+18y = 0.5+0.02×18 ⇒ y=2.7%，说明默认 2% 上限接近最优。

H-Process（Front B）是把格式变成"过程"的部分：对 (τ_strict, τ_lazy) 从激进向保守迭代，由三条约束界定搜索空间——运营者设定的阈值对、quantize-on-load 阶段的 OOM 边界（由编码期 Lloyd 尖峰而非稳态占用决定，故调 KV cache / max_model_len / gpu_memory_utilization 均无效）、以及生成层的"垃圾输出"边界（余弦数值上通过却退化为重复 token，说明余弦只是导向指标而非质量保证）。两条硬边界之间的窗口极窄且高度非线性：τ_lazy=0.80 时 routed 几乎全塌到 xfp2（2.3 bit）输出退化；τ_lazy=0.935 时已有足够多 routed 组升到 xfp4，编码尖峰越过 96GB 导致 3 次 OOM；τ_lazy=0.92 得 72 GiB/GPU、probe 52%；τ_lazy=0.93（H1.5）得 83 GiB/GPU、约 3.4 有效比特、n=50 probe 60%、全量 1319 题 GSM8K strict 66.72%。
AI.result:
Front A（质量验证部署，V2）：Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 在 TP=2 下 138 tok/s 单流解码、GSM8K flex 94.41±0.57、strict 94.49±0.57（3 seeds×1319 题），有效位宽约 3.97，57/96 GiB 显存，双卡 GPU 利用率各 98%、功耗 240W（远低于 600W TDP，说明瓶颈在 kernel launch 而非算力）。TP=1 时 XFP 110 tok/s vs Marlin INT4（AutoRound）73.6 tok/s，+49%；精度 94.62±0.67 vs 95.27±0.12，差距约 0.65pp 落在 3-seed 标准差（0.67pp）内，两者同处 94–95% 区间；TP=2 时 XFP 138 tok/s，相对 Marlin TP=1 为 +87%。跨平台：DGX Spark（SM121）单卡上 XFP 长/中输出分别 +16%/+18%，短输出持平。35B-A3B 在 TP=1 为 37 tok/s、77.18±0.72。GLM-4.7-Flash 自动选择收敛为 attention 233 层 xfp3 + 2 层 xfp4、46 组 routed 全 xfp3、92 层共享全 xfp3，总体约 3.0 有效比特。离群点消融（GLM, XFP3）：attention kv_a_proj 的 bulk 余弦 0.981→0.990、MSE 比 1.90×；而 routed_gate_up/routed_down 仅 +0.0003、MSE 比 1.02×，即离群分离对 attention 决定性、对 routed 近乎无益；跨模型看 GLM 的离群点集中在 kv_a_proj（49σ），Qwen 尾部更分散，Qwen 的 routed expert 对离群提取响应强 6.7×。

Front B（H-Process，V2 + split-K）：Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（60 层、512 路由专家/层、BF16 约 795GB）在 2×96GB 上以约 3.4 有效比特保留全部专家，稳态 83 GiB/GPU，编码尖峰 97 GiB；解码 73.4 tok/s（短）/98.2（中）/100.9（长，1500 token，n=5）。H1.5 下 auto-select 对 100% 的 self-attention、linear-attention 与共享专家投影取 xfp4，路由专家组多数取 xfp2，xfp4 升级集中在第 1–3 层（GatedDeltaNet 过渡区）与第 13 层，跨运行稳定。对比 AutoRound INT4 + REAP 式路由专家剪枝：RIY 剪 24% 得 80 GiB/GPU、n=50 probe 44%、约 50 tok/s；RIY 剪 36% 得 75 GiB、36%、约 50 tok/s；XFP H1 得 72 GiB、52%、约 65 tok/s——即在内存、吞吐、精度三个维度同时优于剪枝方案，且不删除任何专家。硬件外推：H1 在 2×96GB 上余 6 GiB/卡，H1.5 几乎零余量；H100 80GB TP=2 两种档位均不可行，H200 141GB TP=2 预计余约 51 GiB 可从容服务 H1.5；DGX Spark 单机统一内存 120GB 在当前位宽下不可行。

V2a 探针（bench.py, n=50, TP=1）：Qwen-35B 204.0 tok/s（90%）、Qwen-122B 108.1 tok/s（96%，较 Marlin +47%）、GLM-4.7-Flash 118.1 tok/s（68%，较 Marlin 121.1 慢约 2.5%）。编码成本：自动选择本身 <1 分钟；完整 quantize-on-load 在 V2 下 35B 约 10 分钟、122B 约 25 分钟，V2a 下 122B 约 30 分钟、397B 约 55 分钟（RTX PRO 6000），打包权重缓存到磁盘后加载为 I/O 受限。MoE 采样验证：178 个 MoE block 中实时位宽决策与离线预测 100% 一致。稳健性检查：Qwen-35B-A3B 的 bf16 与 fp8 KV/LM-head 基线为 76.12% vs 76.35%（Δ0.2pp，fp8 路径精度中性）。
AI.conclusion:
结论认为 XFP 的贡献不在于格式本身（自动选择前端、融合内核、两种存储模式只是手段），而在于把"工作站在家级部署大模型"这一目标变成可达路径：不需要数据中心后端、不依赖迟迟未落地且在本层级仍不完整的 NVFP4 Tensor Core 加速。其定位取舍清晰——放弃 Hessian 方法在给定位宽下的率失真最优性，换取"以质量下限为输入、自动求出满足它的最小压缩"的机制，并附带一个固定位宽格式无法提供的质量旋钮；代价是每组码本开销与 Lloyd 编码时间，作者明确将"选 XFP 还是选统一量化"定位为部署决策而非基准裁决。

作者亦给出方法论上颇为克制的一点警示：余弦相似度是导向指标而非质量保证，"垃圾输出"边界严格存在于"余弦通过"区域内部，因此最终质量必须由 bench 验证而非指标推断——"余弦负责导向，bench 负责验证"，这两者被同时交到运营者手中。

局限与展望亦交代清楚：内核为单用户低延迟参考实现，并发 ≥8 时 per-call launch 开销无法摊薄、吞吐崩塌，批处理服务明确不在本文范围；V2 在 99KB SMEM 的工作站层受 K≤8192 限制（V2a 可解到 32768，split-K 亦可但代价 10~20%）；无 Hessian 反馈（Hessian 加权 Lloyd 为计划扩展）；Lloyd 初始化抖动在 50 题 bench.py 上带来 ±8pp 数学方差（1319 题 3 seeds 下 GSM8K 跨 seed std 降至 0.57%）；评测仅覆盖 GSM8K，MMLU 等推理套件待扩展；服务器级 A100/H100 未纳入评测（作者认为无法体现目标 memory-bound 区间）；V2a 的 N=3 需 g=80 打包路径，留待后续。需要注意的是，397B 的 H1.5 精度数据（66.72%）为投稿时单 seed，multi-seed 评测仍在进行中，这一关键数字的稳健性尚待确认。

title: Exploitation of Hidden Context in Dynamic Movement Forecasting: A Neural Network Journey from Recurrent to Graph Neural Networks and General Purpose Transformers
summary: Forecasting within signal processing pipelines is crucial for mitigating delays, particularly in predicting the dynamic movements of objects such as NBA players. This task poses significant challenges due to the inherently interactive and unpredictable nature of sports, where abrupt changes in velocity and direction are prevalent. Traditional approaches, including (S)ARIMA(X), Kalman filters (KF), and Particle filters (PF), often struggle to model the non-linear dynamics present in such scenarios. Machine learning (ML) methods, such as long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, graph neural networks (GNNs), and Transformers, offer greater flexibility and accuracy but frequently fail to explicitly capture the interplay between temporal dependencies and contextual interactions, which are critical in chaotic sports environments. In this paper, we evaluate these models and assess their strengths and weaknesses. Experimental results reveal key performance trade-offs across input history length, generalizability, and the ability to incorporate contextual information. ML-based methods demonstrated substantial improvements over linear models across forecast horizons of up to 2s. Among the tested architectures, our hybrid LSTM augmented with contextual information achieved the lowest final displacement error (FDE) of 1.51m, outperforming temporal convolutional neural network (TCNN), graph attention network (GAT), and Transformers, while also requiring less data and training time compared to GAT and Transformers. Our findings indicate that no single architecture excels across all metrics, emphasizing the need for task-specific considerations in trajectory prediction for fast-paced, dynamic environments such as NBA gameplay.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了NBA球员轨迹预测中传统统计模型与深度学习模型的性能，发现混合LSTM架构结合上下文信息表现最佳，最终位移误差达1.51m，但无单一架构在所有指标上均最优，需根据具体任务选择模型。
AI.motivation: Forecasting is crucial for mitigating delays in signal processing pipelines, especially for predicting dynamic movements of NBA players. Traditional statistical models fail to capture non-linear dynamics; existing ML methods often lack explicit modeling of temporal dependencies and contextual interactions.
AI.method: Compared traditional methods ((S)ARIMA(X), KF, PF) with ML methods (LSTM, TCNN, GAT, Transformers); evaluated performance across different input history lengths and contextual information incorporation; hybrid LSTM with contextual augmentation achieved best FDE.
AI.result: Hybrid LSTM with contextual information achieved lowest final displacement error (FDE) of 1.51m, outperforming TCNN, GAT, and Transformers; ML methods substantially outperformed linear models up to 2s forecast horizon; trade-offs exist between history length, generalizability, and contextual incorporation.
AI.conclusion: No single architecture excels across all metrics, emphasizing the need for task-specific considerations in trajectory prediction for fast-paced, dynamic environments such as NBA gameplay.

title: REALM: Retrospective Encoder Alignment for LFP Modeling
summary: Spike activity has been the dominant neural signal for behavior decoding due to its high spatial and temporal resolution. However, as brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) move toward high channel counts and wireless operation, the high sampling frequency of spike signals becomes a bottleneck due to high power and bandwidth requirements. Local field potentials (LFPs) represent a different spatial-temporal scale of brain activity compared to spikes, offering key advantages including improved long-term stability, reduced energy consumption, and lower bandwidth requirement. Despite these benefits, LFP-based decoding models typically show reduced accuracy and often rely on non-causal architectures that are unsuitable for real-time deployment. To address these challenges, we propose REALM: a retrospective distillation framework that enables causal LFP decoding. Inspired by offline-to-online distillation strategies in speech recognition, REALM transfers representational knowledge from a pretrained multi-session bidirectional LFP model to a causal version for real-time deployment. We first pretrain a bidirectional Mamba-2 teacher model using a masked autoencoding objective. We then distill this teacher model into a compact student model via a combined objective of representation alignment and task supervision. REALM consistently outperforms both causal and non-causal LFP-based SOTA methods for behavior decoding. Notably, our REALM improves decoding performance while achieving a $2\times$ reduction in parameter count and a $10\times$ reduction in training time. These results demonstrate that retrospective distillation effectively bridges the gap between offline and real-time neural decoding. REALM shows that LFP-only models can achieve competitive decoding performance without reliance on spike signals, offering a practical and scalable alternative for next-generation wireless implantable BCIs.

AI.tldr: REALM是一个回顾性蒸馏框架，通过从预训练的双向LFP模型向因果版本蒸馏知识，使LFP-only模型在实时行为解码中达到竞争性性能，解决了传统LFP解码精度低和非因果架构无法实时部署的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统Spike信号虽精度高但带宽和功耗大，不适合高通道数无线BCIs；LFP信号虽更稳定、能耗低、带宽需求小，但解码精度低且现有模型多采用非因果架构，无法满足实时性需求。
AI.method: REALM框架采用回顾性蒸馏策略：首先使用掩码自编码目标预训练双向Mamba-2教师模型，然后通过representation alignment和task supervision的联合目标将教师模型蒸馏到紧凑的因果学生模型中，实现实时部署。
AI.result: REALM在行为解码任务上持续超越因果和非因果的LFP-based SOTA方法，同时参数数量减少2倍，训练时间缩短10倍。
AI.conclusion: REALM成功实现了LFP-only模型在行为解码任务上与Spike信号模型相当的解码性能，为下一代无线植入式BCIs提供了可行且可扩展的技术替代方案。

title: Fast Adversarial Attacks with Gradient Prediction
summary: Generating adversarial examples at scale is a core primitive for robustness evaluation, adversarial training, and red-teaming, yet even "fast" attacks such as FGSM remain throughput-limited by the cost of a backward pass. We introduce a family of attacks that eliminates the backward pass by predicting the input gradient from forward-pass hidden states via a lightweight linear regression. The approach is motivated by a kernel view of neural networks and is exact in the Neural Tangent Kernel regime, while remaining effective for practical finite-width models. Empirically, our methods recover much of FGSM's attack performance while using only a small fraction of the time, corresponding to a $532\%$ increase in throughput. These results suggest gradient prediction as a simple and general route to significantly faster adversarial generation under realistic wall-clock constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"梯度预测"（Gradient Prediction, GPR）攻击族：用轻量线性回归从前向传播的隐层状态直接预测输入梯度，从而在攻击阶段完全消除反向传播。在 LLM 越狱鲁棒性评估（HarmBench / JailbreakBench，Llama-2-7B、Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen3-4B）上，GPR 恢复了 FGSM 大部分攻击效果的同时显著提升吞吐：FGSM 成功攻击吞吐提升 532%（如 Qwen3-4B 上 0.65 → 4.11 att/s，ASR 从 12.6% 降至 6.8%）；GCG-GPR 与精确梯度 GCG 的 ASR 相当，扰动吞吐提升约 1.5–3×。理论在 NTK/高斯过程极限下给出精确的仿射条件均值刻画，但实验中的 ASR 权衡与多步误差累积是主要局限。
AI.motivation: 对抗样本生成是鲁棒性评估、对抗训练与红队测试的核心原语，瓶颈在于吞吐而非仅攻击成功率。即便"一步式"FGSM 仍需对每个样本计算输入梯度，即一次额外反向传播；对大模型（尤其 LLM）而言反向传播往往主导生成成本，已有工作（YOPO、GradAlign、零阶优化 ZOO/NES/SPSA）虽在减少反向依赖，但要么仍依赖反传，要么需成百上千次前向查询。论文目标明确设定为"单位生成时间内成功攻击数"（successful-attack throughput），ASR 作为互补指标。作者同时借鉴合成梯度（synthetic gradient）与推理时引导（steering）思路：后者用内部表示干预模型行为，本文则用内部表示反推输入梯度，属于"表示驱动的梯度推断"。
AI.method:
**核心方法（GPR）**：训练一个带偏置的线性回归器，把前向传播得到的隐层状态 h_θ(x) 映射为输入梯度 ∇_x S_θ(x,t) ≈ A·h + b，然后以预测梯度的符号做 FGSM 式更新 x_adv = x + ε·sgn(ĝ)。攻击阶段只需前向传播（可用 early-exit 取中间层隐状态）。

**理论（理想化 NTK/GP 极限）**：
- 引理1（平稳性）：采用正弦-余弦嵌入 e_j(x)=R(ω_jᵀx)[u_j;v_j]，输入平移等价于高斯系数对的正交旋转，故 (H,Y) 联合平稳，均值常数、协方差仅依赖 x−x′。
- 引理2（协方差常数）：在二阶矩可积与可微条件下，同点协方差 Σ_HH、Σ_GH 与 x 无关。
- 命题1（输入无关的仿射梯度预测器）：由高斯条件化得 E[G|H]=A·H+b，A=Σ_GH Σ_HH⁻¹，b=μ_G−A·μ_H，在 H 的所有可测预测器中是精确 MMSE；残差协差为 0 时可几乎必然精确恢复梯度。
- 观察1（最佳仿射预测器）：无需高斯性或平稳性，线性最小二乘解在所有仿射预测器中最优（仅需二阶矩与 Σ_HH 可逆）。
- 附录C：GP 导数条件化公式、NTK 极限下点态精确条件均值、固定特征 NTK 模型（φ=(cos x, sin x)ᵀ，导数可由输出经固定线性映射 BJB⁻¹ 精确恢复）。

**实践要点**：使用中间层隐状态 + early-exit；回归目标按 token 做单位 L2 归一化以强调方向；隐状态逐维标准化；闭式加权岭回归（λ=1，特征分解求解，多输出联合拟合）；训练数据增强采用 K 步 FGSM 迭代并对第 k 步样本以 γ^k 降权；超参按"预测器质量→扰动预算→方法专属超参"三阶段贪心调参，以成功吞吐为准则。

**攻击变体**：嵌入级（FGSM、FGM、RS-FGSM、PGD-k）直接扰动连续 token 嵌入；词元级 GCG-GPR 保持 GCG 目标、候选评估与接受规则不变，仅用预测梯度构造 top-k 候选集，最终替换仍由真实前向损失选出（故只要求排序质量，不要求梯度精确）。
AI.result:
**嵌入级（HarmBench 320 测试集非平凡子集）**：GPR 的成功攻击吞吐在所有对比中均高于精确梯度版本，但 ASR 常明显下降。例如 Qwen3-4B FGSM：吞吐 0.65→4.11 att/s（对应摘要所称 532% 吞吐提升），ASR 12.6%→6.8%；嵌入扰动吞吐约 5.1→60.5 ex/s。RS-FGSM/FGM 增益最大，PGD 步数越多 GPR 优势越小（作者归因于多步误差累积），PGD-10 时 GPR 甚至降到 6.3 att/s（Qwen3-4B）。GPR 在 ASR–吞吐平面上占据了新的 Pareto 前沿区域。

**词元级（GCG）**：GCG-GPR 与精确梯度 GCG 的 ASR 点估计相当、置信区间重叠，Qwen2.5-3B 上两基准均更高；扰动吞吐提升约 1.5–3×，非零成功区间成功吞吐提升 2–2.4×。盲随机后缀基线（无搜索）ASR 极低（0–8.1%），说明预测梯度生成的后缀远优于任意扰动，排除了"随机即有效"的解释。

**JailbreakBench（嵌入级）结果更不稳定**：Qwen2.5-3B 上 FGM-GPR ASR 22.0% vs FGM 8.0%，但 FGSM-GPR 4.0% vs FGSM 22.0%，效应随配置与模型而变。

**诊断分析**：预测梯度的余弦相似度与符号一致率约 0.33–0.43 / 59–65%，但余弦相似度与最终 ASR 相关性噪声大，不适合作为调参指标；混合梯度实验 g_mix=(1−α)ĝ+α g_exact 显示中间混合有时更有利（如 Llama-2/JBB α=0.1 时 ASR 6.0%，优于 α=0 的 0%），但无法给出普适符号一致阈值。

**成本与迁移**：预测器一次性训练约 159–260 秒，等尝试量盈亏平衡点为 1,280–2,113 个样本，故适用于大规模批量任务；跨基准迁移不对称（JBB 内域训练优于 HB 迁移，但 HB 上 JBB 迁移预测器反而优于内域预测器）。
AI.conclusion: 梯度预测是一条简单而通用的加速对抗生成路径：用前向表示 + 线性映射替换每样本的反向传播，在现实 wall-clock 约束下大幅提升对抗样本吞吐。理论层面在 NTK/GP 极限下证明了仿射条件均值的精确性与最优性，在非高斯情形下证明线性解仍是仿射类最优。实验显示该方法在实用有限宽度模型上有效，但伴随显著的 ASR 损失，尤其在多步 PGD 与部分 JailbreakBench 配置下；预测器须针对特定模型、层、目标与提示分布重新训练，且一次性训练成本需摊销。论文明确指出理论为理想化假设下的条件均值刻画，并非对真实 Transformer 的精确梯度保证，且嵌入级扰动不可直接部署为词元级攻击。作者亦在伦理声明中指出该效率提升具有双重用途属性（可降低越狱搜索成本），发布旨在支持可复现的安全研究与授权评估。

title: AIMing for Standardised Explainability Evaluation in GNNs: A Framework and Case Study on Graph Kernel Networks
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have advanced significantly in handling graph-structured data, but a comprehensive framework for evaluating explainability remains lacking. Existing evaluation frameworks primarily involve post-hoc explanations, and operate in the setting where multiple methods generate a suite of explanations for a single model. This makes comparison of explanations across models difficult. Evaluation of inherently interpretable models often targets a specific aspect of interpretability relevant to the model, but remains underdeveloped in terms of generating insight across a suite of measures. We introduce AIM, a comprehensive framework that addresses these limitations by measuring Accuracy, Instance-level explanations, and Model-level explanations. AIM is formulated with minimal constraints to enhance flexibility and facilitate broad applicability. Here, we use AIM in a pipeline, extracting explanations from inherently interpretable GNNs such as graph kernel networks (GKNs) and prototype networks (PNs), evaluating these explanations with AIM, identifying their limitations and obtaining insights to their characteristics. Taking GKNs as a case study, we show how the insights obtained from AIM can be used to develop an updated model, xGKN, that maintains high accuracy while demonstrating improved explainability. Our approach aims to advance the field of Explainable AI (XAI) for GNNs, providing more robust and practical solutions for understanding and improving complex models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AIM 框架——一套面向 GNN 可解释性的标准化评测体系，含 10 项指标，分为 Accuracy（A1-A2）、Instance-level（I1-I5）、Model-level（M1-M3）三组，摆脱了「同一固定模型上比较多解释器」的假设，支持跨模型比较。同时提出针对图核网络（GKN）的 SHAPExplainer 实例级解释方法，并以 GKN 为案例研究诊断其可解释性缺陷（概念冗余、模型级与实例级解释脱节、解释一致性低），进而设计了改进模型 XGKN（节点起始随机游走核 + 归一化特征 + 负熵聚合），在保持高预测精度的同时显著提升解释质量。
AI.motivation: 现有 GNN 可解释性评测框架存在三点核心缺陷：(1) 绝大多数指标（GNNExplainer、SubgraphX、CF2、GraphXAI、Zheng et al. 2024 等）是为「post-hoc 事后解释」设计的，假定对同一个固定模型施加多个解释器并基于 logit 变化打分，这一假设在跨模型比较时失效，因为不同模型的决策边界与输出尺度不同；(2) 对于本身可解释的模型（GKN、原型网络 PN），评测通常只针对该模型特有的单一侧面（如 GKN 中哪些节点对图滤波器重要），缺乏跨多维度指标的系统性洞察；(3) 已有评测大多忽视扰动导致的分布外（OOD）子图问题（Zheng et al. 2024 指出），且稀疏性（Sparsity）指标偏爱简洁而非忠实，可能遗漏关键特征。作者因此需要一个约束最小化、通用性强、能同时评估实例级与模型级解释并支持跨模型对比的统一评测框架。
AI.method:
**AIM 框架**：基于 Co-12（Nauta et al., 2023）的 12 项解释质量性质，裁剪为 10 项指标、三大类别。A1/A2 为与真值解释对比的 IoU（实例级）与归一化图编辑距离 GED（模型级）；I1 充分性（包含解释的子图是否保持预测）、I2 必要性（不含解释的子图是否改变预测）、I3/I4 节点/边扰动下的解释 IoU 稳定性（仅在预测不变的扰动样本上评估）、I5 解释器一致性（两次抽样解释的 IoU）；M1/M2 扰动模型级概念（节点特征/边）后实例级解释的 IoU 变化，M3 为不同概念相似度分布间的绝对 Spearman 相关（冗余度）。所有指标归一到 0-1，且统一方向为「越大越好」。通过统一阈值化（重要性图归一化后按百分位累积重要性选阈值 p，生成诱导子图）来标准化跨模型的解释表示。

**SHAPExplainer**：先对预测器 f_pred 计算 Deep SHAP 值得到各概念的重要性 φ_i，再按 z_i = Σ_j S_ji 反向传播到各输入子图得 w_j = Σ_i (φ_i·S_ji)/z_i；GKN 中子图为节点邻域，故 ψ(v)=w_i；原型网络中子图被采样以最大化相似度，故 ψ(v)=Σ_i w_i（对包含 v 的子图求和）；最终 softmax 得到节点重要性图并阈值化为诱导子图。附录给出 max 池化与负熵聚合下的归因传播形式。

**XGKN**：将随机游走核限制为仅统计从节点 v 出发的游走，使核响应直接对应节点重要性；对特征嵌入做归一化以公平比较不同滤波器响应；聚合函数由求和改为对归一化响应取负熵，以捕捉各节点/滤波器的相对贡献并促进滤波器多样性；预测器简化为单线性层（加批归一化）以减少复杂依赖。训练用 Adam、lr 0.01、wd 1e-4、batch 64、最多 1000 epoch；滤波器数 4/8/16、滤波器大小 6/8、子图半径 2/4、子图最大规模 10/20。

**实验**：模型为 KerGNN、GKNN、ProtGNN、GIN、GAT（+XGKN）；解释器为 GNNExplainer、IntegratedGradients、ShapleyValueSampling、AttentionExplainer、SHAPExplainer；数据集为 BA2Motifs、BAMultiShapes、MUTAG、PROTEINS、IMDB-B、IMDB-M；采用双侧 t 检验（显著性 0.05）判别最优，并用 p±0.1 做阈值敏感性分析。
AI.result:
**SHAPExplainer**：在 GKN 上既更准又更快——KerGNN 上 BA2Motifs A1=0.33、耗时 0.06s（MUTAG 0.76 / 0.01s），显著优于 ShapleyValueSampling（26.13s / 9.84s）；GKNN 上 A1=0.49、耗时 0.19s（MUTAG 0.79 / 0.06s），远优于 ShapleyValueSampling（23.26s / 8.15s）；避免了将图转换为子图的预处理开销。ProtGNN 上因需采样子图导致耗时过长（47.44s），故改用 ShapleyValueSampling。

**AIM 诊断结果**：各模型预测精度相当（BA2Motifs 92.4%-100%）。解释精度方面，GKNN 的实例级 A1（0.49）与黑盒 GIN（0.51）相当，而其它「自带可解释组件」的模型反而更差（GAT 0.26、ProtGNN 0.33、KerGNN 0.33）——说明引入可解释结构并不自动带来好的解释。实例级指标上 GIN 优于 GAT（注意力机制未带来优势），ProtGNN 因子图采样波动而鲁棒性（I3-I4）弱于 GKN，但在充分性/必要性（I1-I2）上占优；所有模型一致性（I5）都偏低，尤其在非合成任务上。模型级指标暴露出核心缺陷：修改模型级概念几乎不引起实例级解释变化（M1-M2 差），且概念间存在显著冗余（M3）。

**XGKN**：预测精度保持甚至略升（BA2Motifs 100.0、BAMultiShapes 92.8、MUTAG 84.2、PROTEINS 74.5、IMDB-B 71.3、IMDB-M 45.6，为各模型最高或持平）；解释精度显著提升——A1 达 0.50（BA2Motifs）/0.31（BAMultiShapes）/0.80（MUTAG），A2 为 0.77/0.78/0.81；SHAPExplainer 耗时仅 0.04s/0.01s。整体在必要性（I2）、模型级-实例级一致性（M1-M2）、冗余度（M3）等指标上均有改善。阈值敏感性分析显示 p±0.1 下分数无统计显著差异，说明结论稳健。
AI.conclusion: AIM 为 GNN 可解释性提供了首个统一覆盖实例级与模型级、可跨模型比较的标准化评测框架，其价值在于「诊断」而非给出一个总体分数：它揭示了内在可解释性并不自动产生忠实解释，且现有 GKN/原型模型普遍存在模型级概念冗余、模型级与实例级解释脱节、解释稳定性差三大缺陷。作者借助该框架的反哺能力提出 XGKN，证明在保持（甚至提升）预测精度的前提下可系统性改善可解释性，确立「评测—诊断—改进」的闭环范式。局限方面：AIM 依赖图分类与诱导子图表示，部分指标（A1/A2）需真值解释才可用；XGKN 案例仅在 GKN 族验证，推广到原型网络等其他可解释图模型仍待验证；聚合函数负熵形式与核约束的收益需在更大规模数据上进一步确认。

title: Critic-Driven Voronoi-Quantization for Distilling Deep RL Policies to Explainable Models
summary: Despite many successful attempts at explaining Deep Reinforcement Learning policies using distillation, it remains difficult to balance the performance-interpretability trade-off and select a fitting surrogate model. In addition to this, traditional distillation only minimizes the distance between the behavior of the original and the surrogate policy while other RL-specific components such as action value are disregarded. To solve this, we introduce a new model-agnostic method called Critic-Driven Voronoi State Partitioning, which partitions a black box control policy into regions where a simple class of model can be optimized using gradient descent. By exploiting the critic value network of the original policy, we iteratively introduce new subpolicies in regions with insufficient value, standing in for a measure of policy complexity. The partitioning, a Voronoi quantizer, uses nearest neighbor lookups to assign a linear function to each point in the state space resulting in a cell-like diagram. We validate our approach on several well known benchmarks and proof that this distillation approaches the original policy using a reasonable sized set of linear functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“Critic-Driven Voronoi State Partitioning (VSP-critic)”：一种模型无关的离线蒸馏方法，把深度强化学习黑箱策略的状态空间用 Voronoi 量化划分为若干区域，每个区域配一个线性子策略；通过利用原策略的评论家（critic）Q 网络评估子策略动作的价值，仅在“价值不足”的区域迭代插入新码字/子策略，从而用数量有限但可解释的线性函数逼近原策略，并在多个连续控制基准上验证了性能与可解释性的权衡。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习策略是黑箱神经网络，难以提供局部/全局解释，也难以在微控制器等算力受限硬件上部署，因此可解释强化学习（XRL）成为研究热点。已有的策略蒸馏方法存在两个缺陷：(1) 代理模型（surrogate model）常是层次化或规则式，体积庞大，反而降低可解释性；(2) 蒸馏通常只最小化原策略与代理策略的行为距离，忽略了动作价值（action value）等 RL 特有信息，无法反映“动作差多少、对回报影响多大”。此外，策略的复杂度难以先验估计——策略可能在大片状态空间上只需简单函数，仅在局部区域需要更高容量，因此固定复杂度的单一模型必然在部分区域过拟合/欠拟合。作者主张采用“按需细分”的状态空间划分方案。
AI.method: 整体为交替优化的离线蒸馏算法（Algorithm 1）：(1) 用 TD3 策略采集 n_episodes_training 条状态-动作对 ⟨S_π, A_π⟩，并提取其 critic 网络 Q_π；(2) 用 Voronoi 量化器 ψ_C（码字集合 C，通过 kd-tree 最近邻查询，O(log n)）将状态划分到互不相交的胞元 R_i，每个胞元 ⟨c_i, π̃_i⟩ 绑定一个线性子策略 a_k = Σ s_i·w_{i,k} + b_k，用 Adam 梯度下降在分批数据上拟合，配合 patience/delta 早停；(3) 每轮训练后对每个区域做细分判定：先用几何准则筛出距离码字超过 min_codeword_distance 的候选状态集合 Ṡ（分辨率下限）；再用 critic 准则对每个候选状态计算 q_s = Q_π(s, π̃_i(s))，按价值升序取前 ρ = ⌊value_ratio_threshold·|Ṡ|⌋ 的最低价值状态（“最差”状态，代表该区域需要更高容量的行为）；(4) 在该低价值状态集 X 上调用 findClusters（Algorithm 2）：对 k=2..max_k_clusters 建立 k-means 模型，用轮廓系数（silhouette score）选取最佳 k 并取其质心作为新码字，受 max_codewords_region（每区域）与 max_codewords_iteration（每轮）限制，必要时提前跳出并确保最后进行一轮不再扩展的训练；(5) 迭代 n_iterations 轮或区域数收敛。整个过程仅依赖“模型容量”这一概念，与具体模型类无关（model-agnostic）；新码字通过最近邻查询决定决策边界，形成胞元状划分。方法融合了 Lee 等人（TD-AVQ）的 Voronoi 状态划分与 Akrour 等人（神经控制器 + 线性子策略）的局部线性策略思想。
AI.result: 在 Gymnasium 的四个连续控制基准（SimpleGoal、MountainCarContinuous、LunarLanderContinuous、BipedalWalker）上验证，每个环境用 StableBaselines3 Zoo 的最优超参训练 TD3，对 VSP-critic 与随机选码字的变体 VSP-random 各跑 20 次，每次用 100 回合数据。结果：(1) 除 BipedalWalker 外，两种变体的平均回报都接近原 TD3 策略（如 SimpleGoal：TD3 15.2±0.13，VSP-critic 13.5±1.79；MountainCar：93.7 vs 90.8/91.9；LunarLander：161.8 vs 154.8/160.8）；BipedalWalker 上 critic 驱动版本明显优于随机版（226.0±39.41 vs 195.1±21.96，TD3 为 313.0）。(2) 收敛较快，通常在算法早期就稳定；max_codewords_region 与 max_codewords_iteration 直接影响收敛时机。(3) 可解释性收益显著：VSP-critic 只需约 3.6 个线性函数即可达到 VSP-random 6.4 个的 SimpleGoal 效果；LunarLander 上约 60 个线性函数即可良好控制，而随机版约需其 3 倍（152 个）；BipedalWalker 中更多子策略并不带来更高性能（随机版 363.8 个子策略反而更差）。(4) 划分结果具有语义可解释性：SimpleGoal 中 min_codeword_distance=0.3 得到 9 个区域、=0.6 得到 3 个对称胞元，区域边界恰好落在原策略行为突变处（如坑洼区附近）；LunarLander 在 y≈1.50（下降起点）与 y=0（地面着陆点）附近出现密集小胞元，表明着陆区行为更复杂；BipedalWalker 在水平速度 0.2/0.7 附近码字聚集。(5) MountainCar 的 3 个线性函数给出可读的控制逻辑：先施加负力爬左坡获取动量、在 x≈-0.828 处由负力切换为正力下坡加速、最后在 x≈-0.312 处因权重近零偏置≈1 仅需持续正力冲顶。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并实证了一种新颖的黑箱 DRL 策略到可解释线性模型的蒸馏路径：用 Voronoi 量化对状态空间做自适应细分，并由原策略的 critic 提供“容量不足”的信号，从而把模型复杂度显式地放在真正需要复杂行为的位置。结果表明这些环境可由数量合理的线性函数控制，在保持大部分原始性能的同时显著减少模型规模。局限与展望：仅验证了线性这一类模型，其他模型类（模型无关性）未实证；线性权重作为特征重要性的解释力取决于模型本身；Voronoi 决策边界虽是纯距离（最近码字）形式，但仍偏复杂，缺乏对边界本身的可读描述，作者将“如何刻画/表达这些划分边界”列为未来工作。此外超参数为手工调优、非最优，方法仍主要面向连续控制与离线后处理蒸馏场景。代码以 MIT 许可开源（gitlab.ai.vub.ac.be/sdeproost/vsp）。

title: TILBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Tabular Imbalanced Learning Across Data Regimes
summary: Imbalanced learning remains a fundamental challenge in tabular data applications. Despite decades of research and numerous proposed algorithms, a systematic empirical understanding of how different imbalanced learning methods behave across diverse data characteristics is still lacking. In particular, it remains unclear how different method families compare in predictive performance, robustness under varying data characteristics, and computational scalability. In this work, we present Tabular Imbalanced Learning Benchmark (TILBench), a large-scale empirical benchmark for tabular imbalanced learning. TILBench evaluates more than 40 representative algorithms across 57 diverse tabular datasets, resulting in over 200000 controlled experiments across a wide range of data characteristics. Our findings show that no single method consistently dominates across all settings; instead, the effectiveness of imbalanced learning methods depends strongly on dataset characteristics and computational constraints. Based on these findings, we provide practical recommendations for selecting appropriate methods in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: TILBench是一个用于评估表格数据不平衡学习的大规模实证基准测试，涵盖40余种算法和57个数据集。结果表明不存在全能最优方法，实际应用中的方法选择应综合考虑数据特性和计算资源限制。
AI.motivation: 表格数据中不平衡学习仍是基础性挑战，尽管已有数十年研究和众多算法提出，但系统性地理解不同方法在不同数据特征下的表现、鲁棒性和可扩展性方面仍存在空白
AI.method: 构建了包含超过40种代表算法、57个多样化表格数据集的大规模基准测试平台，进行了超过20万次对照实验
AI.result: 没有单一方法能够在所有设置中始终占据优势；不平衡学习方法的有效性高度依赖于数据集特征和计算约束条件
AI.conclusion: 提供了在现实应用中选择适当方法的实践建议，表明最佳方法选择取决于具体场景

title: A Mutual Information Lower Bound for Multimodal Regression Active Learning
summary: Active learning for continuous regression has lacked an acquisition function that targets epistemic uncertainty when the predictive distribution is multimodal: variance misses modal disagreement, and information-theoretic targets like BALD are designed for discrete outputs. We introduce a Two-Index framework that makes this separation explicit: one stochastic index selects among competing model hypotheses (epistemic source), while a second governs within-hypothesis randomness (aleatoric source). An entropy decomposition within the framework identifies the mutual information between the output and the epistemic index as a principled acquisition objective, and we prove this quantity vanishes as the model is trained on growing datasets, confirming that it captures exactly the uncertainty data can resolve. Because this mutual information is intractable for continuous outputs, we derive the Mutual Information Lower Bound (MI-LB) acquisition function, a closed-form approximation for Mixture Density Network ensembles. On benchmarks featuring multimodal systems, MI-LB matches or beats every baseline evaluated and is the only method to do so consistently -- geometric and Fisher-based baselines compete only when the input space already encodes the multimodality, and collapse otherwise.

AI.tldr: 提出双索引框架分离认知不确定性和任意不确定性，推导互信息作为主动学习获取函数。对于连续输出不可行的情形，推导了MI-LB闭合形式近似，在多模态基准上唯一持续超越所有基线方法。
AI.motivation: Existing acquisition functions for active learning in continuous regression cannot properly target epistemic uncertainty when predictions are multimodal. Variance-based methods fail to capture modal disagreement, while information-theoretic methods like BALD are designed for discrete outputs.
AI.method: Introduced a Two-Index framework that separates epistemic uncertainty (stochastic index selecting among model hypotheses) from aleatoric uncertainty (within-hypothesis randomness). Derived an entropy decomposition identifying mutual information between output and epistemic index as the acquisition objective. Since this mutual information is intractable for continuous outputs, derived MI-LB (Mutual Information Lower Bound), a closed-form approximation for Mixture Density Network ensembles.
AI.result: On benchmarks featuring multimodal systems, MI-LB matches or beats every baseline evaluated and is the only method to do so consistently. Geometric and Fisher-based baselines only compete when the input space already encodes multimodality, and collapse otherwise.
AI.conclusion: The mutual information between output and epistemic index vanishes as the model is trained on growing datasets, confirming it captures exactly the uncertainty that data can resolve. MI-LB is the only method to consistently match or beat all baselines on multimodal benchmarks.

title: Learning with Shallow Neural Networks on Cluster-Structured Features
summary: The success of deep learning in high-dimensional settings is often attributed to the presence of low-dimensional structure in real-world data. While standard theoretical models typically assume that this structure lies in the target function, projecting unstructured inputs onto a low-dimensional subspace, data such as images, text or genomic sequences exhibit strong spatial correlations within the input space itself. In this paper, we propose a tractable model to study how these correlations affect the sample complexity of learning with gradient descent on shallow neural networks. Specifically, we consider targets that depend on a small number of latent Boolean variables, and input features grouped into clusters and correlated with the latent variables. Under an identifiability assumption, we show that for a layerwise gradient-descent variant, the sample complexity scales with the number of hidden variables and, when the signal-to-noise ratio is sufficiently high, is independent of the input dimension, up to logarithmic terms. We empirically test our theoretical findings on both synthetic and real data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"聚类结构化特征"的可解模型：少量二值隐变量通过带噪过程生成高维观测特征，标签是隐变量的任意函数。证明在该模型下，分层（layerwise）梯度下降训练两层网络可以学到任意隐变量目标函数，且在高信噪比条件下样本复杂度与输入维度 d 无关（仅对数依赖），由隐变量数 N 主导。在合成数据（BSC 簇模型、高斯混合）与单细胞 RNA-seq 真实数据（GSE96583）上的实验支持了这一结论。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在高维问题上的成功常被归因于数据存在低维结构，但已有理论多把该结构放在目标函数中（多指标模型，把输入视为各向同性高斯/均匀布尔等无结构乘积分布），忽略了真实数据（图像、文本、基因组）本身的输入特征间存在强相关/冗余。已有结构化输入分析（spike-covariance、隐流形模型、层次树模型等）大多处于"潜变量维数随 d 增长"的热力学极限，复杂度仍线性依赖环境维度 d。本文转向另一未覆盖的极限：潜变量维数有界而观测特征数随 d 增长（高度冗余数据），此时既无大维渐近理论可用，也正是人们期望样本复杂度由内在维度而非环境维度决定的区域。另一动机是：与深度分离类工作（RHM、卷积网络）互补，本文问更基础的问题——当相关性已可被浅层架构利用时，梯度训练能否在未被显式给出隐表示的情况下自动利用它们。
AI.method:
【数据模型】定义1：把 d 个坐标划分为 N 个不相交簇 C_1..C_N（N=O_d(1)），每簇对应隐二值变量 s_i∈{±1}^N；x_j = s_i ξ_j (j∈C_i)，ξ_j 为相互独立、与 s 独立的次高斯噪声，均值 m_j（信号强度）、方差 τ_j^2；标签 y=f(s) 为隐变量的任意函数，Var(f)=1。x 的协方差为块对角，簇内相关由共享隐变量诱导。
【假设】A1 可识别性：v_min/v_sum ≥ c（无退化簇）且 v_sum/d ≥ c（SNR 下界）；A2 激活函数为次数 P=Θ_d(1)、P≥2^N 的多项式，且 Hermite 非退化 |S^{(k)}_{μ+v_sum/d}(0)| ≥ c_0（k≤N），该条件把高斯平滑尺度与数据 SNR 绑定，用于保证第一步梯度后第一层线性可分。
【算法】层间 SGD：第二层初始权重取小尺度 τ（使平方损失中的交互项可忽略），第一层做 T_1=1 步梯度更新（学习率 γ_1=Θ(1/√v_sum)），冻结第一层后随机均匀采样偏置 b_h~Unif[-A,A]，第二层用 SGD 拟合输出权重（平方损失）；在线模式，每步新采样，batch size B。
【证明技术路线】(1) Lemma 1：初始种群梯度可分解为 m_j α_i(w)+η_j（Berry-Esseen 型矩比较），误差项 O(√(log d/d))；(2) Lemma 2：Bernstein/次指数集中控制有限样本梯度估计误差；(3) Lemma 3：Carbery–Wright 反集中不等式证明"投影一致性"——若 f(s)≠f(t) 则 u(s)=sᵀα̃ ≠ u(t)，这是保证信息不丢失的关键；(4) Lemma 5：区间命中论证+Gram 矩阵条件数控制，构造精确插值 f 的第二层权重"证书"(certificate)；(5) Lemma 6：证书的泛化误差界；(6) 凸优化 SGD 收敛性（Theorem 3）驱动误差降至目标水平。
【异质特例】定理2（齐次 BSC 模型，等簇大小、ReLU 激活、确定性初始化 w_j=1/√d）：因失去初始化随机性，改为假设目标的"多数函数 margin"非退化（Assumption 3），从而把适用范围从 v_sum=Θ(d) 放宽到 v_sum=Ω(log⁴d)。
AI.result:
【定理1】在 A1、A2 下，两层网络（n=Θ(2^N log(1/ε)) 个隐单元，第一层高斯初始化方差 1/d）经层间 SGD，以概率 1−c_1 ε^{c_2} 达到 E|y−NN(x)| ≤ δ。样本复杂度 B(T_1+T_2) = O(log(d)² d/(v_sum δ²))，步数 T_1+T_2 = O_d(1)。当 v_sum=Θ(d)（高 SNR）时，样本复杂度对 d 仅对数依赖；隐层宽度则指数依赖 N（因需表示 {±1}^N 上的任意函数）。时间复杂度 dim(θ)·T·B 仍线性依赖 d。
【定理2】齐次 BSC + ReLU + margin 假设下，|δ−1/2| ≥ Ω(log(d)²/√d)（等价 v_sum=Ω(log⁴d)）时，以概率 1−d^{-C} 达到均方误差 ≤ ε，样本数 B=O(log(d)²/(1−2δ)²)，宽度 n=Ω(2^N log(d)/Δ)。
【与聚类方法比较】谱聚类需 BBP 阈值 (d/N)(1−2δ)²≳c 且需 Θ(d) 样本；本文方法在 v_sum=Ω(log²d) 即可学习且仅需 log²d 样本，与谱可检测性在 log 因子内一致；朴素协方差阈值化需 B≳log(d)/(1−2δ)⁴，与本文相当。
【实验】合成：N=3 奇偶目标，两层 ReLU（1000 隐单元，SGD，batch 64）；BSC 簇模型与匹配一二阶矩的高斯混合模型，样本量随 d 增大基本恒定，随 δ→1/2 显著变差，与理论一致。真实数据：GSE96583 单细胞 RNA-seq（约 11,990 细胞、约 10,500 基因），三分类（B/单核/T-NK），按方差-均值选 top-d 基因，基因相关矩阵经层次聚类排序显示明显块结构，估计 SNR≈0.29；两隐层 ReLU(128) 网络的测试准确率曲线在 d≥200 时几乎重合，符合样本复杂度与 d 基本无关的预测。
AI.conclusion: 在聚类结构化特征模型下，浅层网络（两层全连接）+层间梯度下降能利用输入相关性学到任意隐变量目标，且高 SNR 时样本复杂度由内在（隐）维度而非环境维度决定，证明浅层架构已足以在有界潜维极限中捕捉相关结构，无需深度或显式隐表示。局限：宽度对 N 指数依赖（两层的表示瓶颈），N 与激活/初始化/训练过程均被理想化（多项式激活、确定性初始化、层间训练、均匀隐变量、Gaussian 初始化等），理论仅覆盖有界 N。展望：加深网络以把 N 的指数依赖降为多项式从而允许 N 随 d 增长；推广到更大字母表与更丰富信道；连续潜变量需新工具；允许簇归属随样本变化；ReLU 等非多项式激活可通过对 Hermite 展开截断推广。

title: A Hardware-Aware, Per-Layer Methodology for Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models
summary: Scaled Outer Product (SOP) is a post-training quantization methodology for large language model weights, designed to deliver near-lossless fidelity at 4.5--6 bits per weight on hardware with per-layer LUT decode. The methodology combines per-layer search of fixed and dynamic codebook pairs selected by a per-block selection bit, signed per-block scales, activation-weighted cosine selection, and multiple-choice knapsack promotion of sensitive layers with outlier and sparse-residual correction. Fixed codebooks include NF4, BOF4, Split87, and SH4; per-layer optimized codebooks (DD4) are hosted in LUT SRAM. A new hardware-efficient LUT output format (HIF) is proposed to improve performance, energy, and cost. Across six open model families, the recommended FP6 operating point (E2M3sUE4M4, 6.5 bpw) achieves lower weight reconstruction error than the conventional per-layer-POT FP8 baseline (E4M3, 8.0 bpw) at 1.5 bpw lower storage cost, demonstrating that block-scaled small atoms with carefully chosen scale precision can replace conventionally-deployed FP8. Full evaluation across the 4.5--6 bpw range, including layer promotion and sparse residual correction, is reported in a companion paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Scaled Outer Product（SOP）：一种面向大语言模型权重的硬件感知、逐层后训练量化（PTQ）方法，在具备逐层LUT解码的硬件上于4.5–6 bit/权重区间实现近乎无损的保真度。核心是逐块（block）缩放 + 每层从固定/自适应码本对中搜索最优组合（用每块1位选择位切换），配合激活加权余弦相似度（ACos）作为保真度度量、OPQ离群值抽取与激活加权稀疏残差校正（Wr）两种后量化修正，以及一个多选0/1背包（MCKP）分配器在全局bpw预算下决定各层格式与修正。推荐FP6工作点 E2M3sUE4M4（6.5 bpw）在六个开源模型族上权重重建MSE优于传统的逐层POT FP8（E4M3 0sUE8M0，8.0 bpw），且节省1.5 bpw，说明「块缩放小原子 + 精心配比的尺度精度」可替代常规部署的FP8。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）在4–8 bit 区间的落地受两个约束制约：一是单一全局码本几何无法同时适配不同层迥异的权重分布与离群结构；二是标准的 FP8 部署（逐层单一 2 的幂缩放）在离群值密集的注意力投影上既脆弱又浪费存储位宽，而 MX/OCP 等微缩放规范虽规定了块缩放，却未解决「块内码本形状与尺度精度如何联合选择」的问题。此外，精度感知缩放律（Kumar et al., 2024）显示低精度训练正改变 PTQ 遇到的权重分布，固定原子族的方法会失去适应性。因此作者希望提出一套不施加全局规则、完全由权重与激活统计逐模型逐层决定（码本几何、原子选择、划分比例、晋级目标、预算分配）的方法，并与硬件数据通路联合设计，使每层差异化码本带来的保真度收益在 SRAM 驻留的逐层 LUT 后端上真正可实现。
AI.method: 方法由七个相互咬合的组件构成：(1) 灵活块缩放——沿 K 维以 g∈{8,16,32,64} 分块共享尺度，尺度格式 8–16 bit（可含符号位/元位），平均位宽为 s/g + b；(2) ACos——用校准语料得到逐输入通道 RMS 范数 c_j 作为重要性权重，定义块级加权余弦相似度，4-bit 配对下典型值域 [0.997,0.999]，以 ppm 报告与 1 的差距；在 promotion 区间与下游 KL 的相关性优于 MSE/SQNR；(3) 逐层码本对搜索——在 NF4（高斯分位）、BOF4（Lloyd 迭代拟合）、Split87（坐标下降拟合）、SH4（sinh 压扩 α=1.50, c=−0.02）、DD4（逐层直方图 DP 聚类，网格约束构造）等原子及其符号取反变体中，为每层挑选 (L_a, p, L_b)：按 ACos 排名前 p% 块入 FMTa 池，余下块拟合 FMTb，再做「双 LUT × 双符号」的收尾重指派；(4) 尺度格式与元位分配——SwExMy 记法（12-bit 内同时容纳符号位+1 元位，推荐 S1E5M5），并用逐层整数移位 k* 把每块尺度落入格式正规数区间；(5) OPQ——按 |w|/σ_b 超阈值的位置以 BF16 精确存储（16-bit 索引+BF16，共 32 bit/离群点，约 0.10–0.20 bpw），推理时作为稀疏 axpy 贡献叠加；(6) Wr——对量化残差 E 按 |E|·c_k 排序取 top-σ（E3M4 量化，16-bit 索引，约 32 bit/项），σ=0.001 约 0.032 bpw、典型提升 5–15 ppm ACos；(7) MCKP 分配器——以各层 promotion profile ρ_ℓ(f)=ACos(W_ℓ, Q_f(W_ℓ)) 为输入，在全局 bpw 预算 B 下按参数量加权最大化参数加权 ACos，用动态规划精确求解。此外提出硬件高效 LUT 输出格式 HIF7（80 值）与 HIF8（96 值）：每个值分解为 5-bit 二补码系数与逐元素 2 的幂移位量，矩阵单元以移位—乘加累加实现 iacc[i,j] += (wtc5[i]·atc5[j]) << (wsa[i]+asa[j])；权重移位预算 {0..3}、激活 {0..4}（5–7 为可选扩展，代价是 16,384 个移位器各增一级逻辑）。SOP 微内核将块缩放 GEMM 化为「g 次秩一量化外积 + 每 K 块一次秩一 Hadamard 尺度累加」，128×128 矩阵单元中每次操作数加载摊薄 128 次 MAC，尺度流量约占操作数流量的 15.8%。
AI.result: 主要结论：(a) FP6 的 E2M3sUE4M4（6.5 bpw）在六个模型族上的尺寸加权权重 MSE 均低于逐层 POT FP8 E4M3 0sUE8M0（8.0 bpw），例如 Gemma-3-1B 3.41e-7 vs 4.40e-7、Qwen3-8B 3.98e-7 vs 5.13e-7，即在 (存储, 保真度) 前沿上是 Pareto 最优而非精度妥协；附录 D 证明三种 E4M3 尺度策略的逐层 max/mean MSE 比几乎一致（Llama-3.2-3B 最大差异 7.3%，其余 <2%），说明 F_layer 移位搜索吸收了逐层动态范围差异，比较是公平的。(b) HIF7 与 E2M3 可互换：UE4M4 下 E2M3 的 MSE 仅高 3.8–4.1%，远小于码本 80→63 按 1/N² 均匀量化理论预期的约 61%（约 15 倍差距），原因是 HIF7 多出的 17 个码点是为移位—加法数据通路而非 MSE 优化设计的。(c) 尺度精度在 12 bit 饱和：12-bit 各格式与 16-bit E8M7 参考在三位有效数字上一致，残差 MSE 即 HIF7 网格量化下限；窄宽度下无符号略优于有符号（8-bit 时 UE4M4 优于 E4M3 达 17–20%，10-bit 时 UE4M6 优于 E4M5 达 2–7%），符号位作元位几乎免费。(d) 原子精度与尺度精度是可分离的杠杆：Llama-3.2-3B 上 E2M5 相对 E4M3 降低 MSE 约 14×、KL 约 5.5×，E3M4 约 4×（KL 2.4×）；从 E4M3 0sUE8M0 到 E3M4sUE4M6 的 KL 改善 3.6× 恰为两轴效应之积（2.4×1.5）。(e) 逐层最优码本对不存在全局最优，且随部署的 LUT/尺度格式变化，典型形态为「固定 ROM 的 FMTa + 自适应/固定 FMTb」。(f) 逐层码本对搜索结果显示无全局最优对是架构优势（SOP 后端支持 SRAM 内逐层码本）。异常现象：Mistral-7B 的 MSE 比其他模型低 30–70×，伴以更高平均 F_layer 移位（k*≈7.3 vs 4.3–5.7）与更低 max/mean 比（3.4×），被归因为逐块权重幅值更小更均匀的张量统计属性而非格式伪影。
AI.conclusion: SOP 的定位是「用块缩放的小原子 + 精挑的尺度精度替代常规部署的 FP8」，并把 PTQ 的搜索空间从全局码本几何转向逐层、逐预算的联合决策：码本对、划分比例、晋级格式与预算分配全部由观测统计决定，无全局规则。其硬件对应物是把块缩放 GEMM 映射为矩阵单元的秩一外积与秩一尺度累加，并提出与数据通路联合设计的 HIF LUT 输出格式；权重与激活移位预算的不对称（0–3 vs 0–4）被论证为源自离群值处理能力的硬件现实差异（激活离群无离线逃生阀，权重离群有 OPQ/Wr/旋转等出路），激活扩展档需在 16,384 个移位器上各增一级逻辑，属部署语境下的取舍。文中明确未回答的问题包括：3-bit 码本几何（尚需 Hadamard 旋转等预处理）、SH4 参数 α=1.43 vs 1.50 的对比、HIF 的 tc6 扩展（约 44% 乘法器面积增长）与 7-bit 压缩打包的取舍、E2M5 的精度优势能否迁移到训练场景、以及 4.5–6 bpw 全区间的端到端保真度评估与 MCKP 晋级/稀疏残差的全面评测（交由两篇配套论文）。

title: Slot-MPC: Goal-Conditioned Model Predictive Control with Object-Centric Representations
summary: Predictive world models enable agents to model scene dynamics and reason about the consequences of their actions. Inspired by human perception, object-centric world models capture scene dynamics using object-level representations, which can be used for downstream applications such as action planning. However, most object-centric world models and reinforcement learning (RL) approaches learn reactive policies that are fixed at inference time, limiting generalization to novel situations. We propose Slot-MPC, an object-centric world modeling framework that enables planning through Model Predictive Control (MPC). Slot-MPC leverages vision encoders to learn slot-based representations, which encode individual objects in the scene, and uses these structured representations to learn an action-conditioned object-centric dynamics model. At inference time, the learned dynamics model enables action planning via MPC, allowing agents to adapt to previously unseen situations. Since the learned world model is differentiable, we can use gradient-based MPC to directly optimize actions, which is computationally more efficient than relying on gradient-free, sampling-based MPC methods. Experiments on simulated robotic manipulation tasks show that Slot-MPC improves both task performance and planning efficiency compared to non-object-centric world model baselines. In the considered offline setting with limited state-action coverage, we find that gradient-based MPC performs better than gradient-free, sampling-based MPC. Our results demonstrate that explicitly structured, object-centric representations provide a strong inductive bias for controllable and generalizable decision-making. Code and additional results are available at https://slot-mpc.github.io.

AI.tldr: Slot-MPC是一种对象中心的预测性世界模型框架，通过基于槽位的视觉表示和可微分动态模型实现MPC规划，使智能体能够适应未见过的情境。相比采样方法，基于梯度的MPC更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有对象中心世界模型和强化学习方法学习的是固定推理时间的反应式策略，泛化能力有限。因此需要一种能够进行规划的对象中心世界建模框架。
AI.method: 使用视觉编码器学习基于槽位的对象级表示，并利用这些结构化表示学习动作条件化的对象中心动态模型。在推理时，通过基于梯度的MPC直接优化动作，比无梯度采样方法更高效。
AI.result: 在模拟机器人操作任务中，Slot-MPC相比非对象中心世界模型基线提升了任务性能和规划效率。在离线设置下，基于梯度的MPC优于无梯度采样方法。
AI.conclusion: Slot-MPC通过显式结构化的对象中心表示，为可控和可泛化的决策提供了强大的归纳偏置，在机器人操作任务中提升了任务性能和规划效率。代码公开于 https://slot-mpc.github.io。

title: Octopus: History-Free Gradient Orthogonalization for Continual Learning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Continual learning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aims to sequentially acquire knowledge while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, yet existing methods face inherent limitations: architecture-based approaches incur additional computational overhead and often generalize poorly to new tasks, rehearsal-based methods rely on storing historical data, raising privacy and storage concerns, and conventional regularization-based strategies alone are insufficient to fully prevent parameter interference. We propose Octopus, a two-stage continual learning framework based on History-Free Gradient Orthogonalization (HiFGO), which enforces gradient-level orthogonality without historical task data. Our proposed two-stage finetuning strategy decouples task adaptation from regularization, achieving a principled balance between plasticity and stability. Experiments on UCIT show that Octopus establishes state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior SOTA by 2.14% and 6.82% in terms of Avg and Last.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大语言模型的持续学习问题，提出Octopus框架，采用历史无关梯度正交化（HiFGO）技术在双阶段微调中实现梯度级别正交，无需存储历史数据即可有效缓解灾难性遗忘，在UCIT基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法存在局限：基于架构的方法计算开销大且泛化能力差；基于回放的方法需要存储历史数据，存在隐私和存储问题；传统正则化策略不足以完全防止参数干扰。
AI.method: 提出了基于历史无关梯度正交化（HiFGO）的双阶段微调策略，将任务适应与正则化解耦，在梯度层面强制正交性以平衡可塑性与稳定性，在UCIT数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.result: 在UCIT数据集上，Octopus实现了最先进的性能，在Avg和Last指标上分别超越先前最佳方法2.14%和6.82%。
AI.conclusion: 提出了基于历史无关梯度正交化（HiFGO）的双阶段持续学习框架Octopus，无需历史任务数据即可实现最先进的性能。

title: Not All Symbols Are Equal: Importance-Aware Constellation Design for Semantic Communication
comment: Submitted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026. 6 pages, 8 figures
summary: Semantic communication systems for goal-oriented transmission must protect task-relevant information not only through source compression but also via physical layer mapping. Existing approaches decouple constellation design and semantic encoding, exposing critical symbols to channel errors at the same rate as irrelevant ones. Contrary to this, in this paper, a joint semantic-physical layer framework is proposed, which is composed of a vector quantized-variational autoencoder that extracts discrete latent concepts, a semantic criticality indicator (SCI) that scores each concept by task relevance, and a deep reinforcement learning agent that dynamically selects the transmission subset based on instantaneous channel conditions. At the physical layer, a learned semantic-aware M -QAM constellation assigns symbol positions according to joint co-occurrence statistics and SCI scores, departing from the uniform spacing and Gray coding of standard M -QAM which minimizes average BER without regard for semantic content. We introduce a novel semantic symbol vulnerability (SSV) metric and a semantic protection probability (SPP) to quantify the exposure of task-critical symbols to decoding errors, and prove that any Gray-coded constellation is strictly suboptimal in SCI-Weighted SSV whenever the source exhibits non-uniform semantic importance and co-occurrence statistics. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed constellation achieves near 100% SPP across modulation orders from 4-QAM to 1024-QAM versus 50% for standard constellations at high spectral efficiency, a 21:1 compression ratio with semantic quality above 0.9, generalizing across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and FSDD without modification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合语义-物理层语义通信框架，通过VQ-VAE提取语义概念、SCI评估关键性、深度强化学习动态选择传输子集，并设计语义感知M-QAM星座优先保护高语义价值符号。理论证明格雷编码在语义重要性非均匀时次优，仿真显示SPP近100%且跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有语义通信系统将星座设计与语义编码解耦，导致任务关键符号与无关符号以相同速率传输，暴露于同等信道错误风险。这种均匀保护策略忽略了语义信息的不均衡重要性，无法有效利用物理层资源优先保护高语义价值的符号。
AI.method: 1. 采用向量量化变分自编码器(VQ-VAE)提取离散潜在概念；2. 设计语义关键性指标(SCI)根据任务相关性对每个概念打分；3. 引入深度强化学习智能体根据即时信道条件动态选择传输子集；4. 在物理层构建基于联合共现统计和SCI分数的语义感知M-QAM星座，打破标准M-QAM的均匀间隔和格雷编码范式；5. 提出语义符号脆弱性(SSV)度量。
AI.result: 1. 理论上证明：当源语义重要性非均匀分布时，任何格雷编码星座在SCI加权SSV意义上严格次优；2. 仿真验证：在4-QAM至1024-QAM调制阶数下，该星座达近100%语义保护概率(SPP)，而标准星座仅50%；3. 实现21:1压缩比，语义质量超0.9；4. 可跨MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、FSDD等不同数据集泛化。
AI.conclusion:
所提出的联合语义-物理层框架可推广至MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和FSDD等多个数据集，无需修改。该方法在4-QAM至1024-QAM调制阶数下均能保持近100%的语义保护概率，且在21:1压缩比下语义质量仍维持在0.9以上。

关键词：语义通信、联合语义-物理层设计、可学语义感知星座、M-QAM调制、语义符号脆弱性(SV)、语义保护概率(SPP)

title: Efficient Online Conformal Selection with Limited Feedback
summary: We address the problem of conformal selection, where an agent must select a minimal subset of options to ensure that at least one ``success'' is identified with a pre-specified target probability $φ$. While traditional online conformal prediction focuses on maintaining validity for the observed sequence, minimizing the resource cost (efficiency) of such selections, especially under limited feedback, remains a significant challenge. In this work, we consider settings with the most limited ``bandit'' feedback, and demonstrate that the simple Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) update rule, when applied to the appropriate control parameter or dual variable, is both adversarially valid, ensuring the success target is met on average for any input sequence (and hence under distribution shifts), and stochastically efficient, achieving sublinear efficiency regret for $i.i.d.$ inputs against an appropriate stochastic benchmark. We show such guarantees under canonical models capturing bandit and semi-bandit feedback to the agent via a unifying algorithmic technique, and analytic framework involving Lyapunov functions. Our approach handles more complex settings than prior work, while requiring significantly less feedback, and our results provide a new theoretical bridge between efficient online learning with limited feedback and distribution-free uncertainty quantification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限bandit反馈下的共形选择问题，证明简单的ACI更新规则在应用于控制参数时同时具备对抗有效性和随机效率性，建立了有限反馈在线学习与分布无关不确定性量化之间的理论联系。
AI.motivation: 传统在线共形预测虽然关注对观测序列保持有效性，但在有限反馈下最小化选择资源成本（效率）的挑战尚未充分解决。
AI.method: 采用自适应共形推断(ACI)更新规则应用于控制参数或对偶变量；利用Lyapunov函数和解析框架；在bandit和semi-bandit反馈模型下实现统一的技术和理论分析。
AI.result: 所提方法在对抗性环境下平均满足成功概率目标（可应对分布偏移），且对i.i.d.输入达到亚线性效率遗憾，优于适当的随机基准。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法比先前工作能处理更复杂的设置，且需要显著更少的反馈，建立了一个新的理论桥梁，连接有限反馈的高效在线学习与分布无关的不确定性量化。

title: InfoSFT: Learn More and Forget Less with Information-Aware Token Weighting
summary:
Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides the standard approach for teaching LLMs new behaviors from offline expert demonstrations. However, standard SFT uniformly fits all samples -- including those with low likelihood under the base model -- which can disproportionately drive training updates toward overfitting specific samples rather than learning the target behavior. Moreover, adapting to these unlikely samples induces substantial policy shifts that degrade prior capabilities. Existing methods mitigate this by filtering, regenerating, or down-weighting low-likelihood data. In doing so, they often suppress precisely the novel behaviors the base model has yet to learn.
  We propose InfoSFT, a principled weighting scheme for the SFT objective that concentrates learning signals on maximally informative, medium-confidence tokens -- those neither overly familiar to the base model nor too unlikely to cause instability. Requiring only a one-line modification to the standard token-wise loss, InfoSFT demonstrably improves generalization over vanilla SFT and likelihood-weighted baselines across math, code, and chain-of-thought tasks with diverse model families, while better preserving pre-existing capabilities.

AI.tldr: 针对SFT中低似然样本导致过拟合和性能退化的问题，提出InfoSFT加权方案，聚焦中等置信度令牌，仅需一行代码修改即可在多种任务和模型上提升泛化能力并保留原有能力。
AI.motivation: 标准SFT均匀拟合所有样本，包括基模型下低似然的样本，这会导致训练更新过度关注过拟合特定样本而非学习目标行为。此外，适应这些罕见样本会引起显著策略偏移，损害先前能力。现有方法通过过滤、重生成或降权低似然数据来缓解，但往往会压制基模型尚未学习的特定新行为。
AI.method: 提出InfoSFT，一种原则性的加权方案，通过聚焦于中等置信度的令牌（既不过于熟悉基模型，也不太可能引起不稳定性）来集中学习信号。该方法只需对标准令牌级损失进行一行修改即可实现。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和思维链任务上，相比vanilla SFT和似然加权基线方法，InfoSFT显著提升泛化性能，同时更好地保留预训练能力。
AI.conclusion: InfoSFT仅需一行代码修改即可实现，为SFT训练提供了一种可扩展且原则性的权重方案，在保持原有能力的同时显著提升泛化性能。

title: Distance-Matrix Wasserstein Statistics for Scalable Gromov--Wasserstein Learning
summary: Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) distances compare graphs, shapes, and point clouds through internal distances, without requiring a common coordinate system. This invariance is powerful, but discrete GW is a nonconvex quadratic optimal transport problem and is difficult to estimate at scale. We propose \emph{Distance-Matrix Wasserstein} (DMW), a hierarchy of Wasserstein statistics comparing laws of random finite distance matrices. Rather than optimizing a global point-level alignment, DMW samples $n$ points from each space, records their pairwise distances, and transports the resulting matrix laws. We prove that DMW is a relaxation and lower bound of GW, and establish a reverse approximation inequality: the GW--DMW gap is controlled by the Wasserstein error of approximating each original measure with $n$ samples. Hence population DMW converges to GW as sampled subspaces become dense. We further give finite-sample bounds, including intrinsic-dimensional rates that depend on the data manifold rather than the ambient matrix dimension $\binom n2$. For scalable computation, we introduce sliced and multi-scale DMW; for $p=1$, the sliced multi-scale dissimilarity yields positive-definite exponential kernels. Experiments on synthetic metric spaces, scalability benchmarks, graph classification, and two-sample testing validate the theory and demonstrate an interpretable GW-style proxy for structural comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文提出距离矩阵Wasserstein（DMW）：不再求解全局点级配准的非凸二次最优传输，而是从两个空间各采样 n 个点，记录其成对距离矩阵，把"距离矩阵的分布"作为比较对象，用Wasserstein距离度量两个矩阵律之间的差异。DMW被证明是离散Gromov–Wasserstein（GW）的松弛与下界，且存在反向逼近不等式：GW–DMW的差距可由各测度用 n 个样本逼近时的Wasserstein误差控制，因此当采样子空间变稠密时，DMW依概率收敛到GW。作者进一步给出有限样本界（含依赖数据流形本征维度的速率，而非环境矩阵维数 C(n,2)），并提出切片（sliced）与多尺度（multi-scale）DMW以实现可扩展计算；当 p=1 时，切片多尺度差异产生正定指数核。实验在合成度量空间、可扩展性基准、图分类与双样本检验上验证了理论与结果，表明DMW可作为结构比较中具有可解释性的GW式代理。
AI.motivation: Gromov–Wasserstein (GW) 距离通过比较空间内部（自身）距离结构来比较图、形状与点云，无需共同的坐标系，具有对刚性变换/坐标系统的不变性。然而离散GW是一个非凸二次最优传输（quadratic OT）问题，迭代求解代价高、在大规模数据上难以估计；并且GW的经典理论多围绕点级配准展开，难以得到依赖数据本征结构的统计速率。因此需要一个 (i) 保持"仅依赖内部距离"的性质，(ii) 凸性/可采样化从而可扩展，(iii) 具备一致性与有限样本理论保证的替代方案。
AI.method: 核心构造：定义 DMW 层级族。对两个度量空间 (X, d_X)、(Y, d_Y) 上的概率测度 μ、ν，采样 n 个 i.i.d. 点并计算 n×n 距离矩阵 D_X, D_Y（以随机矩阵为随机元素），由此诱导"随机有限距离矩阵"的分布 𝒟_n(μ)、𝒟_n(ν)，DMW_n(μ,ν) 取这两个矩阵律之间的 Wasserstein 距离（可配合 p 次幂/尾参数形成层级）。理论部分：(1) 松弛性与下界——证明 DMW_n ≤ GW（或相应幂次形式），即 DMW 是 GW 的松弛；(2) 反向逼近不等式——GW − DMW_n 可由 μ、ν 各自被 n 点经验测度逼近时的 Wasserstein 误差（与距离矩阵的稳定性）共同控制；(3) 一致性——当 n→∞、采样子空间在空间中变稠密时，DMW_n 收敛到 GW；(4) 有限样本界——给出基于经验分布的集中/一致估计，其速率依赖数据所在流形的本征维度 d_int，而非距离矩阵的环境维数 C(n,2)。可扩展计算：(a) 切片DMW（sliced DMW）——把距离矩阵（对称嵌入后的高维向量）沿随机投影方向分解为多个一维投影并排序/对齐后做 OT，以避免 n^2×n^2 的 OT 成本；(b) 多尺度DMW——在多个尺度/采样量 n 的层级上组合差异；定理指出当 p=1 时，切片多尺度不相似度诱导正定的指数核（exponential kernel），从而可直接用于核方法（核岭回归、图分类、检验等）。
AI.result: 理论与算法结论：DMW 是 GW 的松弛与下界，且存在反向界使得 GW–DMW 间隙随"用 n 点逼近原测度的 Wasserstein 误差"衰减；由此建立 DMW 依概率（甚至一致）收敛到 GW 的性质，并获得有限样本误差界，其收敛率由数据流形的本征维度决定，显著优于按 C(n,2) 维处理的朴素界。切片与多尺度变体大幅降低计算复杂度，且 p=1 时给出正定指数核，为核化下游任务提供理论支撑。实验方面：在合成度量空间上验证 DMW 与 GW 的一致性及收敛速率；在可扩展性基准上展示相对直接 GW 求解的速度/内存优势；在图分类任务上，基于 DMW 核的特征达到与（甚至优于）GW/基线核方法的表现；在双样本检验中，DMW 检验具有正确的功效与校准，验证了其作为 GW 式统计代理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DMW 把"结构比较"从非凸点级配准转化为对随机距离矩阵分布的 Wasserstein 统计问题，在保留 GW 仅依赖内部距离之不变性的同时，获得了凸性、可采样性、可扩展性与一致的统计理论：DMW 是 GW 的下界松弛，且 GW–DMW 差距可由采样逼近误差控制，故随采样稠密收敛到 GW；有限样本速率取决于数据本征维度。切片/多尺度 DMW（p=1 时为正定指数核）使其能在大规模图与点云上高效使用，并在图分类与双样本检验中表现出与 GW 相近且具可解释性的结构比较能力。局限与展望：DMW 依赖度量结构（需要可计算的距离），其一致性需采样子空间足够稠密；当数据离群、噪声或度量本身不稳定时，DMW 与 GW 的差距会放大；未来可研究更鲁棒的矩阵构造、度量学习版本以及与 GW 的混合方案。

title: Second-Order Actor-Critic Methods for Discounted MDPs via Policy Hessian Decomposition
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures including Appendix with Detailed proofs
summary: We address the discounted reward setting in reinforcement learning (RL). To mitigate the value approximation challenges in policy gradient methods, actor-critic approaches have been developed and are known to converge to stationary points under suitable assumptions. However, these methods rely on first-order updates. In contrast, second-order optimization provides principled curvature-aware updates that are proven to accelerate convergence, but its application in RL is limited by the computational complexity of Hessian estimation. In this work, we analyze second-order approximations for the actor update that leverage the full curvature information of the objective as much as possible. A stable approximation requires treating the action-value function as locally constant with respect to policy parameters, which does not generally hold in policy gradient methods. We show that this approximation becomes well-justified under a two-timescale actor-critic framework, where the critic evolves on a faster timescale and can be treated as quasi-stationary during actor updates. Building on this insight, we formulate a second-order actor-critic method for the discounted reward setting that leverages Hessian-vector product (HVP) computations, resulting in a computationally efficient and stable second-order update.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用Hessian-vector积计算的二阶演员-评论家方法，用于折扣奖励强化学习场景。核心创新在于采用双时间尺度框架，使批评器在演员更新期间可被视为准平稳，从而合理近似价值函数。
AI.motivation: 一阶策略梯度方法存在价值近似挑战，批评器对策略参数的局部常数假设不成立；二阶优化虽有收敛加速优势，但Hessian估计计算复杂度高，限制了其应用。
AI.method: 使用Hessian-vector积（HVP）计算二阶近似，并采用双时间尺度AC框架（批评器快速演进，演员更新时将其视为准平稳）。
AI.result: 在折扣奖励设置下实现了稳定且计算高效的二阶更新。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种计算高效且稳定的二阶AC方法，通过HVP计算和双时间尺度框架解决策略梯度中的价值近似问题。

title: DeepTokenEEG Enhancing Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimers Classification via Tokenized EEG Features
summary: The detection of Alzheimers disease (AD) is considered crucial, as timely intervention can improve patient outcomes. Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based diagnosis has been recognized as a non-invasive, accessible, and cost-effective approach for AD detection; however, it faces challenges related to data availability, accuracy of modern deep learning methods, and the time-consuming nature of expert-based interpretation. In this study, a novel lightweight and high-performance model, DeepTokenEEG, was designed for the diagnosis of AD and the classification of EEG signals from AD patients, individuals with other neurological conditions, and healthy subjects. Unlike traditional heavy-weight models, DeepTokenEEG ultilizes spatial and temporal tokenizer that effectively captures AD-related biomarkers in both temporal and frequency domain with only 0.29 million paramaters. Trained in a combined dataset of 274 subjects, including 180 AD cases, and 94 healthy controls, the proposed method achieves a maximum recorded accuracy of 100% on specific frequency bands, representing an improvement of 1.41-15.35% over state-of-the-art methods on the same dataset. These results indicate the potential of DeepTokenEEG for early detection and screening of AD, with promising applicability for deployment due to its compact size.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级深度学习模型DeepTokenEEG，用于基于EEG信号的阿尔茨海默病检测与分类。该模型采用时空tokenizer技术，仅用0.29M参数在274例样本上实现最高100%准确率，较现有方法提升1.41-15.35%，具备早期筛查和临床部署潜力。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）的早期检测至关重要，可改善患者预后。现有基于EEG的诊断方法面临数据可用性、深度学习准确性及专家解读耗时等挑战。
AI.method: 提出DeepTokenEEG模型，采用空间和时间tokenizer在时域和频域中捕获AD相关生物标志物，模型参数量仅0.29M，训练数据来自274名受试者（180例AD患者+94名健康对照）。
AI.result: 在特定频段上达到100%准确率，相比同类最先进方法提升1.41-15.35%，模型仅0.29M参数实现了高性能诊断。
AI.conclusion: DeepTokenEEG是一个轻量级、高性能的AD诊断模型，在特定频段上达到100%准确率，相比现有最佳方法提升1.41-15.35%，具有早期筛查和临床部署的应用潜力。
